title: KPI Green Energy signs 25-year PPA with SJVN for 300 MW wind project
summary: KPI Green Energy signed a power purchase agreement with state-owned SJVN for a 300 MW wind project connected to India's inter-state transmission system. Power will be sold at a fixed ₹3.64 per unit for 25 years.
details: The contract was won in SJVN's 600 MW wind auction (WIND-3). Supply is due to start within 24 months of the agreement. A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract to buy a project's electricity at an agreed price.
context: The company says the project supports its plan to own 10 GW of generating capacity by its 2032 financial year.

sources.title: KPI Green Energy Signs 300 MW Wind Power PPA With SJVN At ₹3.64 Per Unit For 25 Years

title: Neoen raises A$1.8 billion of debt for 1.2 GW Australian portfolio
summary: Neoen secured A$1.8 billion of debt from 13 lenders for five Australian assets totalling about 1.2 GW: two wind farms, two batteries and a solar farm.
details: The assets are Hornsdale Power Reserve (150 MW / 193.5 MWh) and Goyder South Stage 1A wind (209 MW) in South Australia, Culcairn Solar Farm (440 MWp) and Culcairn Battery (215 MW / 963 MWh) in New South Wales, and Narrogin wind farm (179 MW) in Western Australia. The portfolio mixes operating projects and projects under construction.
context: Neoen says it has raised more than A$5 billion of debt in Australia since 2024, covering 4.7 GW across 20 assets.

sources.title: Neoen Secures AUD 1.8 Billion Financing For 1.2 GW Renewable Energy Portfolio In Australia

title: Aboitiz Renewables to take 60% of 191 MW Bukidnon solar and storage project
summary: Aboitiz Renewables, part of AboitizPower, signed a joint development and investment agreement to acquire 60% of Manolo Fortich Power Corp., which is developing a 191 MW solar project with battery storage in Bukidnon, the Philippines, with A Brown Co.
details: Aboitiz Renewables will subscribe for common shares and redeemable preferred shares in the project company to reach its 60% stake. Completion depends on due diligence and other closing conditions.

sources.title: AboitizPower Acquires 60% Stake in 191 MW Solar and Battery Storage Project In the Philippines

title: Masdar and Endesa start €25.2 million battery additions at three Spanish solar plants
summary: Masdar and Endesa began building three batteries totalling 60.16 MW / 120.34 MWh at existing solar plants in Extremadura and Andalusia, the first storage projects in their partnership, with a combined investment of €25.2 million.
details: The batteries sit at the Ardila solar plants in Fregenal de la Sierra, Badajoz, and the La Vega I and II plants in Teba, Málaga. Adding batteries next to existing solar plants lets them store midday power and release it later. All three are expected to operate by the end of 2027.

sources.title: Masdar And Endesa Invest €25.2 Million In 60.16 MW Battery Storage Projects Across Spain

title: Return raises €835 million to build battery storage in Germany
summary: Energy flexibility company Return secured €835 million of portfolio financing, underwritten by Deutsche Bank and Rabobank, to expand its battery storage in Germany.
details: The money supports Return's Virtual Flexibility Portfolio, which pools many batteries so customers can buy flexible capacity as one product. The company plans to add at least 1 GW of batteries a year in Germany from 2027.
context: Return expects that pace to need €750 million to €1.2 billion of investment a year, depending on market conditions.

sources.title: Return Secures €835 Million Financing To Expand Battery Storage Capacity In Germany

title: Pentagreen Capital commits US$50 million to Candi Solar's 400 MWp India pipeline
summary: Pentagreen Capital and Candi Solar signed a US$50 million financing partnership for about 400 MWp of rooftop and on-site solar and battery projects serving small and mid-sized businesses in India.
details: Pentagreen manages the Green Investments Partnership under Singapore's FAST-P programme. Candi Solar builds solar and storage systems for commercial and industrial customers.
context: Candi Solar aims to more than double its capacity to over 1 GW within 24 months.

sources.title: Pentagreen Capital and Candi Solar Announce US$50 Million Financing Partnership for 400 MWp Solar and Battery Storage Projects in India

title: Essar Renewables signs PPA with NHPC for 300 MW firm renewable project
summary: Essar Renewables signed a power purchase agreement with NHPC for a 300 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE) project in Andhra Pradesh. Essar Power plans to invest about ₹4,500 crore.
details: The project combines solar, wind and batteries so it can deliver power to a set schedule rather than only when the sun shines or the wind blows. That is what 'firm and dispatchable' means.
context: Essar Power is building a portfolio of about 5 GW across renewable, thermal and gas generation.

sources.title: Essar to Invest INR 4,500 Crore In 300 MW FDRE Renewable Energy Project With NHPC

title: SWELECT invests ₹4.36 crore in 4.5 MWp group-captive solar project in Kerala
summary: SWELECT Energy Systems approved up to ₹4.36 crore of new equity in its subsidiary SWELECT Radiant Power to build a 4.5 MWp group-captive solar plant in Kerala.
details: In a group-captive project, the electricity users buy a stake in the plant and take its power. Shares will also go to these investors, cutting SWELECT's holding from 100% to 74%.

sources.title: SWELECT Energy Invests INR 4.36 Crore in 4.5 MWp Group Captive Solar Project In Keralam

title: PNE sells 250 MW Free State solar project to South African IPP

buyers.name: Unnamed South African independent power producer

summary: Germany's PNE sold a 250 MW solar project in South Africa's Free State province to a large South African independent power producer it did not name.
details: PNE South Africa will keep supporting development for the buyer until the project reaches financial close, the point when all funding is committed.
context: PNE said its South African pipeline held about 2,000 MW of solar projects in mid-2026.

sources.title: PNE Sells 250 MW Solar Project In South Africa’s Free State Province

title: Econergy buys four operating UK batteries totalling 106 MW
summary: Econergy acquired 100% of the holding company of four operating standalone battery projects in the UK, with 106 MW in total.
details: Each battery can currently run for one hour at full power. Econergy plans to extend them to three hours so they can shift more energy into high-price periods.
context: Econergy expects the portfolio to earn about £4.7 million of EBITDA in 2027 before the upgrade.

sources.title: Econergy acquires four UK BESS projects

title: Iberdrola and NBIM add 274 MW Tâmega wind farm to Iberian co-investment platform
summary: Iberdrola and Norges Bank Investment Management added the operating 274 MW Tâmega wind project in northern Portugal to their renewable co-investment alliance in Iberia.
details: The alliance now exceeds 1,800 MW. Earlier in 2026 it added 646 MW of solar at Caparacena and Ciudad Rodrigo in Spain.
context: The partners aim to reach 2,300 MW by 2027 and describe the alliance as backed by more than €2 billion of investment.

sources.title: Iberdrola and Norges Bank Investment Management expand wind power co-investment

title: Datta Infra's Adyant Alpha Power signs 110 MW wind PPA with SJVN
summary: Adyant Alpha Power, part of the Datta Infra Group, signed a power purchase agreement with SJVN for a 110 MW wind project in Davanagere, Karnataka.
details: The group says this takes its signed power contracts past 600 MW. It has commissioned 50 MW and has more than 300 MW of wind under construction.

sources.title: Adyant Alpha Power Signs 110 MW Wind PPA With SJVN, Taking Datta Infra Group Portfolio Beyond 600 MW

title: Crux arranges construction-to-term loan for EnerSmart's 40 MWh UC San Diego battery
summary: Crux arranged a senior secured construction-to-term loan for EnerSmart's 8 MW / 40 MWh battery on the University of California, San Diego campus.
details: A construction-to-term loan pays for building the project and then converts into long-term debt once it operates. The battery has a 10-year resource adequacy contract, which pays it to be available at times of peak demand, and connects to the campus microgrid.
context: Crux says the deal closed six weeks after the term sheet was signed.

sources.title: Crux Arranges Construction-to-Term Financing For 40 MWh Battery Storage Project At UC San Diego

title: Recurrent Energy sells two French batteries totalling 200 MW / 800 MWh to BW ESS
summary: Recurrent Energy, a Canadian Solar subsidiary, completed the sale of the Baixas and Coquainvilliers standalone battery projects in France to BW ESS. Each is 100 MW / 400 MWh.
details: Baixas is in the Pyrénées-Orientales and Coquainvilliers in Calvados. Both hold transmission-level grid connection positions.
context: The deal is BW ESS's entry into the French storage market.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Sells 200 MW/800 MWh BESS Portfolio In France To BW ESS

title: IFC and Proparco provide €30 million for Benin's 62 MWp IPP50 solar plants
summary: IFC and Proparco signed €30 million of financing for the IPP50 project, four solar plants totalling 62 MWp in Natitingou, Djougou, Parakou and Bohicon in Benin, sponsored by AXIAN and CDC Bénin.
details: IFC also mobilised money from the Clean Technology Fund, a climate fund that offers cheaper loans for clean technology in developing countries. Total project cost is estimated at €45 million.
context: The plants are expected to produce about 110 GWh a year and supply around 383,000 people.

sources.title: Benin Secures €30 Million Financing For 62 MW Solar Project Across Four Locations

title: ACME Solar signs 25-year PPA with NTPC for 400 MW firm renewable project
summary: ACME Solar's subsidiary ACME Marigold Urja signed a 25-year power purchase agreement with NTPC for a 400 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy project at ₹4.37 per unit.
details: The contract comes from NTPC's FDRE Tranche 01 auction. Supply is scheduled to begin on 30 June 2028.

sources.title: ACME Solar Signs 400 MW FDRE Power Purchase Agreement With NTPC At INR 4.37 Per Unit

title: Scatec secures US$217 million for 569 MW Dandara solar and storage project in Egypt
summary: Scatec signed US$217 million of non-recourse loans from the EBRD, the African Development Bank and the EIB for the first phase of Dandara, a 569 MW solar plant with a 100 MWh battery in Egypt, and began construction.
details: Non-recourse means lenders are repaid only from the project's own income. The loans cover about 80% of the US$271 million first-phase cost. Power goes to Egypt Aluminium under a long-term PPA. The AfDB's share is US$66 million, including US$20 million of concessional funds from the Climate Investment Funds. The National Bank of Egypt is taking 20% of the project.
context: After the bank's entry and an earlier EBRD deal, Scatec holds 56% of Dandara and plans to bring in more equity partners.

sources.title: Scatec Secures $217 Million Financing For 569 MW Solar And 100 MWh BESS Project In Egypt

title: OnPath Energy reaches financial close on Common Farm solar and battery site
summary: OnPath Energy reached financial close on Common Farm in South Yorkshire, a 49 MW solar park with a 50 MW two-hour battery, with project finance from NatWest.
details: The solar output is sold under a long-term, subsidy-free contract with an unnamed global technology company. A third party will run the battery's trading. Construction is due to finish by mid-2027.
context: It is OnPath's first project to combine solar and storage on one site.

sources.title: OnPath Energy completes financial close at its first co-located solar and BESS site

title: Qualitas Energy raises US$286 million for 259 MW Chilean portfolio
summary: Qualitas Energy secured a US$286 million non-recourse green financing for its whole Chilean portfolio under Fund V: 259 MW of generation and 840 MWh of batteries across eight assets.
details: The portfolio has 66 MW of operating run-of-river hydro, a 154 MWp solar project with 840 MWh of storage, and 39 MW of onshore wind. The solar, storage and wind are under construction for operation in 2028, backed by long-term PPAs.

sources.title: Qualitas Energy secures US$286 million financing for renewables portfolio in Chile

title: Blueleaf Energy signs two solar PPAs with Microsoft in Japan
summary: Blueleaf Energy, owned by Macquarie Asset Management, signed two long-term power purchase agreements with Microsoft for new solar projects in Japan, with Microsoft as the only buyer.
details: The projects are targeting commissioning in mid-2027. Macquarie's Energy Markets and Customer Solutions team coordinated the agreements.
context: Macquarie and Microsoft have worked together on renewable power contracts since 2020.

sources.title: Blueleaf Energy Signs Two Solar PPAs With Microsoft For Japan Projects Targeting Mid-2027 Commissioning

title: Delta Capacity reaches financial close on two 125 MW Finnish batteries
summary: Delta Capacity reached financial close on two standalone batteries in Finland, Karppio in Teuva and AKKU One in Lapinlahti, each 125 MW / 300 MWh.
details: Karppio is developed with the Strioga Family Foundation and AKKU One with COVENERGO, which is its majority owner. Financial close means all the money needed to build is committed, so construction can start. Société Générale provided the debt.
context: Together the two projects are among the largest batteries in Finland to enter construction.

sources.title: Delta Capacity reaches financial close on two standalone battery storage projects

title: Nadara buys 48 MW Bettyhill Phase 2 wind farm from Eden Renewables
summary: Nadara completed the purchase of the consented 48 MW Bettyhill Phase 2 wind farm in Sutherland, Scotland, from Eden Renewables.
details: The project will have up to 10 turbines. Construction is expected to start in early 2027, with operation in late 2028.

sources.title: Nadara completes acquisition of 48 MW wind farm in the UK

title: Return Energy closes €50 million financing for three batteries in Bizkaia, Spain
summary: Return Energy reached financial close on a €50 million portfolio of three standalone batteries in Güeñes, Barakaldo and Lezama in Bizkaia, Spain, with 55 MW / 220 MWh in total.
details: DNV reviewed the design, technology, contracts and technical risks for the lenders, a process called technical due diligence.
context: It is the largest standalone battery portfolio in Spain to reach financial close so far.

sources.title: DNV supports financial close for Spain’s largest standalone battery storage portfolio

title: PowerBank completes CA$25.4 million refinancing of 53 operating solar projects
target: Portfolio of 53 operating solar projects held in 14 project companies
summary: PowerBank Corporation has completed a CA$25.4 million refinancing covering 53 operating solar projects. The new loan from an unnamed major Canadian bank replaces about CA$29.6 million of existing debt, cutting project loan principal by roughly CA$4.2 million, or 14 percent.
details: The refinancing merges 50 separate credit agreements with three lenders into a single facility, and the debt stays at the level of the subsidiaries that own the projects rather than the parent company. PowerBank put in about CA$1.5 million at closing. About CA$5.9 million held in reserve and lockbox accounts (cash set aside under the old loans) is expected to be freed after closing, and about CA$543,000 came from ending interest rate swaps, which are contracts used to fix loan interest costs. After costs and contributions, the company expects net cash of about CA$5.0 million. PowerBank will also take over operations and maintenance for 49 of the projects from a third-party provider.
context: The company says the single facility should lower quarterly debt payments, bank fees and administrative costs, improving cash flow from its operating portfolio. It expects bringing maintenance in-house to reduce operating costs and give it more control over performance. PowerBank presents the deal as part of strengthening its balance sheet while it grows a development pipeline in Canada and the United States, though it notes the expected savings depend on several risks and assumptions.

sources.title: PowerBank Strengthens Balance Sheet and Solar Portfolio with 14% Reduction in Project Debt with Completion of CA$25.4M Refinancing

title: Masdar agrees to buy 550+ MW Greek solar project from Lightsource bp
summary: Masdar signed an agreement to acquire a solar project of more than 550 MW in Greece from Lightsource bp, with plans to add battery storage.
details: The project is expected to start operating by the end of 2026. The deal was announced during a visit to Greece by Abu Dhabi's Crown Prince.
context: It is Masdar's first acquisition in Greece.

sources.title: Masdar To Acquire 550+ MW Solar Project In Greece, Plans Battery Storage Integration

title: Future Biogas buys remaining 49% of six UK biogas plants from FGEN for £104 million
summary: Future Biogas, backed by 3i Infrastructure, bought the remaining 49% of six anaerobic digestion plants that feed biomethane into the UK gas grid from Foresight Environmental Infrastructure for £104 million.
details: Anaerobic digestion breaks down farm and food waste to make biogas. Future Biogas had bought its first 51% in August 2024 and now owns the portfolio outright.
context: Full ownership lets the company pursue planned expansions at the sites.

sources.title: Future Biogas acquires remaining stake in six anaerobic digestion facilities

title: BRUC and Alter Enersun close €222 million for Spanish solar and co-located batteries
summary: BRUC Alter Energías Renovables, a joint venture of BRUC and Alter Enersun, secured €222 million to refinance 208 MW of operating solar in Spain and build 118 MW / 472 MWh of batteries at four of the sites.
details: The projects are in Extremadura and Andalucía. Putting batteries next to existing solar plants lets them store daytime output and sell it later.

sources.title: WFW advises lenders on €222 million hybrid solar and battery storage financing

title: Akaysha Energy refinances 1,086 MW Australian battery portfolio with A$1.75 billion
summary: Akaysha Energy refinanced the debt on four utility-scale batteries totalling 1,086 MW in Australia with an A$1.75 billion non-recourse portfolio facility.
details: The deal replaces separate project loans with one portfolio-level loan. Deutsche Bank was the largest lender in the 10-year tranche.
context: Akaysha says the structure gives it a simpler, scalable base for adding more storage.

sources.title: Deutsche Bank supports Akaysha Energy with Australian battery storage portfolio refinancing

title: Citicore Renewable Energy secures ₱35 billion for 900 MWp of Batangas solar
summary: Citicore Renewable Energy Corporation secured ₱35.014 billion of syndicated project finance from three Philippine banks for five solar projects totalling 900 MWp in Batangas, with battery storage.
details: The projects are two 300 MWp plants and three 100 MWp plants. A syndicated loan is one loan shared by several banks.
context: It is the company's largest syndicated financing so far.

sources.title: CREC Secures ₱35 Billion Financing For 900 MW Solar And 120 MWh Battery Storage Projects In The Philippines

title: EBRD takes 40% of new Scatec renewables platform in Egypt
summary: Scatec and the EBRD signed a share purchase agreement to set up a renewables investment platform in Egypt, 60% owned by Scatec and 40% by the EBRD, which committed up to US$221 million.
details: About US$170 million is equity and the rest is project-level guarantees. The platform will hold Scatec's near-term Egyptian projects, including 40% of Obelisk and 51% of Shadwan.

sources.title: Scatec And EBRD Launch Renewable Energy Investment Platform In Egypt With USD 221 Million Commitment

title: Norfund's Climate Investment Fund and IFU buy 49% of Vena Energy's 500 MWp Philippine solar project
summary: The Climate Investment Fund, managed by Norfund, and Impact Fund Denmark bought 49% of the 500 MWp Ixus Bugallon solar project in Pangasinan, developed by Vena Energy.
details: The project sits next to Vena's 550 MWp Bugallon plant. It reached financial close in July 2026 with about US$310 million of senior loans from eight international lenders.
context: It is the Climate Investment Fund's first investment in the Philippines.

sources.title: Norfund And Impact Fund Denmark Invest In 500 MWp Solar Project In The Philippines

title: Petrovietnam and CIP agree to co-develop 1,000 MW Nam Trung Bo 1 offshore wind
summary: Petrovietnam and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners signed an agreement to jointly develop the 1,000 MW Nam Trung Bo 1 offshore wind project in south-central Vietnam.
details: The project is at an early stage. Feasibility studies, the power contract, risk sharing, financing and timing are still being worked out. The parties say it could need more than US$4 billion.
context: The deal was signed during a Vietnamese state visit to Denmark.

sources.title: Vietnam And Denmark’s CIP Plan $4 Billion Investment In 1,000 MW Offshore Wind Project

title: Enviromena buys 27.5 MWp Parkgate Farm solar project from Innova
summary: Enviromena acquired the consented 27.5 MWp Parkgate Farm solar project near Braintree, Essex, from Innova Renewables.
details: The project won a Contract for Difference in Allocation Round 6, a UK government contract that guarantees a fixed price for its power. It is expected to connect in summer 2028.
context: Enviromena expects to buy 233 MWp of solar and 75 MW of batteries from Innova by the end of 2026.

sources.title: Enviromena acquires Essex solar project from Innova

title: BW ESS lines up debt for 400 MW / 1,424 MWh Hams Hall battery
summary: BW ESS agreed debt financing for its 400 MW / 1,424 MWh Hams Hall battery in the West Midlands from OCBC, Rabobank and Société Générale in equal shares.
details: The loan is expected to close when the battery starts commercial operation. More than 30 lenders took part in the process.
context: Hams Hall is set to be Europe's largest operating battery by stored energy when it opens.

sources.title: BW ESS secures international financing for 400 MW/1424 MWh Hams Hall BESS

title: ENERTRAG reaches financial close on 39 MW / 117 MWh Les Sablons battery in France
summary: ENERTRAG reached financial close on Les Sablons, a 39 MW / 117 MWh battery in Vendeuil, Hauts-de-France.
details: It is one of the first three-hour batteries in France. Construction is under way with operation targeted for spring 2027.

sources.title: ENERTRAG’s Les Sablons BESS project reaches financial close

title: Infinity Power and HAU Energy secure up to US$566 million for 1.2 GWp Nefer Minya solar and battery project
summary: Infinity Power and HAU Energy secured a debt package of up to US$566 million for Nefer Minya in Egypt, which pairs 1.2 GWp of solar with a 600 MWh battery.
details: Up to US$265 million is arranged by the EBRD: a US$160 million loan from its own funds, a US$75 million B-loan from Bank of Jordan and up to US$30 million of concessional money from the Clean Technology Fund. A B-loan is lent by commercial banks under the development bank's umbrella. The battery stores daytime solar for use after sunset.
context: The sponsors say it will be the largest solar plant in Egypt and Africa.

sources.title: Infinity Power and HAU Energy announce investment for Nefer Minya solar project

title: Clean Power Alliance closes $1.4 billion green prepay bond with J.P. Morgan for wind energy supply
summary: Clean Power Alliance, a Southern California community choice energy provider, closed a $1.4 billion energy prepayment bond, its seventh such deal. The agency says the deal will save about $91.1 million on renewable power costs over the bonds' first seven years, with energy coming from 440.8 MW of wind contracts.
details: In a prepay deal, a public agency issues tax-exempt bonds and uses the money to pay a supplier upfront for years of power, receiving a discount in return, which CPA says has historically been 8 to 12 percent. J.P. Morgan acted as underwriter, meaning it arranged and sold the bonds, and J.P. Morgan Ventures Energy Corporation is the prepaid energy supplier. CPA will receive about 1.14 million megawatt-hours per year of PCC1 energy, California's top category of renewable power, during the initial seven-year period. The power comes from existing long-term power purchase agreements covering 440.8 MW of wind. The bonds were rated Aa3 by Moody's and given a green bond label by Kestrel.
context: CPA says this is the first electric prepay deal in the US completed with J.P. Morgan. The agency has now done $8.3 billion of prepay bonds with total initial-period savings of $519.1 million, and its board has authorized up to $4.5 billion of new prepay deals through June 30, 2027. CPA claims the savings are passed to customers through lower and steadier rates and funding for community programs.

sources.title: Clean Power Alliance Secures $1.4 Billion Prepay Bond, Locking in $91.1 Million in Renewable Energy Cost Savings

title: ACME Solar signs 25-year PPA with SECI for 300 MW assured peak power project
summary: ACME Solar's subsidiary ACME Greentech Twenty signed a 25-year power purchase agreement with SECI for a 300 MW assured peak power project at ₹6.00 per unit, under FDRE Tranche IX.
details: Assured peak power projects must deliver electricity during periods of high demand, which usually means pairing renewables with batteries. Supply is scheduled to start on 6 April 2028.

sources.title: ACME Solar Signs 300 MW FDRE PPA With SECI At INR 6.00 Per Unit

title: CleanChoice Energy secures up to US$85 million term loan from Aiga Capital Partners
summary: CleanChoice Energy secured a term loan facility of up to US$85 million from Aiga Capital Partners to build more solar projects in the United States.
details: The facility is a term loan of up to US$85 million from Aiga Capital Partners, an investor that finances companies building sustainable infrastructure in North America. CleanChoice will use it to build new solar projects in the US. It follows a US$166 million project financing the company raised earlier.
context: CleanChoice started as a retail supplier of clean electricity and is now building and owning its own solar plants. The company describes this as linking regional renewable generation directly with its retail customers.

sources.title: CleanChoice Energy Secures Up to $85 Million Financing from Aiga Capital Partners to Expand Solar Power Generation in the U.S.

title: Clearway adds 210 MW of batteries at Utah's Honeycomb Energy Center under PacifiCorp contracts
summary: Clearway Energy Group will add three batteries totalling 210 MW to its Honeycomb Energy Center in southern Utah, backed by long-term agreements with PacifiCorp and about US$400 million of investment.
details: Each battery sits next to an existing Clearway solar plant. The first four Honeycomb batteries began operating earlier in 2026, and Clearway's Utah storage will total seven systems with 2,120 MWh.

sources.title: Clearway Energy Expands Honeycomb Energy Center In Utah With 210 MW Battery Storage Addition Backed By $400 Million Investment

title: Fortis Green Renewables and Zeitinger Invest back GRIPS Energy
summary: Fortis Green Renewables and Zeitinger Invest made a growth equity investment in GRIPS Energy Group, which builds solar and battery systems for businesses in Sub-Saharan Africa.
details: The money will help GRIPS buy operating assets in Senegal, Botswana, Zambia and Uganda and build new distributed solar and solar-plus-storage projects.
context: GRIPS aims to own more than 100 MW of solar and storage by 2030.

sources.title: Fortis Green Renewables And Zeitinger Invest Back GRIPS Energy To Expand Solar And Battery Storage Projects Across Sub-Saharan Africa

title: FMO lends US$100 million to ReNew for Indian solar and hybrid projects
summary: Dutch development bank FMO provided a 10-year US$100 million corporate debt facility, in Indian rupees, to ReNew Solar Power, a subsidiary of ReNew Energy Global.
details: Lending in rupees removes currency risk for the borrower, whose income is in rupees. The money supports solar and hybrid projects across India.
context: It is FMO's largest investment in India's energy sector so far.

sources.title: FMO Invests USD 100 Million in ReNew to Expand India’s Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: GoodWe's Yude Solar and SEDAYUSolar form solar joint venture in Indonesia
summary: Yude Solar Technologies, part of the GoodWe Group, and Indonesian engineering firm SEDAYUSolar formed a joint venture to develop, finance, build and run solar projects in Indonesia.
details: It will cover rooftop solar for businesses, ground-mounted systems and utility-scale projects. Yude brings capital and technology and SEDAYUSolar brings local engineering.

sources.title: Yude Solar And Sedayusolar Form Joint Venture To Expand Renewable Energy Projects In Indonesia

title: Arevon signs three 20-year indexed REC contracts with Illinois utilities for 200 MW Panther solar project
summary: Arevon Energy has executed three 20-year indexed renewable energy credit contracts with Ameren Illinois, ComEd and MidAmerican for its Panther Energy solar project in Perry County, Illinois. The project is sized at 200 MWac (275 MWdc).
details: Renewable energy credits, or RECs, are certificates proving that a unit of clean power was generated, and utilities buy them to meet state clean energy targets. Under an indexed REC structure set by Illinois law, the credit price adjusts against market power prices, giving the project steadier long-term revenue. Panther was selected in the Illinois Power Agency's Summer 2026 indexed REC procurement, approved by the Illinois Commerce Commission, to deliver 421,131 RECs in its first year, split among the three utilities through separate contracts. Construction is expected to start in 2027 with completion in 2028.
context: Arevon says the long-term contracts provide revenue certainty that supports financing and moves the project closer to construction. The utilities will use the credits toward obligations under the Illinois Renewable Portfolio Standard. The procurement, run under the state's Climate and Equitable Jobs Act, approved 1.55 GW of new renewable capacity in total, including four utility-scale solar projects totaling 740 MWac.

sources.title: Arevon Secures Three 20-Year Renewable Energy Credit Contracts for its 200 Megawatt Panther Energy Project in Illinois

title: EIB adds €20 million loan for Burgenland Energie's wind and solar expansion
summary: The European Investment Bank lent a further €20 million to Burgenland Energie for wind and solar expansion in eastern Austria, on top of a €250 million loan in 2025.
details: The EIB has also supported €100 million of loans from Erste Bank and Landesbank Baden-Württemberg for the programme. Burgenland Energie plans up to 2,000 MW more capacity.
context: The utility aims to make Burgenland energy independent by 2030.

sources.title: EIB steps up financing for major Austrian wind and solar project

title: Elgin buys 40 MWp Kilderry solar farm in Ireland from BayWa r.e.
summary: Elgin acquired the 40 MWp Kilderry solar project in County Kilkenny, Ireland, from BayWa r.e.
details: Kilderry is a 40 MWp solar project in County Kilkenny, close to several of Elgin's own development sites. Elgin, an independent power producer that builds and runs utility-scale solar and storage, bought it from developer BayWa r.e.
context: The deal follows Elgin's purchase of the roughly 200 MW Blackhall solar farm in County Meath. Elgin says it combines selective acquisitions with its own pipeline to grow in Ireland, while BayWa r.e. continues to develop projects for sale in the Irish market.

sources.title: Elgin acquires Kilderry solar farm from BayWa r.e.

title: Southwest Iowa Renewable Energy acquires 70 million-gallon Ord, Nebraska ethanol plant from Pilot Travel Centers

advisors.name: McGrath North Mullin & Kratz PC LLO

summary: Farmer-owned ethanol producer Southwest Iowa Renewable Energy (SIRE) bought GreenAmerica Biofuels Ord LLC from Pilot Travel Centers. The acquired company runs an ethanol plant in Ord, Nebraska, with capacity of about 70 million gallons a year. The deal closed on October 9, 2026, and the price was not disclosed.
details: The Ord plant is an operating ethanol facility in central Nebraska's corn-growing region that also sells distillers grains, a livestock feed by-product, and corn oil. After the deal, SIRE will run two plants, in Council Bluffs, Iowa, and Ord, Nebraska, with combined capacity of about 230 million gallons of ethanol a year. SIRE says it will keep the plant's staff and continue buying grain locally. Law firm McGrath North Mullin & Kratz advised SIRE.
context: SIRE presents the purchase as part of its strategy to grow by buying established plants with dependable corn supply and market access. The company says the Ord site gives it a second region to source grain from and more scale in selling its products. For Pilot, a Berkshire Hathaway subsidiary, the sale removes an ethanol production asset from its portfolio.

sources.title: Southwest Iowa Renewable Energy, LLC to Acquire GreenAmerica Biofuels Ord LLC from Pilot Travel Centers

title: Actis buys two Polish batteries totalling 244 MW / 1,141 MWh from DRI

title: Virtus Solis signs 20-year space-based solar PPA with Brae Systems for up to 250 MW
summary: Virtus Solis Technologies has signed a 20-year power purchase agreement to supply space-based solar power to Brae Systems, which builds underwater GPU data centers. The deal covers 100 MW of round-the-clock power delivered through a receiving station in Illinois, with an option to grow to 250 MW.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a producer at set terms. Virtus Solis plans to collect solar energy with satellites and beam it to Earth using radio-frequency waves to a ground receiving station to be built in Illinois. The initial 100 MW is expected to deliver about 876,000 MWh per year, and Brae may expand to 250 MW, about 2.19 million MWh per year, within three years of initial commercial operation. The parties describe the lifetime contract value as multi-billion-dollar but give no exact figure. Virtus Solis plans its first public technical demonstration of wireless power transfer in March 2027.
context: The companies describe this as the first commercial PPA for space-based solar power, and Virtus Solis says it is the first of several offtake deals it expects in the coming months. The technology has not yet been demonstrated publicly at commercial scale, and Virtus Solis claims it can provide continuous power with 99.9% uptime. Brae says the supply will give its AI computing infrastructure predictable, zero-carbon power independent of grid constraints. Virtus Solis is also supported by a $2 million development agreement with ARPA-E for power electronics.

sources.title: Virtus Solis Signs Landmark 20-Year Space Solar PPA with Brae Systems to Deliver 250 MW of Orbital Baseload Clean Power

Masdar also signed an agreement with the Azerbaijan Green Energy Company to study expanding its 230 MW Garadagh plant by at least 350 MW with up to 200 MWh of batteries.

title: Georgia PSC approves 1,137 MW of solar PPAs for Georgia Power under CARES program
target: Seven solar projects totaling 1,137 MW in Georgia
summary: Georgia Power, a Southern Company utility, has won approval from the Georgia Public Service Commission for seven solar power purchase agreements totaling 1,137 MW. The contracts were procured through the CARES 2023 and CARES 2025 competitive solicitations, and the company says the 2023 round is its largest solar procurement to date.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a project at a set price. The seven approved projects are located in Appling (78 MW), Decatur (130 MW), Jefferson (194 MW), Sumter (200 MW), Warren (150 MW), Emanuel (185 MW) and Irwin (200 MW) counties in Georgia. They are expected to start commercial operation as early as 2029. The project developers and contract lengths were not named in the release.
context: The CARES program lets eligible customers subscribe to a proportional share of output from renewable projects to support their sustainability goals, and Georgia Power says demand for such subscriptions is rising. This approval follows 1,068 MW of CARES 2023 projects approved in September 2025. The company has also opened a new customer-identified resource program approved for up to 3,000 MW more of renewable projects.

summary: Indonesian distributed solar developer Hijau raised US$10 million in an early-stage round from Clime Capital's South East Asia Clean Energy Fund II.
details: Hijau, legally PT Investasi Hijau Selaras, was founded in 2017 and installs rooftop solar for commercial and industrial customers. Customers pay nothing upfront: they lease the systems and pay for the power, which lowers their bills. The US$10 million comes from Clime Capital's South East Asia Clean Energy Fund II.
context: Indonesia's solar market is small compared with its neighbours despite large industrial demand. Hijau plans to use the funds to expand its rooftop portfolio across the country.

title: CIP acquires 408 MW Gawara Baya wind and battery project in Queensland from Windlab
target: Gawara Baya hybrid wind and battery project
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners, through its fifth flagship fund, has bought the Gawara Baya hybrid project in North Queensland, Australia, from developer Windlab. The project pairs a 408 MW onshore wind farm with a 104 MW battery, and reached financial close with an AUD 1.7 billion bank facility.
details: Gawara Baya will have 68 wind turbines and a grid-forming battery, meaning a battery that can help set and stabilise grid voltage and frequency, located on Gugu Badhun Country south-west of Ingham. The fund took a final investment decision and reached financial close, the point when all funding is committed, with an AUD 1.7 billion facility from 10 banks, which are not named. Revenue is backed by long-term offtake agreements, contracts to sell the power, with Stanwell and SmartestEnergy, plus participation in the federal Capacity Investment Scheme. Construction now starts and full operation is expected in 2030. The battery's energy capacity in MWh and the purchase price were not disclosed.
context: CIP says the deal lets it put near-term capital from its fifth flagship fund to work and adds to its Australian portfolio. The company claims the project could power up to 240,000 homes, avoid 1.2 million tonnes of carbon a year, bring over AUD 200 million into regional Queensland and create up to 500 direct and indirect jobs.

sources.title: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquires onshore wind and battery project in Australia

title: Ballard completes acquisition of UK hydrogen power provider GeoPura
summary: Canadian fuel cell maker Ballard Power Systems has closed its purchase of GeoPura, a UK company that supplies hydrogen-based power units and green hydrogen. The upfront price is £275 million in cash and shares, with up to £27.5 million more tied to future performance.
details: GeoPura, founded in 2019 and based in Newcastle, builds and operates Hydrogen Power Units that use Ballard fuel cell modules to turn hydrogen into electricity for off-grid sites. It also makes green hydrogen by electrolysis, which means splitting water with electricity, and runs what it describes as the UK's largest compressed hydrogen delivery fleet. The upfront consideration combines £82.5 million in cash, about 49.6 million new Ballard shares and restricted share units to be settled in 12 months for roughly 1.1 million more shares. Former GeoPura shareholders now hold about 14.1% of Ballard, and contingent payments of up to £27.5 million depend on post-closing financial milestones. GeoPura's Andrew Cunningham becomes Ballard's President and joins its board alongside GeoPura chairman Lord Richard Harrington.
context: Ballard says the deal turns it into an integrated hydrogen provider offering Energy-as-a-Service, a model where customers pay for delivered power rather than buying equipment. The company claims the combination strengthens its position in Europe, opens opportunities in North America and supports its path to profitability.

sources.title: Ballard closes acquisition of GeoPura, becoming an integrated hydrogen energy solutions provider

details: Juniper Nirjara Energy, a Juniper Green Energy subsidiary, will sell power to SJVN for 25 years at ₹4.25 per unit. The project combines solar with batteries and must supply four hours of peak power with 90% monthly availability. Juniper won it in SJVN's FDRE-2 auction; the letter of award was issued in February 2025.
context: Firm and dispatchable tenders ask developers to deliver power when the grid needs it, not only when the sun shines. Meeting that obligation requires batteries alongside solar, which is why these contracts carry higher tariffs than plain solar.

title: Highway Holdings signs master agreement for 57%-owned energy storage joint venture with Wowtiger maker Huahu

The venture will hold exclusive rights to market and distribute Wowtiger battery energy storage systems in Germany, Italy, the United States and selected South American markets, and plans semi-knocked-down (SKD) manufacturing, meaning final assembly of products shipped as partly built kits. Huahu may receive up to 400,000 restricted Highway Holdings shares, half on formation and half when European milestones are met, with a two-year transfer restriction. The companies expect to formally set up the venture within 30 days, and Huahu's metal and plastic parts purchases are expected to shift to Highway Holdings' factories.
context: The deal follows a letter of intent announced on July 22, 2026 and marks Highway Holdings' move from contract parts manufacturing into energy storage products. The company says it reviewed more than 20 possible deals and expects the venture and the extra component orders to raise factory utilization and earnings. Huahu, which mainly sells to customers in Africa and Southeast Asia, aims to use its partner's European presence to reach more demanding markets.

title: Twain Financial Partners closes first securitized letter of credit facility, backing a MISO battery storage project

sellers.name: Unnamed global infrastructure developer and manager

target: Utility-scale battery energy storage project in MISO

advisors.name: Guggenheim Securities, LLC
advisors.role: sole structuring advisor and sole placement agent to Twain

advisors.name: White & Case LLP
advisors.role: counsel to Twain on the securitization

advisors.name: Sheppard, Mullin, Richter & Hampton LLP
advisors.role: counsel to Twain on the letter of credit transaction

summary: St. Louis specialty finance firm Twain Financial Partners closed its first securitized letter of credit facility, a platform for providing interconnection security to energy and data center developers. Its first transaction, closed on August 6, 2026, supports a utility-scale battery storage project being developed by an unnamed global infrastructure developer in the MISO grid region of the United States.
details: A letter of credit is a bank-style guarantee that a developer can post instead of cash to meet grid operator deposit requirements. The first deal covers the MISO ERAS M2 interconnection security posting, a required deposit that lets the battery project move to the next stage of MISO's grid connection study process. The project's size, the facility size and the deal value were not disclosed. Guggenheim Securities was sole structuring advisor and placement agent on the securitization, with White & Case as Twain's counsel, while Sheppard Mullin advised Twain on the letter of credit transaction.
context: Twain says rising interconnection deposit requirements and longer grid connection timelines are straining developers' capital, and that its facility lets them meet these requirements while keeping cash for other development needs. The firm, which reports about $6 billion in assets under management, positions the platform as a scalable source of letter of credit capacity for renewable, storage, thermal and digital infrastructure projects.

sources.title: Twain Financial Partners Closes Inaugural Securitized Letter of Credit Facility and Initial Transaction Supporting a Utility-Scale Battery Storage Project

title: Hilco markets Delta Biofuel's Louisiana bagasse pellet plant in foreclosure auction

sellers.role: administrative and collateral agent conducting the sale

sellers.name: Delta Biofuel, LLC
sellers.role: borrower whose assets are being sold

target: Delta Biofuel, LLC assets including biomass pellet facility in Jeanerette, Louisiana
summary: Hilco Global is brokering a public foreclosure auction of the assets of Delta Biofuel, a Louisiana company that built a plant to turn sugarcane bagasse into biomass pellets. The sale is run by CSC Delaware Trust Company on behalf of senior secured lender Bulldog Bioenergy, with bids due August 4, 2026 and the auction set for August 6, 2026.
details: The main asset is a pellet plant in Jeanerette, Louisiana, on a leased site next to the M.A. Patout sugar mill, with systems for receiving, washing, drying, milling, pelletizing, storing and loading bagasse, the fibrous leftover from sugar milling. The plant has been described as permitted for up to 340,000 short tons of pellets per year. The package covers equipment, fixtures, intellectual property, receivables, inventory, permits and records, but not the land. The sale is under Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code, the US legal framework that lets a secured lender sell pledged collateral after a default, and assets will be sold as is and free of the lender's lien. The lender may credit bid, meaning it can bid using the debt it is owed instead of cash, and the auction will be held at Seward & Kissel's New York offices with online bidding available.
context: The auction signals that Delta Biofuel's lender is moving to recover its loan by selling the pledged assets. Hilco claims the plant is a nearly turnkey facility that a strategic operator could put to use serving power generators and other buyers of renewable fuel. No buyer or price has been set, and the agent may cancel or change the process.

summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners reached financial close on the 392 MW Pestera II onshore wind farm in Constanța County, Romania.

sources.title: CIP reaches financial close on Pestera II onshore wind farm

title: ContourGlobal enters UK with 500 MW / 2,000 MWh Wallace battery
summary: ContourGlobal agreed, subject to conditions, to buy the 500 MW / 2,000 MWh Wallace battery project in Ayr, Scotland, from sellers including New Energy Partnership.
details: Wallace is a 500 MW / 2,000 MWh four-hour battery project in Ayr, Scotland. ContourGlobal agreed to buy it, subject to conditions, from several sellers including UK developer New Energy Partnership.
context: It is ContourGlobal's first UK investment and will be the largest battery in its portfolio by stored energy. The company recently commissioned a hybrid plant in Chile with a 200 MW / 1,300 MWh battery.

sources.title: ContourGlobal enters UK through 500 MW BESS acquisition

title: Innagreen buys consented 49.9 MW Longhedge solar farm from RES
summary: Innagreen Investments completed the purchase of the consented 49.9 MW Longhedge solar farm in Nottinghamshire from RES.
details: Innagreen Investments completed its purchase of the consented Longhedge solar farm in Nottinghamshire, about 49.9 MW, from developer RES. RES will continue to manage development and construction and provide technical services once it operates. The plan includes more than 2.5 km of new hedgerows and two permissive bridleways.
context: It marks Innagreen's entry into the UK renewables market. Keeping the original developer on for construction and operation is a common way for new owners to reduce delivery risk.

sources.title: Innagreen acquires Longhedge solar farm from RES

title: Ballard Power Systems agrees to acquire UK hydrogen power provider GeoPura
summary: Canadian fuel cell maker Ballard Power Systems has signed a definitive agreement to buy all of GeoPura, a UK company that leases and sells hydrogen power units and supplies hydrogen fuel. The upfront price is £275 million, paid partly in cash and partly in new Ballard shares, and the enterprise value including assumed net debt is about £301.1 million.
details: GeoPura, founded in 2019, runs three hydrogen production sites, including a 50% stake in HyMarnham Power, and holds a contract under the UK's first Hydrogen Allocation Round, a subsidy scheme that guarantees hydrogen production revenue for fifteen years. Ballard will pay £82.5 million in cash and issue about 50.8 million shares at US$5.02 each, leaving GeoPura shareholders with roughly 14.4% of Ballard, plus up to £27.5 million more if financial milestones are met after closing. RBC Capital Markets is financial adviser to Ballard, with Ashurst and Stikeman Elliott as legal counsel, while Barclays advises GeoPura with Winston Taylor as legal counsel. Closing is expected in the second half of 2026, subject to a UK National Security and Investment Act filing and TSX approval of the share issue.
context: Ballard already supplies the fuel cell engines used in GeoPura's hydrogen power units, and the deal moves it into selling energy as a service, meaning bundled supply of hydrogen, equipment and power rather than only components. Ballard says it expects about US$25 million in yearly EBITDA synergies and that the deal supports its goal of becoming profitable by 2028. GeoPura expects around £38 million in revenue for 2026.

sources.title: BALLARD ANNOUNCES ACQUISITION OF UK-BASED GEOPURA, POWERING FUTURE GROWTH AND TRANSFORMING BALLARD INTO AN INTEGRATED HYDROGEN ECOSYSTEM PROVIDER

sources.title: Titan Egypt Signs 25-Year PPA With SolarizEgypt For 11.45 MW Solar Plant At Cement Facility

summary: Rivington Energy sold a 50 MW battery development in Yarnton, Oxfordshire, to Wessex Gardens, a Schroders Greencoat fund for local government pension schemes.
details: The Yarnton battery in Oxfordshire will export 49.9 MW and import 40 MW, with a near-term grid connection and a life of up to 40 years. Construction on the 1.5-hectare site starts in 2027. It was developed by Renewable Connections, Rivington Energy's development arm, and bought by Wessex Gardens, a Schroders Greencoat fund for local government pension schemes.
context: Wessex Gardens invests pension money in local renewable infrastructure. The developer says planning consent followed extensive consultation with residents and Cherwell District Council.

sources.title: Rivington Energy sells Oxfordshire BESS

title: MSP Steel and Power signs 25-year solar PPA with Elevate Solar
summary: MSP Steel and Power signed a 25-year PPA with Elevate Solar for solar power for its steel operations.
details: Elevate Solar will supply MSP Steel and Power with power from its solar project for 25 years. The size and location of the project were not disclosed.
context: Steelmaking uses a lot of electricity, and long-term solar contracts give producers more predictable costs and lower emissions. The article notes a broader move by Indian steelmakers toward direct renewable purchases.

sources.title: Indian Steel Maker MSP Steel and Power Limited Signs 25-Year Solar Power Purchase Agreement with Elevate Solar for Long-Term Clean Energy Supply

title: AfDB approves US$100 million package for EBID to boost West African renewables

sellers.name: ECOWAS Bank for Investment and Development

summary: The African Development Bank approved a US$100 million, two-part financing package for the ECOWAS Bank for Investment and Development to expand clean energy lending in West Africa.
details: The African Development Bank approved US$100 million for the ECOWAS Bank for Investment and Development on 17 June 2026. It has two parts: a US$30 million equity investment, which makes the AfDB the first development finance institution to own part of EBID and gives it a board seat, and a second component to expand EBID's clean energy lending.
context: Strengthening a regional bank's capital lets it lend several times the amount to projects across West Africa. The AfDB presents it as a way to speed up clean energy investment in the region.

sources.title: African Development Bank Group Approves US$100 Million Financing Package For EBID To Boost Renewable Energy In West Africa

title: Zenobe reaches financial close on 200 MW / 800 MWh Coalburn battery
summary: Zenobe reached financial close on its 200 MW / 800 MWh battery at Coalburn, South Lanarkshire.
details: Coalburn in South Lanarkshire is a 200 MW / 800 MWh battery connected to the transmission network. Preparatory works have begun, full construction starts in July and operation is expected in 2028. It was financed without subsidy.
context: Zenobe says it is the first four-hour battery connected to the GB transmission network to reach financial close. Four hours of storage lets it shift solar and wind output across the evening peak, a step up from the one-hour batteries common a few years ago.

sources.title: Zenobe achieves financial close on UK BESS

title: RP Global closes €174 million Eiffel facility for 123.9 MW Wałcz wind farm
summary: RP Global closed a €174 million unitranche facility from Eiffel Investment Group to build the 123.9 MW Wałcz wind farm in Poland.
details: A unitranche facility combines senior and junior debt into one loan. The project will sell power on the market for now, and RP Global may refinance once it signs a PPA.

sources.title: RP Global secures financing for Walcz wind farm

title: EBRD, EU and EIB back €61.3 million for 100 MW Sidi Bouzid solar plant in Tunisia
summary: The EBRD, the EU and the EIB provided €61.3 million for a 100 MW solar plant in Sidi Bouzid, Tunisia, developed by the Scatec–Aeolus joint venture through Scatec Khobna PV Power.
details: The €61.3 million package includes an EBRD loan, alongside EU and EIB support, for a 100 MW solar plant in the Sidi Bouzid region. It is developed by the Scatec–Aeolus joint venture through Scatec Khobna PV Power and is expected to generate about 252 GWh a year.
context: Tunisia relies heavily on natural gas for power. The lenders present the plant as improving energy security and diversifying supply.

sources.title: EBRD Supports Tunisia’s Renewable Energy Goals With €61.3 Million Financing For 100 MW Solar Project

title: Hexa Climate signs PPA with NHPC for 160 MW round-the-clock renewable project
summary: Hexa Climate signed a PPA with NHPC for a 160 MW firm and dispatchable renewable project that will supply power 24 hours a day.
details: The 160 MW contract with NHPC combines an 80 MW base allocation with 80 MW taken up under the green-shoe option, which lets the buyer increase the volume. The project must deliver firm power around the clock with an annual capacity utilisation factor of 65%.
context: A 65% utilisation factor is very high for renewables and needs a large combination of solar, wind and storage. The company presents it as reducing India's reliance on coal for round-the-clock supply.

sources.title: Hexa Climate Signs 160 MW FDRE Power Purchase Agreement With NHPC For Round-The-Clock Clean Energy Supply

title: Novva agrees to buy 120 MWp solar project in the Philippines
summary: AI infrastructure company Novva agreed to acquire a 120 MWp solar project in the Philippines to secure clean power for data operations.
details: Novva, an AI infrastructure company, agreed to acquire a 120 MWp solar project in the Philippines. The seller, location and price were not disclosed.
context: Novva says owning generation will secure clean power for its data operations and reduce exposure to volatile electricity prices, part of a wider move by data centre operators to own energy assets directly.

sources.title: Novva to Acquire 120 MWp Solar Project in the Philippines

title: A.P. Moller Capital's EMIF II to buy Mainstream Renewable Power South Africa
summary: A.P. Moller Capital agreed, through its Emerging Markets Infrastructure Fund II, to acquire 100% of Mainstream Renewable Power's South African business.

sources.title: A.P. Moller Capital Expands Renewable Energy Push with South Africa Acquisition Deal

sources.title: Scatec Reaches Financial Close for 120 MW Sidi Bouzid II Solar Project in Tunisia

title: UrbanChain signs 15-year PPA for AMPYR's UK solar portfolio
summary: UrbanChain signed a 15-year PPA with AMPYR for output from a UK solar portfolio, which it will sell to business customers through its peer-to-peer trading platform.
details: UrbanChain will buy the output of a portfolio of AMPYR solar farms in the UK for 15 years and resell it directly to commercial and industrial customers through its peer-to-peer trading platform, which matches generation to customer demand.
context: Businesses get traceable renewable power at a price fixed for the long term, and AMPYR gets predictable revenue that supports financing. UrbanChain presents its marketplace as a way to make renewable procurement more efficient.

sources.title: UrbanChain Signs 15-Year Solar PPA for AMPYR’s UK Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: Powertrac signs PPAs with PGVCL for 480 MW of distributed solar in Gujarat
summary: Powertrac Group signed PPAs with Paschim Gujarat Vij Company for 480 MW of distributed solar projects under Gujarat's DREBP programme.
details: Powertrac Group signed PPAs with Paschim Gujarat Vij Company for 480 MW of distributed solar under Gujarat's Distributed Renewable Energy Bilateral Purchase programme. Power will be sold at ₹2.76 per kWh from plants using domestically made, DCR-compliant modules. Investment is about ₹2,155 crore.
context: Distributed plants connect to local substations, close to where power is used, which cuts losses on the network. The domestic-content rule supports India's solar manufacturing industry.

sources.title: Powertrac Group Secures PPAs for 480 MW Distributed Solar Portfolio in Gujarat, Advancing Grid Decarbonization

title: FEI and Norfund provide US$90 million to CREI for renewable telecom power in Africa

sources.title: CREI Secures US$90 Million Financing to Expand Renewable Telecom Energy Infrastructure Across Africa

context: It is Anza Power's first offtake deal in New Zealand.

sources.title: ANZA Power secures PPA for 42-MW New Zealand solar project

title: Ingka Investments buys its first two solar parks in Spain
summary: Ingka Investments, the investment arm of IKEA's largest retailer, acquired two solar parks in Spain, including the operating La Oliva farm in Toledo and a project in Murcia.
details: Ingka Investments bought two solar parks: La Oliva in Toledo, already operating and producing about 51 GWh a year, and a site in Murcia that will add about 55 GWh a year, 106 GWh in total.
context: These are Ingka's first solar parks in Spain, one of its priority markets. The IKEA retailer has invested or committed €4.3 billion to renewable energy worldwide and recently added batteries at other Iberian sites.

sources.title: Ingka Group acquires first solar parks in Spain

title: Chrysalis Renewables buys Atlas V and VI solar projects from Hanwha
summary: Chrysalis Renewables, set up by Morrison, acquired the Atlas V and Atlas VI solar projects in the US from Hanwha Renewables.
details: Atlas V and Atlas VI are two US solar projects with about 357 MWdc combined. Chrysalis Renewables, a platform set up by infrastructure manager Morrison, bought them from Hanwha Renewables.
context: It is the first deal under a partnership announced in February 2026, under which Chrysalis buys construction-ready and operating projects from Hanwha, which keeps providing engineering, modules and operations.

sources.title: Chrysalis Renewables acquires two US solar projects through Hanwha partnership

title: Gresham House and Amegni reach financial close on 45 MW Carno 3 wind farm

sources.title: Gresham House and Amegni Renewables reach financial close on Carno 3 wind farm

The sale happens in phases, starting with a 10% voting stake. Financial terms were not disclosed.

sources.title: ACEN to Divest Up to 49% Stake in 250 MW Solar Project in Rajasthan

title: ECO STOR secures financing for 300 MW / 718 MWh Förderstedt battery
summary: ECO STOR secured financing from Banco Santander and NORD/LB for the 300 MW / 718 MWh Förderstedt battery in Germany, due to operate fully in 2027.
details: Banco Santander and NORD/LB financed ECO STOR's 300 MW / 718 MWh battery in Förderstedt, which will operate fully in 2027. A long-term flexibility tolling agreement with Next Kraftwerke supports the financing.
context: It is the largest battery financed in Germany so far, about three times ECO STOR's Bollingstedt battery. Under a tolling agreement, a trader pays a fixed fee to use the battery, which gives lenders predictable income.

sources.title: ECO STOR, Banco Santander, and NORD/LB secure financing for German BESS

summary: Radiance Renewables signed a PPA to supply green power to Softgel Healthcare, which expects to avoid about 130,000 tonnes of CO2.
details: Radiance Renewables will supply green power to Softgel Healthcare under a long-term PPA. The capacity and term were not disclosed; the company expects the deal to avoid about 130,000 tonnes of CO2 over its life.
context: Radiance also says the supply will save more than 314,000 cubic metres of water compared with conventional generation. Indian manufacturers are signing such contracts to cut costs and meet customer emissions targets.

sources.title: Radiance Renewables Signs Green Power PPA with Softgel Healthcare, Aiming to Avoid 130,000 Tonnes of CO₂ Emissions

sources.title: Masdar to Acquire 49.99% Stake in Repsol’s 705 MW Renewable Energy Portfolio in Spain

title: Cypress Creek Energy closes $3.5 billion financing for first two phases of Steel River solar and storage project in Arkansas

buyers.name: Barclays
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, joint bookrunner and green loan agent

buyers.name: BNP Paribas
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, joint bookrunner and hedge coordinator

buyers.name: Santander
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, joint bookrunner and administrative agent

buyers.name: Wells Fargo
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, joint bookrunner, hedge coordinator and green loan agent

target: Steel River Energy Center Phases 1 and 2

advisors.name: Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP
advisors.role: Legal counsel to Cypress Creek Energy

summary: Cypress Creek Energy has reached financial close on $3.5 billion of financing for Phases 1 and 2 of the Steel River Energy Center in Arkansas. The two phases will add 1.63 GW of solar and 1.9 GWh of battery storage.
details: Financial close means the loan agreements are signed and money can flow to start building. The financing was fully underwritten by Barclays, BNP Paribas, Santander and Wells Fargo as coordinating lead arrangers, and Cypress Creek also closed tax equity financing with an unnamed major investor, a structure where an investor provides capital in exchange for the project's tax credits. Power from both phases is sold under a virtual power purchase agreement, a financial contract that fixes the price of electricity, with an unnamed investment-grade corporate buyer. The full three-phase project is expected to reach 2.45 GW of solar and 2.9 GWh of storage by 2029, using First Solar panels and US-made structural steel.
context: The company describes Steel River as one of the largest solar and storage developments in the United States and says the lending process was highly competitive. Cypress Creek expects the project to generate nearly $300 million in tax revenue over its life and about 700 construction jobs. The deal reflects lender appetite for large projects aimed at rising US electricity demand, according to the company.

context: The loan supports PPC's growth beyond Greece into neighbouring markets. The lenders say it will strengthen energy security and reduce reliance on fossil fuels in south-eastern Europe.

sources.title: EBRD Provides €175 Million Loan To PPC For 400 MW Of New Renewable Energy Projects Across Bulgaria, Greece And Romania

sources.title: EBRD Provides Up To $12.1 Million Loan To Kawar Energy To Support Renewable Energy Expansion In Jordan

title: esVolta upsizes Nomura-led corporate credit facility to $450 million for US battery storage

buyers.name: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (Green Credit Fund I & Fund II)

summary: US battery storage developer esVolta has closed an extended and enlarged corporate credit facility of up to $450 million, led by Nomura. The deal replaces and grows a $200 million facility first arranged in March 2024.
details: A corporate credit facility is a loan line available to the company as a whole rather than tied to a single project. esVolta says it will mainly use the money for project development, buying equipment that takes a long time to deliver, and costs incurred before construction begins. Its portfolio is about 30 storage projects totaling roughly 25 GWh, of which about 2.0 GWh is operating or under construction, across the CAISO, ERCOT and WECC power markets, with expansion planned into SPP and MISO. Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners is the largest lender, joined by Allianz Global Investors, Celtic Bank, HSBC Asset Management, Fiera Infrastructure Private Debt and Truist Bank. Orrick advised esVolta and Norton Rose Fulbright advised the lenders.
context: The larger facility more than doubles the company-level debt available to esVolta, a Generate Capital portfolio company, as it grows its pipeline into new US regions. esVolta claims the financing reflects lender confidence in its strategy, and Nomura points to the growing role of battery storage in the US grid as demand for electricity rises.

sources.title: esVolta Secures Upsized Corporate Credit Facility to Support Expansion of Energy Storage Portfolio

title: Pace Group's TRANSGREENX signs PPA with BESCOM for 250 MW solar and 1,100 MWh storage

context: The battery lets the plant store daytime solar and supply it in the evening, making its output dispatchable. Karnataka is using such auctions to add flexible clean power.

sources.title: Pace Digitek Arm Signs PPA with BESCOM for 250 MW Solar and 1,100 MWh Battery Storage Project

sources.title: Aura Power secures solar project financing

title: INOX Solar Americas agrees to buy Boviet Solar's North Carolina module and cell manufacturing assets for about $750 million
target: Assets of Boviet Solar Technology LLC (Greenville, North Carolina solar module and cell manufacturing)
summary: INOX Solar Americas, a US company backed by India's INOX Clean Energy, has agreed to buy all of the assets of Boviet Solar Technology LLC in a deal valued at about $750 million. The assets include a 3 GW per year solar module factory in Greenville, North Carolina, and a binding agreement covering 3 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacity.
details: The module plant started commercial production in 2025 and makes N-type solar panels with roughly 3 GW of yearly output. The cell manufacturing capacity, also N-type technology, is expected to be commissioned by December 2026. The figures describe factory output, not power plant capacity. Closing is expected in May 2026, subject to usual conditions and regulatory approvals. Boviet says its brand, products, customer contracts, delivery schedules and warranties will stay unchanged.
context: Boviet presents the sale as a way to align with US rules on Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC), which restrict involvement of certain foreign-linked companies in projects seeking federal incentives, and says this should improve financing eligibility for customers. The release claims the deal ranks among the largest purchases of US assets by an Indian group. For INOX Clean, which targets 11 GW of integrated solar manufacturing by FY28, the deal expands its US manufacturing footprint.

sources.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Boviet Solar USA/
