target: 112.89 kW rooftop solar system at Monument Consulting office, Richmond, Virginia
summary: Talent and consulting firm Insight Global has signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Atlanta-based Cherry Street Energy for a rooftop solar system in Richmond, Virginia. The 112.89 kW array has been running since early spring 2026.
details: The system uses 210 panels on the Summit Avenue office building of Monument Consulting, an Insight Global subsidiary, and is expected to produce about 156,647 kWh of electricity each year. Cherry Street Energy financed and installed the array and sells its output to Insight Global under a 20-year power purchase agreement, which is a long-term contract to buy electricity at agreed terms. The building is owned by Monument Consulting's founder, which allowed the rooftop installation despite Insight Global mostly leasing its offices.
context: Insight Global describes the project as its first direct clean energy initiative within its climate strategy. The deal is a small distributed solar arrangement, and Cherry Street Energy says it adds the company to a customer network that includes schools, manufacturers and a major airport.

sources.title: Insight Global Invests in Renewable Energy Through New Solar Partnership

title: British Solar Renewables buys 56 MWp Berden solar farm in Essex
summary: British Solar Renewables acquired the consented, ready-to-build 56 MWp Berden solar farm near Bishop's Stortford, Essex.
details: Berden is a consented, ready-to-build 56 MWp solar farm on about 177 acres near Bishop's Stortford, Essex, expected to produce nearly 60 GWh a year with farming continuing on site. It holds a 20-year Contract for Difference from Allocation Round 7, and its grid connection is due in 2027.
context: A Contract for Difference fixes the price the plant receives, which secures revenue for financing. British Solar Renewables says the project is a near-term addition to its UK portfolio.

sources.title: British Solar Renewables Acquires 56 MWp Berden Solar Farm in Essex to Expand UK Clean Energy Portfolio

title: AmBank provides RM102.4 million for Constant Energy's 29.99 MWac LSS5 solar project
summary: AmBank Group provided RM102.4 million to Gajahsuria Power, led by Constant Energy, for a 29.99 MWac LSS5 solar project in Kampung Gajah, Perak.
details: AmBank Group provided RM102.4 million to Gajahsuria Power, the project company for a 29.99 MWac solar plant in Kampung Gajah, Perak, under Malaysia's fifth large-scale solar round (LSS5). Gajahsuria was set up in January 2025 and is jointly owned by Sun Energy Ventures, Constant Energy Malaysia Holding and BayWa r.e. Energy Solutions. The facilities cover construction, commissioning and working capital.
context: The project was awarded by Malaysia's Energy Commission in December 2024. LSS rounds give winners long-term contracts with the national utility, which makes them bankable for local lenders.

sources.title: AmBank Group Approves RM102.40 Million Financing For 29.99 MWac LSS5 Solar Project In Kampung Gajah, Perak Led By Constant Energy

title: Ortigas Land signs long-term solar supply deal with AUSI for GH Mall
summary: Ortigas Land signed a long-term solar supply agreement with Advent Upgrade Solar, an Aboitiz Power joint venture, for GH Mall in San Juan City.
details: Advent Upgrade Solar, a joint venture of Aboitiz Power Distributed Renewables and Upgrade Energy Philippines, will install and run a 1,587 kWp rooftop solar system at GH Mall in San Juan City and sell its power to Ortigas Land for 20 years.
context: The mall owner pays only for power used and avoids upfront costs, while the joint venture owns and operates the system.

sources.title: Ortigas Land Partners With AUSI, A Joint Venture Of Aboitiz Power, For Long-Term Solar Energy Supply To GH Mall

title: TotalEnergies and MK Land reach financial close on 30 MWac solar plant in Kedah
summary: TotalEnergies and MK Land reached financial close on a 30 MWac (about 50 MWp) solar plant in Kulim, Kedah, Malaysia.
details: It was awarded in 2023 under Malaysia's Corporate Green Power Programme to TotalEnergies (49%) and MK Land's Solar Citra (51%).

sources.title: TotalEnergies and MK Land close financing for 30 MW solar project in Malaysia

title: Mubadala invests US$325 million in Hornsea 3 offshore wind
summary: Mubadala invested US$325 million in Ørsted's Hornsea 3 offshore wind farm alongside an Apollo-led consortium that includes USS and La Caisse.
details: Apollo funds bought 50% of the joint venture owning Hornsea 3, and Ørsted keeps the other 50%.
context: Hornsea 3 will be the world's largest single offshore wind farm.

sources.title: Mubadala invests in Hornsea 3 offshore wind farm alongside consortium

title: Sonaura signs private-wire PPA with Bentley Motors for 7 MW solar at Crewe
summary: Sonaura signed a PPA to build and run a 7 MW solar project supplying Bentley Motors' Crewe headquarters by private wire, subject to planning.
details: A private wire is a direct cable from the plant to the user, bypassing the public grid.

sources.title: Sonaura Signs Power Purchase Agreement With Bentley Motors To Supply Renewable Energy To Crewe Manufacturing Site

title: Dutch Lady Milk Industries signs 15-year rooftop solar PPA with Pekat
summary: Dutch Lady Milk Industries signed a 15-year PPA with Pekat Solar, which will install, own and run a rooftop solar system at its DLMI@Enstek plant in Malaysia, covering about 24% of the plant's power use.
details: Pekat Solar, a Pekat Group subsidiary, will design, install, own and run rooftop solar on several buildings at Dutch Lady Milk Industries' DLMI@Enstek plant, including the distribution centre, offices and car park, and sell the power to DLMI for 15 years. It should cover about 24% of the plant's electricity use.
context: DLMI gets renewable power without capital spending and with more predictable costs.

sources.title: Dutch Lady Milk Industries Berhad Signs 15-Year Solar PPA with Pekat Group Berhad to Offset 24% of Manufacturing Facility Power Consumption

title: Tata Communications takes 26% of CleanMax solar-wind SPV
summary: Tata Communications signed a share purchase agreement for 26% of Clean Max Yuhdul, a new CleanMax project company generating solar and wind power for its captive use.
details: Tata Communications signed a share purchase agreement for 26% of Clean Max Yuhdul, a newly formed CleanMax project company that will build solar and wind plants for captive supply.
context: Tata Communications is moving from buying power from third parties to owning part of its supply, to power its digital and network infrastructure with renewables. The 26% stake qualifies it as a captive user under Indian rules.

sources.title: Tata Communications Takes 26% Stake in CleanMax SPV for Solar-Wind Net-Zero Strategy

title: Yindjibarndi Energy Corporation reaches financial close on Jinbi solar project
summary: The Yindjibarndi Energy Corporation reached financial close on the Jinbi solar project in Western Australia's Pilbara, one of Australia's largest Indigenous-led renewable developments.
details: The Jinbi solar project in the Pilbara is being developed by the Yindjibarndi Energy Corporation, a partnership of the Yindjibarndi Aboriginal Corporation and ACEN, on Yindjibarndi Country. Financial close confirms all funding, contracts and approvals, with a 30-year PPA in place.
context: It is one of Australia's largest Indigenous-led renewable projects, with the traditional owners taking a leading role and sharing in its benefits.

sources.title: Yindjibarndi Energy Corporation Reaches Financial Close For Jinbi Solar Project In Australia

title: ACWA Power signs US$226 million for 300 MW Bash II wind farm in Uzbekistan
summary: ACWA Power signed US$226 million of senior debt with the Asian Development Bank, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and Standard Chartered for the 300 MW Bash II wind farm in Uzbekistan's Bukhara region.
details: ACWA Power signed US$226 million of senior debt with the Asian Development Bank, the AIIB and Standard Chartered for the 300 MW Bash II wind farm in Gijduvan District, Bukhara region. The debt covers more than two-thirds of the project cost. It was signed at the ADB's 2026 annual meeting.
context: Bash II extends the neighbouring Bash I wind farm and forms part of a renewable cluster in the region. Uzbekistan is using foreign-built wind and solar to diversify its power mix.

sources.title: ACWA Power Secures USD 226 Million International Financing to Accelerate Uzbekistan’s Renewable Energy and Energy Transition Goals

title: Elements Green buys 300 MW Newarthill battery project from Geocore
summary: Elements Green acquired the transmission-connected 300 MW Newarthill battery project near Motherwell, Scotland, from Geocore.
details: It has consent for two-hour storage, with potential to extend to four.

sources.title: Elements Green acquires 300 MW Newarthill BESS project

title: National Bank of Egypt takes 20% of Scatec's 1.1 GW Obelisk solar and storage project
summary: Scatec signed a shareholder agreement under which the National Bank of Egypt takes a 20% economic interest in Obelisk, a 1.1 GW solar and 100 MW / 200 MWh battery project in Egypt.
details: Under the shareholder agreement, the National Bank of Egypt takes a 20% economic interest in Scatec's Obelisk project, which pairs 1.1 GW of solar with a 100 MW / 200 MWh battery.
context: Scatec says bringing in Egypt's largest bank strengthens local support for the project while letting Scatec keep control and optimise its capital.

sources.title: Scatec ASA Partners With National Bank Of Egypt For Equity Stake In Egypt’s 1.1GW Obelisk Solar And Storage Project

title: World Bank signs US$515 million for 1,125 MW Dorjilung hydropower in Bhutan
summary: Bhutan and the World Bank signed US$515 million of financing agreements for the 1,125 MW Dorjilung hydropower project.
details: It will be the country's largest hydro project developed as a public-private partnership.
context: The project will supply about a third of Bhutan's electricity.

sources.title: Government of Bhutan and World Bank sign financing agreements for the Dorjilung hydroelectric power project

title: PNE sells 25.2 MW Bokel wind farm to Union Investment fund
summary: PNE sold the 25.2 MW Bokel wind farm in Lower Saxony, operating since April 2025, to a fund managed by Union Investment.
details: Bokel's seven turbines, 25.2 MW in total, stand on farmland in Sprakensehl, Lower Saxony, and have run since April 2025. PNE sold the wind farm to a fund managed by Union Investment; PNE's subsidiary energy consult continues to operate it.
context: PNE says the sale strengthens its finances and gives it room to keep building, a typical develop-and-sell model.

sources.title: PNE sells Bokel wind farm to investment fund managed by Union Investment

title: TotalEnergies and Nextnorth reach financial close on 440 MWp Isabela solar project
summary: TotalEnergies and Nextnorth reached financial close and began building a 440 MWp solar plant in Ilagan City, Isabela, the largest internationally financed solar project in the Philippines.
details: More than half of the output is contracted long term. Full operation is expected by the end of 2027.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises lenders on landmark Philippine solar project financing

title: IFC and Norfund invest US$83.2 million in Nigerian solar mini-grids
summary: IFC and Norfund announced US$83.2 million to expand solar mini-grids in Nigeria, targeting about 500,000 new connections.
details: The IFC and Norfund are investing US$83.2 million to build solar-hybrid mini-grids in Nigeria, aiming for about 500,000 new connections for households and small businesses in rural and peri-urban areas.
context: Many Nigerian communities have no grid power and rely on diesel generators. Mini-grids with solar and batteries can supply cheaper, cleaner power around the clock.

sources.title: IFC And Norfund Invest $83.2 Million To Expand Solar Mini-Grids In Nigeria, Targeting 500,000 New Connections

title: Alternus Clean Energy to buy 80 MWp US solar portfolio for US$60 million
summary: Alternus Clean Energy signed definitive agreements to buy 33 operating solar projects in eight US states, more than 80 MWp in total, from a US investment fund for about US$60 million.
details: Alternus Clean Energy agreed to buy 33 operating solar projects in eight US states, more than 80 MWp in total, from a US investment fund for about US$60 million. They sell power to 16 buyers under contracts with more than 12 years left on average; about a fifth of the buyers are rated AA or AAA.
context: Long contracts with strong buyers give predictable cash flow, and spreading the projects across states reduces regional risk.

sources.title: Alternus Clean Energy To Acquire 80+ MW U.S. Solar Portfolio In $60 Million Deal

title: TotalEnergies ENEOS signs 15-year solar PPA with Jintana Intertrade in Thailand
summary: TotalEnergies ENEOS signed a 15-year PPA with garment maker Jintana Intertrade for a 1.2 MWp solar system at its Thai factory.
details: TotalEnergies ENEOS will finance, design, install and maintain a 1.2 MWp solar system at Jintana Intertrade's garment factory and sell it the power for 15 years. It should produce about 1,650 MWh a year.
context: The manufacturer cuts its power bill and emissions without investing upfront or running the system itself.

sources.title: TotalEnergies ENEOS Signs 15-Year Solar PPA With Jintana Intertrade In Thailand

title: CIP completes €1.44 billion purchase of Ørsted's European onshore business, renamed Perigus Energy
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners completed its purchase of Ørsted's European onshore business through its fifth flagship fund and relaunched it as Perigus Energy.
details: The deal, signed in February 2026, valued the business at €1.44 billion (DKK 10.7 billion).

sources.title: CIP completes acquisition of Ørsted’s European onshore platform and launches Perigus Energy

title: Monarch Private Capital and Generate Capital close 104 MW community solar tax credit investment
summary: Monarch Private Capital and Generate Capital closed an investment in a 104 MW portfolio of more than 15 community solar projects, expected to generate about US$200 million of investment tax credits.
details: Monarch Private Capital and Generate Capital closed an investment in more than 15 US community solar projects, 104 MW in total, due online in the second and third quarters of 2026. The portfolio is expected to generate about US$200 million of investment tax credits.
context: Investment tax credits cut the cost of US solar; specialist investors like Monarch buy them to monetise the subsidy. Community solar lets households subscribe to a local plant without rooftop panels.

sources.title: Monarch Private Capital and Generate Capital Close 104 MW Community Solar Investment Portfolio Supporting Over 15 Projects

title: BayernLB finances RP Global's 49.5 MWp Harbke solar park
summary: BayernLB provided project financing for RP Global's 49.5 MWp solar park on a former lignite mine in Harbke, Saxony-Anhalt.
details: The full capacity is supported under Germany's EEG.
context: It is RP Global's first project in Germany.

sources.title: WFW advises BayernLB on solar project construction financing

title: J.K. Cement takes 26% of Oriana Power SPV for 70 MW captive solar
summary: J.K. Cement subscribed for 26% of Truere Guj SPV, set up by Oriana Power, to secure 70 MW of captive solar power in Rajasthan.
details: J.K. Cement subscribed for 32,76,000 shares of Truere Guj SPV, a company set up by Oriana Power in January 2024, for about ₹4.22 crore in cash, giving it 26%. The project company will supply 70 MW of captive solar power to J.K. Cement's plants.
context: Holding 26% lets J.K. Cement count as a captive user and buy the power with lower surcharges. The company says the aim is cleaner and more reliable supply for its manufacturing.

sources.title: J.K. Cement Secures 70 MW Solar Power Through 26% Stake In Renewable SPV In Rajasthan

title: Vikran Engineering buys 49% of NOPL Solar Projects for ₹4.9 crore
summary: Vikran Engineering acquired 49% of NOPL Solar Projects for ₹4.9 crore to move into solar power generation.
details: Vikran Engineering paid ₹4.9 crore for 49% of NOPL Solar Projects, which develops solar plants under the national PM-KUSUM scheme for decentralised power in rural areas.
context: Vikran, an engineering and construction contractor, is moving into owning solar assets. PM-KUSUM supports small solar plants near farm feeders and solar pumps.

sources.title: Vikran Engineering Strengthens Clean Energy Play with 49% Stake Acquisition in NOPL Solar Projects

title: Commerzbank finances Blue Elephant's 268 MWp Schafhöfen solar park in Bavaria
summary: Commerzbank is the sole lender for construction of Blue Elephant Energy's 268 MWp Schafhöfen solar park in Regensburg district, Bavaria.
details: Commerzbank is sole lender for the 268 MWp Schafhöfen solar park, built by Blue Elephant Energy on about 200 hectares in Mötzing, Regensburg district. It should produce about 300 GWh a year, enough for about 100,000 households.
context: It will be the second-largest solar park in Germany and the largest ever built in Bavaria. Part of Blue Elephant's German output is sold to Deutsche Bahn under long-term PPAs.

sources.title: Blue Elephant Energy GmbH Secures Financing From Commerzbank For 268 MWp Solar Park In Bavaria

title: Eurazeo makes further investment in Sonaura
summary: Existing investor Eurazeo made a further investment in Sonaura, a private-wire renewable platform with a pipeline above 3 GWp.
details: Existing investor Eurazeo made a further investment in Sonaura, which builds off-site renewable plants connected to customers by private wire, a direct cable that bypasses the public grid. Its pipeline now exceeds 3 GWp.
context: Sonaura has recently signed PPAs with buyers in car-making, cold storage and consumer goods. Private-wire supply avoids some grid charges, which makes the power cheaper for the buyer.

sources.title: Sonaura Secures Additional Investment from Eurazeo to Accelerate Renewable Energy Expansion

title: SunVest Solar closes US$67 million for community solar
summary: SunVest Solar closed US$67 million: a US$47 million sale of investment tax credits for a 26 MW community solar portfolio and a US$20 million equipment loan from Live Oak Bank.
details: US rules let projects sell their tax credits to other companies for cash.

sources.title: SunVest Solar Secures $67 Million Financing to Expand Community Solar Portfolio and Pipeline

title: Evren secures about US$600 million for 1 GW firm renewable project
summary: Evren, Brookfield's Indian platform with Axis Energy, secured about US$600 million for a roughly 1 GW firm and dispatchable hybrid project across Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan.
details: Evren, Brookfield's Indian platform run with Axis Energy, secured about US$600 million from SMBC, Standard Chartered, MUFG, DBS, Crédit Agricole CIB and BNP Paribas. It funds a roughly 1 GW firm and dispatchable project combining solar, wind and batteries across Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan, backed by a long-term PPA with NTPC.
context: It is among the first large financings of a fully integrated firm-power project in India. Lenders' willingness to fund the battery component shows growing confidence in storage-backed contracts.

sources.title: Evren Secures $600 Million Financing for 1 GW FDRE Hybrid Project Across Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan

title: TotalEnergies ENEOS signs 15-year PPA with Jintana for 650 kWp rooftop solar
summary: TotalEnergies ENEOS signed a 15-year PPA with Jintana Intertrade for a 650 kWp rooftop solar system at its factory in Nakhon Ratchasima, covering about 55% of the site's power use.
details: TotalEnergies ENEOS will finance, build, run and maintain a 650 kWp rooftop system of about 1,000 panels at Jintana Intertrade's factory in Nakhon Ratchasima. It should produce more than 1,000 MWh a year, about 55% of the site's power use, cutting more than 480 tonnes of CO2 a year. Jintana buys the power for 15 years.
context: This is a second, separate rooftop agreement with the same garment maker, after a 1.2 MWp system announced in May 2026.

sources.title: TotalEnergies ENEOS Signs 15-Year Solar PPA with Jintana for 650 kWp Rooftop Project in Thailand

title: KfW lends €100 million to NLC India for solar and battery projects
summary: NLC India signed a €100 million loan with KfW to develop solar and battery storage projects in India.
details: NLC India signed a €100 million loan with Germany's development bank KfW to build solar and battery projects in India.
context: KfW offers long-term capital at competitive rates. NLC India, historically a lignite miner and coal power producer, is building up a clean energy portfolio.

sources.title: NLC India Signs €100 Million Loan Agreement with KfW to Develop Solar and BESS Projects

title: KDDI signs third virtual PPA with J-POWER for new onshore wind farm
summary: KDDI signed a virtual PPA with J-POWER and J-Wind for a new 8.4 MW onshore wind farm, its third such deal with the group.
details: KDDI signed a virtual PPA with J-POWER and its subsidiary J-Wind for the new 8.4 MW Iwaki Futago wind farm. It is the third such deal between them, after the New Minami Osumi wind farm in December 2024 and Kaminokuni No. 3 in March 2025.
context: A virtual PPA lets a company buy the environmental value of renewable power without taking the electricity itself. KDDI expects the three deals to cover about 16% of the CO2 from its base stations.

sources.title: KDDI signs third virtual PPA with J-POWER Group for new wind farm

title: Lydian Energy buys 1.5 GW Atlas North solar and storage portfolio from Hanwha
summary: Lydian Energy, backed by Excelsior Energy Capital, acquired Hanwha Renewables' roughly 1.5 GW Atlas North portfolio of four late-stage solar and battery projects.
details: Atlas North is four late-stage projects with more than 1,000 MW of solar and 450 MW / 1,800 MWh of batteries. A 500 kV line of up to two miles links them to California's grid via the Cielo Azul switchyard and the Ten West Link. Lydian Energy, backed by Excelsior Energy Capital, bought them from Hanwha Renewables.
context: It is one of the largest solar-plus-storage projects in North America. Most of its power and capacity is already contracted, which reduces risk for the buyer.

sources.title: Lydian Energy acquires Atlas North portfolio from Hanwha Renewables

title: Tenaska signs 20-year storage agreement with TVA for 225 MW Bobwhite battery project in Tennessee
summary: Bobwhite Energy Storage, an affiliate of Tenaska, has signed a 20-year energy storage agreement with the Tennessee Valley Authority. The deal covers a 225 MW / 900 MWh standalone battery project in Hawkins County, East Tennessee.
details: The battery project is in advanced development, meaning permitting and planning are well along but construction has not begun. Its 900 MWh of energy at 225 MW implies it can discharge at full power for about four hours. Construction is expected to begin in 2027, with operation targeted for late 2029. Under the long-term agreement, TVA will use the battery's capacity to support its grid. Total investment is estimated at about $300 million, with up to 75 jobs at peak construction.
context: TVA says the agreement brings its contracted standalone battery storage to 425 MW across its seven-state territory, and it presents batteries as a tool for managing peak demand and grid reliability. Tenaska says the project reflects its ability to site projects where the grid needs them, and it reports about 7,000 MW of battery storage in its development pipeline.

sources.title: Tenaska, TVA Sign on Battery Project Bringing Energy Security, Jobs and $300 Million Investment to East Tennessee

title: EBRD lends €70 million to Renalfa IPP for Hungarian solar and battery project
summary: The EBRD is lending €70 million to project companies owned by Renalfa IPP for a large solar and battery project in Hungary, part of a €210 million package with commercial banks.
details: The EBRD is lending €70 million to Renalfa IPP project companies as part of a €210 million package with commercial banks. It funds 450 MW of solar with co-located batteries of 250 MW / 1 GWh in north-eastern Hungary.
context: It is one of the first utility-scale hybrid solar and storage projects in Central and Eastern Europe to be project-financed. The bank presents it as strengthening Hungary's energy security.

sources.title: EBRD Boosts Hungary’s Energy Security With €70 Million Loan For Major Solar And Battery Project

title: J.K. Cement invests ₹2.1 crore in 7 MW captive solar SPV
summary: J.K. Cement took a minority stake in Mehrauni Electro Power, a project company supplying 7 MW of solar power to its plants, investing ₹2.1 crore.
details: J.K. Cement subscribed for 21,00,000 shares of Mehrauni Electro Power, a Delhi company set up in 2023 by Onward Solar Power, for ₹2.1 crore, a 9.77% stake. The project company will supply 7 MW of solar power to its plants.
context: It is a smaller, separate investment from the 26% stake J.K. Cement took in an Oriana Power project the same month. Both secure renewable supply for its factories.

sources.title: J.K. Cement Invests ₹2.1 Crore In Solar SPV MEPPL For 7 MW Green Power Supply

title: Welspun New Energy signs SECI PPA for 200 MW solar with 400 MWh battery
summary: Welspun New Energy signed a PPA with SECI for a 200 MW solar project with a 400 MWh battery, its first storage-backed project.
details: Welspun New Energy signed a PPA with SECI for a 200 MW solar plant with a 400 MWh battery, at a tariff of about ₹2.86 per kWh.
context: It is Welspun's first storage-backed project. The article notes that the price gap between plain solar and solar with storage is narrowing in SECI's auctions.

sources.title: Welspun New Energy Signs SECI PPA for 200 MW Solar Project with 400 MWh BESS, Marking Shift Toward Dispatchable Renewable Power

title: Chugoku Electric and TODA join 54 MW Masuda-Hikimi wind project
summary: Chugoku Electric Power and TODA bought shares in Asia Wind Power, joining Mitsui O.S.K. Lines and Hokutaku in the 54 MW Masuda-Hikimi wind project.
details: It will have 13 turbines of 4.2 MW, with operation targeted for January 2030.

sources.title: Chugoku Electric Power and TODA acquire stake in Masuda-Hikimi wind project

title: Mulilo reaches financial close on 380 MWdc Beaufort West solar project
summary: Mulilo reached financial close on the 380 MWdc (250 MWac export) Beaufort West solar project in the Western Cape, one of South Africa's largest.
details: Beaufort West is a 380 MWdc solar plant near Beaufort West in the Western Cape with 250 MWac of contracted export capacity, connecting to the Droërivier transmission substation.
context: It is one of South Africa's largest solar plants and Mulilo's fourth financial close of 2026, after Orkney solar and the Middlepunt solar and Mercury battery projects. Mulilo says it has passed its target of 1 GW a year.

sources.title: Mulilo achieves financial close on 380 MW solar project in South Africa

title: Alight agrees to buy 79 MWp solar and 55 MW battery project in Denmark from GreenGo
summary: Alight agreed to buy a 79 MWp solar park with a 55 MW co-located battery in Kalundborg, Denmark, from GreenGo Energy. The two will keep developing it together.
details: The Kalundborg project on Sjælland combines a 79 MWp solar park on 90 hectares with a co-located 55 MW battery and should produce about 95 GWh a year. Alight is buying it from GreenGo Energy, and the two will keep developing it together.
context: Alight says Kalundborg had the strongest returns of 7 GW of Danish projects it assessed, thanks to good sun, land and grid conditions. The battery lets the plant shift midday output to higher-priced hours.

sources.title: Alight acquires large scale solar and storage project in Denmark

title: Navigator Energy Debt Finance provides development loan for Harmony Energy's 3 GW German batteries
summary: Navigator Energy Debt Finance, managed by Triple Point, provided a three-year development loan to Harmony Energy for 3 GW of late-stage battery projects in Germany.
details: Navigator Energy Debt Finance, a partnership managed by Triple Point, is providing Harmony Energy with a three-year development loan for 3 GW of late-stage battery projects in Germany, with both transmission and distribution connections. Watson Farley & Williams advised the lender.
context: Development loans fund grid applications, permits and design before construction finance is available. It is Triple Point's first exposure to Germany.

sources.title: WFW advises NEDF on development financing for Harmony Energy German BESS

title: Levanta refinances 93 MWp Daisy solar portfolio in Thailand
summary: Levanta Renewables signed project finance agreements with Kasikornbank and SMBC to refinance the debt on its 93 MWp operating Daisy Solar Portfolio in Thailand.
details: Levanta Renewables signed project finance agreements with Kasikornbank and SMBC to refinance the debt on its 93 MWp Daisy Solar Portfolio, which it bought earlier in 2026.
context: Refinancing after an acquisition lets an owner replace short-term acquisition debt with cheaper long-term loans. It is Levanta's third long-term financing in Thailand.

sources.title: Levanta Secures Financing for 93 MWp Daisy Solar Portfolio in Thailand

title: Orrön Energy sells 91 MW German agrivoltaic project to Gülermak
summary: Orrön Energy sold a 91 MW agrivoltaic project in eastern Germany, with a battery option, to Gülermak Renewables for up to €5.6 million.
details: Orrön will keep developing it until it is ready to build, expected by 2027.

sources.title: WFW advises Orrön Energy on sale of 91 MW German agrivoltaic project

title: PPC to buy 66.6 MW Greek wind and solar portfolio from Copelouzos and Samaras
summary: PPC Group agreed to buy a 66.6 MW operating portfolio from the Copelouzos and Samaras groups: 43.3 MW of wind in South Evia and Lakonia and 23.3 MW of solar.
details: PPC Group is buying a 66.6 MW operating portfolio from the Copelouzos and Samaras groups: two new wind parks in South Evia and Lakonia with 43.3 MW, and 23.3 MW of solar parks, at an enterprise value of €111 million, 7.2 times EBITDA. It is also buying a 1.7 GW development pipeline for €106 million, to be developed jointly. Norton Rose Fulbright advised the sellers.
context: The deal adds operating assets and a large pipeline to Greece's biggest utility. Pricing at 7.2 times EBITDA gives a reference point for Greek renewable valuations.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises Copelouzos Group and Samaras Group on sale of renewable projects to PPC Group

title: ContourGlobal secures €43.8 million from Eurobank to refinance 36.7 MW Greek solar
summary: ContourGlobal secured €43.8 million from Eurobank to refinance 26 operating solar plants in Greece totalling 36.7 MW.
details: Eurobank provided €43.8 million to refinance 26 operating solar plants in Greece, 36.7 MW in total, held in seven project companies. The plants started operating between 2011 and 2022 and were bought by ContourGlobal in December 2025.
context: It is ContourGlobal's first financing in Greece. The plants earn regulated feed-in tariffs and premiums, which gives lenders stable cash flows.

sources.title: ContourGlobal secures €43.8 million refinancing for Greek solar PV portfolio

title: Hulic and Clean Energy Connect form joint venture for 70 MW off-site solar PPAs
summary: Hulic and Clean Energy Connect formed a joint venture to build about 800 small non-FIT solar plants, 70 MW in total, supplying corporate buyers under off-site PPAs.
details: Hulic and Clean Energy Connect formed a joint venture to build and run about 800 small solar plants outside Japan's feed-in tariff scheme, 70 MW in total, commissioned in phases from July 2026 to March 2029. They should produce about 73 GWh a year, supplied to Hulic Group buildings through Hulic Energy Solution under off-site PPAs.
context: Hulic expects the plants to meet nearly 20% of its electricity demand, toward its goal of running all its buildings on renewable power.

sources.title: Hulic, Clean Energy Connect Drive RE100 Progress with 70 MW Solar PPA Partnership in Japan

title: CleanPeak Energy buys Sustainable Energy Infrastructure and its small solar and battery portfolio
summary: CleanPeak Energy acquired Sustainable Energy Infrastructure, which builds small solar and battery projects under 5 MW in Australia, including 71 MWac of solar across 16 sites.
details: CleanPeak Energy bought all of Sustainable Energy Infrastructure, which builds solar and battery projects under 5 MW. The portfolio includes 71 MWac of solar across 16 sites and 42 MW of batteries across 11 sites in New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia.
context: CleanPeak wants to grow in projects that feed the grid directly rather than sit behind a customer's meter. Sub-5 MW projects can connect to local networks faster than large plants.

sources.title: CleanPeak Energy Acquires SEI To Expand Solar And Battery Portfolio Across Australia

title: Piraeus Bank and Optima bank finance Luxcara's 83 MWp Kozani solar parks
summary: Piraeus Bank and Optima bank financed four solar parks totalling 83 MWp in Kozani, Greece, developed by a project company majority-owned by Luxcara.
details: Piraeus Bank and Optima bank are financing four solar parks with 83 MWp in Kozani, built by a project company majority-owned by Luxcara. The investment is in the mid-tens of millions of euros and includes money from Greece's Recovery and Resilience Facility. Piraeus also acts as coordinator and agent. Norton Rose Fulbright advised the banks.
context: Money from Greece's EU-funded Recovery and Resilience Facility sits alongside the bank loans, which lowers the project's financing cost.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises Piraeus Bank and Optima bank on PV financing

title: Matrix Renewables closes ITC funding and term debt conversion for 281 MWdc Stillhouse Solar in Texas

buyers.name: MUFG
buyers.role: term lender and letter of credit provider

buyers.name: HSBC
buyers.role: term lender and letter of credit provider

buyers.name: ING Capital LLC
buyers.role: term lender and letter of credit provider

summary: Matrix Renewables said its 281 MWdc / 210 MWac Stillhouse Solar project in Bell County, Texas has started commercial operations. At the same time it received investment tax credit funding and converted its construction loan into long-term term debt. The company puts the total project investment at over $380 million.
details: The project sells power under 15-year power purchase agreements, which are long-term contracts to buy electricity, with affiliates of Hyundai Motor Group. MUFG, HSBC and ING Capital LLC provided the term debt and letter of credit support, while Northleaf Capital joined as a minority investor. The investment tax credit is a federal tax incentive, and term conversion means the short-term construction loan was turned into a longer-term loan once the plant was built. Acadia Infrastructure arranged the sale of environmental attribute certificates from the project to a hyperscale data center company, and SOLV Energy built the plant as the engineering, procurement and construction contractor.
context: The deal moves the project from construction into long-term operation in the ERCOT Texas grid market. Matrix says construction finished ahead of schedule and under budget, and claims the plant will power the equivalent of about 48,862 homes. The project also contributes nearly $3 million to community programs through the Sustain Our Future Foundation. Matrix, backed by TPG, reports more than 8.7 GW of US projects and over 15.5 GW globally.

sources.title: MATRIX RENEWABLES ANNOUNCES COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS AND INVESTMENT TAX CREDIT FUNDING WITH CONCURRENT TERM CONVERSION FOR A 281MWDC SOLAR PROJECT IN BELL COUNTY, TEXAS

title: Vena Group reaches financial close on 80.6 MWp Astra solar in Ilocos Norte
summary: Vena Group reached financial close on the 80.6 MWp Astra solar project in Currimao, Ilocos Norte, the Philippines.
details: Astra is an 80.6 MWp solar project in Currimao, Ilocos Norte, expected to produce about 142 GWh a year, enough for about 120,500 households.
context: Vena already runs two solar plants in Ilocos Norte and is building the 300 MWp Opus project there, making the province a hub for its Philippine business.

sources.title: Vena Group Secures Financial Close For 80.6 MWp Astra Solar Project In Ilocos Norte

title: responsAbility invests up to US$15 million in Skye Renewables
summary: responsAbility committed up to US$15 million to Skye Renewables to expand solar projects in the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Singapore.
details: responsAbility committed up to US$15 million to Skye Renewables, a Singapore energy-as-a-service company that builds rooftop and on-site solar for manufacturers, retailers and pharmaceutical firms in the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Singapore.
context: Skye plans to grow its installed capacity to several hundred megawatts. It is responsAbility's first climate investment in Malaysia and the Philippines.

sources.title: responsAbility Invests USD 15 Million In Skye Renewables To Expand Southeast Asia Solar Projects

title: Cosmo Eco Power signs virtual PPA with Fuji Electric for wind power
summary: Cosmo Eco Power signed a virtual PPA to give Fuji Electric the environmental value of about 10 million kWh a year from the Enshu wind plant.
details: Cosmo Eco Power, part of Cosmo Energy Holdings, will provide Fuji Electric with the environmental value of about 10 million kWh a year from the 6.33 MW Enshu wind plant it is building. The credits go to Fuji Electric's Matsumoto power semiconductor plant in Nagano.
context: Under a virtual PPA the buyer pays for the renewable attributes without the physical power. The deal should cut about 4,210 tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: Cosmo Eco Power and Fuji Electric sign virtual PPA for wind power supply

title: EBRD lends US$65 million to HAU Energy for 200 MW solar and battery project at Benban
summary: The EBRD provided a US$65 million construction bridge loan to HAU Energy for a 200 MW solar plant with battery storage at Benban, near Aswan, Egypt.
details: The EBRD is providing a US$65 million construction bridge loan to HAU Energy for a 200 MW solar plant with a 120 MWh battery at Benban, near Aswan. A bridge loan covers construction until long-term financing is in place.
context: Benban is one of Egypt's main solar hubs. The battery stores surplus solar power for use after sunset, which the bank says will make renewable supply more reliable.

sources.title: EBRD Provides US$65 Million Loan To HAU Energy For 200 MW Solar Project With Battery Storage In Egypt’s Benban Near Aswan

title: AFC closes €43 million green bond for 66 MW Poro Power solar in Côte d'Ivoire
summary: The Africa Finance Corporation reached financial close and disbursed €43 million under the Poro Power green bond for a 66 MW solar project in Côte d'Ivoire, part of a €65 million dual-currency facility.
details: The Africa Finance Corporation closed and paid out €43 million under the Poro Power green bond, part of a €65 million facility in euros and CFA francs. It funds a 66 MW solar plant in the Korhogo region of northern Côte d'Ivoire, due in 2027.
context: It is described as the first project-finance green bond in Côte d'Ivoire and the WAEMU region, and was led, arranged and funded entirely by African institutions. The plant will be the country's largest.

sources.title: Africa Finance Corporation Closes €43 Million Green Bond To Fund 66 MW Solar Project In Côte d’Ivoire

title: Elgin closes £500 million platform financing for UK solar and storage
summary: Elgin closed a £500 million platform financing with NatWest, Société Générale, BNP Paribas, Siemens Bank and Standard Chartered for its UK solar and co-located battery pipeline.
details: A platform financing lets the company add projects to one loan over time instead of borrowing project by project.

sources.title: WFW advises Elgin on solar PV and BESS project financing

title: EIG holds initial closing of Geothermal Catalyst Partners fund
summary: EIG held the initial closing of EIG Geothermal Catalyst Partners, a fund providing mid-stage development capital to next-generation geothermal projects in the US.
details: EIG held the first close of EIG Geothermal Catalyst Partners, a fund that provides mid-stage development capital to next-generation geothermal projects in the US. The amount raised was not disclosed.
context: Mid-stage capital carries projects through drilling and commercial milestones before they can raise project finance. EIG aims to reduce risk so that more institutional investors can enter geothermal.

sources.title: EIG holds initial closing of fund focused on geothermal power projects

title: Iberdrola agrees to buy 42 MW Lazio solar plant from CCE
summary: Iberdrola agreed to buy a 42 MW solar plant in Lazio, Italy, commissioned less than six months earlier, from CCE.
details: The plant has long-term PPAs and joins Iberdrola's Etruria complex, which reaches 174 MW.

sources.title: Iberdrola acquires Italian solar plant

title: Atlas Renewable Energy reaches financial close on El Campano solar in Colombia
summary: Atlas Renewable Energy reached financial close on the El Campano solar project in Córdoba, Colombia, with a COP 292.1 billion (US$77.6 million) project loan and a COP 58.38 billion commercial credit line.
details: Atlas closed a COP 292.1 billion (US$77.6 million) project loan and a COP 58.38 billion (US$15.5 million) commercial credit line from Financiera de Desarrollo Nacional and BBVA CIB, which also issue letters of credit; BBVA provides hedging. The El Campano plant in Córdoba was awarded in Colombia's 2024 reliability charge auction.
context: Borrowing in Colombian pesos matches the loan to the currency of the plant's revenue. Financial close lets construction begin.

sources.title: Atlas Renewable Energy secures financing for its second solar project in Colombia

title: Palisade's Intera Renewables to buy 240 MW / 960 MWh Summerfield battery from CIP
summary: Palisade Investment Partners agreed to acquire 100% of the 240 MW / 960 MWh Summerfield battery, east of Adelaide, from Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners through Intera Renewables.
details: CIP began construction in February 2025, and Palisade is buying partway through.

sources.title: Palisade signs transaction to acquire large scale battery through Intera Renewables

title: Mahindra & Mahindra to take 26% of Neon Hybren for 30 MW captive solar
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra approved buying 26% of Neon Hybren for up to ₹11.17 crore to source 30 MW of captive solar power.
details: Mahindra & Mahindra's board approved buying 26% of Neon Hybren for up to ₹11.17 crore, in one or more phases. Neon is developing a 30 MW solar project and will remain a step-down subsidiary of M&M.
context: India's Electricity Rules 2005 require a captive user to own at least 26% of the plant; the stake lets M&M source the solar power for its factories as captive supply.

sources.title: Mahindra & Mahindra To Acquire 26% Stake In Neon Hybren For Captive 30 MW Solar Project

title: Ortus Power Resources Italy closes €97 million green loan
summary: Ortus Power Resources Italy closed a non-recourse green loan of about €97 million to refinance an operating solar portfolio and fund new projects in Italy.
details: Ortus Power Resources Italy, through OPR Sun 0, closed a non-recourse green loan of about €97 million. It refinances about 23 MW of operating solar, much of it earning incentive tariffs from Italy's GSE under the FER 1 decree, and funds about 78 MW of ready-to-build projects.
context: Combining refinancing of incentive-backed plants with new construction lets the owner use the stable income of the old plants to support borrowing for the new ones.

sources.title: Ortus Power Resources Italy Secures €97 Million Green Loan For Solar Portfolio Refinancing And Expansion

title: EIB and Société Générale finance 137 MW Sand Solar in Sicily with €153 million
summary: The EIB and Société Générale signed €153 million to build and run the 137 MW Sand Solar plant in Monreale and Gibellina, Sicily.
details: The EIB and Société Générale signed €153 million to build and run Sand Solar, a 137 MW plant in Monreale and Gibellina, Sicily. It should produce about 256 GWh a year, enough for nearly 100,000 households.
context: The EIB is increasing renewable lending under REPowerEU, the EU plan to cut reliance on imported fossil fuels. The plant also counts toward Italy's 2030 climate plan.

sources.title: EIB And Societe Generale Provide €153M Financing For 137 MW Sand Solar Project In Sicily To Support Italy’s 2030 Green Goals

title: Qualitas Energy buys 376 MWp of operating Polish solar from Better Energy JV
summary: Qualitas Energy acquired nine operating solar plants in Poland, 376 MWp in total, from a joint venture of Better Energy and Industriens Pension.
details: Qualitas Energy bought nine operating solar plants in Poland, 376 MWp in total, from a joint venture of Better Energy and Industriens Pension. Better Energy built them between 2021 and 2024. They produce more than 400 GWh a year and connect to three distribution operators: Tauron, Energa and Enea.
context: It is one of the larger operating solar portfolios to change hands in Poland. Spreading plants across regions and grid operators reduces the risk of local curtailment.

sources.title: Qualitas Energy acquires operational solar portfolio in Poland

title: Consumers Energy presses ahead with sale of 13 Michigan hydroelectric dams to Confluence Hydro
summary: Consumers Energy is selling 13 hydroelectric dams in Michigan to Confluence Hydro, a sale first announced in September. The two companies presented the deal to the Michigan Natural Resources Commission while state and federal regulators review it.
details: The release does not state a price or the combined generating capacity of the dams. Once regulators approve the sale, Confluence Hydro plans to sell the dams' electricity back to Consumers Energy under a 30-year contract, a long-term agreement to buy power. Confluence Hydro would also begin relicensing the dams, meaning it would seek renewed federal permission to keep operating them. The companies say operations and the surrounding land footprint will stay the same, and the Tippy Dam is among the sites mentioned.
context: Consumers Energy says it studied the dams' future for more than four years and argues the sale is the lowest-cost option for its customers. According to the utility's public filings, alternatives such as removing the dams would cost customers significantly more. The companies also say keeping the dams preserves reservoirs that local communities rely on for recreation, habitat and tax revenue.

sources.title: Consumers Energy Tells State Commission: Sale of 13 Hydroelectric Dams Is Best Option for Michigan

title: Sunsure signs three open-access solar PPAs with Wonder Cement
summary: Sunsure Energy signed three long-term open-access PPAs with Wonder Cement, supplying its Dhule and Aligarh plants from Sunsure's 150 MWp Solapur and 49 MWp solar parks.
details: Sunsure signed three long-term open-access PPAs with Wonder Cement and has started supplying its plants in Dhule and Aligarh from Sunsure's 150 MWp Solapur plant and 49 MWp Augasi plant.
context: Wonder Cement expects solar to replace about 67% of the electricity at Dhule and 52% at Aligarh. It is a repeat partnership between the two companies.

sources.title: Sunsure Signs 3 Solar PPAs with India's Wonder Cement, Powered by 150 MWp and 49 MWp Plants

title: Oikocredit and GCPF lend US$10 million to Sawa Energy for East African C&I solar
summary: Oikocredit and the Global Climate Partnership Fund provided a US$10 million facility to Sawa Energy for about 35 MW of solar and battery systems across 250 business sites in East Africa.
details: Oikocredit and the Global Climate Partnership Fund provided a US$10 million debt facility to Sawa Energy to install about 35 MW of solar and batteries at about 250 business sites in East Africa over three years. Sawa finances the systems and charges customers under long-term service agreements.
context: Businesses in the region face rising tariffs, unstable grids and costly diesel back-up. Pay-as-you-go solar removes the upfront cost for customers.

sources.title: Oikocredit and GCPF Provide USD 10 Million Solar Financing Facility to Sawa Energy to Deploy 35 MW Across East Africa

title: Zelestra and EDP sign Spain's first PPA to add a battery to an operating solar plant
summary: Zelestra and EDP signed Spain's first PPA to hybridise an operating solar plant with storage: a 160 MWh battery at the 50 MW Pizarroso plant in Cáceres.
details: Zelestra will add a 160 MWh battery to its 50 MW Pizarroso solar plant in Cáceres, which has operated since 2023. EDP, already buying the plant's solar output, will use the battery to manage when power is delivered.
context: It is Spain's first PPA to add storage to an operating solar plant. In 2025 the same companies signed Spain's first combined solar and battery PPA.

sources.title: Zelestra and EDP sign Spain’s first PPA to hybridise solar plant with battery storage

title: Quality Care India signs group-captive solar PPAs with AMPIN and Radiance
summary: Hospital group Quality Care India signed group-captive solar PPAs with AMPIN Energy Transition and Radiance Renewables.
details: Hospital group Quality Care India signed group-captive solar PPAs with AMPIN Energy Transition and Radiance Renewables. The first phase covers several hospitals across Odisha, Chhattisgarh and other states.
context: Hospitals need uninterrupted power, and long-term solar contracts give them more control over costs. Group-captive status lowers the charges on the power.

sources.title: Healthcare Sector Accelerates Renewable Shift as QCIL Signs Solar PPAs with AMPIN and Radiance

title: Blackstone Tactical Opportunities makes structured equity investment in Sunotec
summary: Funds managed by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities made a structured equity investment in Sunotec, a European integrator that builds utility-scale solar and battery projects.
details: Funds managed by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities made a structured equity investment, a hybrid of debt and equity terms, in Sunotec, which builds utility-scale solar and battery projects. The amount was not disclosed.
context: The money will support Sunotec's growth in Germany, the UK, Scandinavia and South-East Europe, and its move into grid infrastructure and its own hybrid asset platform.

sources.title: Sunotec Forms New Partnership Backed By Blackstone Investment To Accelerate Solar And Battery Storage Growth Across Europe

title: Recurrent Energy sells 42.5 MWp Higher Witheven solar project in Cornwall
summary: Recurrent Energy sold the 42.5 MWp Higher Witheven solar project near Launceston, Cornwall, which holds a UK Contract for Difference, to an unnamed infrastructure investor.
details: Higher Witheven is a 42.5 MWp standalone solar project near Launceston, Cornwall. It won a Contract for Difference in the UK's Allocation Round 7, and Recurrent Energy sold it to an unnamed infrastructure investor.
context: A CfD fixes the price the plant receives for 20 years, which makes a ready project attractive to long-term investors. Recurrent typically develops projects and sells them before or during construction.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Sells 42.5 MWp Higher Witheven Solar Project In Cornwall After Securing UK CfD Contract

title: AXIAN Energy reaches financial close on 60 MWp NEA Kolda solar and storage in Senegal
summary: AXIAN Energy reached financial close on the NEA Kolda plant in Casamance, Senegal: 60 MWp of solar with 72 MWh of batteries.
details: Construction began in May 2025 with the company's own funds.

sources.title: AXIAN Energy Achieves Financial Close for 60 MW NEA Kolda Solar and Storage Project in Senegal

title: Aurobindo Pharma to take 26% of Swarnaakshu Solar Power for captive supply
summary: Aurobindo Pharma plans to buy 26% of Swarnaakshu Solar Power to secure captive solar power for its operations.
details: Aurobindo Pharma plans to buy 26% of Swarnaakshu Solar Power, which will build a solar project supplying its plants. Completion is expected by 30 June, subject to approvals.
context: Indian rules require captive users to own at least 26% of the plant; the stake lets Aurobindo buy power through open access at lower cost.

sources.title: Aurobindo Pharma to Acquire 26% Stake in Swarnaakshu Solar Power for Captive Renewable Energy Project

title: Resolven refinances 136 MWp portfolio with ₹450 crore from NIIF IFL
summary: Resolven refinanced its 136 MWp operating portfolio in Telangana and Karnataka with ₹450 crore from NIIF Infrastructure Finance, cutting borrowing costs by more than 100 basis points.
details: Resolven refinanced its 136 MWp of operating solar in Telangana and Karnataka with ₹450 crore from NIIF Infrastructure Finance. The new debt cuts borrowing costs by more than 100 basis points and extends the term by three to five years.
context: Lower interest and longer repayment raise the cash the plants return to Resolven's institutional investors. Refinancing is common once plants have a record of steady output.

sources.title: Resolven Raises ₹450 Cr from NIIF IFL to Refinance 136 MW Renewable Assets, Cuts Financing Costs

title: Roofsol Energy signs 2 MWp OPEX solar PPA with Whirlpool India
summary: Roofsol Energy signed a 2 MWp PPA under the OPEX model with Whirlpool of India for one of its factories.
details: Roofsol will build a 2 MWp solar system at a Whirlpool of India factory under an OPEX model, in which Roofsol pays for the system and Whirlpool buys the power. It should produce 3 to 3.5 million units a year and cut 2,500 to 3,000 tonnes of CO2.
context: The OPEX model lets manufacturers adopt solar without capital spending while locking in lower power costs.

sources.title: Roofsol Energy Signs 2 MWp OPEX Solar PPA with Whirlpool India

title: TotalEnergies and Masdar agree US$2.2 billion joint venture for onshore renewables in Asia
summary: TotalEnergies and Masdar signed a binding agreement to form a US$2.2 billion 50/50 joint venture combining their onshore renewable businesses in nine Asian countries.
details: TotalEnergies and Masdar signed a binding agreement for a US$2.2 billion 50/50 joint venture merging their onshore renewable businesses in Azerbaijan, Indonesia, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea and Uzbekistan. It starts with 3 GW operating and 6 GW in development and construction.
context: Once closed, the venture will be both companies' only vehicle for onshore solar, wind and storage in those countries. Pooling assets gives it the scale to grow quickly as Asian power demand rises.

sources.title: TotalEnergies and Masdar to form US$2.2 billion joint venture to accelerate renewable energy growth in Asia

title: Sonaura signs private-wire solar PPA with Albéa's Scheßlitz factory
summary: Sonaura signed a long-term private-wire PPA to build and run a solar project supplying power directly to Albéa's factory in Scheßlitz, Germany.
details: Sonaura will build and run a 4.2 MWp solar plant near Albéa's factory in Scheßlitz, Germany, and supply it by private wire, a dedicated cable that bypasses the public grid. The plant sits on land classed as privileged under German planning law, which eases permitting.
context: Private-wire supply shields Albéa from grid price swings and some network charges. Sonaura has signed several such contracts with German manufacturers.

sources.title: Sonaura To Supply Albéa’s Scheßlitz Factory With Long-Term Solar Power Through New Private-Wire PPA

title: Ceigall Green Energy signs 15 PPAs for 130 MW of feeder solar in Madhya Pradesh
summary: Ceigall Green Energy MP signed 15 PPAs with Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company for 130 MW of solar under the Surya Mitra Krishi Feeder Yojana, which powers farm feeders with solar.
details: Ceigall Green Energy MP signed 15 PPAs with Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company for 130 MW of solar under the Surya Mitra Krishi Feeder Yojana. It will build and run the plants and sell power for 25 years at ₹2.85 per unit. The EPC investment is about ₹572 crore and construction should take 12 months.
context: The scheme places solar plants on dedicated farm feeders to give farmers reliable daytime power. It adds to Ceigall's move from road building into renewables.

sources.title: Ceigall Green Energy Signs 15 PPAs for 130 MW Solar Project in Madhya Pradesh

title: WIND-projekt sells 381 MW German wind portfolio to Blue Elephant Energy
summary: WIND-projekt sold a 381 MW onshore wind portfolio in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern to Blue Elephant Energy, the largest German onshore wind M&A deal of 2025.
details: It includes 37 operating wind farms (260 MW) and further projects in construction and development.

sources.title: WFW advises WIND-projekt on sale of 381 MW German onshore wind portfolio

title: TotalEnergies sells 50% of 800 MW German battery portfolio to Allianz Global Investors
summary: TotalEnergies sold 50% of a portfolio of 11 German battery projects under construction, 789 MW / 1,628 MWh, to Allianz Global Investors, valuing the portfolio at about €500 million.

sources.title: DNV advises on TotalEnergies’ sale of 800 MW German battery portfolio

title: CleanMax signs 21 MWp solar PPA with STT GDC for Chennai data centres
summary: CleanMax signed a 21 MWp solar PPA to supply STT GDC India's data centres in Chennai.
details: CleanMax will supply STT GDC India's Chennai data centres from 21 MWp of solar under a long-term PPA.
context: Data centre power demand is growing quickly with digitalisation and AI. Long-term solar contracts lower both emissions and costs for operators.

sources.title: CleanMax, STT GDC Sign 21 MWp Solar PPA for Chennai Data Centres

title: Serentica signs 32 MW round-the-clock hybrid PPA with Sanathan Polycot
summary: Serentica Renewables signed a long-term PPA with Sanathan Polycot, a Sanathan Textiles subsidiary, for a 32 MW hybrid project supplying round-the-clock power through a new project company.
details: Serentica will set up a project company for a 32 MW hybrid project supplying round-the-clock power to Sanathan Polycot's factory in Punjab. Sanathan Polycot, a Sanathan Textiles subsidiary, will hold 26% and Serentica the rest.
context: Round-the-clock contracts combine solar, wind and often storage so the factory gets steady supply. The 26% stake gives the buyer captive status.

sources.title: Serentica Renewables Signs 32 MW RTC Hybrid PPA with Sanathan Polycot, Expands Industrial Decarbonisation in India’s Textile Sector

title: Inox Clean Energy completes ₹5,000 crore purchase of Vibrant Energy from Macquarie
summary: Inox Clean Energy completed its purchase of Vibrant Energy, a 1,337 MW commercial and industrial renewables platform, from Macquarie and other shareholders for about ₹5,000 crore.
details: The deal closed in four months.

sources.title: Inox Clean Energy Acquires 1,337 MW Vibrant Energy Portfolio in Rs 5,000 Crore Deal, Strengthening C&I Renewable Footprint

title: European Energy sells 470 MW Jonava hybrid project in Lithuania to Energix
summary: European Energy completed the sale of the Jonava hybrid renewable project in Lithuania, planned at about 470 MW, to Energix.
details: European Energy completed the sale of the Jonava hybrid project in Lithuania to Energix. It is planned at about 470 MW: some 140 MW of onshore wind, 330 MWp of solar and 320 MWh of storage. Construction is expected to start soon, with full operation by 2027.
context: The two companies agreed the sale in March 2025. European Energy takes projects from concept through permits and design before selling them to long-term owners.

sources.title: European Energy Divests Jonava Renewable Project To Energix, Reinforcing Its Strategy Of Delivering Investment-Ready Clean Energy Assets

title: AfDB approves US$150 million for 100 MW floating solar on Cahora Bassa lake
summary: The African Development Bank approved a US$150 million loan for a 100 MW floating solar plant on Lake Cahora Bassa in Mozambique.
details: The African Development Bank approved a US$150 million loan for a 100 MW floating solar plant on Lake Cahora Bassa, the reservoir of the Cahora Bassa dam.
context: Solar output by day lets the dam hold back water to generate at night or at peak times, making the two plants work as a hybrid. Floating panels also avoid using farmland.

sources.title: Mozambique Secures $150 Million AfDB Loan For 100 MW Floating Solar Project At Cahora Bassa Lake

title: Capital Dynamics and Solo Renewables form £100 million long-duration storage venture in Northern Ireland
summary: Capital Dynamics agreed to partner with Solo Renewables on a potential £100 million long-duration energy storage project at Islandmagee, Northern Ireland.
details: It received planning approval in February 2026.

sources.title: Capital Dynamics and Solo Renewables agree £100 million joint venture for LDES

title: BGK lends PLN 350 million to Qair for 203 MW Polish solar and wind
summary: Qair secured PLN 350 million (about €82 million) from Polish development bank BGK for three projects: an 18 MW wind farm in Jenkowo and solar plants of 105 MW in Grudziądz and 80 MW.
details: Polish development bank BGK lent Qair PLN 350 million (about €82 million) under Poland's Recovery and Resilience Plan, through the Energy Support Fund. It funds an 18 MW wind farm in Jenkowo, Lower Silesia, and solar plants of 105 MW in Grudziądz and 80 MW in Wierzbica, 203 MW in total. Jenkowo and Wierzbica start construction in 2026, Grudziądz in 2028.

sources.title: Qair Secures Financing for 203 MW Solar and Wind Portfolio in Poland

title: DZGM Energy Resources signs PPA with ZESCO for 100 MW wind-solar hybrid
summary: DZGM Energy Resources signed a PPA with ZESCO for a 100 MW hybrid wind and solar project in Zambia, expected to be built within six months.
details: DZGM Energy Resources signed a PPA with ZESCO for a 100 MW hybrid wind and solar project in Zambia, to be built within six months.
context: Zambia relies heavily on hydropower, which drought has made unreliable. The government wants private investment to diversify the power mix quickly.

sources.title: Zambia signs 100 MW Hybrid Wind-Solar PPA to Diversify Energy Mix

title: SolarAfrica buys Inspired Evolution's controlling stake in C&I developer Cesa
summary: Inspired Evolution sold its controlling stake in Cesa, a South African commercial and industrial solar developer, to SolarAfrica.
details: Inspired Evolution, a renewables investor, sold its controlling stake in Cesa, a South African developer of commercial and industrial solar, to SolarAfrica. Terms were not disclosed.
context: The purchase adds Cesa's commercial and industrial project pipeline to SolarAfrica, which also supplies businesses with solar power, and gives Inspired Evolution an exit from its investment.

sources.title: inspired evolution sells stake renewable ci platform solarafrica

title: Q Energy takes one-third of 250 MW Pennavel floating offshore wind project
summary: Elicio and BayWa r.e. opened the capital of the 250 MW Pennavel floating offshore wind project in southern Brittany to Q Energy, so each now holds an equal third.
details: Elicio and BayWa r.e. sold a stake in the 250 MW Pennavel floating offshore wind project in southern Brittany to Q Energy, so the three now own a third each. Watson Farley & Williams advised the sellers.
context: Floating turbines can be installed in deep water where fixed foundations are impractical. The partners say Q Energy brings technical and industrial skills at a key stage of development.

sources.title: WFW advises Elicio and BayWa r.e. on opening capital to Q Energy for stake in Pennavel offshore wind farm

title: LG Electronics India signs solar PPAs with Hinduja Renewables and Sunsure
summary: LG Electronics India signed long-term solar PPAs with Hinduja Renewables (9.8 MWp, for Pune) and Sunsure Energy (11 MWp, for Greater Noida).
details: LG Electronics India signed a 9.8 MWp PPA with Hinduja Renewables, supplied from its 27.7 MWp Nanded plant, for its Pune factory, and an 11 MWp PPA with Sunsure, from its 82.5 MWp Erach plant, for Greater Noida. Together they should supply about 3.21 crore units a year.
context: LG expects the contracts to avoid about 0.61 million tonnes of CO2 over their lives. Buying slices of larger open-access parks is a common route for Indian factories.

sources.title: LGE India Signs Solar PPAs with HREPL and Sunsure Energy to Power Manufacturing Units

title: Axpo signs solar PPA with McDonald's Spain franchises for 83 GWh a year
summary: Axpo signed a PPA to supply McDonald's franchises in Spain with 83 GWh a year from a new 200 MWp solar complex in León.
details: Axpo will supply McDonald's franchises in Spain with about 83 GWh a year from a new 200 MWp solar complex of four 50 MWp plants in Villadangos del Páramo and Cimanes del Tejar, León. ZConsultores Energéticos helped arrange the deal.
context: Pooling many franchise restaurants into one PPA gives them the scale to buy power directly from a large plant.

sources.title: Axpo Signs Solar PPA with McDonald’s Spain to Supply 83 GWh Annually

title: Sokhoro 52 MWp solar project in Côte d'Ivoire reaches financial close
summary: The 52 MWp Sokhoro solar project near Ferkessédougou, Côte d'Ivoire, reached financial close with a mix of CFA franc and euro financing.
details: The 52 MWp Sokhoro plant near Ferkessédougou, Tchologo region, is developed by Poro Power 1, led by PFO Africa. Its financing combines CFA franc and euro funds, including the country's first green bonds for an energy project.
context: Borrowing partly in local currency reduces exchange-rate risk, which often weighs on African infrastructure. The plant will be one of Côte d'Ivoire's largest.

title: Linea Energy closes debt financing for 172 MWdc Watertown solar project in Michigan
summary: Linea Energy, a US developer backed by EnCap Investments, has closed project debt financing for its 172 MWdc Watertown solar project in Sanilac County, Michigan. Santander led the lender group, which also included Société Générale, NORD/LB and Truist. The loan amount was not disclosed.
details: Watertown is a utility-scale solar plant now under construction, with power sales on the MISO regional grid market expected to start in April 2027. The financing combines a construction-to-term loan (a loan that funds building and then converts into long-term debt), a tax equity bridge loan (short-term debt repaid once tax credit investors fund the project), and a letter of credit facility (bank guarantees the project can post to counterparties). Linea has signed a 25-year power purchase agreement with utility Consumers Energy, meaning the utility has agreed to buy the plant's output for that period. Winston & Strawn advised the lenders and Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe advised Linea.
context: This is the third Linea project to reach financial close, the point at which funding is committed and construction can proceed in full. The company says the plant will support about 150 construction jobs and generate power for roughly 25,000 Michigan homes. It also projects about $16.4 million in local property tax revenue over 20 years.

sources.title: Linea Energy Closes Project Debt Financing for Watertown Solar in Michigan

title: Doral Renewables closes about $525 million in surety-backed letter of credit facilities

buyers.name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA)
buyers.role: primary intermediary letter of credit issuer

advisors.name: Howden Capital Advisory and Placement (Howden CAP)

summary: US solar and battery storage developer Doral Renewables has closed roughly $525 million in cross-border letter of credit facilities backed by insurance-market surety. The financing is split into a facility of about $385 million and a second of about $140 million, underwritten by six international underwriters.
details: The larger facility, about $385 million, is a deferred equity contribution guarantee, which lets Doral post letters of credit in place of putting cash equity into projects up front when project lenders require it. The roughly $140 million all purpose guarantee facility will mainly cover letters of credit needed for grid interconnection and power purchase agreements (long-term power sale contracts) across the pipeline. A letter of credit is a promise by a bank to pay if the company fails to meet an obligation, and here insurers acting as surety providers stand behind it. BBVA is the main issuing bank and GLAS acts as process and security agent. The company and underwriters expect to enlarge both facilities over time.
context: Doral says the structure helps it keep cash on hand and raise equity returns at the project level while it grows a solar and storage pipeline it puts at nearly 18 GW, including about 450 MW operating and 1,500 MW under construction. The deal shows insurance-market capacity being used alongside a bank to support renewable developers' collateral needs, which the broker describes as a long-term committed capital solution.

title: Ashtrom Renewable Energy closes about $200 million BHI financing for El Patrimonio solar project in Texas
summary: Ashtrom Renewable Energy, a subsidiary of Israel's Ashtrom Group, reached financial close on a financing package of roughly $200 million from BHI, the U.S. branch of Bank Hapoalim. The money will fund construction of the El Patrimonio solar project near San Antonio, Texas.
details: Financial close is the point when loan agreements are signed and funds can be drawn. Construction of El Patrimonio started in 2025 and is expected to finish in 2027, and the release does not state its capacity. Alongside the loan, Ashtrom agreed to sell the project's production tax credits, which are federal tax incentives earned per unit of power generated, to an unnamed large U.S. institution rated Aa3 by Moody's for 10 years. Under a 20-year power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy electricity, local municipal utility CPS Energy will take about 70% of the output plus renewable energy certificates. The remaining power will be sold on the Texas open wholesale market, known as merchant sales, meaning at market prices rather than a fixed contract.
context: Ashtrom describes the deal as an important milestone for its U.S. business, where it reports a pipeline of about 1.3 GWdc of generation projects plus around 600 MWh of battery storage. The company projects the plant will serve about 37,000 households once running. BHI says renewable energy is a long-term part of its growth strategy and that it plans to keep lending to Israeli-affiliated and international developers.

title: Atlas Renewable Energy closes $3 billion refinancing of Latin American solar and storage portfolio with MUFG among arrangers

buyers.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG)
buyers.role: Initial Joint Lead Arranger, Joint Bookrunner, Green Loan Coordinator and Hedge Provider

target: Atlas Renewable Energy solar and battery storage portfolio in Chile, Brazil and Mexico
summary: Atlas Renewable Energy has completed a $3 billion refinancing that brings together financing for its solar and battery storage projects in Chile, Brazil and Mexico. MUFG took part as one of the lead banks arranging the deal.
details: The refinancing pulls several existing project financings into one structure. It consists of term loans at both the operating company level and the holding company level, plus letter of credit facilities, which are bank guarantees that projects often need to post with counterparties. All parts carry five-year tenors, meaning they are repaid or due within five years. MUFG served as initial joint lead arranger, joint bookrunner, green loan coordinator, meaning it helped align the loan with green lending standards, and hedge provider, offering contracts that protect against interest rate or currency swings. Other lenders were not named in the release.
context: MUFG describes the deal as first of its kind in Latin America for its size and multi-country reach. Atlas, which says it has more than 10.8 GW of contracted renewable assets, describes itself as the largest renewable independent power producer in the region. Consolidating debt across three countries may simplify the company's capital structure, and MUFG presents the deal as evidence of its role in large cross-border energy financings.

sources.title: MUFG Announces Participation in Refinancing of $3 Billion Capital Structure for Atlas Renewable Energy

sources.title: Sunsure Energy Signs 8 MWp Solar PPAs with Korean Automotive Firms in Tamil Nadu

title: UltraTech Cement takes 26% of AMPIN C&I Power Forty Four for 45 MW solar with storage

details: UltraTech Cement bought 26% of AMPIN C&I Power Forty Four, which is building a 45 MWp DC (30 MW AC) solar plant with battery storage at Golamunda in Kalahandi district, Odisha, as a captive supply for UltraTech.
context: Owning 26% qualifies UltraTech as a captive user, lowering its power costs. Adding batteries lets the plant supply power outside daylight hours.

title: Natura Energy reaches financial close on 31 MWp Parsons Power Park Phase 1A

context: Taking a project from early development through to bankability is the riskiest part of the process; reaching close lets construction start.

sources.title: Natura Energy Achieves Financial Close For 31 MW Solar Project At Parsons Power Park In Eastern Cape

title: Exus Renewables North America acquires greenfield developer Ozone Renewables
summary: Exus Renewables North America, a Pittsburgh-based developer and operator of utility-scale renewable projects, has acquired Ozone Renewables, an early-stage project developer. The deal brings Ozone's team and its pipeline of early-stage wind, solar and storage projects into Exus. No price was disclosed.
details: The purchase covers Ozone's existing pipeline of early-stage wind, solar and storage projects plus project concepts at various stages of land control, meaning securing rights to the land a project would use. Ozone's team will work on greenfield development, which means building projects from scratch rather than buying them part-built, across the PJM, MISO, WECC and SPP grid regions. Larry Seiler of Ozone will lead a new greenfield development team at Exus. The release does not give financial terms or name any advisers.
context: This is Exus' first acquisition of a whole organization, and the company says it marks a shift toward originating projects internally instead of relying on buying early-stage projects from outside developers. Ozone's founder says the firm has originated more than 9 GW of assets, and its team has helped partners bring over 3 GW of wind projects into operation. Exus executives framed the deal as a response to industry consolidation that is making life harder for small independent developers. Exus reports a total portfolio of over 5.8 GW, with 764 MW operating or under construction.

sources.title: Exus Renewables North America Acquires Ozone Renewables to Expand In-House Greenfield Development Capabilities

title: Low Carbon reaches financial close on 8 MW Przeworsk battery in Poland
summary: Low Carbon reached financial close on the 8 MW Przeworsk battery near Rzeszów, its first in Poland, due to operate in early 2027.
details: The 8 MW Przeworsk battery near Rzeszów is built by a joint venture of LC Energia, Low Carbon's majority-owned Polish company, local developer Evercon and trading house InCommodities. It should operate in early 2027.
context: It is Low Carbon's first battery in Poland and one of the country's first standalone grid-connected batteries, providing flexibility as Poland adds renewables.

sources.title: Low Carbon reaches financial close on its first Polish battery project

context: Firm and dispatchable projects must deliver scheduled power whatever the weather, which requires large batteries; that is why the tariff is far above plain solar.

sources.title: ACME Solar Signs 450 MW FDRE Power Purchase Agreements With SJVN At ₹6.74 Tariff

context: EBRD equity alongside a private sponsor lowers risk for other lenders and supports Poland's move away from coal.

sources.title: EBRD invests in Virya Renewables

title: MacLean-Fogg acquires US solar tracker maker OMCO Solar
summary: Family-owned US manufacturer MacLean-Fogg has acquired OMCO Solar, a Phoenix-based maker of solar trackers and fixed-tilt mounting structures. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: OMCO Solar builds single-axis trackers, which are mounts that turn solar panels to follow the sun, as well as fixed-tilt structures that hold panels at a set angle. The company says it has supplied more than 12 GW of mounting structures in the US, made from US steel at factories across the country. OMCO will keep its brand and current leadership team as a distinct unit within MacLean-Fogg. The release does not state a price, advisers or the exact closing date.
context: The parties say the deal was driven by OMCO's growth in the US tracker and fixed-tilt markets. For MacLean-Fogg, whose businesses mainly serve automotive, truck and industrial customers, the purchase adds a solar manufacturing platform alongside roll forming and fabrication. The companies describe the acquisition as part of a commitment to strengthening domestic US manufacturing.

sources.title: OMCO Solar Acquired by MacLean-Fogg, positioned for continued growth.

context: Indexing the tariff to inflation protects revenue in real terms. Barzalosa is Scatec's first project in Colombia.

title: DESRI signs preferred equity investment in Linea Energy's 235 MW Duffy BESS in Texas
summary: DESRI has signed a preferred equity investment in Linea Energy's Duffy BESS, a 235 MW battery storage project in Matagorda County, Texas. The size of the investment was not disclosed.
details: Duffy BESS is a utility-scale battery energy storage system rated at 235 MWac with a two-hour duration, meaning it can discharge at full power for about two hours. Preferred equity is an ownership investment that gets paid ahead of common equity holders but behind lenders. Linea had already closed debt financing for the project and issued full notice to proceed, the formal go-ahead for construction, in December 2025. Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe advised Linea and King & Spalding advised DESRI.
context: DESRI says the deal shows its role as a capital provider for renewable projects beyond owning its own assets, and it hopes to expand its partnership with Linea. Linea, which is backed by EnCap Energy Transition, presents the investment as evidence of its ability to attract capital partners. Both parties point to the project's role in supporting grid reliability in Texas.

sources.title: DESRI and Linea Announce Signing of Preferred Equity Financing for Duffy BESS in Matagorda County, TX

title: Revego Africa Energy Fund raises R1 billion from BII and Alexander Forbes
