details: Revego Africa Energy Fund raised R1 billion (about US$62 million): R500 million from British International Investment and R500 million from Alexander Forbes. Its portfolio rises to R3 billion. BII may add R250 million more if another institution matches it.
context: It is Revego's first raise since 2021. The money will complete its investment in the 150 MW Springbok solar plant in the Free State and fund five wind projects.

title: EBRD lends up to €34 million for Scatec-backed 189.7 MW solar in southern Romania

sources.title: Lyra Energy Secures Private Sector PPAs For Thakadu Solar Power Plant In South Africa

sources.title: bp Sells 10% Stake In 240 MW Shafag Solar Project To MVM Energetika Zrt. (MVM)

title: Greenbacker closes US$440 million tax equity for Cider solar in New York

context: Tax equity investors fund part of the cost in exchange for the project's US tax credits. The project has already passed several construction and financing milestones.

sources.title: Greenbacker Secures $440 Million Tax Equity From U.S. Bank And M&T Bank To Fully Fund New York’s 674 MWdc / 500 MWac Cider Solar Project

summary: SOLA reached financial close on Naos-1, South Africa's largest utility-scale solar and battery project built for private buyers.

context: It is South Africa's largest utility-scale solar and battery project built for private buyers. Storage lets it deliver firmer power than solar alone, which large industrial users need.

sources.title: SOLA Reaches Financial Close on South Africa’s Largest Solar and Battery Storage Project for Private Off-Takers

sources.title: WFW advises Sonnedix on acquisition of six PV projects and high-voltage substation

sources.title: Tamilnadu Petroproducts To Acquire 26% Stake In Solar SPV For Captive Power Supply

title: GULF secures THB 60 billion for 939 MW of Thai renewables
summary: Gulf Development secured THB 60 billion (about US$1.85 billion) of loans for 27 renewable projects in Thailand, 939 MW in total, including 15 solar and solar-plus-battery farms.
details: Gulf Development secured THB 60 billion (about US$1.85 billion) of loans through Gulf Renewable Energy and Gulf Waste to Energy Holdings for 27 Thai projects with 939 MW: 15 solar and solar-plus-battery farms (843 MW) and 12 industrial waste-to-energy plants (96 MW).
context: GULF presents the financing as a major step toward its net-zero goal. Funding 27 projects in one package lets it build solar, storage and waste-to-energy plants in parallel.

sources.title: GULF Secures THB 60 Billion Financing for 939 MW Renewable Energy Portfolio in Thailand

title: ib vogt sells 272 MWp Irish solar portfolio at about €230 million

details: ib vogt closed sales of three Irish solar projects, 272 MWp in total, at an enterprise value of about €230 million: Gaskinstown (94.7 MWp, County Meath), Rathnaskilloge (107.7 MWp, County Waterford) and Clonin North (69.4 MWp, County Offaly). All were developed by Highfield Solar, ib vogt's joint venture.
context: Selling built or late-stage projects lets ib vogt recycle capital into new development, as Ireland adds utility-scale solar.

sources.title: ib vogt divests €230 million Irish renewable energy portfolio

title: energyRe signs 25-year PPAs with South Carolina utility for five solar projects totaling 360 MW
target: Shorthorn, Culpepper, Clarendon, Rollins and Ross solar projects
summary: Developer energyRe has signed 25-year power purchase agreements with an unnamed large investor-owned utility in South Carolina. The contracts cover five solar projects with a combined capacity of 360 MW.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract in which a buyer, here a utility, agrees to purchase electricity from a project at set terms. The five projects are Shorthorn, Culpepper, Clarendon, Rollins and Ross Solar, all in South Carolina. The release does not give an expected date for commercial operation, which is when the plants begin delivering power. energyRe estimates the projects could supply roughly 58,600 homes per year once running. No financial terms or advisers were disclosed.
context: Signed long-term offtake contracts give developers predictable revenue, which typically helps them secure financing for construction. energyRe says it has about 16 GW of generation, transmission and storage projects under development across the US, and it presents these agreements as supporting grid reliability in the Carolinas.

sources.title: ENERGYRE SIGNS 25-YEAR POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENTS FOR FIVE SOLAR PROJECTS IN SOUTH CAROLINA

sources.title: Greenvolt secures €58.5 million financing for 49.8 MW wind project in Romania

title: Aypa Power closes $1.5 billion construction warehouse facility for US storage projects

buyers.name: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
buyers.role: Lead structuring agent, coordinating lead arranger, administrative and collateral agent

buyers.name: Wells Fargo
buyers.role: Lead structuring agent, coordinating lead arranger

buyers.name: ING Capital LLC
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, green loan coordinator

buyers.name: Fédération des Caisses Desjardins du Québec
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China

summary: Aypa Power, a Blackstone-owned storage developer, has closed a $1.5 billion revolving credit facility to fund construction of utility-scale battery storage projects in the US. The facility, led by CIBC and Wells Fargo, includes an option to grow by a further $0.5 billion.
details: The deal is a construction warehouse facility, meaning a pooled revolving loan that the company can draw on to build several projects before each gets its own long-term financing. It runs for three years and has a $0.5 billion accordion, a built-in option to increase the loan size. CIBC and Wells Fargo were lead structuring agents and green loan coordinators, with CIBC also acting as administrative and collateral agent and U.S. Bank as depositary agent. A large group of banks including Santander, BNP Paribas, ING, Natixis, RBC and Société Générale joined as arrangers. Aypa says the facility will be its main funding source for projects expected to start commercial operation through 2028.
context: Aypa describes the deal as the largest warehouse financing for a storage-focused independent power producer. The company reports 30 projects operating or under construction and a development pipeline above 22 GW across North America. The lenders framed the deal as a sign of the growing role of large batteries in the US grid.

sources.title: Aypa Power Secures $1.5 Billion in Warehouse Facility Financing to Accelerate Construction of Utility-Scale Energy Storage Projects

sources.title: Zelestra Signs Long-Term PPA With AEP Energy Partners For 49.9 MW Gem City Solar Project In Dayton, Ohio

summary: Pekat Group's subsidiary Pentas RE signed a 21-year PPA for a 25 MW solar plant with a 40 MWh battery in Kuantan, Pahang.
details: Pentas RE, a Pekat Group subsidiary, signed a 21-year PPA for a 25 MWac solar plant with a 40 MWh battery in Kuantan, Pahang. The buyer was not named.

sources.title: ACME Solar Signs 25-Year PPA With NHPC For 250 MW FDRE Project

title: Greenko secures ₹4,800 crore 25-year loan to refinance green bonds
summary: Greenko secured a 25-year loan of ₹4,800 crore to refinance US$940 million of green bonds issued in 2021 and falling due this year.

The loan is secured on 38 project companies owning about 1 GW of solar, wind and hydro, ring-fenced in a restricted group so their cash flows service the debt.
context: Swapping dollar bonds for a long rupee loan removes currency risk and refinancing pressure, and matches the debt to the decades-long life of the plants.

sources.title: Crossboundary Access Expands Into Madagascar With Landmark Solar Mini-Grid Acquisition

sources.title: Enlight Strengthens European Energy Storage Presence With Majority Stake In Germany’s Project Jupiter

title: GlassPoint raises $20 million led by N.I.S. New Investment Solutions for solar process heat expansion
summary: GlassPoint, a Dubai-based company that uses solar energy to make steam for industry, has closed a $20 million funding round. The round was led by Liechtenstein asset manager N.I.S. New Investment Solutions, with German venture investor MIG Capital also taking part.
details: The company says the money will support its existing large projects, including a 750 MWth deployment with Searles Valley Minerals in California and a 1.5 GWth project with Ma'aden at a bauxite refinery in Saudi Arabia. MWth means megawatts of heat output rather than electricity. GlassPoint also runs a 330 MWth plant in Oman that has supplied steam since 2017. Its technology uses enclosed solar troughs to capture sunlight as heat, plus a thermal storage system that holds heat for use at night. The funding will also expand its technology center in Stuttgart and hiring in Dubai and the United States.
context: Industrial heat accounts for a larger share of global energy use than electricity and is hard to decarbonize because burning fossil fuels is cheap, according to IEA figures cited in the release. GlassPoint claims its solar steam is cheaper than fossil fuels or electrification in sunny regions. The company plans to target new markets in the U.S. Southwest, Southern Europe, the Middle East and South America.

sources.title: GlassPoint Closes $20M Funding Round to Fuel Global Expansion of Solar Industrial Process Heat

sources.title: African Development Bank approves loan to boost Kenyan geothermal

context: It is Innagreen's first UK investment and should power about 31,000 homes. Keeping RES on for construction and operations gives the new owner continuity with the original developer.

sources.title: Innagreen acquires Dunbeg South wind farm from RES

title: Toesca's T Power secures US$325 million for Chilean battery and solar platform
summary: T Power, the renewables platform of Chilean asset manager Toesca, secured a US$325 million financing to build one of Chile's largest batteries and a solar portfolio.
details: T Power, the renewables platform of Chilean asset manager Toesca, secured US$325 million from SMBC, Natixis and BCI. It funds a new 141 MW / 677 MWh battery and refinances a co-located 141 MW solar plant and other solar assets. DNV advised on the market.
context: The battery will be one of Chile's largest. Pairing it with solar lets T Power store midday output and sell it later in the day.

sources.title: DNV helps secure financing for renewable energy platform in Chile

title: Masdar and ENGIE reach financial close on 1.5 GW Khazna solar project
summary: Masdar and ENGIE reached financial close on the 1.5 GWac Khazna solar independent power project in Abu Dhabi with seven regional and international banks.
details: Masdar and ENGIE closed the financing of the 1.5 GWac Khazna solar IPP in Abu Dhabi with seven banks: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Crédit Agricole CIB, KfW IPEX, BNP Paribas, HSBC, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and Emirates Development Bank. The project company has a 30-year PPA with Emirates Water and Electricity Company.
context: The project was awarded to the partners in October 2025. Abu Dhabi is building several gigawatt-scale solar plants through EWEC tenders.

sources.title: Masdar and ENGIE achieve financial close for 1.5 GW solar project

title: Masdar and partners reach financial close on Ibri III, Oman's first solar and battery project
summary: Masdar, Al Khadra Partners, KOMIPO and OQ Alternative Energy reached financial close on Ibri III, a 500 MW solar plant with a 100 MW battery, Oman's first utility-scale solar and storage project.
details: Natixis, First Abu Dhabi Bank and Bank Muscat provided the project finance. Total cost is about US$300 million.

sources.title: Masdar and Partners Reach Financial Close for Oman’s First Utility-Scale Solar and Battery Project

title: OPEC Fund lends US$37 million for 1 GW Abydos II solar in Egypt
summary: The OPEC Fund is lending US$37 million for Abydos II in Aswan, a 1,000 MW solar plant with battery storage, one of Egypt's largest clean energy projects.
details: The OPEC Fund is lending US$37 million to Abydos II in Aswan Governorate, a 1,000 MW solar plant with a 600 MWh battery, part of a US$571.8 million package arranged by the IFC.
context: It is one of Egypt's largest clean energy projects and should supply more than 3 million MWh a year, cutting about 1.6 million tonnes of CO2.

sources.title: OPEC Fund Supports Egypt’s Clean Energy Push with $37 Million Loan for Abydos II Solar Project

title: IREDA sanctions first international loan, for 100 MW solar in Zambia

buyers.name: IREDA Global Green Energy Finance IFSC

summary: IREDA's GIFT City subsidiary sanctioned its first international loan, for a 100 MW solar project in Zambia.
details: IREDA's subsidiary in GIFT City, IREDA Global Green Energy Finance IFSC, sanctioned a US$22.5 million loan to Swarna Solar for a 100 MW solar plant in Serenje District, Central Province, Zambia.
context: It is IREDA's first international loan, extending the Indian state lender's reach to African projects.

sources.title: IREDA Sanctions First International Loan For 100 MW Solar Project In Zambia

title: JERA Nex bp to buy EnBW's stake in Mona offshore wind farm
summary: JERA Nex bp is acquiring EnBW's stake in the Mona offshore wind project in the Irish Sea and signed its lease with The Crown Estate.
details: Mona could deliver up to 1.5 GW.

sources.title: JERA Nex bp acquires EnBW’s stake in the Mona offshore wind farm

title: Bison Energy sells Australia and New Zealand development portfolio to I Squared Capital
summary: Bison Energy sold its renewable development portfolio in Australia and New Zealand to I Squared Capital.
details: Bison Energy sold its renewable development portfolio in Australia and New Zealand to I Squared Capital. Terms were not disclosed.
context: The two already work together in Japan. Bison says selling development projects lets it turn over capital and focus its portfolio.

sources.title: Bison Energy completes sale of Australia and New Zealand renewables portfolio

title: TCL Zhonghuan plans to acquire controlling stake in solar cell and module maker DASOLAR

buyers.name: TCL Zhonghuan Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

summary: TCL Zhonghuan (TZE), a Chinese maker of silicon wafers for solar panels, has announced its intention to take a controlling stake in DASOLAR, a producer of N-type TOPCon solar cells and modules. No price, stake size or timetable was disclosed.
details: TZE is known for large G12 N-type silicon wafers, the thin slices of silicon that solar cells are built on. DASOLAR makes N-type TOPCon cells and finished modules and is described in the release as the second-largest shipper of N-type modules worldwide in 2024. The deal is a vertical integration, meaning TZE would combine its upstream wafer production with downstream cell and module manufacturing. The release says the two companies already work together as supplier and customer and plan a joint research platform for newer technologies such as back-contact and perovskite tandem cells. Financial terms, the exact stake, advisers and expected closing dates were not stated.
context: TZE says the acquisition fills its historical gap in finished solar products and supports its shift from materials supplier to a broader solar solutions provider. The company claims the deal will shorten development cycles, reduce reliance on outside suppliers and strengthen its position in premium markets. The release itself notes that the success of the integration will take time to prove.

sources.title: TCL Zhonghuan Announces Strategic Acquisition of DASOLAR to Accelerate the Development of a Vertical Integration Driven by N-type PV Technology

title: EBRD arranges up to US$195.5 million for 300 MW solar and battery in Kashkadarya, Uzbekistan
summary: The EBRD is arranging up to US$195.5 million for a 300 MW solar plant with a 75 MWh battery in Uzbekistan's Kashkadarya region.
details: The EBRD is arranging up to US$195.5 million (€168.5 million) for a greenfield 300 MW solar plant with a 75 MWh battery in Kashkadarya, including a senior loan of up to US$141.6 million and a guaranteed facility of up to US$25 million. The borrower is Nur Kashkadarya Solar, wholly owned by Masdar.
context: Masdar is building several solar and battery plants in Uzbekistan with development bank support as the country adds renewables.

sources.title: EBRD Drives Uzbekistan’s Energy Transition With US$195.5 Million Investment In Solar Plant And Battery System

title: NTPC Green Energy and GAIL form 50:50 renewables joint venture
summary: NTPC Green Energy's board approved a 50:50 joint venture with GAIL to develop renewable energy projects in India.
details: NTPC Green Energy's board approved a 50:50 joint venture with GAIL to develop renewable projects in India; the company still has to be incorporated.
context: Both partners are state-owned: NTPC Green Energy is the renewables arm of NTPC, and GAIL is a gas company. The venture adds to NTPC Green's joint ventures with state bodies.

sources.title: NTPC Green Energy And GAIL Join Hands To Launch 50:50 Joint Venture For Renewable Energy Projects

title: Dalmia Bharat takes 26% of TrueRE Surya for 128 MW captive solar
summary: Dalmia Bharat, through Dalmia Cement (Bharat), bought 26% of TrueRE Surya, an Oriana Power company, to secure 128 MW of captive solar power.
details: Dalmia Cement (Bharat), Dalmia Bharat's subsidiary, completed on 14 January 2026 the purchase of 2,62,60,337 shares, 26% of TrueRE Surya, an Oriana Power company, for ₹42.87 crore in cash. The project company will supply 128 MW of solar power to Dalmia's plants.
context: The deal follows a share subscription agreement disclosed in September 2024. The 26% stake gives Dalmia captive status and a long-term source of cheaper solar power.

sources.title: Dalmia Bharat Acquires 26% Stake In Truere Surya To Secure 128 MW Captive Solar Power

title: World Bank approves US$13.3 million for Cabo Verde's renewable energy transition
summary: The World Bank approved US$13.3 million of concessional IDA financing for Cabo Verde's Renewable Energy and Improved Utility Performance Project.
details: The World Bank approved US$13.3 million of concessional IDA financing for Cabo Verde's Renewable Energy and Improved Utility Performance Project. It is co-financed by a US$1.2 million loan and US$0.41 million grant from the Canada Clean Energy and Forest Climate Facility and a US$0.4 million reimbursable grant from the Global Infrastructure Facility.
context: Cabo Verde already has 98% electricity access and aims for 100% renewable power. The project also aims to improve the performance of the national utility.

sources.title: World Bank Approves $13.3 Million Concessional Financing for Cabo Verde’s Renewable Energy Transition

title: Al Dhafra solar plant refinanced with US$870.75 million green bonds
summary: TAQA, EWEC, Masdar, EDF power solutions and Jinko Power issued US$870.75 million of green bonds to refinance the Al Dhafra solar plant in Abu Dhabi.
details: TAQA, with EWEC, Masdar, EDF Power Solutions and Jinko Power, issued US$870.75 million of green bonds to refinance the Al Dhafra solar plant in Abu Dhabi. The bonds pay 5.794% and mature in June 2053, with expected ratings of A3 from Moody's and A from S&P. BNP Paribas and HSBC were joint global coordinators.
context: Refinancing an operating plant's bank loans with long-dated bonds suits its steady, contracted income. It was announced at Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week 2026.

sources.title: Abu Dhabi’s Al Dhafra Solar Plant Secures $870.75 Million Green Bond Financing For Sustainable Operations

title: EIB signs €175 million green loan with Iberdrola for 274 MW Tâmega wind farms
summary: The European Investment Bank signed a €175 million green loan with Iberdrola for two wind farms totalling 274 MW at the Tâmega pumped storage complex in northern Portugal.
details: The wind farms share the pumped storage plant's grid connection, a hybrid set-up.

sources.title: EIB and Iberdrola sign €175 million green loan to support Tâmega wind farms construction

title: Elevate Renewables buys 150 MW / 600 MWh Prospect Power Storage from Swift Current
summary: Elevate Renewables, an ArcLight company, acquired Prospect Power Storage, a 150 MW / 600 MWh battery under construction in Rockingham County, Virginia, from Swift Current Energy.
details: Elevate Renewables, an ArcLight company, bought Prospect Power Storage, a 150 MW / 600 MWh battery under construction in Rockingham County, Virginia, from Swift Current Energy. It is due to operate in mid-2026 and is fully contracted under a 15-year agreement with Dominion Energy Virginia.
context: It is the largest standalone battery in the PJM grid region, near Northern Virginia's data centre cluster, where power demand is rising fast.

sources.title: Elevate Renewables acquires Prospect Power Storage

title: KKR to take 50% of RWE's Norfolk Vanguard offshore wind projects
summary: RWE agreed a 50/50 joint venture with KKR for the Norfolk Vanguard East and West offshore wind projects in the UK North Sea, with KKR buying half of each.
details: RWE agreed a 50/50 joint venture with KKR for the Norfolk Vanguard East and West offshore wind projects in the UK North Sea, with KKR buying half of each. Closing is expected in summer 2026. Norton Rose Fulbright advised RWE.
context: The two projects won Contracts for Difference for 3.1 GW in the UK's January 2026 allocation round. Bringing in a partner shares the large construction cost.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises RWE on offshore wind joint venture

title: Lender club finances Aer Soléir's 250 MW / 1 GWh Rondissone battery in Italy
summary: ABN AMRO, BayernLB, CIBC, Nord/LB and Siemens Bank financed Aer Soléir's 250 MW / 1 GWh Rondissone battery in Piedmont, one of Italy's largest under construction.
details: ABN AMRO, BayernLB, CIBC, Nord/LB and Siemens Bank financed Aer Soléir's 250 MW / 1 GWh four-hour Rondissone battery in Piedmont, due online in the fourth quarter of 2027. It holds a 15-year capacity market contract won in early 2025 and a fixed toll with EGO Energy, a Shell Italia subsidiary. DLA Piper advised the lenders.
context: It is one of Italy's largest batteries under construction. The capacity contract and fixed toll give lenders predictable income, which made this first-of-its-kind financing possible.

sources.title: DLA Piper advises a club of lenders on Italian BESS project financing

title: Greenbacker sells 237 MW distributed solar and storage portfolio to Altus Power
summary: Greenbacker sold a 237 MW portfolio of distributed solar and storage assets to Altus Power, to focus on utility-scale projects.
details: Greenbacker sold more than 100 distributed solar and storage projects in 18 US states, 237 MW in total, to Altus Power, which owns and runs commercial-scale solar.
context: Greenbacker is concentrating on utility-scale projects, which it says offer higher efficiency and long-term value.

sources.title: Greenbacker Advances Utility-Scale Strategy With Sale Of 237 MW Distributed Solar Portfolio to Altus Power

title: EIB Global provides US$150 million for Obelisk solar project in Egypt
summary: EIB Global announced US$150 million for Scatec's Obelisk solar and battery project in Qena, Egypt, as the first phase was inaugurated.
details: EIB Global announced US$150 million for Scatec's Obelisk project in Qena, which combines 1.1 GW of solar with a 100 MW / 200 MWh battery, as the first phase was inaugurated in the presence of Egypt's prime minister.
context: Obelisk is one of Egypt's largest renewable projects, financed by several European and development lenders.

sources.title: EIB Backs Africa’s Largest Hybrid Solar Project with $150M Financing

title: Banks provide €135 million for ENCAVIS's 199 MW Spanish wind and solar portfolio
summary: A bank group led by NORD/LB, Rabobank and Siemens Bank provided €135 million for a 199 MW portfolio of three wind and two solar farms in Spain acquired by ENCAVIS.
details: NORD/LB and Rabobank, as lead arrangers, with Siemens Bank, provided €135 million for ENCAVIS's 199 MW Spanish portfolio of three wind farms and two solar farms: a €117 million term loan to June 2044, a €5 million debt service reserve facility and a €13 million letter of credit. Some assets operate and the rest are due in early 2026.
context: Long-dated debt on a mixed wind and solar portfolio spreads risk across technologies. ENCAVIS bought the portfolio before arranging the financing.

sources.title: Banks Back €135 Million Financing for 199MW Solar-Led Renewable Portfolio Acquired by ENCAVIS in Spain

title: Levanta Renewables buys 93 MWp operating solar portfolio in Thailand
summary: Levanta Renewables, Actis's Southeast Asian platform, acquired a fully operating 93 MWp ground-mounted solar portfolio across eight provinces in Thailand.
details: Levanta Renewables, Actis's Southeast Asian platform, bought a fully operating 93 MWp ground-mounted solar portfolio across eight Thai provinces. It produces more than 140 GWh a year for the Provincial and Metropolitan Electricity Authorities under long-term PPAs.
context: Levanta is targeting 1.5 GW. It later refinanced the portfolio, known as Daisy, with Kasikornbank and SMBC.

sources.title: Levanta Renewables Acquires 93 MWp Solar Portfolio in Thailand to Boost Southeast Asia Clean Energy Capacity

title: Crayhill and Monarch form US$300 million joint venture for hybrid preferred tax equity
summary: Crayhill Capital Management committed US$300 million to Monarch JVT, a joint venture with Monarch Private Capital for hybrid preferred tax equity in solar, storage and distributed projects.
details: Crayhill Capital Management committed US$300 million to Monarch JVT Funding, a joint venture with Monarch Private Capital. It will invest in hybrid preferred tax equity for utility-scale solar, storage and distributed generation.
context: The structure helps developers capture the full value of US tax credits in one package, without the complexity of selling credits separately.

sources.title: Crayhill And Monarch Launch Joint Venture with $300M To Fund Hybrid Preferred Tax Equity For Solar, Battery, And Distributed Energy Projects

title: Energy Transition Europe II provides €6.5 million junior debt for 58 MWp Hungarian solar
summary: ETIC Partners' Energy Transition Europe II fund provided €6.5 million of junior debt to refinance ID Energy Group's equity in two Hungarian solar plants totalling 58 MWp.
details: ETIC Partners' Energy Transition Europe II fund provided €6.5 million of junior debt to refinance ID Energy Group's equity in two Hungarian solar plants, 58 MWp in total, operating since 2025. One earns an incentive under Hungary's METÁR scheme and the other sells to Holcim's local subsidiary under a long-term PPA.
context: Junior debt lets the developer take money out of operating plants to reinvest. It is ETIC's fourth investment in Hungary.

sources.title: Energy Transition Europe II Makes Fourth Investment In Hungary, Financing 58 MWp Solar Portfolio With €6.5M Junior Debt

title: Elements Green buys 148.8 MW Bolney battery site from Envirotech
summary: Elements Green acquired the Bolney Green Energy Hub, a 148.8 MW four-hour battery development in West Sussex, from Envirotech Energy Solutions.
details: Elements Green bought the Bolney Green Energy Hub near Wineham, West Sussex, a 148.8 MW four-hour battery, from Envirotech Energy Solutions under a share purchase agreement. Mid-Sussex District Council granted planning in September 2024 and full operation is due in the fourth quarter of 2027. Bird & Bird and Everoze advised the buyer; Fladgate and Savills the seller.
context: Four-hour batteries can cover the evening demand peak. The deal is a large addition to Elements Green's UK portfolio.

sources.title: Elements Green completes acquisition of 149 MW BESS in the UK

title: Cubico refinances 75 MW wind and solar portfolio in Uruguay
summary: Cubico refinanced its 50 MW Vientos de Pastorale wind farm and added project debt to its 25 MW Alto Cielo solar plant in Uruguay in a single structure.
details: Cubico closed a single project financing of about US$90 million from lenders including BBVA and Itaú. It refinances the 50 MW Vientos de Pastorale wind farm and adds project debt to the 25 MW Alto Cielo solar plant, which had no debt before. Itaú also provides guarantees; BBVA is agent and account bank.
context: Combining two operating plants in one structure strengthens the capital profile of Cubico's Uruguayan portfolio and releases equity for new investment.

sources.title: Cubico closes refinancing of 75 MW wind and solar portfolio in Uruguay

title: Masdar signs PPA for 150 MW Quipungo solar in Angola
summary: Masdar signed its first PPA in Angola, for the 150 MW Quipungo solar project, the first site under its planned 500 MW Project Royal Sable.
details: Masdar signed a PPA with Angola's state grid company RNT-EP for the 150 MW Quipungo solar project, its first in the country. It is the first site in Project Royal Sable, a planned 500 MW programme across three sites to strengthen Angola's southern grid. It was signed at the IRENA General Assembly in Abu Dhabi.
context: Solar in southern Angola can supply a grid region that is far from the country's large hydro dams in the north.

sources.title: Masdar Signs First Power Purchase Agreement for 150MW Quipungo Solar Project in Angola

title: Zelestra signs €13 million BPER financing for first two Italian solar projects
summary: Zelestra signed about €13 million of senior green debt from BPER for its first two Italian solar projects: Ginosa (6.5 MWdc, Puglia) and Bellomo (9.5 MWdc, Sicily).
details: BPER, which also acts as hedging and agent bank, provided about €13 million of senior green debt for Zelestra's first two Italian solar plants: Ginosa (6.5 MWdc) in Puglia and Bellomo (9.5 MWdc) in Sicily. Both sell their output to Swiss energy group BKW under long-term PPAs.
context: It is Zelestra's first financing in Italy. Long-term contracts with an investment-grade buyer make even small plants bankable.

sources.title: Zelestra secures €13 million green financing for solar projects

title: Anesco buys 36 MWp Beachampton solar farm project
summary: Anesco acquired the consented 36 MWp Beachampton solar project in Buckinghamshire from One Planet Developments and its partners.
details: Anesco bought the consented 36 MWp Beachampton solar project in Buckinghamshire, developed by One Planet Developments with Viridi Re Development, Solar Ambition Europe and landowner Kingwell. Planning was granted in January 2024 and connection is due in early 2027.
context: The plant should power about 9,000 homes and avoid about 5,700 tonnes of CO2 a year, with hedgerow and woodland planting for biodiversity.

sources.title: Anesco acquires Beachampton solar farm from One Planet Developments

title: Scottish National Investment Bank commits £20 million to Renewco Power
summary: The Scottish National Investment Bank committed £20 million to Glasgow developer Renewco Power through a Corran Capital fund, alongside £9 million from existing investor SSE.
details: The Scottish National Investment Bank committed £20 million to Renewco Power, a Glasgow developer founded in 2021, through a fund managed by Corran Capital. Existing investor SSE adds £9 million.
context: Renewco has a pipeline of more than 7 GW across solar, onshore wind, storage and green hydrogen, with 38 staff in Glasgow, Edinburgh, London, Madrid and Milan.

sources.title: Scottish National Investment Bank Backs Renewco with £20 Million to Accelerate Renewable Energy Projects

title: Altus Power buys 12 MW operating solar portfolio from Hecate Energy
summary: Altus Power acquired a 12 MW operating solar portfolio in Florida, Georgia, Maryland and Rhode Island from Hecate Energy.
details: Altus Power bought a 12 MW operating solar portfolio in Florida, Georgia, Maryland and Rhode Island from Hecate Energy.
context: Altus owns more than 1.3 GW of operating solar across 600 projects in 30 states and Washington DC, selling to businesses and utilities.

sources.title: Altus Power Expands Solar Footprint with 12 MW Portfolio Acquisition Across Four States

title: IRSC signs 30-year PPA for 27 MW solar plant in Egypt
summary: IRSC for Renewable Energy Solutions signed a 30-year PPA to supply El Nahda Industries from a 27 MW solar plant in Egypt.
details: IRSC will build, own and run a 27 MW solar plant in Egypt and supply El Nahda Industries for 30 years. Its subsidiary handles financing, engineering, construction, operation and maintenance.
context: A long contract with an industrial buyer gives IRSC the revenue certainty it needs to raise project finance.

sources.title: IRSC Signs 30-Year PPA for 27 MW Solar Power Plant in Egypt

title: ConnectM takes 40% stake in Sun Solar
summary: ConnectM Technology Solutions acquired a 40% equity stake in Sun Solar, a US residential and small-commercial solar developer and installer.
details: ConnectM Technology Solutions acquired 40% of Sun Solar, a US residential and small-commercial solar installer. ConnectM expects the deal to raise its shareholders' equity by at least US$6.5 million, to more than US$9 million.
context: Sun Solar will be central to ConnectM's virtual power plant strategy, which links home solar and batteries to sell grid services.

sources.title: ConnectM Acquires 40% Stake in Sun Solar to Scale AI-Driven Renewable Energy and VPP Platform in the US

title: Inox Clean Energy raises ₹3,100 crore in equity round
summary: Inox Clean Energy raised ₹3,100 crore from foreign and domestic investors for about 5.8% dilution, to fund its 10 GW capacity target by FY2028.
details: Inox Clean Energy raised ₹3,100 crore at a pre-money valuation of ₹50,000 crore, diluting about 5.8%. Investors included CalPERS, SUN Group Global, Authum Investments, Akash Bhansali and family offices.
context: The money funds Inox's target of 10 GW of capacity by fiscal 2028. A US public pension fund's participation signals foreign appetite for Indian renewables.

sources.title: Inox Clean Energy Raises ₹3,100 Crore To Fuel 10 GW Capacity Target By FY2028

title: BII commits US$37 million to Abydos II solar and battery project in Egypt
summary: British International Investment committed US$37 million to AMEA Power's Abydos II solar and battery storage project in Egypt.
details: British International Investment committed US$37 million to Abydos II in Aswan Governorate, a US$737 million project combining 1 GWac of solar with a 600 MWh battery, developed by AMEA Power. It should produce about 2,910 GWh a year from 2026.
context: It is set to be one of Africa's largest solar and battery plants. BII joins a group of development lenders led by the IFC.

sources.title: BII Invests $37 Million In Egypt’s Abydos II, Boosting Africa’s Largest Solar And Battery Storage Project

title: ADNEC Group signs PPA with Positive Zero for 5 MWp rooftop solar
summary: ADNEC Group signed a PPA with Positive Zero for a 5 MWp rooftop solar system expected to supply about 30% of its Abu Dhabi centre's electricity.
details: Positive Zero will install a 5 MWp rooftop solar system on ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi and sell the power to ADNEC Group, part of Modon, under a PPA signed at the World Future Energy Summit.
context: The system should supply about 30% of the venue's electricity and cut about 6,000 tonnes of CO2.

sources.title: ADNEC Group Signs PPA With Positive Zero For 5 MWp Rooftop Solar, Cutting 6,000 Tonnes CO₂ And Powering 30% Of Centre’s Electricity

title: EBRD and EU provide €75 million to Ukrhydroenergo
summary: The EBRD and the EU provided a €75 million package to Ukraine's state hydropower company Ukrhydroenergo for critical equipment at its hydro plants.
details: The EBRD is lending up to €75 million to Ukrhydroenergo, with up to €20 million of donor grants and the company's own funds, for a €120 million project. It buys critical equipment for Ukraine's hydro plants, including an emergency reserve of electrical components, plus consultancy. The loan carries an EU guarantee.
context: Ukraine's power plants have been repeatedly attacked during the war; spare parts let damaged hydro units return to service quickly and keep supply resilient.

sources.title: EBRD And EU Provide €75M Loan To Ukraine’s Ukrhydroenergo For Hydro Plant Upgrades, Green Energy, Staff Training, And Wartime Energy Security

title: Ubombo Sugar signs 40 MW biomass PPA with Eswatini Electricity Company
summary: Ubombo Sugar signed a 40 MW biomass PPA with the Eswatini Electricity Company under the country's biomass procurement programme.
details: Ubombo Sugar will supply up to 40 MW of export capacity from biomass power to the Eswatini Electricity Company under a PPA signed through the country's biomass procurement programme, run by the Eswatini Energy Regulatory Authority.
context: Sugar mills burn bagasse, the fibre left after crushing cane, to make steam and power. Selling surplus power to the grid improves Eswatini's energy security.

sources.title: Eswatini Strengthens Energy Security with 40 MW Biomass Power PPA Between Ubombo Sugar Limited and EEC

title: Tokyo Century and Kyuden International to buy 20 MW Pennsylvania solar project
summary: Tokyo Century and Kyuden International agreed to jointly acquire full ownership of a 20 MW solar project in Pennsylvania developed by Oriden.
details: Tokyo Century and Kyuden International agreed to buy 100% of a 20 MW solar project in Pennsylvania from Oriden, a Mitsubishi Heavy Industries group developer. Tokyo Century will hold 50%.
context: It extends Tokyo Century's US renewables business, which began in June 2024 with a fund investment and development rights.

sources.title: Tokyo Century and Kyuden International Acquire 20 MW Solar Project in Pennsylvania to Expand US Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: Qualitas Energy buys 91 MW wind portfolio from PNE
summary: Qualitas Energy acquired a 91 MW portfolio of six wind projects at different stages from PNE.
details: Qualitas Energy bought six wind projects from PNE with 91 MW in total: three wind farms under construction in Rhineland-Palatinate, Hesse and Brandenburg (40.6 MW), bought turnkey, and rights to three greenfield projects in Hesse (50.4 MW).
context: Buying turnkey means PNE finishes construction before handover. The deal combines near-term operating capacity with a development pipeline.

sources.title: Qualitas Energy acquires wind energy portfolio from PNE AG

title: Spearmint Energy closes equity for two 100 MW / 200 MWh Texas batteries
summary: Spearmint Energy closed an equity investment in its Tierra Seca (Del Rio) and Seven Flags (Laredo) batteries in Texas, each 100 MW / 200 MWh.
details: Kyuden International, the overseas arm of Japan's Kyuden Group, made an equity investment in Spearmint Energy's Tierra Seca (Del Rio) and Seven Flags (Laredo) batteries in Texas, each 100 MW / 200 MWh.
context: Together they add 400 MWh of storage to the ERCOT grid, where fast-growing demand and wind and solar make batteries valuable.

sources.title: Spearmint Energy secures investment for 400 MWh battery energy storage across two projects

title: GIP to invest up to ₹3,000 crore in Aditya Birla Renewables
summary: Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock, will invest up to ₹3,000 crore in Grasim's Aditya Birla Renewables: ₹2,000 crore at first and an option on ₹1,000 crore more.
details: Global Infrastructure Partners, part of BlackRock, will invest up to ₹3,000 crore in Aditya Birla Renewables, Grasim's subsidiary: ₹2,000 crore at first and an option on ₹1,000 crore more, valuing the company at about ₹14,600 crore. It owns about 4.3 GW across ten states, including solar, hybrid, floating solar and round-the-clock projects.
context: It is one of the largest primary investments for a minority stake in an Indian renewables platform.

sources.title: GIP To Invest ₹3000 Crores In Aditya Birla Renewables To Boost India’s Clean Energy Expansion

title: Hydro Rein sells Energy Solutions unit to Global Green Asset Management
summary: Hydro Rein sold its Energy Solutions business, with assets in Sweden, Germany and Canada, to Norway's Global Green Asset Management, with employees joining as co-owners.
details: Hydro Rein sold its Energy Solutions business, which owns assets in Sweden, Germany and Canada, to Norway's Global Green Asset Management, with several employees joining as co-owners.
context: After reorganising in a difficult market, Hydro Rein is focusing on large renewable assets that supply industrial power demand.

sources.title: Hydro Rein Sells Energy Solutions Unit To Norway-Based Global Green Asset Management, Covering Assets In Sweden, Germany, And Canada

title: Masdar signs PPA for 200 MW floating solar at Chereh Dam, Malaysia
summary: Masdar signed a PPA for a 200 MW floating solar project at Chereh Dam in Pahang, its first in Malaysia and set to be Southeast Asia's largest floating solar plant.
details: A Masdar-led consortium with Citaglobal and Tiza Global signed a long-term PPA with Tenaga Nasional for a 200 MW floating solar plant on about 950 acres of the Chereh Dam reservoir in Pahang, with more than 300 MWp of panels.
context: It is Masdar's first project in Malaysia and is expected to be Southeast Asia's largest floating solar plant, supplying more than 100,000 homes.

sources.title: Masdar Secures PPA for Southeast Asia’s Largest 200 MW Floating Solar Project at Malaysia’s Chereh Dam

title: Juniper Green Energy secures ₹2,039 crore of debt
summary: Juniper Green Energy secured ₹2,039 crore of debt from lenders including NaBFID, HSBC, DBS and Barclays for its upcoming renewable projects.
details: Juniper Green Energy raised ₹2,039 crore of debt from NaBFID, HSBC, DBS, Barclays and Aseem Infrastructure Finance, and expanded non-fund credit limits with Federal Bank and Axis Bank.
context: It follows ₹1,739 crore raised in August 2025 and funds Juniper's upcoming wind, solar and hybrid projects.

sources.title: Juniper Green Energy Secures ₹2,039 Crore Debt Financing To Boost Renewable Energy Projects Across India

title: AIIB approves US$21 million for 100 MW Pasuruan solar in Indonesia
summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank approved US$21 million of non-sovereign financing for the 100 MW Pasuruan solar project under the Hijaunesia staple financing facility.
details: The AIIB approved US$21 million of non-sovereign financing for a greenfield 100 MW ground-mounted solar plant on about 401.5 acres in Pasuruan, East Java, under the Hijaunesia staple financing initiative, with the ADB as lead partner.
context: Staple financing offers pre-agreed loans to bidders in Indonesian tenders, which lowers their costs and helps the country add renewables.

sources.title: Indonesia’s Pasuruan 100 MW Solar Project Secures USD 21 Million Financing For Clean Energy Expansion

title: DTEK's D.TRADING signs offtake for 200 MW of Econergy solar in Romania
summary: D.TRADING, the trading arm of DTEK, signed an offtake agreement for 200 MW from Econergy's Ratesti and Parau solar projects in Romania.
details: D.TRADING, DTEK's European trading arm, will buy the output of 200 MW of Econergy's Rătești and Părău solar plants in Romania under a structured offtake agreement.
context: The deal helps commercialise two of Econergy's flagship Romanian assets, and reflects demand for tailored renewable supply products in the region.

sources.title: D.TRADING and Econergy sign solar PPA offtake agreement

title: Bruc refinances €474 million for 858 MW solar and 650 MW storage in Spain
summary: Bruc refinanced €474 million of non-recourse debt backing 858 MW of operating solar plants and 650 MW of planned storage in Spain.
details: Bruc refinanced €474 million of non-recourse green debt on 858 MW of operating solar in Andalusia, Aragón and Extremadura, with room to add 650 MW of batteries. Lenders were BNP Asset Management, Santander, Sabadell, Export Development Canada and Banco Cooperativo; Santander and Astris Finance advised.
context: Building the batteries into the refinancing lets Bruc store low-priced midday solar power, a growing issue in Spain.

sources.title: Bruc Secures €474 Million Refinancing To Back 858 MW Solar Plants And 650 MW Battery Storage Capacity Across Spain

title: Inox Clean Energy buys about 300 MWp of solar assets from SunSource
summary: Inox Clean Energy's IPP arm Inox Neo Energies bought about 250 MWp of operating solar projects from SunSource Energy, with about 50 MWp more pending approval.
details: Inox Neo Energies, Inox Clean Energy's IPP arm, bought about 250 MWp of operating solar projects from SunSource Energy, a subsidiary of Dutch group SHV Energy, with about 50 MWp more awaiting approval. The projects sit in project companies across 13 states, including Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra.
context: They sell power under long-term contracts to many creditworthy commercial and industrial customers, giving Inox a ready-made C&I customer base.

sources.title: Inox Clean Energy Acquires 250 MWp Solar Portfolio From SunSource, Expands Customer Base Across 13 States

title: ADM Solar Power signs 10 MW captive solar PPA with Avener Green
summary: ADM Solar Power signed a 10 MW captive open-access solar PPA with Avener Green to supply its Aligarh manufacturing unit.
details: ADM Solar Power will take 10 MW of solar from a captive open-access plant built by Avener Green to supply its solar module and cell factory in Aligarh.
context: Running a solar factory on solar power lowers both costs and the carbon footprint of the modules it makes.

sources.title: ADM Solar Power Signs 10 MW Captive Solar PPA with Avener Green to Power Aligarh Manufacturing Unit

title: SUSI Partners sells 89 MW Danish wind portfolio to NRGi
summary: SUSI Partners agreed to sell an 89 MW Danish onshore wind portfolio of 25 turbines to local utility NRGi Renewables.
details: SUSI Partners agreed to sell 25 onshore wind turbines at four Danish sites, 89 MW in total and about 275 GWh a year, to local utility NRGi Renewables. SUSI bought the assets in four deals between December 2018 and June 2019.
context: The sale is the final exit of SUSI Renewable Energy Fund II, launched in 2014, completing the fund's full life cycle.

sources.title: SUSI Partners completes sale of Danish onshore wind portfolio

title: TAURON secures nearly PLN 538 million from Poland's environment fund for 11 batteries

buyers.name: National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management

summary: TAURON Group companies signed agreements with Poland's National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management for nearly PLN 538 million to build 11 batteries between 2026 and 2028.
details: TAURON Group companies signed agreements with Poland's National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management for nearly PLN 538 million to build 11 batteries between 2026 and 2028, under a programme to improve grid stability.
context: TAURON plans 700 MW of batteries by 2030 and 1.4 GW by 2035 as part of its 2025–2035 strategy.

sources.title: TAURON Group companies secure nearly PLN 538 million in BESS financing

title: Entech closes €60 million loan facility
summary: Entech closed a three-year €60 million loan package with its banking partners, including a €30 million revolving credit facility, to fund business growth.
details: Entech closed a three-year €60 million package with its banks on 17 December: a €30 million revolving credit facility for working capital on projects and a €30 million signature line for bank guarantees.
context: Entech designs and installs solar, power conversion and storage systems. Guarantee lines are needed because clients require bank guarantees on large contracts.

sources.title: Entech Secures €60 Million Loan Facility to Support Renewable Energy Business Growth

title: Skyworth PV signs agreement for 10 MW solar project in Ocre, Italy through local joint venture

buyers.name: Skyworth PV
buyers.role: joint venture partner and EPC contractor

target: 10 MW distributed solar project in Ocre, Abruzzo, Italy
summary: Skyworth PV has signed an agreement covering a 10 MW distributed solar plant in Ocre, in Italy's Abruzzo region, marking the start of construction. The project is being carried out by a joint venture between Skyworth PV and an unnamed Italian partner.
details: The plant sits near the border of the Lazio and Abruzzo regions and is expected to produce about 14.059 million kWh of electricity a year. It has reached ready-to-build status, meaning permits and grid arrangements are in place so construction can begin. The project won a place in an Italian government feed-in tariff auction, a scheme that pays a set price for the power it produces. Skyworth PV acts as the EPC contractor, the firm responsible for engineering, procurement and construction, and will supply key equipment. No deal value or ownership split was disclosed.
context: Skyworth PV presents the deal as part of its expansion in Europe, alongside a separate 10 MW project in Bordeaux, France. The company says the joint venture pairs its technology, manufacturing and financing strengths with the partner's local market knowledge, and claims the model can be repeated elsewhere.

sources.title: Skyworth PV Secures 10 MW Solar Project in Italy

title: Orrön Energy sells three German agri-PV projects to Gülermak for up to €14 million
summary: Orrön Energy agreed to sell three German agri-PV development projects of about 234 MW to Gülermak Renewables for up to €14 million.
details: Orrön Energy agreed to sell three agri-PV development projects in eastern Germany, about 234 MW in total with options for co-located batteries, to Gülermak Renewables Deutschland for up to €14 million. €0.7 million is paid at closing and the rest on reaching development milestones up to ready-to-build.
context: Agri-PV lets farming continue under or between the panels. Milestone payments share development risk between seller and buyer.

sources.title: Orrön Energy Sells Three German Agri-PV Projects With 234 MW Capacity To Gülermak Renewables For Up To €14 Million

title: Greenvolt agrees to sell 253.1 MW Romanian wind project to ENGIE Romania
summary: Greenvolt Power agreed to sell a 253.1 MW onshore wind project in Romania to ENGIE Romania.
details: Greenvolt will build it and hand it over at commercial operation.
context: ENGIE Romania's renewable capacity doubles to 500 MW.

sources.title: Greenvolt Group sells wind project to ENGIE Romania

title: ib vogt sells 95.18 MWp Baobab solar project in Spain to EOS NER
summary: ib vogt sold the 95.18 MWp Baobab solar project in Segovia to EOS NER Solar España, part of Swiss producer EOS Holding.
details: ib vogt sold the 95.18 MWp Baobab solar plant in Segovia to EOS NER Solar España, part of Swiss producer EOS Holding. It produces about 190 GWh a year and has a 15-year PPA.
context: The deal supports EOS's expansion in Iberia; for ib vogt it recycles capital into new development.

sources.title: ib vogt sells Baobab solar project to EOS NER Solar España

title: IFC invests US$300 million in Argentina's Central Puerto
summary: The IFC announced a US$300 million investment in Central Puerto to develop hydropower and 150 MW of battery storage that strengthen Argentina's grid.
details: The IFC's US$300 million package supports Central Puerto's purchase of shares in the 1,440 MW Piedra del Águila hydropower plant, awarded in December 2025 in the privatisation of the Limay River dams, and other projects including battery storage.
context: Piedra del Águila is critical to Argentina's grid stability. The IFC says the investment will make the system more reliable and flexible and help integrate renewables.

sources.title: IFC Invests US$300M In Central Puerto To Boost Argentina’s Grid With Hydropower & 150 MW Battery Storage

title: Lightrock invests US$40 million in Sun King
summary: Lightrock invested US$40 million in off-grid solar provider Sun King to expand solar home systems across Africa and Asia.
details: Lightrock invested US$40 million of equity in Sun King, which sells off-grid solar home systems and efficient appliances to households and businesses in Africa and Asia.
context: Sun King's kits replace kerosene lamps, diesel generators and wood fires. The money will speed rollout in sub-Saharan Africa, where millions lack reliable power.

sources.title: Lightrock Invests $40 Million In Sun King To Expand Off-Grid Solar Access Across Africa And Asia

title: IREDA lends ₹125 crore to Sahaj Solar for solar pumps and off-grid projects
summary: IREDA signed a ₹125 crore medium-term loan with Sahaj Solar for 15,000 solar pumps and 300 off-grid solar projects.
details: IREDA signed a ₹125 crore medium-term loan with Sahaj Solar on 18 December 2025, at 10.9%, to install 15,000 solar pumps under PM-KUSUM components B and C and 300 off-grid solar plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Punjab.
context: PM-KUSUM supports solar irrigation pumps and small plants serving farmers. The loan lets Sahaj, a solar manufacturer and installer, fund thousands of installations across four states.

sources.title: IREDA Extends ₹125 Crore Loan To Sahaj Solar For 15,000 Solar Pumps And 300 Off-Grid Solar Projects

title: NTPC board approves renewables joint venture with EDF
summary: NTPC's board approved a joint venture with EDF to expand renewable energy projects, alongside a Mauritius subsidiary for overseas growth.
details: NTPC's board approved a 50:50 joint venture with EDF Power Solutions India to develop pumped storage plants in India, and a Mauritius subsidiary for overseas growth.
context: Pumped storage stores power by pumping water uphill and releasing it later, providing long-duration storage to balance solar and wind.

sources.title: NTPC Approves Joint Venture With EDF And Mauritius Subsidiary To Expand Renewable Energy Projects

title: EBRD lends up to €37 million for 134 MW Bitola 3 solar in North Macedonia
summary: The EBRD is lending up to €37 million, alongside €50 million from KfW, to state generator ESM for the 134 MWdc Bitola 3 solar plant in North Macedonia.
details: The EBRD is lending up to €37 million, sovereign-guaranteed, to state generator ESM for the 134 MWdc Bitola 3 solar plant on a former coal mine at Bitola, alongside a €50 million loan from KfW.
context: It is the first project the EBRD and KfW finance and implement together, and a centrepiece of North Macedonia's Just Energy Transition Investment Platform.

sources.title: EBRD Provides €37M Loan To North Macedonia’s ESM For 134 MW Bitola 3 Solar Plant With KfW’s €50M Support

title: Mobi Solar Philippines and Long Neng Power form US$60 million solar joint venture
summary: Mobi Solar Philippines and Long Neng Power Philippines signed a US$60 million joint venture to develop solar projects in the Philippines.
details: Mobi Solar Philippines and Long Neng Power Philippines formed a joint venture that will invest US$20 million over three years to build 30 MW of solar, then US$40 million over a second three years to reach 60 MW, through their Hong Kong affiliates.
context: The venture pairs Long Neng's experience in solar generation and industrial storage with Mobi Solar's local business with commercial clients.

sources.title: Mobi Solar Philippines, Long Neng Power Form USD 60 Million Joint Venture to Develop Solar Projects

title: Saeta Yield closes €340 million Portuguese refinancing and €200 million Spanish credit facility
summary: Masdar's Saeta Yield closed a €340 million refinancing of its Portuguese assets and a €200 million revolving credit facility in Spain.
details: Saeta Yield, a Masdar company, closed €340 million of senior loans maturing in 2041 to refinance its Portuguese assets, and a €200 million revolving credit facility in Spain. Lenders included Bank of America, BBVA, Crédit Agricole CIB, DWS and Millennium; ING advised.
context: The refinancing was heavily oversubscribed. The new facilities give Saeta funding to grow its Iberian portfolio, including more solar in Portugal.

sources.title: Saeta Yield Bolsters Iberian Expansion with €340 Million Refinancing, Unlocking Solar Additions and Hybrid Renewable Projects

title: Encavis buys Italy's largest solar portfolio, 248 MW, from EDP Renewables
summary: Encavis acquired five solar plants totalling 248 MW from EDP Renewables, Italy's largest solar portfolio.
details: Encavis bought five solar plants with 248 MW from EDP Renewables: three in Lazio and two in Puglia, plus 17 MW to be added at the Lazio plants. They earn revenue under long-term PPAs or incentives. Watson Farley & Williams advised on the purchase and financing.
context: It is described as Italy's largest solar portfolio and one of the largest in Europe. Their long-term contracts give the new owner stable revenue.

sources.title: WFW advises Encavis on acquisition of Italy’s largest solar portfolio

title: BayWa r.e. sells largest Dutch floating solar project to Friesland community buyers
summary: BayWa r.e. and GroenLeven sold the rights to a floating solar project in Friesland to a local energy cooperative, the municipality of Tytsjerksteradiel and the Friesland Clean Energy Fund.
details: BayWa r.e. and its Dutch subsidiary GroenLeven sold the rights to the Skûlenboarch floating solar project in Friesland, 46 MW on 35 hectares, to local energy cooperative Enerzjyk Skûlenboarch, the municipality of Tytsjerksteradiel and the Friesland Clean Energy Fund, who will build it.
context: It will be the largest floating solar park in the Netherlands, supplying more than 15,500 households, and keeps ownership in local hands.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. completes sale of largest floating-PV project in the Netherlands

title: ACME Solar secures ₹4,725 crore of long-term debt
summary: ACME Solar secured ₹4,725 crore of long-term financing and refinancing from Indian lenders to build projects and lower its financing costs.
details: ACME Solar's subsidiaries secured ₹4,725 crore of new and refinancing debt with 18 to 20-year tenors, including ₹2,716 crore from Power Finance Corporation for the 300 MW ACME Sigma firm and dispatchable project with four-hour batteries, and ₹800 crore from NaBFID for a 150 MW project.
context: Long tenors from state-backed lenders lower ACME's financing costs and match the decades-long life of its plants.

sources.title: ACME Solar Secures INR 4,725 Crore in Long-Term Debt to Fund Renewable Projects and Optimise Capital Structure

title: Green Venture closes €55.1 million for 104.7 MWp Portuguese solar portfolio
summary: Green Venture closed €55.1 million with Kommunalkredit for a 104.7 MWp solar portfolio of 22 SPVs across Portugal.
details: Kommunalkredit, as sole arranger and lender, provided €55.1 million to Green Venture for a 104.7 MWp solar portfolio of 22 project companies across Portugal: a €40.1 million senior bridge facility and a €15 million subordinated term loan. Marsh Risk & Capital advised.
context: Green Venture says the many small sites made the deal complex. Combining senior and subordinated debt from one lender reduces the equity it must put in.

sources.title: Green Venture Secures €55.1 Million Financing for 104.7 MWp Solar Portfolio in Portugal

title: Aboitiz-led Thunder Consortium secures ₱70 billion bridge loans for CBK hydro acquisition
summary: The Aboitiz-led Thunder Consortium secured two ₱35 billion bridge loans, up to ₱70 billion (about US$1.19 billion), to part-fund its purchase of the Caliraya-Botocan-Kalayaan hydro complex.
details: The Thunder Consortium of Aboitiz Renewables, Sumitomo and J-POWER secured two ₱35 billion bridge loans from BDO Unibank and Metrobank, up to ₱70 billion (about US$1.19 billion), to part-fund its purchase of the Caliraya-Botocan-Kalayaan hydro complex.
context: A bridge loan funds the acquisition until long-term financing is arranged. AboitizPower says the purchase is a major addition to its renewable portfolio.

sources.title: Thunder Consortium secures $1.19b bridge loan for CBK hydro acquisition

title: Pivot Energy secures $225 million in financing from ATLAS, First Citizens and Comerica for US community solar
target: Portfolio of about 60 community solar projects
summary: Denver-based solar developer Pivot Energy has closed three financing agreements worth a combined $225 million with three of its existing lenders. The bulk of the money supports a new portfolio of roughly 60 community solar projects totalling about 225 MW across nine US states.
details: The package includes a $170 million upsize of an existing construction warehouse facility with ATLAS SP and First Citizens Bank. A warehouse facility is a revolving loan that funds many projects during construction before they are refinanced with long-term debt. The projects are in Illinois, Colorado, Maryland, Virginia, New York, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Michigan and California, and ATLAS says it committed the majority of the upsize. First Citizens also provided a $40 million equipment facility to buy US-made panels from Silfab Solar, which the bank says secures Pivot's access to safe-harbored investment tax credits, meaning tax credits locked in by buying equipment early. Comerica Bank added a $15 million corporate financing facility.
context: The deal follows a $450 million warehouse facility Pivot raised last year, and brings the company's total financing in 2025 to $435 million. Pivot, which is backed by Energy Capital Partners, presents the raise as evidence that strong solar developers can still attract capital despite federal policy headwinds. Community solar lets households and businesses subscribe to a shared local solar farm instead of installing panels themselves.

sources.title: Pivot Energy Secures Over $225 Million from Three Existing Lenders to Advance Community Solar Projects

title: TotalEnergies signs 21-year PPA with Google for 1 TWh of Malaysian solar
summary: TotalEnergies signed a 21-year PPA with Google for 1 TWh of power from the Citra Energies solar plant in Kedah to support Google's Malaysian data centre.
details: TotalEnergies signed a 21-year PPA with Google for 1 TWh from the Citra Energies solar plant in Kedah, owned 49% by TotalEnergies and 51% by MK Land. The plant was awarded in August 2023 under Malaysia's Corporate Green Power Programme and will start construction in early 2026; the PPA takes effect at financial close.
context: The power will support Google's data centre operations in Malaysia. A 21-year contract with a large technology buyer gives the plant long-term revenue to support its financing.

sources.title: TotalEnergies enters 21-year PPA for 1 TWh of Malaysian solar power

title: TotalEnergies sells 50% of 424 MW Greek wind and solar portfolio to Asterion
summary: TotalEnergies closed the sale of 50% of its 424 MW wind and solar portfolio in Greece to Asterion Industrial Partners, valuing the portfolio at €508 million (about €1.2 million per MW).
details: TotalEnergies stays operator and buys most of the output.

sources.title: TotalEnergies divests 50% of a 424 MW portfolio in Greece

title: OX2 secures €330 million for three Finnish wind farms totalling 277 MW
summary: OX2 secured €330 million of project finance from KfW IPEX, NatWest, Nordea and SEB to build three onshore wind farms in Finland totalling 277 MW.
details: KfW IPEX, NatWest, Nordea and SEB provided €330 million of project finance for OX2 to build three greenfield onshore wind farms in Finland, 277 MW in total. Watson Farley & Williams advised the lenders.
context: Together with €600 million raised earlier in 2025, OX2 has financed 750 MW of Finnish onshore wind that year.

sources.title: WFW advises lenders on €330 million OX2 Finnish onshore wind project financing

title: Qair buys Eno Energy's French subsidiary and German projects
summary: Qair acquired Eno Energy's French subsidiary EEF SAS and some of its German development projects.
details: Qair bought Eno Energy's French subsidiary EEF SAS and some of Eno's German development projects, about 260 MW across France, Germany and Belgium, some of which should be ready to build soon. Capcora advised Eno.
context: The deal adds to Qair's wind pipeline and broadens its mix of technologies. Taking over a whole subsidiary brings its staff and projects together, which Qair says ensures continuity.

sources.title: Qair strengthens European wind portfolio with acquisition of Eno Energy’s French subsidiary

title: Soltage closes $80 million development revolver led by First Citizens Bank and East West Bank

buyers.name: First Citizens Bank
buyers.role: sole bookrunner, administrative agent and coordinating lead arranger

summary: US independent power producer Soltage has closed an $80 million syndicated development revolving credit facility. First Citizens Bank leads the facility and East West Bank joins as a coordinating lead arranger. The money will fund early-stage work on Soltage's distributed solar and storage pipeline, which the company puts at more than 2 GW.
details: The facility is a multi-year revolver, meaning Soltage can borrow, repay and borrow again up to the limit as needs arise. It is syndicated, so several banks share the lending. It is meant to cover development-stage costs such as interconnection deposits, which are payments to secure a grid connection, and equipment purchases. Soltage describes it as its first major pre-notice-to-proceed financing, meaning funding available before projects are cleared to start construction. First Citizens Bank acts as sole bookrunner and administrative agent, the bank that arranges the syndicate and manages the loan.
context: Soltage says it has developed more than 125 projects totaling over 500 MW of distributed generation capacity across the US. The company presents the facility as a sign of lender confidence and expanded financial capacity, and expects it to help it deploy capital efficiently across its pipeline. First Citizens Bank noted it has an existing relationship with Soltage.

sources.title: Soltage Closes $80 Million Syndicated Development Revolver Facility to Accelerate Solar & Storage Deployment

title: AboitizPower takes full ownership of Ubay Solar for US$8.5 million
summary: AboitizPower, through Aboitiz Renewables, took 100% of Ubay Solar Corp., which is developing a solar project in Ubay, Bohol, in a US$8.5 million deal.
details: Aboitiz Renewables, AboitizPower's subsidiary, exercised a call option agreed in January 2025 with Ignis Philippines Development to take 100% of Ubay Solar, which is developing a greenfield solar project in Ubay, Bohol. Shares transferred on 12 December, with US$8.5 million paid in phases on project milestones.
context: AboitizPower says the deal speeds up its renewable growth plan. Paying in phases tied to milestones means most of the price is due only as the project advances.

sources.title: Aboitiz Power acquires full stake in Ubay Solar for $8.5m

title: ACCIONA Energía sells 49% of 1.3 GW US solar and 321 MW Mexican wind to MIP
summary: ACCIONA Energía agreed to sell Mexico Infrastructure Partners 49% of a 1.3 GW US solar portfolio and all of two Mexican wind farms of 321 MW, in a deal worth about US$1 billion.
details: ACCIONA Energía agreed to sell Mexico Infrastructure Partners 49% of four operating US solar plants totalling 1.3 GW (Red Tailed Hawk 458 MWp and Fort Bend 316 MWp in Texas, High Point 127 MWp in Illinois and Union Solar in Ohio) and all of two Mexican wind farms of 321 MW. The equity value is about US$1 billion (€855 million).
context: Selling a minority stake in the US plants lets ACCIONA release capital while keeping control of them. The Mexican wind farms are sold outright.

sources.title: ACCIONA Energía Sells 49% Stake In 1.3 GW U.S. Solar Portfolio And 321 MW Mexico Wind Assets To MIP In US$1B Deal

title: Sonnedix refinances 1.3 GW European solar portfolio with €2 billion
summary: Sonnedix completed a €2 billion refinancing of 50 solar plants with 1.3 GW in Spain, Italy, France, Portugal, Poland and the UK.
details: Sonnedix refinanced 50 solar plants, 1.3 GW in total, in Spain, Italy, France, Portugal, Poland and the UK with €2 billion from Bank of China, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, ING, Intesa Sanpaolo, La Banque Postale, Santander CIB and Société Générale. DNV was technical adviser.
context: A single large refinancing across six countries lowers Sonnedix's cost of debt and releases capital for new investment.

sources.title: DNV supports Sonnedix’s €2 billion refinancing for solar portfolio

title: Ocean Winds closes about €2 billion financing for BC-Wind offshore project in Poland
summary: Ocean Winds, the EDP Renewables–ENGIE joint venture, closed about €2 billion of financing for the BC-Wind offshore wind farm in the Polish Baltic Sea, with EIB participation.
details: Ocean Winds, the 50:50 EDP Renewables–ENGIE joint venture, closed about €2 billion of financing for the BC-Wind offshore wind farm in the Polish Baltic Sea. The EIB provides close to a third, alongside Spain's ICO and 13 commercial banks. Norton Rose Fulbright advised the lenders.
context: The financing takes the project from development into construction. The EIB's large share reflects what the lenders call the maturity and long-term stability of the investment.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises lenders on €2 billion project financing for offshore wind farm

title: Doral Renewables signs PPA with unnamed US corporation for 270 MWac Lambs Draw Solar in Kansas
summary: Doral Renewables has signed a power purchase agreement with an unnamed large US corporation for its 270 MWac Lambs Draw Solar Project in Decatur County, Kansas. The buyer will take all of the plant's electricity and the related renewable energy credits.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific power plant. Under this deal the corporate buyer takes 100% of the project's output plus its Renewable Energy Credits, which are certificates proving a unit of power came from a renewable source. The project sits in the Southwest Power Pool, the grid operator covering Kansas and nearby states, and has not yet started construction. LevelTen Energy acted as the marketplace and platform that matched Doral with the buyer. The contract length and price were not disclosed.
context: Doral says the deal lifts its contracted generation to nearly 2 GW. The company describes it as the latest in a series of 2025 milestones, including a $1.5 billion debt financing for the Mammoth Solar project in Indiana, tax equity for Great Bend Solar in Ohio and an offtake deal for Cold Creek Solar in Texas. Doral also claims the project will be one of the largest energy investments in the region and create hundreds of construction jobs.

sources.title: Doral Renewables Inks Power Purchase Agreement for the Lambs Draw Solar Project in Kansas

title: Exxaro's Cennergi to buy majority stakes in 213 MW of South African wind and solar
summary: Exxaro, through Cennergi, will buy majority stakes in two operating South African assets totalling 213 MW, including the 138 MW Gouda Wind Farm.
details: Cennergi, Exxaro's renewables subsidiary, signed binding agreements with Acciona Energía to buy majority stakes in the 138 MW Gouda wind farm in the Western Cape and the 75 MW Sishen solar plant in the Northern Cape, plus their operations company, for R1.7 billion to R1.8 billion depending on timing.
context: Both plants were developed under Bid Window 2 of South Africa's renewable IPP procurement programme. Exxaro says the purchase scales up its renewable energy business.

sources.title: Exxaro Expands Renewable Portfolio In South Africa With Majority Stake Acquisition In 213 MW Wind And Solar Assets

title: Vena Energy reaches financial close on Opus solar project in the Philippines
summary: Vena Energy reached financial close on the Opus solar project, its first fully international project financing in the Philippines, with banks from Singapore, Hong Kong and Japan.
details: Opus was awarded under the government's second Green Energy Auction.

sources.title: Vena Group reaches financial close on internationally-financed renewables project

title: Tactical Infrastructure Partners and GoodLeap close $140.2 million residential solar lease and PPA securitization
summary: GoodLeap and Tactical Infrastructure Partners closed TIP Solar ABS 2025-2, a $140.2 million securitization backed by residential solar leases and power purchase agreements originated on GoodLeap's platform in the United States. It is Tactical's second such issuance under its partnership with GoodLeap.
details: A securitization pools many small contracts, here home solar leases and PPAs (agreements where homeowners pay for the power a system produces), and sells bonds backed by their payments. The deal provides permanent, long-term financing for residential solar assets Tactical previously invested in alongside GoodLeap. Kroll Bond Rating Agency rated the notes and ATLAS SP Partners acted as sole structuring agent. The systems are third-party owned, meaning the investor rather than the homeowner owns the equipment.
context: The issuance builds on a partnership under which Tactical plans to acquire more than $1.5 billion of residential solar and storage products originated through GoodLeap. The companies say the deal frees up capital to expand deployment of third-party owned solar and storage systems. GoodLeap states it has provided more than $32 billion in solar and home efficiency loans since 2018.

sources.title: GoodLeap and Tactical Infrastructure Partners Announce Closing of $140.2 Million Securitization Backed by GoodLeap-Originated Solar Leases and Power Purchase Agreements

title: K2 Infragen takes 49% of Animaus Energy for 2 MW Haryana solar
summary: K2 Infragen acquired 49% of Animaus Energy, which has a PPA at ₹2.99/kWh with Haryana's power purchase centre for a 2 MW solar plant.
details: K2 Infragen bought 49% of Animaus Energy, which has a PPA with the Haryana Power Purchase Centre at ₹2.99 per kWh for a 2 MW solar plant. K2 will develop and build the plant and plans to make Animaus a wholly owned subsidiary once approvals allow.
context: K2 Infragen wants a base of annuity-like renewable assets with steady long-term income.

sources.title: K2 Infragen To Build 2 MW Solar Plant In Haryana After Acquiring 49% Stake In Animaus Energy; Power Purchase Agreement Signed At ₹2.99/kWh

title: NewPower Energy buys 30 MWp Cambridge solar project from Lightyears Solar
summary: NewPower Energy acquired a fully consented 30 MWp solar project near Cambridge from Lightyears Solar, with construction due in early 2026.
details: NewPower Energy bought a fully consented 30 MWp solar project near Cambridge, New Zealand, from Lightyears Solar. Infratec, a fellow WEL Networks subsidiary, will build it with more than 45,000 sun-tracking panels; construction starts in early 2026.
context: The companies say the project will be developed with the local community and mana whenua, the local Māori, and will strengthen the region's energy resilience.

sources.title: NewPower Energy Acquires 30 MWp Cambridge Solar Project from Lightyears Solar; Construction to Begin in Early 2026

title: Tages Capital SGR closes €671 million green loan for its 272 MWp Italian solar fleet
summary: Tages Capital SGR, Italy's second-largest solar operator, closed a €671 million non-recourse green loan to refinance its 272 MWp portfolio, upgrade plants and add storage.
details: Tages Capital SGR closed a €671 million non-recourse green loan in two phases: €276 million in October 2024 and €395 million in October 2025, from a group of seven banks including Banco BPM. It refinances its whole 272 MWp solar portfolio and funds repowering, capacity upgrades and batteries.
context: Tages is Italy's second-largest solar operator by capacity. Repowering older plants with newer panels raises output from the same sites.

sources.title: Massive €671 Million Green Loan Positions Tages Capital SGR to Modernise 272 MWp PV Fleet and Scale Energy Storage Across Italy

title: BayWa r.e. sells two French solar projects totalling 44 MWp to Heling Enr
summary: BayWa r.e. completed the sale of two solar projects under construction in France, Gièvres (21 MWp, on a former sand quarry) and Salsigne-Villardonnel, about 44 MWp in total, to Heling Enr.
details: Both are due to start operating in summer 2026.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells French solar farms

title: Origis Energy closes $290 million debt financing for Swift Air Solar II and III in Texas

buyers.name: Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking
buyers.role: coordinating lead arranger, green loan coordinator and administrative agent

target: Swift Air Solar II and Swift Air Solar III
summary: Origis Energy has reached financial close, meaning the funding is fully secured, on $290 million of senior secured debt for its Swift Air Solar II and III projects in Ector County, Texas. The two solar projects total 313 MWdc and the loans come from Natixis CIB and Santander.
details: The debt package combines a construction loan, a longer-term loan, and a tax credit bridge loan, which is short-term money repaid once the projects' federal tax credits are monetized. Natixis CIB and Santander acted as lead arrangers, hedging banks and letter-of-credit issuers, with Natixis CIB also serving as administrative agent and green loan coordinator. The projects will sell power and renewable energy credits to Occidental and its subsidiary OLCV Stratos Development under two 15-year power purchase agreements, supplying the STRATOS direct air capture facility being built in the Permian Basin. Commercial operation is expected in the fourth quarter of 2025. Latham & Watkins and Reed Smith advised Origis, while Milbank and Husch Blackwell advised the lenders.
context: The projects form the first phase of a planned 600 MW solar complex in West Texas and follow the 184 MWdc Swift Air Solar I project, also contracted with Oxy. Origis says the deal supports its goal of bringing more than 3 GW of long-term contracted assets online by the end of 2026. It is the first project financing jointly led for Origis by the two banks, which previously worked with the company on construction and development facilities.

sources.title: Origis Energy Closes $290 Million Financing for Swift Air Solar II and III Projects with Natixis CIB and Santander

title: NTPC Green Energy and CSPGCL form joint venture for 2 GW in Chhattisgarh
summary: NTPC Green Energy and Chhattisgarh State Power Generation Company incorporated Chhattisgarh NTPC Green Energy, a joint venture to develop 2 GW of renewables in the state.
details: NTPC Green Energy (74%) and Chhattisgarh State Power Generation Company (26%) incorporated Chhattisgarh NTPC Green Energy on 5 December 2025. It will build about 2 GW of solar, wind, hybrid and floating solar, including large renewable energy parks.
context: It is one of several joint ventures NTPC Green Energy has formed with state utilities. The planned parks would host large blocks of renewable capacity in Chhattisgarh.

sources.title: NGEL and CSPGCL Form Joint Venture to Develop 2 GW Renewable Energy Capacity in Chhattisgarh

title: Advantage Capital and Origis Energy close US$265 million tax equity for three solar projects
summary: Advantage Capital closed a US$265 million tax equity commitment with Origis Energy for three utility-scale solar projects in Florida and Alabama.
