details: Advantage Capital closed a US$265 million tax equity commitment for three Origis Energy solar projects in Florida and Alabama, including US$65 million for the 96 MWdc Whistling Duck project in Levy County, Florida, due online in late 2025.
context: Tax equity investors fund projects in exchange for US tax credits; both firms highlight benefits for rural communities.

sources.title: Advantage Capital And Origis Energy Close $265M Tax Equity Deal To Fund Three Utility-Scale Solar Projects In Florida And Alabama

title: African Development Fund approves US$22.9 million grant for Malawi hydro rehabilitation
summary: The African Development Fund approved a US$22.9 million grant toward a US$118.7 million programme to rehabilitate Malawi's Kapichira I and Nkula B hydropower plants.
details: The African Development Fund approved a US$22.9 million grant toward a US$118.7 million programme to rehabilitate Malawi's Kapichira I (64 MW) in Chikwawa District and Nkula B (100 MW), the oldest major hydro station, built in 1966.
context: The two plants supply about half of Malawi's electricity but run well below capacity because of ageing equipment and cyclone damage.

sources.title: African Development Fund approves grant to revitalise Malawi's critical hydropower infrastructure

title: ReFeel New Energy sells 52 MW Tuscany battery project to ENGIE Italia
summary: ReFeel New Energy, a joint venture of ReFeel and SUSI Partners, sold a ready-to-build 52 MW battery project in Tuscany to ENGIE Italia.
details: The project won a 15-year capacity market contract in Terna's February 2025 auction.

sources.title: ReFeel New Energy sells battery storage project

title: LS Power completes acquisition of bp's 1,300 MW US onshore wind business

buyers.name: Clearlight Energy
buyers.role: LS Power affiliate integrating the assets

target: BP Wind Energy North America Inc.
summary: LS Power has closed its purchase of BP Wind Energy North America, bp's US onshore wind business. The deal brings about 1,300 MW of net operating wind capacity across 10 projects in seven US states. No price was disclosed.
details: The 10 operating wind projects are in Indiana, Kansas, South Dakota, Colorado, Pennsylvania, Hawaii and Idaho, and the 1,300 MW figure is LS Power's net share of their capacity. The business will be folded into Clearlight Energy, an LS Power renewable platform set up in 2025, which will then manage about 4,300 MW of wind, solar and battery assets in the US and Canada. The deal closed on December 9, 2025, after regulatory approvals and other standard conditions were met. Greenberg Traurig advised LS Power on legal matters, while Barclays and Santander acted as financial advisers.
context: LS Power says buying projects that already operate helps it meet fast-rising electricity demand at a time when building new plants is taking longer. The company describes its strategy as pursuing many types of energy at once. After the deal, LS Power reports operating over 22,300 MW of US generation capacity plus more than 780 miles of high-voltage transmission lines.

sources.title: LS Power Completes Acquisition of bp's US Onshore Wind Business

title: NextEra and Meta reach about 2.5 GW of clean energy contracts
summary: NextEra Energy Resources and Meta reached about 2.5 GW of clean energy contracts through 11 PPAs and two energy storage agreements across the US.
details: NextEra Energy Resources and Meta have reached about 2.5 GW of contracts: PPAs for 2.1 GW from nine solar projects in the ERCOT, SPP and MISO markets, and two energy storage agreements.
context: Meta is signing large volumes of renewable supply to match its data centres' growing power use.

sources.title: NextEra Energy And Meta Reach 2.5 GW Clean Energy Milestone With 11 PPAs And 2 Energy Storage Deals Across The U.S.

title: Deutsche Bahn signs two long-term solar PPAs with Blue Elephant Energy for 2.5 TWh
summary: Deutsche Bahn's DB Energie signed two long-term PPAs with Blue Elephant Energy for about 2.5 TWh of solar power in total.
details: DB Energie signed two PPAs of up to 13 years with Blue Elephant Energy for about 2.5 TWh in total from two large solar parks in Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg, due by mid-2027.
context: The power will run Deutsche Bahn's ICE trains for about 14 million kilometres a year. Long contracts with the railway helped the parks get built.

sources.title: Deutsche Bahn Signs Two Long-Term PPAs For 2.5 TWh Solar Power, Green Energy To Power ICE Trains 14 Million km Annually

title: Squadron Energy secures A$1 billion for Clarke Creek wind farm
summary: Squadron Energy secured A$1 billion from a group of 10 banks for the Clarke Creek wind farm in Queensland, which will exceed 1 GW.
details: Squadron Energy secured A$1 billion from a group of ten banks for the Clarke Creek wind farm in Queensland, which will exceed 1 GW. Stage one, 100 turbines and 450 MW, recently opened.
context: The first stage alone can power about 330,000 Queensland homes. Squadron says the farm is pivotal to Australia's energy transition.

sources.title: Squadron Energy secures $1b financing for Clarke Creek Wind Farm

title: TOYO buys remaining 24.99% of US solar module maker TOYO Solar LLC
summary: Japan-based, Nasdaq-listed solar company TOYO Co., Ltd. has acquired the remaining 24.99% membership interest in its US subsidiary TOYO Solar LLC. The deal makes TOYO Solar LLC a wholly owned subsidiary. No price or seller was disclosed.
details: TOYO Solar LLC is developing a solar module manufacturing plant in Texas with a planned annual production capacity of 2.5 GW. A membership interest is the ownership share in a US limited liability company, so this purchase gives TOYO full ownership of the unit. The release does not name the party that sold the stake, the purchase price or any advisers. The transaction has already been completed.
context: The deal follows TOYO's recent move into US-based manufacturing. The company says full ownership gives it more operational control and supports its plan to supply American-made solar products at scale. It reflects broader efforts by solar manufacturers to build a presence in the US supply chain.

sources.title: TOYO Co., Ltd. Acquires Remaining 24.99% Interest in TOYO Solar LLC

title: Saxovent Renewables buys 81.8 MW solar project from Milvio
summary: Saxovent Renewables acquired a construction-ready 81.8 MW solar project south of Rostock from developer Milvio.
details: Saxovent Renewables bought a construction-ready 81.8 MW solar project south of Rostock in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania from developer Milvio. 20 MW won an EEG tender, and the rest will be sold under a PPA. A battery is being considered.
context: Mixing a guaranteed tender price for part of the output with a corporate PPA for the rest balances security and upside. Saxovent says the plant will connect to the grid quickly.

sources.title: Saxovent Renewables Acquires 81.8 MW Solar Project in Northern Germany

title: Synera signs long-term corporate PPA for Formosa 4 offshore wind
summary: Synera Renewable Energy signed a long-term corporate PPA with Taiwan Smart Electricity & Energy for a fixed share of output from the Formosa 4 offshore wind project.
details: Synera Renewable Energy signed a long-term corporate PPA with Taiwan Smart Electricity & Energy for a fixed share of the output of its Formosa 4 offshore wind project once connected. TSEE will resell the power through its platform to companies pursuing decarbonisation targets.
context: Synera says the deal gives long-term revenue certainty and strengthens Formosa 4's finances. The project is expected to power about 500,000 households a year.

sources.title: Synera secures long-term PPA for Formosa 4 offshore wind project

title: Chint Solar buys Burcot solar and battery site from Hive Energy and Ethical Power
summary: Chint Solar acquired the 49.9 MW Burcot solar and battery project in Oxfordshire from the Hive Energy and Ethical Power partnership.
details: Chint Solar bought the Burcot solar farm in Oxfordshire from the Hive Energy and Ethical Power partnership. It will have nearly 80,000 panels and about 50 MW, plus battery storage, powering about 18,000 homes. TLT advised Chint.
context: Chint Solar, a European developer and contractor, has built more than 900 MW of solar parks in Europe.

sources.title: TLT advises Chint Solar on UK solar and battery storage site acquisition

title: JK Cement raises its stake in O2 Renewable Energy V to 28.97%
summary: J.K. Cement bought additional shares in independent power producer O2 Renewable Energy V, raising its stake to 28.97%.
details: J.K. Cement bought 46,45,658 more shares of O2 Renewable Energy V from JSW Neo Energy for ₹5.19 crore in cash, raising its stake from 16.76% to 28.97%.
context: Raising the stake helps J.K. Cement meet captive power rules on the share of ownership held by users of the plant.

sources.title: JK Cement Boosts Renewable Portfolio With Increased Stake To 28.97% In O2 Renewable Energy V

title: FMO invests US$50 million in AMPIN Energy Transition
summary: Dutch development bank FMO invested US$50 million in AMPIN Energy Transition to expand its renewable portfolio in India.
details: Dutch development bank FMO invested US$50 million in AMPIN Energy Transition to fund its renewable expansion in India, alongside its equity investors.
context: FMO says it is scaling its climate investments. AMPIN links the money to India's target of 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.

sources.title: AMPIN Energy secures $50m FMO investment for Indian renewables

title: European Energy sells majority of 21 MW German wind portfolio to Alterric
summary: European Energy sold a majority stake in a 21 MW onshore wind portfolio of four Enercon turbines in Germany to Alterric.
details: European Energy sold a majority stake in a 21 MW portfolio of four Enercon turbines in Germany to Alterric. Three are operating and one is due later in 2025; all earn a 20-year feed-in tariff.
context: The two companies have a long partnership developing wind in the region. The 20-year feed-in tariff gives the new majority owner predictable revenue.

sources.title: Alterric acquires stake in European Energy wind portfolio

title: Sunstone Credit completes financing for third King Energy rooftop solar portfolio
target: King Energy third C&I solar program portfolio
summary: Sunstone Credit, a commercial solar lending platform, has closed financing for a third portfolio of rooftop solar projects developed by King Energy. The partnership now covers 15 US retail properties with more than 5 MWdc of solar serving over 300 business tenants.
details: The portfolio consists of commercial and industrial (C&I) rooftop solar systems on multi-tenant retail properties in several US markets, expected to produce over 8,000 MWh of electricity a year. MWdc refers to the direct current rating of the solar panels, before conversion to grid power. King Energy uses virtual net metering, a scheme that lets one solar system credit several tenants' utility bills, and bills tenants through its OneBill software. The loan amount, lenders behind Sunstone and loan terms were not disclosed.
context: The companies say most of the tenants served operate in low and medium-income communities and that rooftop solar can help small businesses offset rising energy costs. The deal extends an existing partnership, with Sunstone describing it as proof that specialised financing can widen access to distributed solar.

sources.title: SUNSTONE CREDIT COMPLETES FINANCING FOR KING ENERGY SOLAR PORTFOLIO

title: Citicore Renewable Energy secures ₱3.975 billion from BPI for Pangasinan 2 solar
summary: Citicore Renewable Energy signed a ₱3.975 billion project loan with BPI to complete its 113 MWp Citicore Solar Pangasinan 2 project in Binalonan.
details: BPI provided a ₱3.975 billion project loan, signed on 3 December, to complete Citicore's 113 MWp Citicore Solar Pangasinan 2 plant in Binalonan before year-end. The project holds a Certificate of Energy Project of National Significance.
context: That certificate speeds up permits and approvals in the Philippines. Citicore says the loan supports its push to expand clean capacity.

sources.title: Citicore Renewable Energy Taps PHP 3.975-B Financing from BPI to Accelerate Utility-Scale Solar Expansion Aligned With Philippines’ Energy Transition Goals

title: IFC lends US$20 million for Kahirós, Uruguay's first green hydrogen project
summary: The IFC made its first green hydrogen investment, a US$20 million loan with Grupo Santander, for the Kahirós project in Uruguay.
details: The IFC's first green hydrogen investment is a US$20 million loan, with Grupo Santander, for the Kahirós project in Uruguay, which uses solar power to make green hydrogen.
context: Fewer than 5% of announced green hydrogen projects worldwide have reached investment, the IFC notes. Uruguay hopes to become a regional leader in the technology.

sources.title: IFC Partners With Grupo Santander To Launch Uruguay’s First Green Hydrogen Project, Backed By $20M Loan

title: ADB approves US$650 million policy loan for India's rooftop solar push
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a US$650 million policy-based loan, the first subprogramme of its rooftop solar programme, to help India's PM Surya Ghar scheme reach 10 million households by 2027.
details: The ADB approved a US$650 million policy-based loan, the first subprogramme of its rooftop solar programme, supporting India's PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana scheme to put rooftop solar on 10 million homes by 2027.
context: Policy-based loans fund the government in return for reforms, here to remove financial barriers to rooftop solar. The scheme aims at 30 GW of rooftop capacity.

sources.title: ADB approves $650m loan to accelerate India's solar deployment

title: BayWa r.e. sells two UK solar farms totalling 121 MWp to Capital Dynamics
summary: BayWa r.e. sold the consented Clump Farm and Yanel solar farms in the UK, more than 121 MWp in total, to Capital Dynamics.
details: BayWa r.e. sold two consented UK solar farms to Capital Dynamics: Clump Farm in Leicestershire, about 77 MWp, and Yanel in North Somerset, 44 MWp. They were developed in a joint venture with Grüne Energien.
context: Together they could supply about 30,000 homes. Both projects were developed in a joint venture with Grüne Energien.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells UK solar portfolio to Capital Dynamics

title: BrightNight and Cordelio Power reach financial close on 200 MW / 800 MWh Greenwater battery project in Washington

buyers.name: Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
Fédération des caisses Desjardins du Québec

summary: BrightNight and its joint venture partner Cordelio Power have reached financial close on the Greenwater battery storage project in Pierce County, Washington. The 200 MW / 800 MWh system is backed by project financing the companies describe as approaching 400 million US dollars from a group of six banks.
details: Greenwater is a lithium-ion battery system able to discharge 200 MW for about four hours, connecting to the existing White River Substation through a short tie line. Financial close means the funding agreements are signed and money can be drawn to build the project. Lenders include Royal Bank of Canada, Credit Agricole CIB, CoBank, National Bank of Canada, Desjardins and Zions Bancorporation. The project will supply firm capacity and grid services to the utility Puget Sound Energy, and commercial operation is targeted for 2026.
context: The partners say this is their first jointly held Pacific Northwest asset to reach financial close. BrightNight claims the project shows how storage can strengthen the regional grid, and Puget Sound Energy says such batteries help it meet peak demand and state clean energy goals. Cordelio is wholly owned by Canada Pension Plan Investment Board.

sources.title: BrightNight and Cordelio Power Announce Financial Close on Greenwater: 200 MW / 800 MWh Battery Energy Storage System in Pierce County, Washington

title: Econergy secures €40.5 million from UniCredit for 87 MW Oradea solar in Romania
summary: Econergy signed a €40.5 million project finance agreement with UniCredit Bank for its operating 87 MW Oradea solar project in north-western Romania.
details: UniCredit Bank provided €40.5 million of project finance for Econergy's 87 MW Oradea solar plant in Crișana, which has fed the grid since August 2025; part refinances construction loans. Econergy plans a 68 MW battery at the site costing about €21 million.
context: Adding batteries to its Romanian solar plants is part of Econergy's hybrid strategy.

sources.title: Econergy Secures €40.5 Million Financing from UniCredit for 87 MW Oradea Solar Project in Romania

title: France lends Mauritania €39 million for ten solar plants with storage
summary: Mauritania and France signed a €39 million concessional loan to build ten solar power stations with storage.
details: France lent Mauritania €39.2 million (1.817 billion ouguiyas) on concessional terms to build ten solar plants with storage. It was signed in Nouakchott by Mauritania's economy minister and France's trade minister.
context: The plants aim to narrow the gap in electricity access between rural and urban areas.

sources.title: Mauritania And France Sign €39 Million Loan Agreement To Build 10 Solar Power Stations With Storage Units

title: WBS Power sells Project Jupiter battery and solar development to Prime Capital

buyers.name: Prime Capital (Prime Green Energy Infrastructure Fund II)

summary: WBS Power sold Project Jupiter, a co-located 500 MW / 2,000 MWh battery and solar development in Germany, to Prime Capital's Prime Green Energy Infrastructure Fund II.
details: WBS Power sold Project Jupiter, a 500 MW / 2,000 MWh battery with up to 150 MWp of solar on a former airfield, to Prime Capital's Prime Green Energy Infrastructure Fund II. The two will also form a joint venture to develop a 500 MW hyperscale data centre on the same site. PwC and Capcora advised the seller.
context: It is the largest planned co-located solar and battery project in Germany. The planned data centre on the same site would sit next to its own source of solar power and storage.

sources.title: WBS Power Sells Germany’s Largest Co-Located BESS + Solar PV Project To Prime Capital, Forms New Joint Venture To Build A Hyperscale Data Center

title: Terra-Gen closes US$383.3 million for 205 MW Lockhart III & IV solar in California
summary: Terra-Gen, owned by Igneo Infrastructure Partners and Masdar, closed US$383.3 million of project financing to build the 205 MW Lockhart III & IV solar project in San Bernardino County.
details: Terra-Gen, owned by Igneo Infrastructure Partners and Masdar, closed US$383.3 million for the 205 MW Lockhart III & IV solar project in San Bernardino County: a US$236.1 million tax equity bridge loan, a US$107.5 million construction and term loan and US$39.7 million of unfunded facilities, from four banks led by Crédit Agricole CIB.
context: Terra-Gen is one of the largest independent renewable producers in the US. A tax equity bridge loan covers costs until tax equity investors fund at completion.

sources.title: Terra-Gen Secures $383.3M Financing For 205 MW Lockhart III & IV Solar Project In California, Supporting Clean Energy Goals And Local Jobs

title: Aukera secures DKB financing for 50 MWp Lachendorf solar in Lower Saxony
summary: Aukera Energy closed senior debt from Deutsche Kreditbank to fully finance its 50 MWp solar plant near Lachendorf, Lower Saxony.
details: Deutsche Kreditbank provided senior debt to fully finance Aukera's 50 MWp solar plant near Lachendorf, Lower Saxony. Site work began in August 2025, and Intec Energy Solutions will build and maintain it. 20 MWp qualifies for EEG support.
context: The EEG award fixes the price for part of the output, which supports the project's economics. Aukera can now move into full construction.

sources.title: Aukera Secures Full Financing For 50 MW Solar Project In Germany’s Lower Saxony

title: REDC takes 95% of 25 MW Maramag hydropower project
summary: Repower Energy Development Corporation took 95% of Maramag Hydropower Corporation, developer of the 25 MW Pulangi IV project in Bukidnon.
details: Repower Energy Development Corporation took 95% of Maramag Hydropower Corporation, developer of the 25 MW Pulangi IV run-of-river project in Maramag, Bukidnon, downstream of REDC's new 18.2 MW Pulangi plant.
context: It is REDC's second investment on the Pulangi River and part of its plan to expand domestic hydropower in Mindanao.

sources.title: REDC acquires 95% stake in Maramag Hydropower project

title: Origis Energy secures J.P. Morgan tax equity commitment for 210 MW Wheatland Solar in Indiana
summary: Origis Energy has obtained a tax equity commitment from J.P. Morgan for its 210 MW Wheatland Solar project in Knox County, Indiana. An initial funding was made at the same time as the commitment. The amount was not disclosed.
details: Tax equity is an investment where a party such as a bank funds part of a project in exchange for the right to use its federal tax credits and other tax benefits. Wheatland sells its output to CenterPoint Energy under a 20-year power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy the electricity. The project already received debt financing from MUFG in May 2025 as part of a portfolio loan that also covers the Optimist Solar + Storage project in Clay County, Mississippi, which pairs 285 MW of solar with 50 MW of four-hour storage due in early 2026. Origis expects Wheatland to begin operating in the first quarter of 2026. Latham & Watkins advised Origis, with Taft Stettinius & Hollister acting as Indiana counsel.
context: The company says this is its fifth tax equity commitment with J.P. Morgan, pointing to a repeat financing relationship. The funding moves the project toward commercial operation and completes its capital stack alongside the earlier MUFG debt.

sources.title: Origis Energy Secures Tax Equity Commitment and Initial Funding with J.P. Morgan for Wheatland Solar

title: ACWA Power, Badeel and SAPCO reach financial close on 15 GW of Saudi solar and wind
summary: ACWA Power, Badeel and Saudi Aramco Power Company reached financial close on seven solar and wind plants totalling 15 GW under Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program.
details: ACWA Power, Badeel and Saudi Aramco Power reached financial close on seven plants totalling 15 GW under Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program: Bisha (3 GW solar), Humaij (3 GW solar), Khulis (2 GW solar), Afif 1 and Afif 2 (2 GW solar each), Starah (2 GW wind) and a further plant.
context: Closing seven gigawatt-scale plants together is one of the largest renewable financings on record in our tracker. The plants form part of Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program.

sources.title: ACWA Power achieves financial close for 15 GW of RE projects in Saudi Arabia

title: Ecopetrol agrees terms to acquire seven Grenergy solar project companies in Colombia totalling up to 88.2 MWp
target: Seven Colombian solar photovoltaic project companies from Grenergy's portfolio
summary: Colombian energy company Ecopetrol has concluded negotiations with Spanish developer Grenergy Renovables to potentially buy seven companies that each hold a solar photovoltaic project in Colombia. The portfolio totals up to 88.2 MWp. The purchase price was not disclosed.
details: Each of the seven companies owns the assets, licences, agreements and permits for one solar project of up to about 12.6 MWp, where MWp means peak output of the solar panels under standard test conditions. Three projects are in Córdoba, two in Cesar, one in Magdalena and one in Sucre. The deals still depend on conditions precedent, meaning requirements that must be met before closing, plus other legal steps. Ecopetrol says it will publish the closing and final value of each transaction once these are satisfied.
context: Ecopetrol says the projects would count toward its goal of 900 MW of self-generated renewable power under its 2040 strategy. The company expects the solar output to supply its own operations at competitive cost, cutting its reliance on bilateral power contracts and on purchases from the volatile spot electricity market. The deal is part of a broader push by the oil-focused group into energy transition assets.

sources.title: Ecopetrol S.A. Negotiates Acquisition of a Portfolio of up to 88.2 MWp in Solar Photovoltaic Projects in Colombia

title: Grasim to take 29% of GMR Kalinga Solar Power for 10 MW captive project
summary: Grasim Industries will acquire 29% of GMR Kalinga Solar Power, a GMR Energy SPV, for a 10 MW captive renewable project in Odisha.
details: Grasim Industries will invest up to ₹3.60 crore for 29% of GMR Kalinga Solar Power, a GMR Energy project company, to supply its Ganjam plant in Odisha with captive renewable power from a 10 MW project.
context: It follows Grasim's November 2025 announcement of the plan. A stake above 26% qualifies the plant as captive.

sources.title: Grasim Industries to Acquire 29% Stake in 10 MW GMR Kalinga Solar Power for Captive RE Project In Odisha

title: Havells India to take 26% of Kundan Solar (Pali) for 15 MWac captive plant
summary: Havells India approved buying 26% of Kundan Solar (Pali), an SPV building a 15 MWac captive solar plant in Rajasthan.
details: Havells India's executive committee approved investing about ₹5.63 crore for 26% of Kundan Solar (Pali), a Kundan Green Energy subsidiary set up to build a 15 MWac captive solar plant in Rajasthan.
context: Havells is scaling up its use of renewable power across its factories. Holding 26% of the plant company makes the plant a captive source under Indian rules, lowering the charges on the power.

sources.title: Havells India Acquires 26% Stake in Kundan Solar SPV for 15 MWac Captive Plant

title: Brookfield buys Alba Renewables in its first Southeast Asian renewables investment
summary: Brookfield Asset Management is acquiring Philippine developer Alba Renewables, its first renewable energy investment in Southeast Asia.
details: Brookfield is buying Alba Renewables, which has a 1.8 GW portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects, mainly in the Philippines and Thailand, with early work in Vietnam.
context: It is Brookfield's first renewable investment in Southeast Asia, giving it a team and a platform to expand across the region.

sources.title: Brookfield Makes First Renewable Energy Investments in Southeast Asia, Acquires Alba Renewables to Anchor Regional Expansion

title: Sunsure signs long-term solar PPA with Bisleri for 82.5 MWp plant
summary: Sunsure Energy signed a long-term PPA to supply Bisleri's Sahibabad unit from an 82.5 MWp solar plant, covering about 48% of its power needs.
details: Sunsure will supply Bisleri's Sahibabad factory in Ghaziabad from its 82.5 MWp Erach solar plant in Uttar Pradesh, covering about 48% of the site's electricity.
context: The bottled water maker expects to avoid about 2,700 tonnes of CO2 a year. Buying from a large open-access plant lets it cut emissions without building its own.

sources.title: Sunsure’s 82.5 MWp Solar Plant to Power Bisleri’s Sahibabad Unit Under New PPA

title: B.C. Jindal Group signs PPA with SECI for 150 MW round-the-clock renewables
summary: B.C. Jindal Group signed a PPA with SECI for a 150 MW round-the-clock renewable energy project.
details: B.C. Jindal Group signed a PPA with SECI for a 150 MW round-the-clock project combining solar, wind and batteries, connected to the inter-state grid, part of SECI's 1,200 MW tender from November 2024. It will buy land, build the plant and connect it.
context: Round-the-clock contracts require steady supply, so the developer must blend wind, solar and storage.

sources.title: B.C. Jindal Group Secures 150 MW Round-the-Clock Renewable Energy PPA with SECI

title: ACME Solar signs 25-year SECI PPA for 200 MW solar with 400 MWh battery
summary: ACME Solar's ACME Platinum Urja signed a 25-year PPA with SECI for a 200 MW solar project with a 100 MW / 400 MWh battery.
details: ACME Platinum Urja signed a 25-year PPA with SECI for 200 MW of solar with a 100 MW / 400 MWh battery at ₹3.42 per kWh, part of a 350 MW award. Solar output must reach a 25–27% capacity factor and the battery at least 70% availability in the evening peak.
context: The terms are designed to make solar power available in the evening, when India's demand peaks.

sources.title: ACME Solar Advances India’s Firm Renewable Power Push With SECI PPA for 200 MW Solar and 400 MWh Battery Storage

title: Capwatt sells 68 MW Iberian behind-the-meter solar to SDCL's Global Energy Transition Fund
summary: Capwatt sold a 68 MW behind-the-meter solar portfolio in Portugal and Spain to the Global Energy Transition Fund managed by SDCL.
details: Capwatt, controlled by Portugal's Azevedo family, sold a 68 MW behind-the-meter solar portfolio in Portugal and Spain to SDCL's Global Energy Transition Fund. Capwatt will keep leading development, operations and asset management.
context: It is the fund's first Iberian investment; it plans to invest more than €100 million in commercial and industrial solar there within a year.

sources.title: Capwatt Sells 68 MW Iberian Solar Portfolio to UK’s SDCL Fund

title: Asper and Craydel joint venture buys 49.9 MW Beauly battery project
summary: A joint venture of Asper Investment Management's Asper Iona fund and the Craydel Group acquired the project company for a 49.9 MW battery near Beauly in the Scottish Highlands.
details: A joint venture of Asper Investment Management's Asper Iona fund and the Craydel Group bought LG-B-50A Ltd, which holds the rights to a 49.9 MW battery project near Beauly in the Scottish Highlands. Burges Salmon advised the buyers.
context: It is the partners' first battery acquisition in Great Britain, adding storage alongside their existing generation assets.

sources.title: Burges Salmon advises joint venture on acquisition of Scottish Highlands BESS

title: ADB approves US$470 million results-based loan to Indonesia's PLN
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a US$470 million results-based loan to PLN for solar, wind and grid strengthening under phase 1 of its clean energy transition programme.
details: The ADB approved a US$470 million results-based loan to Indonesia's state utility PLN for phase 1 of the Accelerating Indonesia's Clean Energy Transition Program. It funds more solar and wind, grid upgrades in Java-Madura-Bali, Sumatra and Sulawesi, and PLN's capacity to manage clean energy.
context: In a results-based loan, money is released as agreed targets are met rather than against specific purchases, tying funding to progress.

sources.title: ADB Approves $470 Million Loan To Indonesia’s PLN To Boost Solar, Wind, And Grid Strengthening Under Clean Energy Transition Program—Phase 1

title: ib vogt sells 210 MWp Rajasthan solar project to Ingka Investments
summary: ib vogt sold a 210 MWp ready-to-build solar project in Rajasthan to Ingka Investments, the investment arm of IKEA operator Ingka Group.
details: ib vogt sold a ready-to-build 210 MWp solar project in Rajasthan to Ingka Investments, the investment arm of IKEA retailer Ingka Group. ib vogt secured the land, design, permits and grid connection, and will supervise construction and run the plant.
context: It is Ingka's first utility-scale renewable investment in India and supports its goal of 100% renewable power for its operations by 2030.

sources.title: ib vogt Sells 210 MWp Rajasthan Solar Project to Ingka Investments in Landmark India Deal

title: Greenvolt sells two Polish batteries totalling 300 MW / 1.2 GWh to Northland Power
summary: Greenvolt Power agreed to sell two ready-to-build battery projects in Poland, 300 MW / 1.2 GWh in total, to Northland Power.
details: Greenvolt Power agreed to sell two ready-to-build four-hour batteries in western Poland to Northland Power: Mieczysławów (200 MW / 800 MWh) and Kamionka (100 MW / 400 MWh).
context: Both projects have secured their grid connections and will provide balancing services as Poland adds renewables.

sources.title: Greenvolt sells two energy storage projects to Northland Power

title: JUWI sells 156 MW Greek solar portfolio to Mirova
summary: JUWI, part of MVV Energie, agreed to sell a 156 MW solar portfolio in Greece to Mirova, and will build and maintain the plants.
details: JUWI, part of MVV Energie, agreed to sell its 156 MW Clover solar portfolio of four projects in Kozani and Grevena, north-western Greece, to Mirova. JUWI will build and maintain the plants.
context: Staying on as contractor gives JUWI continued revenue after the sale and gives Mirova an experienced builder.

sources.title: JUWI sells 156 MW PV portfolio to Mirova

title: Recurrent Energy sells 275 MW Gunning Energy Park in NSW to European investor
summary: Recurrent Energy sold its 275 MW Gunning Energy Park solar-plus-storage project in New South Wales to a European infrastructure investor.
details: Gunning Energy Park near Gunning, New South Wales, about an hour north of Canberra, combines a 275 MWdc solar farm with a 120 MW battery and will connect to the grid via a Transgrid line. Recurrent Energy sold it to a European infrastructure investor.
context: It should power more than 76,000 homes. Recurrent typically sells projects to long-term owners once they are ready to build.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Sells 275 MW Solar-Plus-Storage Project in New South Wales to European Investor

title: CrossBoundary Energy raises US$200 million of senior debt for African projects
summary: CrossBoundary Energy secured US$200 million of additional senior debt for its energy-as-a-service renewable projects across Africa.
details: CrossBoundary Energy closed a US$200 million second tranche of its portfolio facility, first closed in December 2024, led by Standard Bank with Absa, Mauritius Commercial Bank, the Facility for Energy Inclusion, DEG and FMO.
context: CrossBoundary supplies solar and storage as a service to mines, heavy industry and telecom firms in Africa. A portfolio facility lets it finance many sites under one set of terms.

sources.title: Crossboundary Energy Raises USD 200 Million To Boost Renewable Projects Across Africa

title: Cypress Creek closes financing for 505 MWdc Hanson Solar project in Texas backed by Meta PPA
summary: Cypress Creek Renewables has reached financial close and started construction on Hanson Solar, a 505 MWdc (396 MWac) solar farm in Coleman County, Texas. The project is funded with preferred equity from funds run by an unnamed global credit manager and debt from MUFG and SMBC. Its power will be sold to Meta.
details: Financial close means all the funding needed to build the project has been signed and committed. The financing combines preferred equity, an investment that gets paid before ordinary shareholders, with bank loans from MUFG and SMBC, though the amounts were not disclosed. TIC - The Industrial Company, a Kiewit subsidiary, is the engineering, procurement and construction contractor, and site work began earlier in 2025. The plant will feed the ERCOT grid, which serves most of Texas, under a power purchase agreement with Meta, a long-term contract to buy the electricity. Commercial operation is expected in mid-2027.
context: The deal adds to Cypress Creek's growing investment in Texas and its relationship with Meta as a corporate buyer of clean power. The company says the project will support about 300 construction jobs and generate more than $80 million in local tax revenue over its life. The lenders described the financing as a sign of continued confidence in Cypress Creek's platform.

sources.title: Cypress Creek Closes Financing for Hanson Solar, a Flagship 505MWdc Project Supporting Meta's Operations and Strengthening Texas' Grid and Economy

title: GRP signs captive solar PPA with BECIS Solar 5 and takes 26.43% stake
summary: GRP signed a PPA with BECIS Solar 5 for captive solar power and acquired 26.43% of the SPV.
details: GRP signed a PPA with BECIS Solar 5 as captive user and a share subscription agreement with the company and its promoter BE-Onsite Solar Energy to take 26.43%.
context: The stake qualifies GRP as a captive user, giving it cheaper solar power for its operations.

sources.title: GRP Ltd Signs PPA with BECIS Solar 5; Acquires 26.43% Stake in Captive Solar SPV

title: Standard Solar buys two Illinois community solar projects from Cenergy Power
summary: Standard Solar acquired two Illinois community solar projects of nearly 9 MW from Cenergy Power.
details: Standard Solar bought two Illinois community solar projects from Cenergy Power: a 6.7 MW single-axis tracker array in Worden, expected to produce about 11,060 MWh in its first year, and a 2.4 MW ground-mounted array in the Zion Park District.
context: Illinois has become a hub for community solar, which lets households subscribe to a local plant.

sources.title: Standard Solar Adds Nearly 9MW To Its Portfolio With Acquisition Of Two New Illinois Community Solar Projects From Cenergy Power

title: Econergy signs option to buy 435 MW of German battery projects
summary: Econergy signed an option agreement to acquire two grid-licensed battery storage projects totalling 435 MW in Bad Lauchstädt, Saxony-Anhalt.
details: Econergy UK, about 75% owned by Econergy, secured an option to buy all of the German company holding two grid-licensed battery projects in Bad Lauchstädt, Saxony-Anhalt, 435 MW in total, now close to building permits.
context: It marks Econergy's entry into Germany, one of Europe's fastest-growing storage markets.

sources.title: Econergy Secures Right To Acquire 435 MW German Battery Storage Projects, Strengthening European Storage Platform

title: Neoen agrees to sell 760 MW French operating portfolio to Plenitude
summary: Neoen agreed to sell 760 MW of its French operating portfolio, 37 solar farms, 14 wind farms and one battery, to Eni's Plenitude.
details: Neoen will keep managing the plants for some years.

sources.title: Neoen divests 760 MW operating portfolio in France to Plenitude

title: Moment Energy secures $5 million debt financing from TD Innovation Partners
summary: Vancouver-based Moment Energy, which turns retired electric vehicle batteries into stationary storage systems, has obtained $5 million in growth debt financing from TD Innovation Partners, the innovation banking arm of The Toronto-Dominion Bank.
details: The loan is described as growth financing, meaning debt used to expand the business rather than to fund a single project. Moment Energy says it will use the money to scale up repurposing of used lithium-ion EV batteries into battery energy storage systems for commercial, industrial and utility customers. The company plans to raise production of its Luna BESS product to meet domestic demand. The release does not state the loan terms, maturity or currency, though the parties are Canadian.
context: The financing follows a strategic investment and partnership with Copec WIND Ventures, the venture arm of Latin American energy group Copec, under which Moment Energy aims to deploy second-life battery projects in Latin America and Europe. The company claims to be the first in North America certified to the UL 1974 standard for EV battery repurposing. Second-life batteries are presented by the company as a way to cut waste and reduce reliance on new battery production.

sources.title: Moment Energy Secures $5 Million in Debt Financing from TD Innovation Partners to Help Advance Global Shift Toward Clean, Reliable Energy Storage

title: Atlas Renewable Energy secures US$475 million for Copiapó solar and battery in Chile
summary: Atlas Renewable Energy secured US$475 million for its Copiapó hybrid project in Chile, 357 MWp of solar with a 320 MW / 1.28 GWh battery, with DNV as market adviser.
details: BBVA, BCI, Crédit Agricole CIB, Natixis, SMBC and Société Générale provided US$475 million for Atlas's Copiapó project in the Atacama Region: 357 MWp of solar with a 320 MW / 1.28 GWh four-hour battery. It will supply 750 GWh a year to CMP and Aguas CAP, subsidiaries of steel and mining group CAP. DNV advised.
context: Supplying an industrial buyer around the clock requires storage to cover the night. The six-bank group reflects lender appetite for contracted hybrid projects in Chile.

sources.title: DNV Supports Atlas Renewable Energy In Securing USD 475 Million Financing For Chile’s Copiapó 357 MWp Solar + 320 MW / 1.28 GWh Battery Storage Project

title: Alternergy takes 95% of 80 MW Alegria Cebu wind project
summary: Alternergy acquired 95% of MC Project Solutions, developer of the 80 MW Alegria Cebu wind project, its first in the Visayas grid.
details: Alternergy Wind Holdings will take 95% of MC Project Solutions, developer of the 80 MW Alegria Cebu wind project, a winner in the Philippine Department of Energy's fourth green energy auction in September. It is at pre-development, with delivery committed for late 2028.
context: It is Alternergy's first wind project on the Visayas grid. Winning an auction slot gives the project a guaranteed tariff, which Alternergy can use to finance construction.

sources.title: Alternergy acquires 80 MW wind project in Visayas

title: Aukera secures €60 million from Kommunalkredit for 250 MW / 500 MWh Romanian battery
summary: Aukera Energy secured a €60 million facility from Kommunalkredit Austria for its first standalone battery in Romania, 250 MW / 500 MWh at Gura Ialomiței, built in two phases.
details: Kommunalkredit Austria, as sole lead arranger, provided a €60 million facility for Aukera's first standalone battery in Romania: 250 MW / 500 MWh at Gura Ialomiței, Ialomița County, built in two phases. Phase 1 is under construction and the full project should operate by mid-2026.
context: It will be one of the largest batteries in Central and Eastern Europe. The IFC later lent €48.5 million for the second phase.

sources.title: Aukera secures financing for battery storage project in Romania

title: Velto Renewables takes full ownership of 74.3 MWp Les Îlots Blandin floating solar
summary: Velto Renewables bought Q ENERGY's 50% of Les Îlots Blandin in Haute-Marne, Europe's largest floating solar plant at 74.3 MWp, becoming sole owner as it began operating.
details: Velto Renewables bought Q ENERGY's 50% of Les Îlots Blandin in Perthes, Haute-Marne, becoming sole owner. The 74.3 MWp plant floats more than 135,000 panels across 127 hectares of a former industrial site.
context: It is Europe's largest floating solar plant and shows how unused industrial land and water can host solar. It should cover the power use of about 37,000 people.

sources.title: Velto Renewables completes acquisition and begins operation of floating solar farm

title: rPlus Energies buys 900 MW of solar and storage projects in Idaho
summary: rPlus Energies acquired the Blacks Creek Energy Center and Bluebird Solar projects in Ada County, Idaho, together 900 MW of planned solar and storage.
details: rPlus Energies bought two projects in Ada County, Idaho: Blacks Creek Energy Center from Qcells, 400 MW of solar with a 200 MW battery phase, and Bluebird Solar from Mission Clean Energy, 200 MW of solar with 100 MW of storage.
context: Together they add 900 MW of planned capacity and strengthen rPlus's position as Idaho's largest solar and storage developer.

sources.title: rPlus Energies Acquires 900 MW Of Solar And Storage Projects In Idaho, Strengthening Its Position As The State’s Largest Solar And Storage Developer

title: Samvardhana Motherson to buy Onega Solar Power for 15 MWp group-captive project
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International approved acquiring Onega Solar Power, an SPV developing a 15 MWp group-captive solar project in Uttar Pradesh.
details: Samvardhana Motherson's subsidiary Motherson New Energy will buy all shares and convertible debentures of Onega Solar Power from IB Energy of Singapore for ₹13.19 million in cash. Onega, set up in August 2021, is developing a 15 MWp group-captive solar project in Uttar Pradesh.
context: Owning the project company lets the car-parts group supply its factories with captive solar power.

sources.title: SAMIL Expands Renewable Portfolio with Acquisition of Onega Solar’s 15 MW Group-Captive Project in Uttar Pradesh

title: Société Générale finances Nala Renewables' 50 MW / 100 MWh battery in Finland
summary: Société Générale financed Nala Renewables' 50 MW / 100 MWh battery in Finland, one of the country's largest.
details: Sungrow supplies the batteries and Trafigura will use the capacity for trading.

sources.title: DLA Piper supports the financing of Nala’s 50 MW BESS project

title: Ecopetrol completes purchase of 0.6 GW Colombian solar portfolio from Statkraft

sellers.name: Statkraft European Wind and Solar Holding AS

target: Statkraft's Colombian development and operating company and six solar project companies
summary: Colombian state-controlled oil company Ecopetrol closed its acquisition of Statkraft's Colombian solar business on November 13, 2025. The deal covers one development and operating company plus six project companies holding about 0.6 GW of solar projects, for a total of US$157.5 million.
details: The assets were held by Statkraft subsidiaries Enerfín Sociedad de Energía and Enerfin Enervento Exterior, and Ecopetrol now owns 100% of the shares. The purchase agreement, signed on May 20, 2025, covers up to ten companies in total. The remaining three special purpose entities, which are companies set up to own a single project, hold about 0.7 GW of wind projects and their transfer still depends on further conditions and legal requirements. Ecopetrol paid using additional debt included in its funding plan for acquisitions.
context: Ecopetrol says the deal supports its decarbonization goals under its 2040 strategy and adds low-emission power for the group's own consumption. The company presents the solar assets as a complement to its core oil and gas business. Integration of the acquired companies into the Ecopetrol Group is now set to begin.

sources.title: Ecopetrol S.A. Announces the Acquisition of a Solar Project Portfolio in Colombia

title: Peregrine Energy Solutions closes preferred equity and bank financing for $317 million battery storage project
target: Battery energy storage project under construction in ERCOT (Texas)
summary: Boulder-based developer Peregrine Energy Solutions has closed a preferred equity commitment from Bildmore Clean Energy and a bank loan facility for a battery storage project described as a $317 million project. The project is under construction in the ERCOT market in Texas.
details: Bildmore provided preferred equity, a class of ownership that is paid back ahead of common equity, and the release says this commitment supports a bridge loan, which is short-term debt repaid later from longer-term funding. The lender group was led by First Citizens Bank and Societe Generale as coordinating lead arrangers, with Siemens Financial Services as joint lead arranger and East West Bank as an additional lender. The project size in megawatts and the individual loan and equity amounts were not disclosed. McGuireWoods advised Peregrine, Kirkland & Ellis advised Bildmore and Winston & Strawn advised the lenders.
context: Peregrine describes this as its second project financing of 2025, following a March deal with Bildmore, First Citizens Bank and Nomura for another Texas storage project and a $130 million corporate capital raise in October. The company says it has a 15 GWh storage pipeline across several US power markets, with two projects now under construction in Texas. First Citizens noted this is its second financing with Peregrine.

sources.title: Peregrine Energy Solutions Secures Funding to support a $317 Million Battery Energy Storage Project Currently Under Construction

title: Dispatch Energy buys Green Lantern Solar and 208.9 MWdc of projects
summary: Dispatch Energy acquired Green Lantern Solar, taking over 64 solar and battery projects totalling 208.9 MWdc.
details: Dispatch Energy bought Green Lantern Solar, an integrated developer, owner and operator, taking over more than 64 solar and battery projects totalling 208.9 MWdc at different stages. Dispatch's portfolio grows to 489.5 MW.
context: Dispatch aggregates small distributed projects across the US into a large portfolio.

sources.title: Dispatch Energy Acquires Green Lantern Solar, Adding 64 Solar & Battery Projects Totaling 208.9 MWdc To Expand U.S. Distributed Energy Portfolio

title: Norfund invests US$75 million in Mulilo Energy Holdings
summary: Norfund invested US$75 million for a minority stake in South African developer Mulilo Energy Holdings.
details: Norfund invested US$75 million for a minority stake in Mulilo Energy Holdings, alongside CIP's New Markets Fund I, which remains a key shareholder.
context: The money supports Mulilo's growth into a tier-one independent power producer and its 5.5 GW pipeline, expected to reach financial close by the end of 2027.

sources.title: Norfund Invests USD 75 Million in Mulilo Energy Holdings to Accelerate South Africa’s Renewable Expansion

title: ADB provides US$331 million for ReNew's 837 MW hybrid project in Andhra Pradesh
summary: ReNew secured US$331 million from the Asian Development Bank toward a US$477 million package for an 837 MW wind and solar project with a 415 MWh battery in Andhra Pradesh, designed to deliver 300 MW at peak times.
details: The ADB is providing US$331 million toward a US$477 million package for ReNew's Andhra Pradesh project, which combines 837 MW of wind and solar with a 415 MWh battery to deliver 300 MW at peak times. The ADB loan includes up to US$291 million in local currency and US$40 million from its LEAP 2 fund; it will arrange the remaining US$146 million.
context: Lending in rupees avoids exchange-rate risk for a project paid in rupees. The plant should produce about 1,641 GWh a year.

sources.title: ReNew bags $331m loan for 837-MW hybrid project

title: AGL signs 15-year PPA for all output of 105 MW Waddi wind farm
summary: AGL Energy signed a 15-year PPA with Tilt Renewables for 100% of the output of the 105 MW Waddi wind farm in Western Australia.
details: AGL Energy will buy all output of Tilt Renewables' 105 MW Waddi wind farm in Western Australia for 15 years from the supply start, targeted for the second half of 2028.
context: A full-output contract with a large retailer gives the wind farm the revenue certainty needed for financing.

sources.title: AGL secures 15-Year PPA for 105-MW AU wind farm output

title: ADB approves US$180 million loan for Geo Dipa Energy's geothermal expansion
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a US$180 million second additional financing for state-owned PT Geo Dipa Energy to expand geothermal generation in Indonesia.
details: The ADB approved a US$180 million second additional loan to state-owned PT Geo Dipa Energy for its Geothermal Power Generation Project, which is building two 55 MW geothermal plants on Java.
context: The extra money covers rising project costs to keep construction on schedule. Geothermal gives Indonesia steady low-carbon power.

sources.title: ADB Approves $180 Million Loan To Boost Indonesia’s Geothermal Power Development With PT Geo Dipa Energy

title: EBRD invests a further US$40 million in Egypt's Infinity
summary: The EBRD made an additional US$40 million equity investment in Egyptian developer Infinity to accelerate 3 GW of renewable projects across Africa.
details: The EBRD invested a further US$40 million of equity in Infinity, raising its total commitment to US$141.5 million, to help its subsidiary Infinity Power develop about 3 GW of renewables across Africa.
context: Infinity is Egypt's leading renewable developer and a long-standing EBRD client. The bank presents the follow-on as support for private-sector-led renewables across Africa.

sources.title: EBRD Boosts Investment In Egypt’s Infinity With Additional $40 Million To Accelerate 3 GW Renewable Energy Projects Across Africa

title: OMV and Masdar form joint venture for 140 MW green hydrogen plant in Austria
summary: OMV and Masdar signed a binding agreement to form a joint venture to finance, build and run a 140 MW green hydrogen electrolyser in Austria.
details: OMV and Masdar signed a binding agreement for a joint venture, majority-owned by OMV with Masdar holding 49%, to finance, build and run a 140 MW green hydrogen electrolyser in Bruck an der Leitha, Austria. Construction began in September 2025 and commissioning is targeted for 2027.
context: It will be one of Europe's largest green hydrogen plants and a key part of OMV's decarbonisation strategy.

sources.title: OMV and Masdar Form Joint Venture to Develop 140 MW Green Hydrogen Plant in Austria

title: Scatec and Aboitiz secure 20-year PPA for 68 MW Magat floating solar
summary: Scatec and joint venture partner Aboitiz Renewables secured a 20-year PPA for a 68 MW floating solar project on the Magat reservoir in the Philippines.
details: SN Aboitiz Power, the 50:50 joint venture of Scatec and Aboitiz Renewables, won a 20-year PPA for a 68 MW floating solar plant on the Magat reservoir in Isabela province under the Philippines' fourth green energy auction. The reservoir already hosts SNAP's 388 MW Magat hydro plant, an 8.5 MW run-of-river plant and a battery.
context: Placing solar on a hydro reservoir uses existing grid connections and lets the dam save water during sunny hours.

sources.title: Scatec And Aboitiz Renewables Secure 20-Year PPA For 68 MW Floating Solar Project On Magat Reservoir In The Philippines

title: Enlight closes tax equity with Wells Fargo for Quail Ranch solar and storage
summary: Enlight Renewable Energy's Clēnera closed a tax equity agreement of nearly US$150 million with Wells Fargo for the Quail Ranch solar and storage project in New Mexico.
details: Wells Fargo will provide US$131 million of tax equity at commercial operation, rising to nearly US$150 million through pay-as-you-go contributions over ten years, for Quail Ranch in New Mexico: 128 MW of solar with 400 MWh of storage, a US$275 million project due online by the end of 2025.
context: Enlight expects first-year revenue of about US$24 million and EBITDA of about US$17 million. Pay-go tax equity ties part of the investor's payments to the credits the project actually earns.

sources.title: Enlight Renewable Energy Secures $150 Million Tax Equity Financing from Wells Fargo for Solar and Storage Project in New Mexico

title: Standard Solar buys 6.3 MW Plaines II West community solar from Calvert Energy
summary: Standard Solar acquired the 6.3 MW Plaines II West Community Solar Garden in Channahon, Illinois, from Calvert Energy.
details: Standard Solar bought the 6.3 MW Plaines II West Community Solar Garden in Channahon, Illinois, from Calvert Energy.
context: Standard Solar holds a stock of safe-harboured panels, bought early to lock in US tax credit eligibility, which lets it move acquired projects into operation quickly.

sources.title: Standard Solar Acquires 6.3 MW Community Solar Project From Calvert Energy, Leveraging Safe Harbor Strategy For Faster Project Execution

title: EDF power solutions, SPIC HHDC and SAPCO reach financial close on 1,400 MW of Saudi solar projects

sellers.name: SPIC Huanghe Hydropower Development Co., Ltd. (SPIC HHDC)

target: Al Masa'a (1,000 MW) and Al Henakiyah-2 (400 MW) solar PV projects
summary: A consortium of EDF power solutions, SPIC HHDC and Aramco subsidiary SAPCO has secured financing for two solar photovoltaic plants in Saudi Arabia totalling 1,400 MW. Financial close means the loan agreements are signed and funds can be drawn to build the projects. The loan amount was not disclosed.
details: Al Masa'a is a 1,000 MW plant in Hail Province about 590 km north of Riyadh, expected to start commercial operation in Q3 2027. Al Henakiyah-2 is a 400 MW plant in Madinah Province about 720 km west of Riyadh, expected online in Q1 2027. Both sell power under 25-year power purchase agreements, which are long-term electricity sales contracts, with the state buyer Saudi Power Procurement Company, and the consortium will design, finance, build and operate them. Lenders include Saudi Investment Bank, Bank of China, Société Générale, BNP Paribas, Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank and First Abu Dhabi Bank.
context: The projects are part of Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program, which targets about half of electricity from renewables by 2030. The companies say the plants will supply more than 240,000 households and avoid around 3 million tons of CO2 per year. EDF says the deal lifts its renewable capacity in the Kingdom above 3,500 MW, and Aramco presents it as an expansion of its New Energies business.

sources.title: EDF Power Solutions, SPIC HHDC and SAPCO consortium achieve financial close on 1,400MW Solar Power Projects in Saudi Arabia

title: BOOM Power sells Firsfield and Osgodby solar farms to Enray Power
summary: BOOM Power completed the sale of the Firsfield solar farm in West Suffolk and the Osgodby solar farm in North Yorkshire to Enray Power.
details: BOOM Power completed the sale of two UK solar farms to Enray Power: Firsfield in Bardwell, West Suffolk, about 71 MWp on 237 acres with up to 46.9 MW of export capacity, consented by West Suffolk Council in April 2024, and Osgodby in North Yorkshire.
context: BOOM Power develops projects to the consented stage and sells them to builders and long-term owners.

sources.title: BOOM Power completes sale of Firsfield and Osgodby solar farm

title: Morgan Stanley provides $160 million tax equity to Plus Power for two New England battery projects
target: Cranberry Point Energy Storage and Cross Town Energy Storage
summary: Plus Power has secured $160 million in tax equity investment from Morgan Stanley for two standalone battery storage projects in New England. The deal covers $95 million for Cranberry Point in Massachusetts and $65 million for Cross Town in Maine, totalling 325 MW and 650 MWh.
details: Cranberry Point in Carver, Massachusetts is a 150 MW / 300 MWh two-hour battery that began operating in May 2025. Cross Town in Gorham, Maine is a 175 MW / 350 MWh battery expected to start commercial operations in late Q4 2025. Tax equity means an investor puts money into a project in exchange for the right to use its federal tax credits. Plus Power had already closed debt financing in 2024, with First Citizens Bank, Nord LB, Investec and Siemens Financial Services lending to Cranberry Point and Nord LB, Investec and Siemens Financial Services lending to Cross Town. Across both projects the company says it has raised over $290 million in debt, including construction-to-term loans, tax equity bridge loans (short-term loans repaid when tax equity arrives) and letter of credit facilities.
context: Plus Power describes the two facilities as the largest standalone batteries in New England. They will sell capacity and energy services to grid operator ISO-NE, which the company says will help balance variable renewables and meet demand as older power plants retire and data centers grow. Plus Power reports a portfolio of 11 GW of projects across more than 20 states.

sources.title: Plus Power Secures $160 Million in Tax Equity Investments for its Landmark ISO-NE Battery Storage Projects

title: AfDB approves US$14.54 million for 20 MW Garneton North solar in Zambia
summary: The African Development Bank approved US$14.54 million for the US$24.5 million, 20 MW Garneton North solar project in Zambia's Copperbelt Province.
details: The African Development Bank approved US$14.54 million for the US$24.5 million Garneton North solar project in the Copperbelt Province: US$7.27 million from its own resources and the same amount of concessional finance from another lender. The 20 MW plant should serve about 82,000 people.
context: Zambia has a persistent power deficit after droughts cut hydro output. The plant should cut about 58,740 tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: African Development Bank Supports Zambia’s $24.5 Million Garneton North 20 MW Solar Project With $14.54 Million Financing To Advance Mission 300 Goals

title: Kansai Electric invests in Irish offshore wind developer Simply Blue Energy
summary: Kansai Electric Power signed a share subscription agreement to invest in Simply Blue Energy OSW, an Irish offshore wind developer working on projects across Europe.
details: Kansai Electric Power signed a share subscription agreement to invest in Simply Blue Energy OSW, an Irish developer of offshore wind projects, mainly in Europe. The size of the stake was not disclosed.
context: KEPCO says the investment will help SBE grow and give it experience in offshore wind development, in line with its 2050 goals.

sources.title: Kansai Electric invests in Ireland-based offshore wind company

title: Tokyo Gas invests in Truong Thanh Duyen Hai wind company in Vietnam
target: Truong Thanh Duyen Hai Wind Power
summary: Tokyo Gas agreed to invest in Truong Thanh Duyen Hai Wind Power, which runs a nearshore wind project off Vinh Long Province, Vietnam.
details: Tokyo Gas agreed with Truong Thanh Vietnam Group and Truong Thanh Energy to invest in Truong Thanh Duyen Hai Wind Power, which runs a 48 MW nearshore wind farm off Vinh Long Province, operating since 2021, and plans to add 48 MW more after a feasibility study.
context: Nearshore wind in the Mekong Delta uses turbines in shallow coastal water. The deal gives Tokyo Gas a foothold in Vietnamese wind.

sources.title: Tokyo Gas invests in wind power generation company in Vietnam

title: BrightNight and Cordelio Power close financing for 300 MW solar and 1,200 MWh storage Pioneer project in Arizona
summary: BrightNight and its joint venture partner Cordelio Power have reached financial close, meaning the funding is secured so building can proceed, for the Pioneer Clean Energy Center in Yuma, Arizona. The hybrid project pairs a 300 MWac solar plant with a 300 MW / 1,200 MWh battery. A group of six banks provided the financing, whose amount was not disclosed.
details: Pioneer combines 300 MWac of solar with a battery able to discharge 300 MW for about four hours, totalling 1,200 MWh. It was developed to serve a long-term tolling agreement with a local utility, a contract under which the utility pays for the right to use and dispatch the plant's capacity. The lender syndicate includes Crédit Agricole, MUFG, Royal Bank of Canada, National Bank of Canada, CoBank and ING. Full construction is underway and commercial operation is expected by April 2027. BrightNight says its AI-based software PowerAlpha was used to optimise the project design.
context: The companies say the project will supply on-demand clean capacity as electricity demand in Arizona grows. They present the financing as a sign of lender confidence in their ability to deliver complex solar-plus-storage projects in the US. Cordelio is wholly owned by Canada Pension Plan Investment Board.

sources.title: BrightNight and Cordelio Power Reach Financial Close for 300 MW / 1,200 MWh Pioneer Hybrid Renewable Project in Arizona

title: Copec WIND Ventures invests in Moment Energy and forms second-life battery storage partnership with Copec
summary: Vancouver-based Moment Energy, which repurposes used electric vehicle batteries into stationary storage, received an undisclosed strategic investment from Copec WIND Ventures, the venture arm of Latin American energy group Copec. The two companies also formed a commercial partnership to deploy second-life battery storage projects in Latin America and Europe.
details: The partners plan 45 MWh of near-term projects for commercial and industrial customers, with a further 300 MWh planned using batteries retired from Chile's electric bus fleet. Second-life batteries are EV batteries that no longer suit vehicles but can still store energy for buildings or the grid before recycling. The investment amount was not disclosed. Moment Energy says it has raised nearly 60 million dollars in total, plus more than 30 million dollars in non-dilutive government funding, meaning grants that do not give up ownership.
context: The companies present the deal as a step toward a local second-life battery supply chain in Latin America and Europe that would reduce reliance on Asian imports. Copec's venture head argues stationary storage faces a supply gap as lithium-ion production focuses on EVs. Moment Energy claims its repurposed systems cost over 30% less than systems built with new batteries.

sources.title: Moment Energy secures Copec WIND Ventures investment and Forms Strategic Partnership with Copec

title: Baltic Storage Platform secures €85.6 million from EBRD, NIB and Edmond de Rothschild
summary: The Baltic Storage Platform, a joint venture of Corsica Sole, Evecon and Mirova, secured €85.6 million from the EBRD, NIB and Edmond de Rothschild Asset Management for battery storage in Estonia.
details: The Baltic Storage Platform, owned by Corsica Sole, Evecon and Mirova, secured €85.6 million from the EBRD, Edmond de Rothschild Asset Management and the Nordic Investment Bank for two batteries in Estonia, Hertz 1 and Hertz 2.
context: It is the first project financing in the Baltics based only on revenue from balancing and trading power. Lenders accepted market-based revenue without a fixed contract, a step forward for storage financing in the region.

context: NIIF IFL specialises in lending against operating infrastructure; refinancing lowers costs and releases capital for growth.

context: Holmen's businesses span forestry, wood products, paper and energy; wind on its own land adds renewable generation to a group whose products replace fossil-based materials.

sources.title: Sweden to receive wind-energy lift with EIB loan to Holmen

summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners made a final investment decision to acquire Ørsted's waste pre-treatment and biogas plant in Northwich, its first UK biogas asset.
details: CIP's Advanced Bioenergy Fund I made a final investment decision to buy Ørsted's combined waste pre-treatment and biogas plant in Northwich, England. Subject to permits, CIP plans to convert it to biogas only and add a digester, biomethane upgrading and CO2 capture.
context: It is CIP's first UK biogas asset. Upgrading biogas to biomethane lets it be injected into the gas grid, and captured biogenic CO2 can be sold.

sources.title: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquires first biogas plant in the UK

context: EU recovery money through BGK lowers the cost of financing for ORLEN's large offshore wind programme in the Baltic.

title: Treaty Oak Clean Energy signs PPAs with Meta for 385 MWac of Louisiana solar
summary: Treaty Oak Clean Energy signed long-term PPAs with Meta for two solar projects totalling 385 MWac in Morehouse and Sabine parishes, Louisiana.

context: The projects expand Treaty Oak in the MISO South region and add capacity to the Louisiana grid.

sources.title: Treaty Oak Clean Energy And Meta Sign Long-Term PPAs For Two Louisiana Solar Projects, Advancing Renewable Energy Commitments

title: energyRe closes about $370 million construction and term financing for South Carolina solar portfolio
summary: US developer energyRe has reached financial close on roughly $370 million of construction and term financing for a group of solar projects in South Carolina. Santander, Bank of America, Natixis and Societe Generale provided the loans.
details: Financial close means the funding agreements are signed and money can be drawn to build the projects. The package combines construction financing, which pays for building the plants, with term financing, a longer loan repaid from project revenue once the plants run. The four banks acted as coordinated lead arrangers, meaning they jointly organised and provided the debt. Santander also structured the deal as financial advisor and serves as administrative agent, handling loan administration for the lenders. The release does not state the portfolio's capacity, offtake arrangements or completion dates.
context: energyRe says the projects will produce enough electricity for about 36,000 homes a year once operating. The company reports a pipeline of 16 GW under development across the US spanning generation, transmission and storage, and presents the financing as support for meeting rising US power demand.

sources.title: ENERGYRE SECURES $370 MILLION FINANCING FOR SOUTH CAROLINA SOLAR PORTFOLIO, BACKED BY LEADING GLOBAL LENDERS

summary: Drax signed an agreement with Apatura to buy three two-hour battery projects totalling 260 MW for £157.2 million, paid in stages to 2028 as construction milestones are met.
details: Drax agreed to buy three two-hour battery projects totalling 260 MW from Apatura for £157.2 million, paid in stages between 2025 and 2028 as construction milestones are met. Two complete in 2025 and the third in early 2026.
context: It is Drax's first short-duration storage investment, part of its FlexGen portfolio alongside its biomass and pumped storage plants.

sources.title: Drax acquires 260 MW 2-hour BESS portfolio

title: SEC and EDF power solutions sign 25-year PPA with SPPC for 600 MW Samtah solar project in Saudi Arabia
summary: A consortium of Saudi Electricity Company and EDF power solutions has signed a 25-year power purchase agreement with the Saudi Power Procurement Company for the 600 MW Samtah solar PV project. The plant is in Jazan Province, Saudi Arabia, and was awarded under Round 6 of the National Renewable Energy Program.
details: The project site lies about 35 km southwest of Jazan city and 15 km north of Samtah. The consortium will develop, finance, build, own and operate the plant, and SPPC, the state's main electricity buyer, will purchase its output for 25 years under the power purchase agreement (a long-term contract to sell electricity at agreed terms). Commercial operation is expected in the first quarter of 2028. The partners say a significant share of materials, equipment and services will be sourced from Saudi companies during construction. No financial terms or lenders were disclosed.
context: SEC describes the project as its first large-scale solar PV venture, marking a move into renewable generation. EDF says the award lifts its renewable capacity in Saudi Arabia to 4,100 MW. The companies expect the plant to supply more than 100,000 homes and avoid about 1.1 million tonnes of CO2 a year, supporting the national goal of roughly 50 percent renewable electricity by 2030.

sources.title: Under the supervision of the Ministry of Energy, Saudi Electricity Company and EDF power solutions win a 600 MW solar PV power project in Samtah and sign the Power Purchase Agreement with the Principal Buyer

context: Junior debt sits behind bank loans and lets the owner release equity. It is ETIC's first Romanian investment.

details: Honda Motor made a strategic equity investment in OMC Power, which builds distributed renewable systems in rural India. The partnership targets a 1 GWp portfolio and new business models for storage, including reusing batteries from electric vehicles.
context: Second-life EV batteries can store solar power for villages at lower cost. Honda links the investment to its 2050 carbon neutrality goal.

summary: Lightsource bp closed US$97.9 million of tax equity with Pinnacle Financial Partners for the 187 MW Peacock Solar project in San Patricio County, Texas.

context: Production tax credits pay per unit of power generated, so investors take some output risk in exchange for the credits.

title: Meta signs PPA for all output of ENGIE's 600 MW Swenson Ranch Solar project in Texas
summary: ENGIE North America has signed additional power purchase agreements with Meta, under which Meta will buy all output from ENGIE's planned 600 MW Swenson Ranch Solar project in Texas. The new contracts bring the companies' combined PPA relationship to more than 1.3 GW across four Texas projects.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific power plant. Swenson Ranch Solar is located in Stonewall County, southeast of Lubbock, Texas, and is expected to begin operating in 2027. ENGIE puts its planned investment in the project at about $900 million and says construction will employ more than 350 workers. The contract length and price were not disclosed.
context: ENGIE says Swenson will be the largest single asset in its North American portfolio of more than 11 GW of operating and under-construction solar, wind and battery projects. Meta says the agreement helps it keep matching its electricity use with clean energy for its US data centers. The deal reflects growing demand from technology companies for renewable power to supply digital infrastructure.

context: Building capacity in advance lets SMFL Mirai respond quickly to Japanese companies seeking renewable supply.

It funds 40 MW of distributed solar and storage across nine US states.
context: Bridge Renewable Energy is a subsidiary of Bridge Investment Group. A flexible facility lets it draw funds as each small project reaches construction.

title: Peregrine Energy Solutions raises $130 million from investor consortium for U.S. battery storage pipeline

buyers.name: Ministry of Environment of South Korea

summary: Boulder-based battery storage developer Peregrine Energy Solutions has raised $130 million in new capital from a group of investors. The backers include South Korea's Ministry of Environment, IMM Investment, Woori Private Equity Asset Management and funds managed by AB CarVal. The money will fund development of its utility-scale storage projects across the United States.
details: Peregrine develops and operates utility-scale batteries, which store electricity and release it to the grid when needed. Its portfolio includes two projects in ERCOT, the grid operator covering most of Texas, which the company says are due to start operating in late 2025 and early 2026. The release does not give project sizes, the stake sold or the structure of the investment. Peregrine was set up in 2022 as a partnership between Peregrine Energy Management and a global alternative investment manager.
context: The company says the funding will let it expand into more U.S. markets as rising power demand puts pressure on the grid. South Korea's Ministry of Environment presented the investment as part of wider Korea-U.S. energy cooperation. AB CarVal noted it has backed Peregrine for several years, so the round extends an existing relationship.

context: It will be among the largest grid-scale batteries in South-East Europe. Having the transmission connection contract already signed removes a major hurdle for construction.

title: Cypress Creek Renewables closes about $190 million financing for Sundance solar-plus-storage project in Colorado
target: Sundance Solar and Energy Storage project
summary: Cypress Creek Renewables has reached financial close, meaning the funding is fully committed, on its Sundance hybrid solar and battery project in Elbert County, Colorado. The project pairs 75 MWac of solar with a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery and is backed by roughly $190 million in construction loans plus tax equity from Fifth Third Bank.
details: Sundance combines 75 MWac of solar panels with a battery system that can deliver 50 MW for about four hours, totalling 200 MWh. MUFG Bank coordinated the roughly $190 million construction loan alongside BNP Paribas, DNB Bank ASA and Santander. Fifth Third Bank is the tax equity investor, an investor that funds the project in exchange for the federal tax credits it generates. Power will flow into the CORE Electric Cooperative system, and McCarthy Building Companies is the engineering, procurement and construction contractor, with construction started in July 2025 and commercial operation expected by late 2026.
context: The company says the project will supply enough power for about 25,000 Colorado homes and create up to 250 construction jobs. It also expects more than $9.5 million in property tax over a planned 40-year life, along with $300,000 in local community investment. Cypress Creek presents the deal as part of a wider push to develop more projects in Colorado.

sources.title: Cypress Creek Renewables Announces Financial Close of Hybrid Solar and Storage Project in Colorado

summary: Grenergy secured US$270 million, led by SMBC, for the Elena hybrid plant in Antofagasta, part of Oasis de Atacama: 77 MW of operating solar with a 430 MW / 3.5 GWh battery.
details: SMBC led a US$270 million financing with BNP Paribas, BBVA and KfW for Grenergy's Elena hybrid plant in Antofagasta, part of its Oasis de Atacama platform: 77 MW of operating solar with a 430 MW / 3.5 GWh battery that charges from the plant and the grid when power is cheap. DNV advised.

title: CIP sells 50% of Coalburn 2 battery to AIP Management funds
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners agreed to sell 50% of the Coalburn 2 battery in Scotland to funds managed by AIP Management.

context: Once built it will be among Europe's largest batteries. Selling half to a pension-backed investor lets CIP recycle capital while keeping control.

sources.title: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners divests 50% ownership stake in BESS project

title: StormFisher Hydrogen acquires Recyclage Carbone Varennes to build e-methanol plant in Quebec
summary: StormFisher Hydrogen has bought Recyclage Carbone Varennes through a court-approved process. It plans to turn the partially built site in Varennes, Quebec, into a low-carbon methanol plant producing more than 72,000 tonnes a year.
details: The original RCV project was designed to make methanol by gasifying biomass, meaning heating organic material to turn it into a gas. StormFisher instead plans to combine hydrogen made from water using clean electricity with carbon dioxide captured from local emitters, reusing part of the existing infrastructure. The plant is meant to meet European RFNBO rules, a standard for fuels made from renewable electricity rather than biomass, and is expected to capture over 100,000 tonnes of CO2 a year. Operation is scheduled for 2028 and the project is expected to create about 75 jobs. No price, electrolyser capacity or advisers were disclosed.
context: StormFisher claims the facility will be the first large-scale low-carbon methanol plant of its kind in North America. The fuel is aimed at shipping, aviation and chemical buyers seeking alternatives to fossil fuels. The company says switching technology lowers project risk, and the deal marks its entry into Quebec.

sources.title: StormFisher Hydrogen acquires Recyclage Carbone Varennes to launch North America's first large-scale low-carbon methanol plant in Varennes

title: T1 Energy takes minority stake in Talon PV, developer of 4.8 GW Texas solar cell plant

advisors.name: Marathon Capital
advisors.role: exclusive financial advisor to Talon PV

summary: T1 Energy has agreed to take a minority ownership interest in Talon PV, a Houston-based company planning a solar cell factory in Baytown, Texas. The planned plant would have 4.8 GW of annual TOPCon cell manufacturing capacity. The size of the investment was not disclosed.
details: T1 signed a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE), a contract where an investor provides money now in exchange for shares issued at a later date, to secure its minority stake. Before this deal, Houston venture capital firm Eagle Group had supplied all of Talon's funding.
