The Baytown factory is designed to make n-type TOPCon cells, a high-efficiency type of silicon solar cell, and has secured $97.1 million in state and local tax incentives. Fraunhofer ISE is the research partner and ARCO Murray will lead construction, with commercial availability expected in the first quarter of 2027. Marathon Capital was Talon's exclusive financial adviser.
context: Talon says the investment supports its technology plans and positions it to move into project financing, and it is still working to complete its funding with other partners. The company presents the factory as adding to US domestic solar cell supply and meeting domestic content and non-FEOC rules, which limit reliance on suppliers linked to certain foreign governments. The two companies say they are exploring a broader strategic collaboration. Note that the deal concerns a manufacturing plant rather than a power generation project, so the 4.8 GW figure is production capacity, not generating capacity.

sources.title: Talon PV Announces Sale of Minority Stake to T1 Energy

title: Eiffel buys 50% of 270 MW French wind and solar portfolio from TotalEnergies
summary: Eiffel Investment Group bought 50% of a 270 MW French wind and solar portfolio from TotalEnergies, valuing it at €265 million. TotalEnergies keeps 50% and runs the assets.
details: Eiffel Investment Group bought 50% of a 270 MW French wind and solar portfolio from TotalEnergies Renouvelables France, valuing it at €265 million. TotalEnergies keeps 50%, runs the assets and sells most of the power. Watson Farley & Williams advised Eiffel.
context: Eiffel manages about €7 billion. TotalEnergies regularly sells half of portfolios to recycle capital while keeping operating control.

sources.title: WFW advises Eiffel Investment Group on renewables portfolio acquisition

title: DESRI closes $129 million preferred equity investment in 250 MW West Texas solar portfolio
target: 250 MWac two-project utility-scale solar portfolio in West Texas
summary: DESRI has closed a $129 million preferred equity investment in a 250 MWac solar development made up of two projects in West Texas. The projects belong to an unnamed US independent power producer.
details: The portfolio consists of two utility-scale solar projects with combined capacity of 250 MW measured on the alternating current side. Preferred equity is an ownership investment that typically gets paid ahead of common owners but behind lenders. DESRI says the money supports construction of the projects, which are intended to serve new industrial electricity demand in the area. King & Spalding LLP acted as legal adviser to DESRI.
context: DESRI, which mainly owns and operates contracted solar and wind projects, presents the deal as evidence of its role as a capital provider to other developers. The company says its experience building over eight gigawatts of projects helps it add value to assets it invests in. The release ties the projects to growing industrial power demand in West Texas.

sources.title: DESRI Announces Closing of Preferred Equity Financing for 250 MW Solar Portfolio in Texas

title: PowerBank signs 20 MW solar and storage lease and PPAs with New York State DMNA

buyers.name: New York State Division of Military and Naval Affairs (DMNA)

target: 20 MW DC portfolio of solar and battery storage projects on DMNA sites in New York
summary: PowerBank Corporation has signed lease and power purchase agreements with the New York State Division of Military and Naval Affairs for a 20 MW DC portfolio of solar and battery storage projects. The systems will sit on DMNA land across New York State, with power sold to DMNA or to local community solar subscribers.
details: The portfolio includes about 19 MW of ground mount, rooftop and parking canopy solar and a 1 MW/2 MWh battery, meaning it can deliver 1 MW for about two hours. Sites include Camp Smith Training Site and facilities in Ithaca, Kingston and Newark. Some systems will be behind-the-meter, meaning they supply the site directly, while others will be community solar projects where local residents subscribe and earn bill credits. Power purchase agreements, which are long-term contracts to buy electricity at set terms, have an initial term of 20 years. PowerBank plans to develop, finance and build the projects and expects construction to begin by the end of 2025.
context: PowerBank's subsidiary Abundant Solar Power won the work through a competitive bidding process run by the New York Power Authority. DMNA says the projects will cut utility costs and improve energy resiliency, and describes it as a first-of-its-kind renewable and microgrid project for the agency. The projects are said to be eligible for NYSERDA incentives under the NY-Sun program, and development remains subject to interconnection approval, permits and financing.

sources.title: 20 MW of Solar and BESS Power Purchase Agreements Secured by PowerBank with the New York State Division of Military and Naval Affairs (DMNA)

title: Westbrooke buys solar and battery portfolio at 91 Shell Downstream SA sites
summary: Westbrooke Renewable Energy Alternatives acquired operating solar and battery assets at 91 Shell Downstream South Africa sites, producing about 7.8 GWh a year.
details: Westbrooke Renewable Energy Alternatives, with independent power producer CVE South Africa, bought operating solar and battery systems at 91 Shell Downstream South Africa service stations from Thebe Solar Energy. They produce about 7.8 GWh a year.
context: The deal fits Westbrooke's strategy of buying behind-the-meter assets with steady contracted income; Thebe sold as part of a strategic realignment.

sources.title: Westbrooke Expands Renewable Footprint With 7.8 GWh Solar Acquisition Covering 91 Shell Downstream SA Sites

title: FRV reaches financial close on 100 MW / 200 MWh SIMO battery in Finland
summary: Fotowatio Renewable Ventures reached financial close on the 100 MW / 200 MWh SIMO battery in Finland, developed with AMPTank Energy.
details: Fotowatio Renewable Ventures, part of Jameel Energy, reached financial close on SIMO phase 2, a 100 MW / 200 MWh two-hour battery developed with AMPTank Energy near Fingrid's Simojoki substation in Lapland. It follows the 30 MW / 60 MWh first phase.
context: FRV is building a storage business in Finland, where batteries earn money balancing the grid.

sources.title: FRV increases BESS portfolio with financial close of SIMO project

title: Ignitis Renewables buys 49% of Curonian Nord offshore wind project from Ocean Winds
summary: After regulatory approval, Ignitis Renewables signed a deal to buy Ocean Winds' 49% of the company developing the Curonian Nord offshore wind project in Lithuania.
details: After approval by Lithuania's energy regulator, Ignitis Renewables signed a deal to buy Ocean Winds' 49% of Offshore Wind Farm 1, the company developing the Curonian Nord offshore wind project, at a nominal price, reimbursing Ocean Winds' direct project costs.
context: Ignitis will take full ownership of the Curonian Nord project and its research data and intellectual property. Paying only a nominal price plus incurred costs reflects the project's early stage.

sources.title: Ignitis Renewables acquires Curonion Nord offshore wind farm

title: EBRD lends up to €12.2 million for Novalja solar plant in Croatia
summary: The EBRD provided a senior non-recourse loan of up to €12.2 million to RP Global's Novalja subsidiary to build a solar plant in Croatia.
details: The EBRD provided a senior non-recourse loan of up to €12.2 million to RP Global Novalja for a 21 MW solar plant in Croatia, under its InvestEU framework.
context: InvestEU guarantees let the bank take more risk on renewable projects in member states such as Croatia.

sources.title: EBRD Grants €12.2 Million Loan To Support Construction Of Novalja Solar PV Plant, Advancing Croatia’s Green Energy Transition

title: ENOVA Value buys 34 MW Nettetal wind project from BMR
summary: ENOVA Value acquired the 34 MW Nettetal wind project in North Rhine-Westphalia from BMR, which will develop it up to commissioning. It will use five Nordex 6.8 MW turbines.
details: ENOVA Value bought the 34 MW Nettetal wind project in Viersen district, North Rhine-Westphalia, from BMR, which will manage development to commissioning. Five Nordex N163 6.8 MW turbines go up from early 2026 for operation in 2027, producing about 70,000 MWh a year.
context: It continues the two companies' partnership in the state, with BMR handling development and ENOVA owning the finished farm. Output should meet the needs of about 17,000 households.

sources.title: ENOVA Value acquires 34 MW Nettetal wind farm

title: Advanced Power sells 200 MW Rock Rose battery storage project in Texas
summary: Advanced Power has completed the sale of Rock Rose Energy Storage, a 200 MW, two-hour battery storage project in Fort Bend County, Texas. The buyer and price were not disclosed.
details: Rock Rose is a fully developed standalone battery project rated at 200 MW with two hours of storage, meaning it can discharge at full power for about two hours. It sits in the ERCOT grid region, which covers most of Texas, and is meant to serve the Houston and Freeport areas. Operations are expected to start in 2027. PEI Global Partners advised Advanced Power on the sale.
context: The project is Advanced Power's first standalone energy storage development, and the company presents the sale as proof of its development capabilities beyond thermal and renewable generation. Advanced Power says it has a pipeline of more than 12 GW of thermal and renewable projects and over 9 GWh of storage across several US grid regions.

sources.title: Advanced Power Closes Sale of Rock Rose Energy Storage

title: Generate Capital closes $85 million community solar tax equity fund with KeyState's SOLCAP
target: Fund X, eight community solar projects in New York and Illinois
summary: Generate Capital has closed an $85 million tax equity commitment from SOLCAP, the investment platform run by KeyState. The money backs Fund X, a group of eight community solar projects in New York and Illinois totaling 38 MWdc.
details: The portfolio consists of eight community solar projects, which sell power or bill credits to local subscribers such as households and businesses, with a combined capacity of 38 MW measured on the direct current side. The projects are expected to start commercial operation between the fourth quarter of 2025 and the first quarter of 2026. Tax equity is a financing structure in which an investor provides capital in exchange for the project's federal tax benefits. SOLCAP pools such investments from community and regional banks. Orrick acted as sponsor counsel and Kutak Rock as investor counsel.
context: Generate says this is its 10th community solar tax equity fund and its 5th with KeyState since 2021. The company reports raising more than $1.4 billion in project debt and tax equity so far in 2025 and says it owns and operates over 430 MW of community solar. KeyState says SOLCAP has deployed or committed over $1 billion to more than 200 renewable projects since 2019.

sources.title: Generate Capital Closes $85 Million Community Solar Tax Equity Fund with KeyState, Expanding Leadership in Distributed Clean Energy Financing

title: Eolian closes $463 million Natixis-arranged financing for Padua 2 and 3 battery storage projects in Texas
target: Padua 2 and Padua 3 battery energy storage projects
summary: Eolian has closed a $463 million financing package arranged by Natixis CIB to fund construction of Padua 2 and Padua 3, two battery storage projects totaling 350 MW and 1.7 GWh in Bexar County, Texas. The projects complete the Padua Complex near San Antonio.
details: Padua 2 is 150 MW and Padua 3 is 200 MW, both designed to discharge for about five hours, and construction on both began in summer 2025. The first phase, Padua 1, is a 50 MW, roughly two-hour system already in commercial operation, bringing the full complex to 400 MW and 1.8 GWh. The package combines a construction loan, a term loan that replaces it once projects operate, and letter of credit facilities, which are bank guarantees often required by grid operators or contract partners. Tesla supplies the battery equipment, and the projects are planned to start operating in winter and spring 2026. Eolian developed the projects and will operate them itself.
context: Eolian says the complex will be the largest battery storage development in Texas and that Padua 2 and 3 will be the longest-duration battery projects built in the ERCOT grid. The site sits next to retiring coal units and an aging gas plant at a transmission pinch point, and the company claims the batteries will make better use of existing lines until planned 345 kV upgrades arrive around 2030. Eolian links its investment to Texas legislation creating reliability products favoring storage of four hours or longer. Total private investment in the complex is stated at more than $700 million.

sources.title: Eolian and Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking Close $463 Million Financing for Largest Battery Energy Storage Site in Texas, Providing Needed Capacity at Critical Location for the Grid

title: Qair secures €55 million from Crédit Agricole and Bpifrance for Hyd'Occ hydrogen in Occitanie
summary: Qair secured €55 million from Crédit Agricole and Bpifrance to build its Hyd'Occ renewable hydrogen ecosystem in Occitanie.
details: Crédit Agricole and Bpifrance provided €55 million for Qair's Hyd'Occ project: a renewable hydrogen plant in Port-La Nouvelle and five refuelling stations on regional transport routes. The first production unit should start by year-end.
context: Covering production, transport and refuelling in one project creates local demand for green hydrogen to decarbonise trucks and buses.

sources.title: Qair Secures €55 Million Financing With Crédit Agricole And Bpifrance To Build The Hyd’Occ Renewable Hydrogen Ecosystem In Occitanie, France

title: GoodLeap and Tactical Infrastructure Partners close $183.3 million residential solar securitization
summary: GoodLeap and Tactical Infrastructure Partners closed TIP Solar ABS 2025 LLC, a $183.3 million securitization backed by residential solar leases and power purchase agreements originated on GoodLeap's platform in the United States. It is the first issuance under the two firms' partnership.
details: A securitization bundles many small contracts, here home solar leases and PPAs where homeowners pay for the system or its power, into bonds sold to investors. The deal provides permanent, long-term financing on cashflows from residential solar assets that Tactical had previously invested in alongside GoodLeap. Kroll Bond Rating Agency rated the notes. ATLAS SP Partners acted as sole structuring agent, meaning it designed and arranged the bond structure.
context: The issuance follows a partnership under which GoodLeap and Tactical plan to acquire more than $1.5 billion of residential solar and storage products. The companies say the transaction frees up capital to grow third-party owned solar and storage, where a company rather than the homeowner owns the system. GoodLeap states it has provided over $30 billion in solar and home efficiency loans since 2018.

sources.title: GoodLeap and Tactical Infrastructure Partners Announce Closing of Inaugural $183 Million Securitization Backed by GoodLeap-Originated Solar Leases and Power Purchase Agreements

title: Solarvest and Press Metal's Mukah Solar signs PPA with SESCO for 100 MW Sarawak solar

sellers.name: Mukah Solar Powerplant (Solarvest and Press Metal)

summary: Mukah Solar Powerplant, a Solarvest–Press Metal SPV, signed a PPA with SESCO for a 100 MW solar farm in Sarawak.
details: Mukah Solar Powerplant, owned 60% by Solarvest and 40% by Press Metal, signed a PPA with SESCO, part of Sarawak Energy, for the 100 MWac Mukah solar plant in Sarawak.
context: The plant is a joint venture between a solar developer and an industrial company, and its output is contracted to Sarawak Energy's SESCO.

sources.title: Solarvest And Press Metal Join Forces To Build Sarawak’s 100MW Solar Farm, Sign PPA With SESCO For Clean Power Supply

title: Deriva Energy and Manulife agree to sell 833 MWdc of operating solar to Clearway
summary: Deriva Energy and joint venture partner Manulife Investment Management agreed to sell an 833 MWdc operating solar portfolio to Clearway Energy.
details: Deriva Energy and joint venture partner Manulife Investment Management agreed to sell an 833 MWdc (613 MWac) operating solar portfolio to Clearway Energy, closing by the second quarter of 2026. Terms were not disclosed; TD Securities advised the sellers.
context: Deriva says the sale recycles capital for its next phase of growth. For Clearway, buying operating plants adds contracted output without construction risk.

sources.title: Deriva Energy And Clearway Energy Complete Agreement For Sale Of 833MWdc Of Operating Solar Projects

title: KGAL buys 60.5 MWp of operating Andalusian solar for Software AG Foundation
summary: KGAL, on behalf of the Software AG Foundation, acquired two grid-connected solar projects in Andalusia totalling 60.5 MWp.
details: KGAL, on behalf of the Software AG Foundation, bought two grid-connected solar plants in Andalusia, 60.5 MWp in total. 70% of their output is sold to Velux under a ten-year PPA. Watson Farley & Williams advised KGAL.
context: A charitable foundation investing in contracted solar gets steady long-term returns.

sources.title: WFW advises KGAL on Spanish PV portfolio acquisition

title: Doral Renewables signs corporate PPA for 430 MW Cold Creek Solar project in Texas
summary: Doral Renewables has signed a power purchase agreement with an unnamed corporate buyer for its 430 MWac Cold Creek Solar Project in Texas. The contract covers 75% of the plant's electricity and all of its renewable energy credits.
details: Cold Creek Solar is located in Schleicher and Tom Green Counties, Texas, and is expected to produce more than 1 million MWh of electricity a year. A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase power from a project at set terms. The buyer also receives all of the project's renewable energy credits, which are certificates proving that a unit of power came from a renewable source. The release does not disclose the buyer's name, the contract length, the price or the construction timeline.
context: Doral says the deal lifts its total contracted generation to more than 1.6 GW. The company reports a solar and storage development pipeline of nearly 18 GW, with 400 MW operating and 950 MW under construction. It also expects the project to create hundreds of construction jobs and support local infrastructure.

sources.title: Doral Renewables Secures Power Purchase Agreement for the Cold Creek Solar Project in Texas

title: EBRD invests €50 million in GEK TERNA's €500 million bond
summary: The EBRD invested €50 million in GEK TERNA's €500 million seven-year senior unsecured bond, funding renewables, storage and infrastructure in Greece, Romania, Albania and Kosovo.
details: The EBRD invested €50 million in GEK TERNA's €500 million seven-year senior unsecured bond, listed in Athens. Proceeds fund renewables, batteries, social infrastructure and water projects in Greece, Romania, Albania and Kosovo, plus refinancing.
context: An anchor investment from the EBRD helps a corporate bond attract other investors.

sources.title: EBRD Invests €50M In GEK TERNA’s €500M Bond To Boost Renewable Energy, Battery Storage, And Infrastructure Across Greece, Romania, Albania, And Kosovo

title: Masdar buys 49.99% of €368 million Spanish solar portfolio from Enel Green Power
summary: Masdar closed the purchase of 49.99% of a €368 million portfolio of four operating solar plants in Spain from Enel Green Power España.
details: Masdar closed its purchase of 49.99% of four operating solar plants in Spain, 446 MW in total, from Enel Green Power España, part of Endesa. The portfolio is valued at €368 million; Masdar put in €69 million of equity and €115 million of acquisition debt.
context: It extends a partnership in which Masdar bought 49.99% of 2 GW of Endesa solar in 2024, one of Spain's largest renewable deals.

sources.title: Masdar Acquires 49.99% Stake in €368M Spanish Solar Portfolio from Enel Green Power

title: Trinasolar signs 20-year PPA with AdventEnergy for 49.9 MW Mabini solar
summary: Trinasolar signed a 20-year PPA with AboitizPower subsidiary AdventEnergy for its 49.9 MW Mabini solar project in Pangasinan.
details: Trinasolar's project development unit signed a 20-year PPA with AdventEnergy, an AboitizPower subsidiary, for the Mabini solar project in Barangay San Pedro, Mabini, Pangasinan: 49.9 MWac / 60.21 MWp. It has Green Lane certification from the Board of Investments.
context: It is Trinasolar's first greenfield project in the Philippines. Green Lane status speeds up permits for priority investments.

sources.title: Trinasolar, AdventEnergy Ink 20-Year PPA For 49.9 MW Mabini Solar Project In Pangasinan

title: SNCF Energie signs four solar PPAs with Neoen
summary: SNCF Energie signed four long-term corporate solar PPAs with Neoen, with supply starting on 1 January 2026.
details: SNCF Energie signed four PPAs of 20 to 25 years with Neoen in July. From 1 January 2026, Neoen supplies SNCF Voyageurs with 137 GWh a year from four solar parks totalling 111 MWp, including Romilly (42 MWp) in Grand Est.
context: The contracts give Neoen stable revenue and shield the railway operator from swings in wholesale power prices.

sources.title: SNCF Energie Signs Four New Solar Power Purchase Agreements With Neoen To Expand Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: JERA Nex sells part of Ishikari Bay offshore wind farm to Hokkaido and Tohoku Electric
summary: JERA Nex transferred part of its stake in the Ishikari Bay New Port offshore wind farm to a company set up by Hokkaido Electric Power and Tohoku Electric Power.
details: JERA Nex transferred part of its stake in the 112 MW Ishikari Bay New Port offshore wind farm in Hokkaido, 14 Siemens Gamesa turbines, to a company formed by Hokkaido Electric Power and Tohoku Electric Power. The farm is now jointly run by JERA, Green Power Investment, Hokkaido Electric and Tohoku Electric.
context: Bringing in the regional utilities spreads ownership of the wind farm among four Japanese power companies, which now run it jointly.

sources.title: JERA transfers stake in Ishikari Bay Offshore Wind project

title: Green Hedge sells 100 MW German battery project to Econergy
summary: Green Hedge sold its first ready-to-build battery project, 100 MW with up to four hours of storage near Senftenberg, Germany, to Econergy.
details: Green Hedge sold its first ready-to-build battery, 100 MW with up to four hours of storage on industrial land near Senftenberg, Brandenburg, to Econergy International in June 2025. Construction is under way.
context: It marks Green Hedge's entry into the German storage market, where it is building a portfolio of projects to improve grid reliability.

sources.title: Green Hedge sells 100 MW German battery storage project

title: Verdant Energy buys 11 MW rooftop solar portfolio in Vietnam
summary: Verdant Energy acquired an 11 MW rooftop solar portfolio in Vietnam.
details: Verdant Energy bought an 11 MW rooftop solar portfolio on ten shopping malls in Vietnam that supply Central Retail's operations. It produces more than 11,700 MWh a year.
context: The deal builds Verdant's Vietnamese business supplying solar directly to businesses, cutting their costs and about 8,100 tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: Verdant Energy Acquires 11 MW Rooftop Solar Portfolio in Vietnam

title: Clearway acquires 109 MW Catalina Solar in Kern County
summary: Clearway Energy Group and Clearway Energy, Inc. acquired the 109 MW Catalina Solar facility in Kern County, California.
details: Clearway Energy Group and Clearway Energy, Inc. bought the 109 MW Catalina Solar plant in Kern County, California, which powers about 37,000 homes and pays about US$11 million in local taxes.
context: Clearway now owns more than 1.5 GW of solar, wind and storage in Kern County. Concentrating assets in one area lets it share operations staff and grid know-how.

sources.title: Clearway Energy Acquires 109 MW Catalina Solar Facility, Boosting Kern County Portfolio to 1.5 GW

title: Iberdrola Italia buys 9.6 MW Montenero solar project from Altea Green Power
summary: Iberdrola Italia acquired Montenero Green Energy, owner of an authorised 9.6 MW solar project in Molise, from Altea Green Power.
details: Iberdrola Italia bought Montenero Green Energy from Altea Green Power. The company owns a solar project of about 9.6 MW in Molise that already has construction authorisation. Watson Farley & Williams advised Iberdrola.
context: Buying projects that already have construction authorisation lets Iberdrola start building in Italy without the long permitting stage. The seller, Altea Green Power, is a renewables-only producer.

sources.title: WFW advises Iberdrola on Italian PV acquisition

title: Oyster Renewable secures ₹1,844 crore Union Bank loan for 342 MW hybrid project
summary: Oyster Renewable's Oyster Green Hybrid Three reached financial close with a ₹1,844 crore Union Bank of India loan for a 342 MW solar-wind hybrid project in Madhya Pradesh.
details: Union Bank of India lent ₹1,844 crore for nearly 20 years to Oyster Green Hybrid Three for a 342 MW co-located solar-wind project in Madhya Pradesh, connected to the inter-state grid. It has a 25-year captive PPA with a large process-industry user.
context: It is one of the largest debt financings for a hybrid project in Madhya Pradesh. It should avoid about 800,000 tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: Oyster Renewable Achieves Financial Closure with ₹1,844 Cr Union Bank Loan for 342 MW Project

title: Enlight raises nearly US$340 million of tax equity for Roadrunner solar and storage
summary: Enlight's Clēnera completed two tax equity partnerships worth nearly US$340 million for the Roadrunner solar and storage project near Tucson, Arizona.
details: Clēnera, Enlight's US subsidiary, signed two tax equity deals for the Roadrunner project near Tucson, Arizona: with J.P. Morgan for the 290 MW solar part, paid at commercial operation plus pay-go payments over ten years, and with M&T Bank and First Citizens Bank for the 940 MWh battery. Together they are worth nearly US$340 million.
context: Separate investors fund the solar and battery parts, each in exchange for the related US tax credits.

sources.title: Enlight Raises Nearly $340M Through Tax Equity Deals For Roadrunner Solar & Energy Storage Project Near Tucson, Arizona

title: Iberdrola adds 708 MW of Spanish solar to its alliance with Norges Bank
summary: Iberdrola added the Ceclavín and Tagus XL solar plants in Extremadura, 708 MW, to its co-investment alliance with Norges Bank Investment Management.
details: Iberdrola added Ceclavín (328 MW, operating since 2021) and Tagus XL (380 MW, operating since 2025) in Extremadura to its joint venture with Norges Bank Investment Management, keeping 51%. The venture's operating capacity rises to nearly 900 MW.
context: The partnership, started in 2023, now covers more than €2 billion and 2,500 MW across Spain and other markets.

sources.title: Iberdrola Expands Co-Investment Alliance with Norges Bank, Adding 708 MW of Renewables in Spain

title: CC&L Infrastructure acquires 49% of three Ontario wind farms from NextEra Energy Resources
target: 49% interest in Adelaide Wind, Bornish Wind and Goshen Wind
summary: Connor, Clark & Lunn Infrastructure has bought a 49% stake in three operating wind farms in southern Ontario from NextEra Energy Resources. The portfolio totals about 235 MW of gross capacity. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio consists of Adelaide Wind (about 60 MW), Bornish Wind (about 73 MW) and Goshen Wind (about 102 MW), all already in operation. All of their output is sold to Ontario's grid operator, the Independent Electricity System Operator, under 20-year power purchase agreements, which are long-term contracts fixing who buys the electricity. NextEra Energy Resources keeps the remaining 51% and will continue to run the projects. CIBC Capital Markets acted as financial adviser and Torys LLP as legal counsel to CC&L Infrastructure.
context: The buyer says the deal lifts its renewable portfolio to nearly 2.4 GW of gross capacity, including more than 1.2 GW of wind across 10 assets. The company presents the investment as part of a strategy built on strong counterparties and stable cash flows, and as a way to expand its presence in Ontario. The projects also have community benefit agreements with several local Indigenous groups.

sources.title: Connor, Clark & Lunn Infrastructure expands renewable energy portfolio to nearly 2.4 GW with investment in three Ontario wind assets

title: TotalEnergies sells 50% of 1.4 GW North American solar to KKR
summary: TotalEnergies agreed to sell 50% of a 1.4 GW North American solar portfolio to KKR-managed insurance accounts, at an enterprise value of US$1.25 billion.
details: TotalEnergies agreed to sell 50% of its North American solar portfolio, six utility-scale projects of 1.3 GW and 41 distributed assets of 140 MW, mainly in the US, to KKR-managed insurance accounts at an enterprise value of US$1.25 billion. It expects US$950 million at closing after refinancing.
context: The power is already contracted under long-term agreements, which suits insurance investors seeking steady returns. TotalEnergies keeps half and recycles capital.

sources.title: TotalEnergies Sells 50% Of 1.4 GW North American Solar Portfolio to KKR In $1.25 Billion Deal, Expects $950 Million At Closing

title: EEF buys Seewald wind farm from Kraftwerke Mainz-Wiesbaden
summary: EEF acquired the Seewald wind farm in Baden-Württemberg, eight turbines under construction producing about 100,000 MWh a year, from Kraftwerke Mainz-Wiesbaden.
details: EEF Erneuerbare Energien Fabrik bought the Seewald wind farm in Baden-Württemberg from Kraftwerke Mainz-Wiesbaden. It is under construction with eight turbines, its own substation and grid connection, and should produce about 100,000 MWh a year. ALTUS renewables developed it; Watson Farley & Williams advised EEF.
context: Its own substation will also strengthen the regional grid. The output equals the use of about 28,000 households.

sources.title: WFW advises EEF on acquisition of Seewald wind farm

title: Greenvolt sells 112 MW / 448 MWh Kozienice battery project in Poland
summary: Greenvolt Power agreed the sale of its ready-to-build 112 MW / 448 MWh Kozienice battery project in Poland.
details: Greenvolt Power agreed to sell its ready-to-build 112 MW / 448 MWh battery project in Kozienice, Poland, with all permits and grid agreements in place, to DRI, the EU renewables arm of Ukraine's DTEK.
context: Greenvolt develops projects to the ready-to-build stage and sells them to recycle capital, its asset rotation strategy.

sources.title: Greenvolt sells 112 MW energy storage project in Poland

title: Global South Utilities buys 51% of Uzbekistan's Yashil Energiya
summary: Abu Dhabi's Global South Utilities acquired 51% of Uzbekistan's Yashil Energiya, its first investment in Central Asia.
details: Global South Utilities of Abu Dhabi completed the purchase of 51% of Yashil Energiya, a vertically integrated developer of commercial and industrial distributed solar in Uzbekistan that is also moving into EV charging and small hydro.
context: It is GSU's first investment in Central Asia and the CIS, and the first purchase of a CIS renewable company by an Emirati firm, adding distributed solar to its utility-scale projects.

sources.title: UAE’s Global South Utilities Acquires 51% Stake in Uzbekistan’s Yashil Energiya, Marking First CIS Renewable Energy Investment

title: Montana-Dakota Utilities wins North Dakota approval for 49% stake in Badger Wind Farm
summary: Montana-Dakota Utilities, a subsidiary of MDU Resources, received North Dakota regulatory approval for its planned purchase of a 49% interest in the Badger Wind Farm. The utility expects to invest about $294 million for a 122.5 MW share of the net 250 MW project near Wishek, North Dakota.
details: The Badger Wind project is under construction and is expected to be finished around the end of 2025. The North Dakota Public Service Commission issued an Advanced Determination of Prudence, a ruling in advance that the spending is reasonable and can be recovered from customers, along with a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity, which is permission to build or acquire the facility. The prudence ruling covers investment of up to $295.5 million, including $1.5 million of internal costs. The release does not name the seller or any advisers.
context: The regulatory approvals give the utility a framework for recovering the investment through customer rates, which the company says supports the project's financial viability. MDU Resources describes the approval as a key step toward delivering cost-effective energy to its customers.

sources.title: MDU's Investment in Wind Farm Deemed Prudent and Cost-Effective for Customers

title: Foss & Company closes $54.4 million tax credit transfer for Innergex's Hale Kuawehi solar-plus-storage project in Hawaii

buyers.name: Foss & Company
buyers.role: tax credit buyer / tax equity syndicator

target: Hale Kuawehi Solar and Storage Project
summary: Foss & Company has closed a $54.4 million tax credit transfer for the Hale Kuawehi Solar and Storage Project on the Island of Hawaii. The project was developed by Innergex and pairs a 30 MW AC solar array with a 30.7 MW / 122.8 MWh battery system.
details: Hale Kuawehi is a newly commissioned facility combining a 30 MW AC photovoltaic array with a co-located four-hour battery of 30.7 MW and 122.8 MWh. The deal used the Inflation Reduction Act's transfer provisions, which let a developer sell its federal investment tax credits to another party for cash rather than using them itself. Innergex is the sponsor responsible for developing, commissioning and operating the project. CRC-IB acted as exclusive financial adviser to Innergex.
context: Foss & Company says this is its third transaction in Hawaii and presents it as evidence of its role in financing clean energy in remote markets. The release states that Hawaii's grid needs dispatchable storage and that limited land favors combined solar-plus-storage sites. Innergex says the project supports Hawaii's shift toward a carbon-free power system.

sources.title: Foss & Company Closes Solar Plus Battery Storage Tax Credit Transfer for Hawaiʻi Island Project

title: SP New Energy secures ₱3.78 billion loan for Tarlac solar expansion
summary: SP New Energy secured a loan facility of up to ₱3.78 billion (about US$64 million) to expand its Tarlac solar plant and refinance existing debt.
details: SP New Energy secured a loan facility of up to ₱3.78 billion (about US$64 million) to expand its solar plant in Tarlac and refinance existing debt. The loan is secured on shares of its subsidiary Solar Philippines Tarlac, with SPNEC providing a standby letter of credit for the debt service reserve.
context: Pledging the subsidiary's shares and funding a reserve account gives lenders extra security.

sources.title: SPNEC bags $64.26m loan for solar expansion

title: Alternergy buys Tayabas North and South wind projects from CleanTech
summary: Alternergy is acquiring the Tayabas North and Tayabas South wind projects in Quezon Province from CleanTech Global Renewables.
details: Alternergy, through its Calavite Passage Wind Power company, is acquiring the Tayabas North and Tayabas South wind projects in Quezon Province from CleanTech Global Renewables under a deed of assignment. Tayabas North, 96 MW, qualified in the Philippines' fourth green energy auction in September 2025.
context: The projects support Alternergy's goal of a 500 MW pipeline and add to its growing wind business. Winning an auction slot gives Tayabas North a contracted tariff.

sources.title: Alternergy acquires two PH wind projects from CleanTech

title: Soltage closes $525 million tax credit investment vehicle for US solar and storage projects
summary: US independent power producer Soltage has closed a $525 million tax credit investment agreement. The financing is expected to fund the next 260 MW of its distributed solar and battery storage projects in the United States.
details: The structure involves the purchase of investment tax credits over two years. Investment tax credits are federal tax breaks earned by building clean energy projects, which developers can sell to companies that want to reduce their tax bills. An unnamed Fortune 500 company has committed to buy tax credits generated through the partnership through 2026. The capital supports Soltage's pipeline of more than 2 GW of photovoltaic and battery storage projects.
context: The deal follows a $260 million debt raise by Soltage in June 2025. The company says the financing gives it stable long-term capital to keep developing, building and operating its projects. Soltage is backed by Igneo Infrastructure Partners and reports having delivered more than 125 projects totaling over 500 MW.

sources.title: Soltage Closes $525 Million Tax Credit Investment Vehicle for Storage and Solar Projects

title: OCI Energy and ING close construction financing for Alamo City battery in Texas
summary: OCI Energy closed construction financing with ING for the 120 MW / 480 MWh Alamo City battery in Bexar County, Texas, contracted with CPS Energy.
details: ING underwrote OCI Energy's construction financing for Alamo City, a 120 MW four-hour battery in Bexar County, Texas: a construction-to-term loan, a tax equity bridge loan and letters of credit. It has a long-term contract with San Antonio utility CPS Energy.
context: It will be one of the largest standalone batteries in Texas, helping keep the San Antonio grid reliable at peak times.

sources.title: OCI Energy And ING Secure Financing For Texas’ Alamo City Battery Project, 480 MWh Storage For CPS Energy

title: Avangrid signs PPA with Amazon for 57 MWdc Oregon Trail Solar
summary: Avangrid signed a PPA with Amazon for power from the new 57 MWdc Oregon Trail Solar project in Gilliam County, Oregon, from 2027.
details: Oregon Trail Solar, 57 MWdc (41 MWac) in Gilliam County, Oregon, will supply Amazon's regional data centres from 2027 under a PPA with Avangrid.
context: It adds to Avangrid's renewable partnership with Amazon, which buys power near its data centres.

sources.title: Avangrid Signs PPA With Amazon For 57 MWdc Oregon Trail Solar In Gilliam County, Powering Regional Data Centers From 2027

title: Constant Energy secures THB 300 million green facility from HSBC
summary: Constant Energy secured a THB 300 million green guarantee and standby credit facility from HSBC to expand solar and battery projects in Thailand.
details: HSBC provided Constant Energy with a THB 300 million green guarantee and standby documentary credit facility to support large solar and battery projects in Thailand.
context: Guarantee lines let developers provide security required in power contracts without tying up cash. Thailand aims for 51% renewable power by 2037.

sources.title: Constant Energy Secures THB 300 Million Green Financing from HSBC to Expand Renewable Projects in Thailand

title: La Caisse agrees to acquire Australian solar and battery developer Edify Energy
summary: Canadian investment group La Caisse, formerly CDPQ, has signed binding agreements to buy Australian renewable energy and battery storage company Edify Energy. Including additional equity funding, the total investment is expected to be about CAD 1 billion (roughly AUD 1.1 billion).
details: The money will pay for the acquisition and provide equity for two ready-to-build hybrid projects that pair solar generation with battery storage, totaling 900 MW and 3,600 MWh. Their output is contracted to offtakers Rio Tinto and the Commonwealth of Australia, meaning these buyers have agreed to purchase the power. Funding will also support Edify's pipeline of more than 11 GW of hybrid and battery projects. Parts of the deal still need customary change-of-control and regulatory approvals. ICA Partners and Clifford Chance advised La Caisse, while Lazard Australia and Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer advised Edify.
context: Edify, founded in 2015, says it built Australia's first utility-scale solar and battery project and has delivered 11 projects totaling over 1.1 GW in New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria. The company's founder says the deal gives it the balance sheet strength to speed up delivery of dispatchable green power, meaning clean supply that can be called on when needed. La Caisse presents the acquisition as reflecting its confidence in renewables and storage for the energy transition.

sources.title: La Caisse to acquire Edify, a leading Australian renewable energy and battery storage company

title: JSW Neo Energy to buy 150 MW Tidong hydro plant from Statkraft
summary: JSW Neo Energy signed a deal to buy 100% of Tidong Power Generation, owner of a 150 MW hydro plant, from Statkraft at an enterprise value of about ₹1,728 crore.
details: JSW Neo Energy agreed to buy all of Tidong Power Generation from Statkraft at an enterprise value of about ₹1,728 crore. Tidong is building a 150 MW run-of-river hydro plant in Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh, with a 22-year PPA with Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation for 75 MW from May to October.
context: Statkraft is selling Indian assets; JSW gains a hydro plant under construction with a contracted buyer.

sources.title: JSW Energy unit to acquire 150 MW Tidong hydro power plant

title: Velto Renewables to buy 260 MW of regulated Spanish solar
summary: Velto Renewables, backed by La Caisse, agreed to buy a 163 MW portfolio of regulated Spanish solar from Helia II FCR plus 97 MW from Plenium Partners.
details: Velto Renewables, backed by La Caisse, agreed to buy a 163 MW portfolio of regulated Spanish solar from Helia II FCR, a Bankinter Investment vehicle, plus 97 MW from Plenium Partners: 53 operating plants, about 260 MW, at an enterprise value of about €1.1 billion. They produce more than 360 GWh a year.
context: Older regulated plants earn a set return under Spanish rules, giving steady income.

sources.title: Velto Renewables to acquire Spanish solar projects

title: GridStor buys 100 MW / 400 MWh White Tank battery from Strata
summary: GridStor acquired the 100 MW / 400 MWh White Tank battery project in Maricopa County, Arizona, from Strata Clean Energy.
details: It has a 20-year tolling agreement with Arizona Public Service.

sources.title: GridStor acquires Arizona BESS from Strata Clean Energy

title: JinkoSolar sells about 300 million A shares of its subsidiary Jiangxi Jinko to institutional investors
summary: JinkoSolar Holding has completed the sale of 300,156,075 A shares in Jinko Solar Co., Ltd., its main operating subsidiary in China, to institutional investors at RMB4.90 per share. After the sale, the NYSE-listed parent holds about 55.59% of the subsidiary.
details: Jiangxi Jinko is an indirect, majority-owned subsidiary of JinkoSolar whose A shares (domestic Chinese shares traded in yuan) are listed on the Sci-Tech Innovation Board of the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The shares were sold through an inquiry transfer and placement, a process under Shanghai Stock Exchange rules in which a major shareholder sells a block of shares to institutional investors at a price set by gathering their bids. The buyers were not named and no total deal value was given in the release.
context: JinkoSolar describes itself as one of the largest solar module manufacturers in the world. The sale reduces its holding in its principal operating subsidiary while keeping majority control at roughly 55.59%. The release does not state how the proceeds will be used.

sources.title: JinkoSolar Announces Completion of Sale of A Shares in Its Subsidiary, Jinko Solar Co., Ltd., through Inquiry Transfer and Placement

title: Serentica Renewables signs 100 MW round-the-clock PPA with SECI
summary: Serentica Renewables signed a PPA with SECI to supply 100 MW of round-the-clock renewable power.
details: Serentica signed a PPA with SECI for 100 MW of round-the-clock renewable power, designed with SECI and state utilities to follow buyers' seasonal demand. Serentica must meet 80% of specified hourly demand each month, with supply varying from 17 MW upward.
context: Serentica calls it India's first load-following PPA, shaping supply to match demand rather than delivering flat output.

sources.title: Serentica Renewables Inks India’s First 100 MW Round-The-Clock Power Purchase Deal With SECI

title: Maharashtra approves Mahagenco–SJVN joint venture for 5,000 MW of renewables
summary: The Maharashtra government approved a joint venture of Mahagenco and SJVN to develop 5,000 MW of renewable energy projects.
details: Maharashtra approved a joint venture of state generator Mahagenco and SJVN to develop 5,000 MW of renewables, building on a June 2023 memorandum covering pumped storage, solar-wind hybrids and other projects. Mahagenco currently has 428 MW of renewables.
context: The state wants half its power from renewables by 2030 and 75% by 2047. Pairing the state generator with central hydro company SJVN brings in pumped storage experience.

sources.title: Maharashtra Clears Joint Venture with SJVN for 5,000 MW Renewable Energy Projects

title: Terra One secures up to €150 million mezzanine financing from Aviva Investors
summary: Terra One secured up to €150 million of mezzanine financing from Aviva Investors, which with equity and project finance lets it invest up to €750 million in about 3 GWh of batteries.
details: Aviva Investors is providing up to €150 million of mezzanine finance to Terra One, a German developer of grid-scale batteries. With equity and project finance, it lets Terra One invest up to €750 million in about 3 GWh of storage.
context: Mezzanine debt sits between bank loans and equity, stretching the developer's own capital. Terra One says 3 GWh could meet about 20% of German households' needs for one hour.

sources.title: Terra One secures €150 million financing from Aviva Investors to expand energy storage portfolio

title: PIF's Massader, APIC and Bank of Palestine form renewable energy company Taqa
summary: Massader, the energy investment arm of the Palestine Investment Fund, together with the Arab Palestinian Investment Company and Bank of Palestine Group, signed an agreement to set up Taqa, a new renewable energy company in Palestine. No investment amount, ownership split or capacity target was disclosed.
details: Taqa is intended to finance and develop medium- and large-scale clean energy plants in Palestine. The release does not name specific projects, sites, capacities or a timeline. The agreement was signed by the chairmen of the three partners. APIC points to solar as an area of strong potential, but the release does not commit Taqa to a particular technology.
context: Palestine depends almost entirely on imported electricity, according to the Palestine Investment Fund, and the partners say Taqa aims to raise the domestic renewable share and reduce the import bill. The partners claim the projects will lower costs, improve supply reliability and create jobs. Bank of Palestine frames its participation as part of its sustainability and ESG commitments, meaning environmental, social and governance goals.

sources.title: 'Taqa': A Strategic Renewable Energy Company established by a joint investment of the Palestine Investment Fund, Arab Palestinian Investment Company, and Bank of Palestine Group

title: Longroad Energy closes financing for 400 MWdc 1000 Mile Solar project in Texas

buyers.name: CIBC
buyers.role: co-coordinating lead arranger and administrative agent

summary: Longroad Energy has reached financial close, meaning all funding is committed, on its 1000 Mile Solar project in Yoakum County, Texas, and has started construction. The project is rated 400 MWdc (300 MWac) and is backed by tax equity from Morgan Stanley Renewables and bank debt led by Societe Generale and CIBC. No financing amount was disclosed.
details: The plant will use First Solar Series 7 modules and Nextracker trackers, with SOLV Energy as the engineering, procurement and construction contractor. Morgan Stanley Renewables committed tax equity, an investment where a party funds the project in exchange for using its tax credits. Debt was led by Societe Generale and CIBC, joined by ANZ, Barclays and KeyBank. Meta signed a long-term Environmental Attributes Purchase Agreement in late 2024, a contract with financial settlement covering the full output, which will feed the Southwest Power Pool grid. Commercial operation is expected in 2026.
context: Longroad says this is its largest solar project, its seventh renewable project in Texas and its first in the SPP region, bringing its developed Texas capacity to 2.1 GW. The offtake supports Meta's goal of matching its data center operations with clean energy. The company cites estimates of about 475,000 tonnes of avoided CO2 a year and over $18 million in local tax revenue over the project's life.

sources.title: Longroad Energy Achieves Financial Close of 1000 Mile Solar, a 400 MWdc Project

title: Serentica Renewables to buy Statkraft's Indian solar business
summary: Serentica Renewables signed binding agreements to acquire Statkraft's Indian solar business.
details: Serentica Renewables signed binding agreements to buy Statkraft's Indian solar business: a 445 MWp operating plant in Bikaner and 1 GWp of development projects in Rajasthan, which now sell power on the merchant market.
context: Serentica plans to move the plants onto long-term contracts with commercial and industrial buyers. Statkraft has been selling assets in India to narrow its focus.

sources.title: Serentica Renewables to Acquire Statkraft’s Indian Solar Business in Major Decarbonization Push

title: Inox Neo Energies to buy 640 MW wind-solar hybrid portfolio in Maharashtra
summary: Inox Neo Energies signed definitive agreements to buy five wind-solar hybrid projects in Maharashtra, 640 MW in total, contracted under SJVN and NHPC tenders, from Evergreen.
details: Inox Neo Energies signed definitive agreements to buy five wind-solar hybrid projects in Maharashtra, 640 MW in total, from Evergreen Power Mauritius and Evergreen Renewables. They hold contracts from SJVN and NTPC tenders and will connect at CTUIL 400/220 kV substations.
context: Buying contracted projects adds to Inox Clean's pipeline with buyers already in place.

sources.title: Inox Clean Energy unit to acquire 640 MW hybrid portfolio

title: ib vogt signs virtual PPA with US tech company for 70 MWp Romanian solar project
summary: ib vogt signed a long-term virtual PPA with an investment-grade US technology company for its roughly 70 MWp solar project in north-western Romania.
details: ib vogt signed a long-term virtual PPA with an investment-grade US technology company for its roughly 70 MWp solar project in north-western Romania, which should produce about 110 GWh a year. ib vogt will build and maintain it with bifacial panels and single-axis trackers, with room for storage.
context: ib vogt calls it a sign that Romania's corporate renewable buying market is maturing.

sources.title: ib vogt signs landmark long-term virtual PPA for a utility scale PV project

title: Statkraft sells 49% of Malana Power to LNJ Bhilwara Group
summary: Statkraft completed the sale of its 49% minority stake in Indian hydropower company Malana Power to its long-term partner LNJ Bhilwara Group.
details: Statkraft completed the sale of its 49% minority stake in Malana Power Company to its long-term Indian partner, LNJ Bhilwara Group.
context: Statkraft says it is sharpening its global focus through selective sales, including in India; LNJ Bhilwara will continue to run the hydro assets.

sources.title: Statkraft Divests Minority Stake In Indian Hydropower Joint Venture, LNJ Bhilwara Group Takes Ownership

title: Aboitiz Renewables secures ₱7.4 billion BPI loan for 221 MWp Olongapo solar
summary: Aboitiz Renewables' subsidiary AP Renewable Energy secured ₱7.4 billion (about US$133 million) from the Bank of the Philippine Islands for the 221 MWp Olongapo solar plant in Zambales.
details: BPI lent ₱7.4 billion (about US$133 million) to AP Renewable Energy, an Aboitiz Renewables subsidiary, for the 221 MWp Olongapo solar plant in Zambales. Construction began in early 2024 and was 95% complete, with commissioning due in the third quarter of 2025 at the Castillejos 230 kV substation.
context: The loan funds engineering, construction, operation and maintenance of a plant that was nearly complete when it was signed, adding to AboitizPower's renewable growth plan.

sources.title: Aboitiz Renewables bags $133.2m loan for PH solar project

title: ADB signs US$51 million for ACWA's Nukus 2 wind and battery project
summary: The Asian Development Bank and ACWA Power signed a US$51 million loan package for the Nukus 2 wind and battery project in Karakalpakstan, Uzbekistan.
details: The ADB and ACWA Power signed a US$51 million package for the Nukus 2 wind and battery project in Qoraozak district, Karakalpakstan: US$25.4 million from ADB's own resources and US$25.4 million from the Leading Asia's Private Infrastructure Fund 2. It is built by ACWA Power Beruniy Wind FE.
context: It will be Central Asia's first wind farm with a utility-scale battery, supporting Uzbekistan's 2030 renewable target.

sources.title: ADB, ACWA Power ink $51m loan for wind plus battery project in Uzbekistan

title: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund refinances 1 GW UK battery portfolio with £240 million
summary: Gresham House Energy Storage Fund refinanced its 1 GW portfolio of 28 operating UK batteries with a £240 million package from a club of five lenders.
details: NORD/LB, Santander UK, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Rabobank and Aviva Investors provided £240 million to refinance Gresham House Energy Storage Fund's 1 GW portfolio of 28 operating UK batteries. Burges Salmon advised the lenders.
context: GRID is the UK's largest battery fund, owning about 20% of UK battery sites. The money funds augmentation, adding cells to raise storage capacity and earnings.

sources.title: Burges Salmon acts on major £240 million refinancing for BESS portfolio

title: CC&L Infrastructure closes over US$200 million refinancing of 560 MW US wind and solar portfolio
target: CC&L Infrastructure US Renewable Power Portfolio

advisors.name: National Bank of Canada Capital Markets

summary: Connor, Clark & Lunn Infrastructure has closed more than US$200 million in bank debt from a group of international lenders including CIBC, MUFG, Desjardins Group and SuMi TRUST. The loans refinance its US renewable portfolio of more than 560 MW of wind and solar capacity.
details: The portfolio includes a 200 MW solar project in Indiana and four wind farms in Indiana, Wisconsin, Oklahoma and Ohio totaling more than 360 MW. Each project sells its power under long-term power purchase agreements, which are contracts fixing the buyer and price for years ahead. The assets span three separate US electricity markets. CC&L acquired the portfolio in 2021 together with two Desjardins Group entities, Régime de Rentes du Mouvement Desjardins and Desjardins Financial Security Life Assurance Company. A refinancing replaces or restructures existing debt on terms the borrower considers better.
context: CC&L says the refinancing improves the value of the portfolio by using the strength of its operating assets and lender relationships. The firm reports owning more than two gigawatts of gross renewable capacity worldwide and having closed over $5 billion in renewable power debt financings in recent years.

sources.title: Connor, Clark & Lunn Infrastructure announces closing of more than US$200 million in debt financing across its US Renewable Power Portfolio

title: Fidra Energy reaches financial close on Thorpe Marsh, the UK's largest battery
summary: Fidra Energy reached financial close on its Thorpe Marsh battery in Doncaster, the UK's largest, with up to £445 million of new equity from EIG and the National Wealth Fund alongside project debt.
details: Construction began immediately.

sources.title: Fidra Energy reaches financial close on UK’s largest BESS project

title: rPlus Energies closes about US$100 million tax equity with Truist for Pleasant Valley Solar 2
summary: rPlus Energies closed a tax equity commitment of about US$100 million with Truist Bank for the 125 MWac Pleasant Valley Solar 2 project in Ada County, Idaho.
details: Truist Bank committed about US$100 million of tax equity to rPlus Energies' 125 MWac Pleasant Valley Solar 2 in Ada County, Idaho, a project of more than US$175 million built by Sundt Construction.
context: It will be rPlus's second plant supplying Idaho Power and will support Meta's data centre in Kuna.

sources.title: rPlus Energies Strengthens Renewable Push With $100 Million Tax Equity Backing From Truist Bank For Pleasant Valley Solar 2

title: SolaREIT secures $200 million debt facility from SLC Management for solar and storage land financing
summary: SolaREIT, a Virginia-based real estate investment company that finances land for solar and battery storage projects, has obtained a $200 million long-term debt commitment from SLC Management, the institutional asset management arm of Sun Life Financial. The money will fund land deals for developers across the United States.
details: The facility will back SolaREIT's three main products: buying land for projects, lease purchases (buying the rights to a land lease that a project pays), and land loans to developers. It is set up so that further debt can be issued under the same arrangement as demand grows. SolaREIT says it has financed real estate for solar and storage projects worth more than $3 billion since 2020 and has closed over $125 million in battery storage transactions since entering that segment last year. No advisers or specific maturity dates were named.
context: SolaREIT presents the facility as a sign of institutional confidence in its land financing model at a time when developers face higher capital needs and shifting federal policy. The company claims the deal gives it scalable access to low-cost capital in a difficult financing market. For SLC Management, which reports about US$300 billion in assets under management, it adds exposure to the real estate side of US clean energy.

sources.title: SolaREIT Secures $200 Million Debt Commitment from SLC Management to Expand Real Estate Financing for Battery Storage and Solar Projects

title: AGCO signs 10-year virtual PPA with BRUC for 100 MW Spanish solar project
target: 100 MW solar PV project in northwest Spain
summary: US agricultural machinery maker AGCO has signed a 10-year virtual power purchase agreement with Spanish renewable energy group BRUC. The deal is tied to a new 100 MW solar PV project BRUC is developing in northwest Spain.
details: A virtual power purchase agreement is a financial contract in which a buyer agrees a long-term price for power from a project without physically receiving the electricity. The 100 MW solar plant is expected to produce about 200 GWh per year, and part of that output is allocated to cover a large share of AGCO's electricity use in Europe and the Middle East. Construction is planned to start in the second half of 2025, with commercial operation targeted for late 2026. Schneider Electric supported AGCO on the agreement.
context: AGCO says the contract helps cut its Scope 2 emissions, meaning emissions from the electricity it buys, and gives it stable long-term power prices. BRUC says such agreements are central to its long-term business plan. AGCO states it uses virtual PPAs where they are the most cost-effective route to renewable power and direct purchase is harder.

sources.title: AGCO Signs 10-year Virtual Power Purchase Agreement with BRUC to Advance European Renewable Energy Supply

title: Kommunalkredit provides €30.25 million for Unigea's 85 MW HELIOS I solar in Romania
summary: Kommunalkredit Austria and Unigea reached financial close on €30.25 million for the 85 MW HELIOS I solar project in Arad, Romania.
details: Kommunalkredit Austria provided €30.25 million of development financing to Unigea Solar Projects Romania, a subsidiary of Berlin-based Unigea, for the 85 MW HELIOS I solar project in Arad. The deal involved parties in Austria, Germany, Bulgaria and Romania.
context: The financing covers development, construction and operation, a complex package with security in several countries.

sources.title: Kommunalkredit and Unigea Romania reach financial close on solar project

title: Elmya Energy and Atlantica form Elmantic JV to develop 4 GW of US renewable projects
summary: Spanish renewable developer Elmya Energy and Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure have set up Elmantic, a joint venture to develop 4 GW of utility-scale renewable energy projects in the United States. Financial terms and ownership split were not disclosed.
details: The joint venture will start with greenfield projects, meaning new sites developed from scratch, in renewable energy and battery storage. Its initial focus is on the ERCOT market, which covers most of Texas, and the WECC region, which covers the western US grid. Development will be run jointly by the Elmya Energy USA team and the Atlantica North America team, with offices in Austin, Texas and Richmond, Virginia. Elmya Energy USA expects to hire additional staff to support the venture during 2025.
context: The venture pairs Elmya's development experience, which the company says includes more than 3 GW connected worldwide, with Atlantica's operating and infrastructure investment capabilities. Elmya argues that rising US electricity demand, competitive renewable pricing and possible changes in grid interconnection queues create openings for its targeted site selection strategy. The deal marks Elmya's expansion into the US market.

sources.title: Elmya Energy and Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure Launch Joint Venture to Bring Online 4 GW of U.S. Power Projects

title: Enfinity Global closes €316 million financing for 276 MW Italian solar portfolio
target: Eight utility-scale solar plants in Italy (276 MW)

advisors.name: Bondholders
advisors.role: Facility agent and documentary and security agent

summary: Enfinity Global reached financial close on €316 million of funding to build eight utility-scale solar plants in Italy with a combined 276 MW. The loans come from a club of three banks, ING, Rabobank and BNP Paribas.
details: The plants sit in the Emilia Romagna, Basilicata and Lazio regions and are expected to be fully running by the end of 2026. Financial close means the loan agreements are signed and money can be drawn. The package includes €214 million of non-recourse senior debt, meaning lenders are repaid from project revenues rather than the parent company, plus €101 million in facilities covering VAT and letters of credit tied to power purchase agreements, PV modules and decommissioning. The three banks also act as hedging counterparties and green loan coordinators. The company expects the portfolio to produce about 403 GWh a year.
context: Enfinity describes this as its largest project financing in Italy so far, bringing its total raised in the country over two years to €1.3 billion. The company says it is advancing an 8 GW Italian pipeline of solar and storage and claims to lead the Italian solar PPA market with 805 MW of long-term contracts signed. It is BNP Paribas's first project financing with Enfinity and the third Italian deal for both ING and Rabobank.

sources.title: Enfinity Global Secures €316 Million Financing for 276 MW of Solar Projects in Italy

title: Swift Current Energy closes US$242 million for 150 MW Prospect Power Storage in Virginia
summary: Swift Current Energy closed US$242 million of project financing for the 150 MW / 600 MWh Prospect Power Storage facility in Rockingham County, Virginia.
details: Truist Securities, CIBC, KeyBank and Natixis, as joint lead arrangers, provided US$242 million of project finance for Swift Current Energy's 150 MW / 600 MWh Prospect Power Storage in Rockingham County, Virginia, due to operate in 2026. It has a 15-year agreement with Dominion Energy Virginia.
context: Dominion is bringing a record number of new projects online to meet rising demand. Swift Current later sold the project to Elevate Renewables.

sources.title: Swift Current Energy Secures $242 Million Financing for 150 MW Prospect Power Storage Project in Virginia

title: Arevon secures US$250 million tax equity commitment from Wells Fargo for 430 MWdc Kelso Solar in Missouri
summary: Arevon Energy has closed a US$250 million tax equity commitment from Wells Fargo for its Kelso Solar Project in Scott County, Missouri. The two-phase project totals 430 MWdc and is under construction.
details: Kelso is a two-phase, 430 MWdc utility-scale solar project with an estimated total cost of US$500 million. Tax equity means an investor such as a bank provides capital in exchange for the right to use the project's federal tax credits and other tax benefits. The first phase is expected to begin commercial operation by the end of 2025 and the second in the first quarter of 2026. Arevon had earlier announced a US$509 million financing package for the project and two long-term agreements with Meta to buy its environmental attributes, meaning the clean energy credits linked to its output. Legal advisers included Amis, Patel & Brewer, Stoel Rives, Sheppard Mullin, Husch Blackwell and BCLP.
context: Kelso is Arevon's first utility-scale project in Missouri, and the company says it will raise the state's installed solar capacity by nearly 50 percent. Arevon describes the deal as among the largest tax equity raises in its history and says it brings its project financings over the past two years to US$4.5 billion. The company plans to own and operate the project long term as part of a wider push into the Midwest.

sources.title: Arevon Closes on $250 Million Tax Equity Commitment with Wells Fargo for its Kelso Solar Project in Missouri

title: Scatec signs 15-year PPA with BTG Pactual for 130 MW Colombian solar
summary: Scatec signed a 15-year PPA with BTG Pactual's Colombian energy trading arm for a 130 MW solar plant in Colombia.
details: Scatec signed a 15-year PPA with BTG Pactual Comercializadora de Energía for nearly 85% of the output of its 130 MW solar project in Nariño, Cundinamarca, about 100 km west of Bogotá. The rest will be sold to the market. The PPA is in pesos and indexed to producer price inflation.
context: It is Scatec's first project in Colombia. The plant later reached financial close as Barzalosa.

sources.title: Scatec Inks 15-Year PPA For 130 MW Solar Power Plant In Colombia, Boosting Nation’s Renewable Energy Drive

title: Equitix, Aware Super and National Wealth Fund commit £500 million to Eelpower batteries
summary: Equitix, Australian pension fund Aware Super and the UK's National Wealth Fund formed a consortium to invest £500 million in Eelpower Energy, aiming to build more than 1 GW of batteries.
details: Equitix, Australian pension fund Aware Super and the UK's National Wealth Fund formed a consortium to invest £500 million in Eelpower Energy, a new UK platform that will build, own and run grid-scale batteries, aiming for more than 1 GW.
context: The UK chancellor presented it as public money investing alongside private capital to upgrade the grid and bring down bills.

sources.title: Equitix, Aware Super, and National Wealth Fund to invest in UK battery storage as-sets

title: Statkraft sells Dutch renewables business to Greenchoice
summary: Statkraft divested its Dutch renewable development business to supplier Greenchoice, which acquired an operating solar portfolio and development activities.
details: Statkraft sold its Dutch renewable business to supplier Greenchoice, which took over an operating 120 MWp solar portfolio, the development pipeline of solar, wind and storage projects, and the local team.
context: Statkraft is selling businesses outside its core markets; Greenchoice will use the portfolio as a platform for growth.

sources.title: Statkraft Agrees to Divest Dutch Renewable Energy Activities to Greenchoice

title: Meridian and Nova form joint venture and secure NZ$300 million for Te Rahui solar
summary: Meridian Energy and Nova Energy completed a 50/50 joint venture for the 400 MW Te Rahui solar farm near Taupō and secured NZ$300 million from ANZ for the first 200 MW phase.
details: The output is shared equally through a PPA with Meridian.

sources.title: Meridian and Nova finalise solar JV and financing

title: Zenobe buys 400 MW Low Harker battery site from Innova
summary: Zenobe acquired a ready-to-build 400 MW battery project at Low Harker, Cumbria, from Innova. It has a 2028 grid connection date.
details: Zenobe bought a ready-to-build 400 MW battery at Low Harker, Cumbria, from Innova. It has a grid connection date in 2028.
context: Zenobe focuses on transmission-connected batteries above 200 MW. It says the deal followed the government's decision to keep a national rather than a zonal power market.

sources.title: Zenobe acquires battery storage site from Innova

title: Odfjell Oceanwind buys Ørsted's 80% of Salamander floating offshore wind project
summary: Odfjell Oceanwind completed its purchase of Ørsted's 80% of the Salamander offshore wind project in Scotland, developed with Simply Blue Group and Subsea7 as a floating wind demonstrator.
details: Odfjell Oceanwind completed its purchase of Ørsted's 80% of the Salamander project, a 100 MW floating offshore wind farm 35 km off Peterhead. It will develop it as a commercial-scale floating wind demonstrator with Simply Blue Group and Subsea7. It holds a seabed lease from the INTOG round and section 36 consent.
context: Floating wind can reach deep waters off Scotland; Salamander is meant to prove the technology at scale.

sources.title: Odfjell Oceanwind acquires Ørsted’s shares in Salamander offshore wind farm

title: OnPath Energy reaches financial close on 33.4 MW Mill Rig wind farm
summary: OnPath Energy reached financial close on the six-turbine, 33.4 MW Mill Rig wind farm in South Lanarkshire, which sells its power to a US technology company without subsidy.
details: NatWest provided a term loan and other facilities for OnPath Energy's Mill Rig wind farm, six turbines and 33.4 MW between Strathaven and Darvel in South Lanarkshire. It sells its power without subsidy to a US technology company under a long-term contract.
context: A corporate PPA replaces government support as the revenue lenders rely on. OnPath says the project adds to its support for Scotland's renewable energy goals.

sources.title: OnPath Energy achieves financial close for South Lanarkshire wind farm

title: FlexGen acquires key assets and intellectual property from Powin
target: Key assets and intellectual property of Powin
summary: Energy storage company FlexGen Power Systems has completed the purchase of key assets and intellectual property from storage firm Powin. The announcement came from venture capital investor Altira Group, an early backer of FlexGen. No price was disclosed.
details: The deal covers selected assets and intellectual property of Powin rather than the whole company. After adding these assets, FlexGen says it supports more than 25 GWh of deployed battery storage across about 200 projects in 10 countries. The acquisition is expected to widen the use of FlexGen's HybridOS control software and its lifecycle services, meaning ongoing maintenance and support over the life of storage systems. Deal terms and advisers were not disclosed.
context: Altira, which led FlexGen's first outside funding round and joined later rounds, presents the deal as strengthening FlexGen's position among grid-scale storage providers. Altira claims the larger installed base will help FlexGen address grid reliability and rising electricity demand from data centers and renewables.

sources.title: Altira Congratulates FlexGen on Powin Assets Acquisition and Growth in Global Energy Storage Leadership

title: OSW raises US$5.5 million from SparkEdge Capital to fund solar distribution expansion
summary: Australian solar wholesaler and distributor OSW has raised US$5.5 million in strategic funding from SparkEdge Capital, a Shanghai-based venture capital firm. The money is aimed at international growth and the rollout of the company's software platform.
details: OSW, founded in 2013, distributes solar equipment in Australia and also operates in Europe, notably the Netherlands and Poland. The new funds are earmarked for expansion into the United States, Mexico, Spain and Romania. Part of the capital will support GreenSketch, a free online tool launched this year that combines solar system design, equipment purchasing, subsidy applications and project management. The release does not disclose the size of the stake SparkEdge receives or any advisers.
context: OSW says it has held the leading share of the Australian solar distribution market for seven straight years and claims more than 20% penetration in some European regions. The company describes its goal as building an AI-driven platform for distributed energy, meaning small-scale systems such as rooftop solar. SparkEdge says it backed OSW for its mix of software and sector know-how.

sources.title: Solar distributor OSW secures $5.5 million USD to accelerate global expansion

title: Constant Energy refinances 13 Thai rooftop solar projects with THB 231 million from KBank
summary: Constant Energy secured THB 231 million of refinancing from KASIKORNBANK for 13 industrial rooftop solar projects in Thailand.
details: KASIKORNBANK extended a THB 231 million facility to refinance 13 operating rooftop solar projects of Constant Energy in Thailand, 13.7 MWp in total.
context: Constant Energy says stable regulation is helping industrial rooftop solar grow in Thailand.

sources.title: Constant Energy Secures THB 231 Million Refinancing from KASIKORNBANK for 13 Industrial Rooftop Solar Projects

title: Masdar, GD Power and KEPCO reach financial close on 2 GW Al Sadawi solar
summary: Masdar and partners GD Power and KEPCO reached financial close on the 2 GW Al Sadawi solar project in Saudi Arabia with eight regional and international lenders.
details: Masdar, GD Power and KEPCO reached financial close on the 2 GW Al Sadawi solar plant in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, about US$1.1 billion, with eight lenders: Standard Chartered, KEXIM, ADCB, BNP Paribas, ADIB, Bank of China, HSBC and Société Générale. It is built on a build-own-operate basis.
context: The project supports Saudi Arabia's 2030 renewable energy goals. The lenders cover a substantial part of the roughly US.1 billion cost.

sources.title: Masdar-led consortium reaches financial close for 2 GW solar project

title: EBRD adds €26 million loan to expand Gvozd wind farm in Montenegro
summary: The EBRD added a €26 million loan to expand the Gvozd wind farm in Montenegro from 55 MW to 75 MW with three more turbines.
details: The EBRD added a €26 million loan to install three more turbines at the Gvozd wind farm, raising it from 55 MW to 75 MW. It is developed by Montenegro's national power utility and will produce 186 GWh a year.
context: It will become Montenegro's largest wind farm, powering more than 35,000 households.

sources.title: EBRD backs expansion of Montenegro wind farm with €26 million loan

title: SAEL signs two PPAs for 880 MW of solar in Gujarat and Punjab
summary: SAEL Industries signed two PPAs for 880 MWac of solar projects in Gujarat and Punjab, including a 480 MW project.
details: SAEL signed two PPAs for 880 MWac of solar: 480 MW in Gujarat with Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam through SAEL Solar P Sixteen and P Seventeen (240 MW initial plus 240 MW more awarded), and 400 MW in Punjab.
context: Long-term contracts with state buyers support financing of the plants and expand SAEL's solar generation portfolio across two states.

sources.title: SAEL Signs Power Purchase Agreements To Deliver 880 MW Solar Capacity In Gujarat And Punjab

title: Infinity Power reaches financial close on 200 MW Ras Ghareb wind farm in Egypt
summary: Infinity Power reached financial close on a 200 MW wind farm at Ras Ghareb, Egypt, which sells to EETC.
details: Commercial operation is planned for summer 2027.

sources.title: Infinity Power reaches financial close on wind power project in Africa

title: CIP takes full ownership of 250 MW / 1 GWh Beehive battery in Arizona
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquired full ownership of the 250 MW / 1,000 MWh Beehive battery in Peoria, Arizona, from EDF power solutions, which began construction earlier in 2025.
details: CIP, through its CI V fund, took full ownership of the 250 MW / 1,000 MWh Beehive battery in Peoria, Arizona, from EDF power solutions, which began construction in 2025. It has a 20-year tolling agreement with Arizona Public Service and should operate in the first half of 2026.
context: Under a tolling agreement the utility pays a fixed fee to use the battery, giving the owner predictable income.

sources.title: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquires Beehive BESS in US from EDF power solutions

title: REC lends ₹3,184 crore for ACME Solar's 280 MW FDRE project
summary: ACME Solar's ACME Hybrid Urja secured ₹3,184 crore of project financing from REC for a 280 MW firm and dispatchable renewable project.
details: REC is sole lender of ₹3,184 crore over 18 years to ACME Hybrid Urja for a 280 MW firm and dispatchable project contracted with NHPC for 25 years, combining solar and batteries. It must reach a 40% annual capacity factor and 90% peak availability each month.
context: Firm power contracts need large batteries to meet peak demand, which raises costs but also tariffs.

sources.title: REC Extends ₹3,184 Cr Financing to ACME Solar’s 280 MW Hybrid Urja Project

title: Greenbacker sells 51.2 MW distributed solar portfolio to CleanCapital
summary: Greenbacker sold a 51.2 MW portfolio of 64 operating distributed solar assets to CleanCapital.
details: Greenbacker sold a portfolio of 64 operating distributed solar assets, 51.2 MW in total, to CleanCapital, an independent power producer focused on distributed clean energy.
context: Greenbacker is selling non-core assets to focus on building larger projects in its pipeline. CleanCapital specialises in owning distributed solar.

sources.title: Greenbacker Sells 51 MW Distributed Solar Portfolio To Advance Strategic Focus On Larger-Scale Clean Energy Projects

title: IFC approves up to US$600 million sustainability-linked loan to ENGIE Energía Perú
summary: The IFC approved a sustainability-linked corporate loan of up to US$600 million to ENGIE Energía Perú to develop renewable energy and cut emissions.
details: The IFC approved a corporate loan of up to US$600 million to ENGIE Energía Perú, one of Peru's largest generators, to develop renewable projects. The first US$120 million tranche is a green and sustainability-linked loan, the first such deal between the IFC and ENGIE Perú.
context: A sustainability-linked loan's interest rate falls if the borrower meets agreed emissions or renewable targets, rewarding progress on the energy transition.
