title: Aypa Power closes $535 million debt financing for 320 MW Vidal solar-plus-storage project in California

buyers.name: Santander Corporate & Investment Banking
buyers.role: Coordinating Lead Arranger, Mandated Lead Arranger, Green Loan Coordinator, Lender and LC Issuer

buyers.name: U.S. Bank National Association (U.S. Bancorp Impact Finance)

summary: Aypa Power, owned by Blackstone, has closed $535 million of debt financing for its Vidal hybrid solar and battery project in San Bernardino County, California. The 320 MW project is backed by a lender group led by Santander.
details: Vidal pairs 160 MW of solar panels with a 160 MW / 640 MWh battery system, meaning the batteries can discharge at full power for about four hours. Santander coordinated the loan and also issued letters of credit, which are bank guarantees backing the project's obligations, while U.S. Bank and Zions acted as mandated lead arrangers and Siemens Financial Services and Associated Bank joined as managing agents. The project will sell electricity, resource adequacy (a commitment to be available when the grid needs capacity) and renewable energy certificates to San Diego Community Power under a long-term power purchase agreement. It is expected to begin operating in 2026.
context: Aypa says the financing shows lender confidence in its ability to deliver grid-scale assets, and it presents the project as supporting California's grid reliability and its target of fully carbon-free electricity by 2045. The company expects the project to bring more than $13.5 million in local economic benefits and up to 260 construction jobs. Aypa reports 35 projects operating or under construction and a pipeline above 22 GW.

sources.title: Aypa Power Closes $535 Million to Advance California Solar and Energy Storage Hybrid Project

details: AGL bought two early-stage pumped hydro projects in the Hunter region, New South Wales, from Upper Hunter Hydro Top Trust: 770 MW and 623 MW, each with ten hours of storage, which could pair with wind.
context: Pumped hydro pumps water uphill when power is cheap and releases it through turbines when needed, giving long-duration storage that can support the grid for many hours.

title: Pivot Energy secures $200 million tax credit purchase commitment for 144 MWdc US community solar portfolio

buyers.name: Acadia Infrastructure Capital
buyers.role: facilitator of tax credit purchase via Climate and Communities Investment Coalition

summary: Pivot Energy, a US independent power producer, has obtained a $200 million commitment from buyers of tax credits to support a 40-project community solar portfolio totalling 144 MWdc. The projects are spread across eight US states, and the commitment was arranged through Acadia's Climate and Communities Investment Coalition.
details: The portfolio covers community solar projects in Colorado, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New York and Virginia, which sell power to local residential and commercial subscribers rather than to a single buyer. Under a tax credit purchase deal, the developer sells federal clean energy tax credits generated by the projects to companies that use them to cut their tax bills, giving the developer upfront cash. The release does not name the corporate buyers of the credits. This follows more than $450 million in financing commitments from HASI, First Citizens Bank and ATLAS SP Partners. The first projects are expected to start commercial operation in the third quarter of 2025.
context: Pivot describes the portfolio as one of the largest community solar portfolios in the US. The projects are expected to fund community benefit programs, administered by the Sustain Our Future Foundation, covering workforce training, education, resilience infrastructure and bill savings for low-income subscribers. Pivot is backed by ECP.

sources.title: Pivot Energy Secures $200 Million Tax Credit Purchase Commitment for 144 MWdc U.S. Community Solar Portfolio

context: Overberg will be one of South Africa's largest wind farms, supplying a mining company directly.

sources.title: Media Release: Red Rocket Reaches Financial Close for South Africa's Largest Wind Farm

title: CIM Group signs mandate for up to US$100 million preferred equity financing of SolarBank's 97 MW US solar portfolio

sellers.name: Abundant Solar Power Inc.
sellers.role: SolarBank subsidiary and joint venture partner

target: Portfolio of 21 solar projects totaling 97 MW
summary: SolarBank and CIM Group have signed a mandate letter under which CIM would provide up to US$100 million in project-level financing for a 97 MW portfolio of solar projects in the United States. The money would come as a preferred equity investment in a new joint venture holding company owned by CIM and SolarBank's subsidiary Abundant Solar Power.
details: The portfolio is expected to include 21 solar projects, and the new holding company would buy the project companies from Abundant Solar Power, paying 20% of each project's price at mechanical completion and 80% at substantial completion. CIM would receive a 3% annual coupon paid twice a year and keep all proceeds from selling the projects' investment tax credits, which US law lets project owners sell to third parties for cash. Remaining cash flow would go to Abundant Solar Power. The holding company can buy back CIM's stake starting 180 days after the fifth anniversary of the last project entering service, and if it does not, CIM can require a redemption. The deal still needs definitive documents and depends on permits, grid connection approvals and community solar contracts.
context: SolarBank says the financing supports its plan to become an independent power producer that owns its projects, and that it will keep majority ownership without issuing new shares because the funding sits at the project level. The company notes that it must separately finance construction up to the completion milestones, since no CIM funds are available before then. CIM describes the deal as part of its ongoing commitment to renewable energy in North America.

sources.title: US$100 Million Transformative, Project Financing Announced by SolarBank and CIM Group to Fund 97 MW of Renewable Energy Assets in the United States

title: Cypress Creek Renewables closes about $150 million construction financing for 104 MW Ostrea Solar in Washington
summary: Cypress Creek Renewables reached financial close on roughly $150 million of construction financing for its 104 MW Ostrea Solar project in Yakima County, Washington. MUFG Bank coordinated the loan with BNP Paribas, DNB and Santander, and U.S. Bank is the tax equity investor.
details: Ostrea is a 104 MW solar project, and construction started in February 2025 with PCL Construction's solar division as the EPC contractor, meaning the firm handling engineering, procurement and construction. Financial close is the point when all funding agreements are signed and money can flow. The debt is a construction loan of about $150 million led by MUFG Bank as coordinating lead arranger. U.S. Bank provides tax equity, an investment in exchange for the project's federal tax benefits. Commercial operation is expected by mid-2026.
context: The company says Ostrea is its first project in Washington State to reach financial close. It expects the project to power 15,000 to 16,000 homes, create about 250 construction jobs and generate around $15 million in county tax revenue over its life. Cypress Creek reports owning over 2 GW of solar and a 20 GW solar and storage pipeline.

sources.title: Cypress Creek Renewables secures $150 Million in financing and begins construction on 104MW Ostrea Solar project in Washington State

context: It is Attero's first move into manure; it already processes almost half of Dutch vegetable, fruit and garden waste into compost, green gas and bio-LNG.

title: Doral Renewables closes $100 million corporate letter of credit facility with HSBC
summary: Philadelphia-based developer Doral Renewables has closed a $100 million corporate letter of credit facility arranged and issued by HSBC. The facility adds to $185 million of existing letter of credit capacity and supports development of its US solar and storage pipeline.
details: A letter of credit is a bank guarantee that a company can post instead of cash to show it can meet its obligations. Doral expects to use these letters mainly to cover security requirements under new grid interconnection agreements and power purchase agreements, which are long-term contracts to sell electricity, during project development. HSBC served as sole arranger and issuing bank. With this facility, Doral's total corporate letter of credit capacity reaches $285 million.
context: Doral says its development portfolio exceeds 16 GW across 20 states, with 400 MW operating and 950 MW under construction. The company's CFO describes this kind of credit support as essential in the current development climate, as it lets developers commit to grid and offtake obligations without tying up cash. The deal extends an existing relationship between Doral and HSBC.

title: Ørsted sells 24.5% of West of Duddon Sands to Schroders Greencoat for £456.1 million
summary: Ørsted sold 24.5% of the 389 MW West of Duddon Sands offshore wind farm to funds managed by Schroders Greencoat for £456.1 million on a debt-free basis.
details: Ørsted completed the sale of 24.5% of the 389 MW West of Duddon Sands offshore wind farm, 14 km off the UK west coast and operating since 2014, to funds managed by Schroders Greencoat for £456.1 million, debt-free, on 30 April 2025.
context: The farm-down builds on earlier co-ownership between the two companies. Schroders Greencoat manages more than 7 GW and £9.6 billion.

sources.title: Ørsted divests 24.5% stake in West of Duddon Sands offshore wind farm

title: Standard Solar buys 39 MW Illinois community solar portfolio from New Leaf Energy
summary: Standard Solar acquired a 39 MW community solar portfolio in Illinois from New Leaf Energy.
details: Standard Solar bought five Illinois community solar projects, 39 MW in total, in Blackstone, Braceville, Dwight, Seneca and Wadsworth, from New Leaf Energy.
context: Its Illinois portfolio rises to more than 30 projects and 150 MW, operating, under construction or contracted, making the state a core market.

sources.title: Standard Solar Acquires 39 MW Community Solar Portfolio in Illinois

title: ALTÉRRA invests US$100 million in Brookfield's Indian platform Evren
summary: ALTÉRRA made its first co-investment, US$100 million into Evren, Brookfield's Indian renewable energy platform.
details: ALTÉRRA invested US$100 million through its Acceleration Fund in Evren, Brookfield's Indian platform, its first co-investment and first direct investment in the Global South. Evren plans up to 11 GW of solar, wind and storage in Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh.
context: ALTÉRRA, the UAE's climate fund, is investing alongside Brookfield to channel capital into emerging-market clean energy.

sources.title: ALTÉRRA Commits $100 Million to Evren in Inaugural Co-Investment, Boosting India’s Renewable Energy Goals

title: Fifth Third commits up to $30 million tax equity to Doral's 48 MW Great Bend solar project in Ohio
summary: Doral Renewables has closed tax equity financing for its Great Bend solar project in Meigs County, Ohio. Fifth Third Bank committed up to $30 million of tax equity to the 48 MWac project, which is under construction.
details: Great Bend is a ground-mounted solar plant using single-axis trackers, which tilt panels to follow the sun, with 48 MWac of capacity, located about 100 miles southeast of Columbus near the West Virginia border. Tax equity is an investment where a party such as a bank funds part of a project in return for its tax benefits. Doral and Fifth Third will also receive proceeds from a separate sale of tax credits to a third party, expected later in 2025. The project will sell electricity and renewable energy certificates under a long-term power purchase agreement with a large investor-owned utility that is not named. Doral expects commercial operation in the fourth quarter of 2025.
context: This is the first deal between Doral and Fifth Third, and both describe it as a basis for a longer relationship. Doral says the plant will power about 9,000 homes and generate over $400,000 a year in new tax revenue for Meigs County. Doral reports a solar and storage pipeline of over 16 GW, with 950 MW under construction.

sources.title: Doral Renewables Secures Tax Equity Financing for Great Bend Solar Project

sources.title: Havells Expands Renewable Energy Portfolio With Strategic Investment In Goldi Solar

sources.title: BW ESS and Nordea Bank sign largest ever battery storage financing in the Nordics

context: The projects support New York's clean energy targets and extend Catalyze's community solar business, which sells discounted power to subscribers.

sources.title: Catalyze Strengthens Clean Energy Portfolio With 48 MW New York Solar Acquisition From Hep Solar

details: Meralco PowerGen closed a ₱150 billion syndicated loan from banks including BDO, Security Bank, China Bank, PNB and Metrobank for the MTerra Solar project of its subsidiary Terra Solar Philippines, spread across Nueva Ecija and Bulacan.

sources.title: MGen Secures P150-Billion Loan for Mega Solar Project in Luzon

title: Limes Renewable Energy sells 287 MW Italian solar and wind portfolio
summary: Limes Renewable Energy completed the sale of a 287 MW portfolio of solar and wind projects in Italy.
details: Limes Renewable Energy sold a 287 MW Italian portfolio, split evenly between solar and wind, including 50 MWp of authorised solar, to an international IPP already active in Italy.

sources.title: Limes Renewable Energy Concludes Sale Of 287 MW Solar And Wind Portfolio Across Italy

context: The plants cut the retailer's power costs and about 4,000 tonnes of CO2 a year, replacing diesel generation.

sources.title: AFRIGREEN Debt Impact Fund and Empower New Energy Unlock Financing for 26 Solar and Storage Projects in Nigeria

title: Celsia acquires 675 MW Colombian wind and solar development portfolio from Mainstream Renewable Power
target: 675 MW Colombian wind and solar development portfolio
summary: Mainstream Renewable Power has sold its 675 MW portfolio of wind and solar projects under development in Colombia to Celsia, a Colombian energy company that belongs to the Argos Group. The sale ends Mainstream's presence in Colombia. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio has five projects that are still in development, meaning not yet built. They are three solar farms, Andromeda at 100 MW, Aries at 175 MW and Pollux at 100 MW, plus two wind farms, Neptuno and Sirius, at 150 MW each. Mainstream had been developing the assets since 2019. The release does not name advisers or give financial terms.
context: Mainstream, which is majority-owned by Oslo-listed Aker Horizons, says the sale fits a narrower strategy focused on South Africa, Australia and the Philippines. The company describes the move as part of capital recycling, which means selling assets to free up money for other projects. For Celsia, the deal adds a sizable pipeline of renewable projects in its home market.

sources.title: Mainstream Renewable Power sells 675 MW Colombian portfolio to Celsia

title: NTPC signs 300 MW PPA with Brookfield's Evren
summary: Evren, Brookfield's Indian renewables platform, signed a 300 MW PPA with NTPC.
details: Evren signed a 300 MW firm and dispatchable PPA with NTPC. To deliver it, Evren will build nearly 1 GW of solar supported by wind and batteries.
context: Firm supply needs much more installed capacity than the contracted amount, which is why 300 MW of firm power requires about 1 GW of plant.

sources.title: NTPC Signs 300 MW PPA with Brookfield’s Evren to Advance Solar-Backed Renewable Development

title: Exus Renewables North America acquires 364 MW solar and 280 MWh storage portfolio from Palladium Energy and Arava Power
target: 364 MW solar plus 280 MWh storage portfolio of three mid-stage projects in PJM and MISO
summary: Palladium Energy and Arava Power Company, through their joint venture, have sold a portfolio of three US solar plus battery storage projects to Pittsburgh-based Exus Renewables North America. The portfolio totals 364 MW of solar and 280 MWh of storage. No price was disclosed.
details: The three projects are at a mid-stage of development and sit in the PJM and MISO regions, which are grid operator territories covering parts of the eastern and central US. Palladium and Arava found the sites, secured the land, carried out early studies and moved the projects forward in the interconnection queues, the waiting lines for permission to connect to the grid. Exus will take over remaining development, construction and ongoing management of the assets. KeyBanc Capital Markets acted as exclusive financial adviser on the sale.
context: The sale reflects a common model in which early-stage developers sell projects to owners who build and operate them. Arava says the deal marks a step in its expansion from Israel into the US market, while Palladium presents it as evidence of its project quality. Palladium reports a 4 GW solar and storage pipeline across several US regions.

sources.title: Palladium Energy and Arava Power Company Announce the Sale of 364 MW / 280 MWh Solar + Storage Portfolio to Exus Renewables North America

title: EDF Renewables and Power Sustainable close long-term financing for Desert Quartzite
summary: EDF Renewables North America and Power Sustainable closed long-term financing for the Desert Quartzite solar and storage project in Riverside County, California.

context: Long-term debt replaces construction financing now that the plant is running and earning steady revenue.

sources.title: EDF Renewables North America And Power Sustainable Secure Financing To Launch Desert Quartzite Solar And Storage Project

title: Eneco and partners secure financing for ZE-BRA wind farm repowering
summary: Eneco, Lindewind and Zeeuwind secured financing for ZE-BRA, replacing 19 turbines on the Zeeland–Noord-Brabant border with 15 new ones.
details: Eneco, Lindewind and Zeeuwind will replace their 19 turbines on the border of Zeeland and Noord-Brabant with 15 more efficient ones: 14 in Reimerswaal and one in Woensdrecht. The project already has SDE subsidy and permits.
context: Repowering produces more power from the same sites; the SDE subsidy tops up market prices to make it viable.

sources.title: Eneco secures financing for ZE-BRA wind farm

title: Spearmint Energy closes over US$250 million for two Texas batteries
summary: Spearmint Energy closed more than US$250 million and started building Tierra Seca and Seven Flags, two 100 MW / 200 MWh batteries in Del Rio and Laredo, Texas.

context: Construction has started. Kyuden International later made an equity investment in the two projects.

sources.title: Spearmint Energy secures over US$250 million financing for 400 MWh of BESS

title: Mulilo reaches financial close on 75 MWac Du Plessis Dam PV2 with Etana as offtaker
summary: Mulilo reached financial close on the 105 MWp (75 MWac) Du Plessis Dam PV2 solar project near De Aar, among the first in South Africa to close under an aggregator model with Etana Energy as buyer.
details: Mulilo reached financial close, with partner H1 Capital, on Du Plessis Dam PV2, a 105 MWp (75 MWac) solar plant near De Aar, Northern Cape. Etana Energy, an energy trader, buys the power and resells it to customers.
context: It is one of the first South African projects to close under an aggregator model, which Mulilo's CEO calls a new era of energy trading.

sources.title: Mulilo Achieves Financial Close on Groundbreaking 75MW Solar Plant in the Northern Cape

title: Fervo Energy signs 15-year geothermal PPA with Shell Energy for 31 MW

details: Eku Energy bought Bluestone Energy's seven planned UK batteries, 1 GW / 2 GWh in total, including 98 MW / 196 MWh projects at Leatherhead (Surrey) and Sturts Farm, West Moors (Dorset), and two 240 MW projects near Ninfield (East Sussex) and Rochester (Kent). title: True Green Capital acquires 64 MWdc US distributed solar portfolio from Ecofin US Renewables Infrastructure Trust

target: Portfolio of 62 operating distributed solar projects (approx. 64 MWdc)

advisors.name: A&O Shearman
advisors.role: legal counsel to True Green Capital Management

summary: Renewable energy investment firm True Green Capital Management bought about 64 megawatts DC of operating solar projects from London-listed Ecofin US Renewables Infrastructure Trust. The deal, made through TGC's fourth fund, closed on March 10, 2025 and covers 62 projects across several US states. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio is made up of 62 already-operating distributed solar projects, meaning smaller systems that supply power close to where it is used rather than large utility-scale plants. The release says they sit in seven states, naming New Jersey, California, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Virginia and Delaware, and span four regional grid markets: PJM, CAISO, ISO-NE and MISO. The projects earn revenue through long-term power purchase agreements, which are contracts to sell electricity at agreed prices, plus sales of renewable energy credits, certificates proving clean power was produced. A&O Shearman acted as legal counsel to TGC.
context: TGC says the deal lifts its distributed solar operating portfolio to more than 600 megawatts. The firm presents the purchase as proof it can take assets held by a listed vehicle into private ownership and says it plans further acquisitions of operating portfolios. It also claims its in-house technical team can improve the value of projects like these, as it says it has done in earlier funds.

sources.title: True Green Capital Management LLC Acquires 64 Megawatts of Operating Solar Assets

title: Google signs geothermal PPA with Baseload Capital in Taiwan and invests in the developer
summary: Geothermal developer Baseload Capital and Google have signed a corporate power purchase agreement covering geothermal electricity in Taiwan, described as the first such deal for geothermal in the country. The initial projects total 10 MW and are meant to supply Google's local data centers and offices. Google is also making an equity investment in Baseload Capital.
details: A corporate power purchase agreement is a long-term contract under which a company agrees to buy electricity from specific power projects. The first projects under this partnership add 10 MW of geothermal capacity and are expected to start operating in 2029. The parties describe the contract as long-term but do not state its length, price or the size of Google's equity stake. No lenders or advisers are named.
context: According to the release, the 10 MW would double the geothermal capacity currently in commercial operation in Taiwan. Geothermal power can run around the clock, which the companies present as useful for data centers whose electricity demand is growing with AI. Google says it hopes the deal will encourage more corporate buying of geothermal power in the region and globally.

sources.title: Major step for geothermal energy in Asia - Baseload Capital and Google forge corporate PPA

title: EIB signs €108 million of green loans with Iberdrola for Valdecañas pumped storage
summary: The EIB signed two green loans with Iberdrola totalling €108 million to expand pumped-storage capacity at the Valdecañas hydro complex.
details: The EIB signed two green loans with Iberdrola: €50 million from its own funds and €58 million from Spain's Regional Resilience Fund, to expand pumping at the Valdecañas complex (Torrejón and Valdecañas plants). It will reach 225 MW installed with a 15 MW / 7.5 MWh hybrid battery, pumping up to 313 MW and raising the Tajo system's storage to 210 GWh.
context: Pumping water uphill when power is cheap and releasing it later makes the hydro complex work as a giant battery for the grid.

sources.title: EIB and Iberdrola Sign €108 Million Green Loan Deal to Boost Pumped-Storage Capacity at Valdecañas Hydroelectric Complex

details: Tata Power Renewable Energy signed a PPA with NTPC for a 200 MW firm and dispatchable project spread across several sites, to be commissioned within 24 months and producing about 1,300 million units a year. It won the project in a competitive auction.
context: It should offset more than 1 million tonnes of CO2 a year, adding to Tata Power's firm-power portfolio.

sources.title: TPREL Signs PPA with NTPC for 200 MW Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy Project

sources.title: RWE and PPC Advance Greece’s Energy Transition with Major Solar Investment

sources.title: JSL Super Steel Teams Up With Sunsure Energy For 11 MWp Power Purchase Agreement

details: JSW Neo Energy completed its purchase of O2 Power, set up by EQT and Temasek in 2020, at an enterprise value of about ₹12,468 crore. It has 4,100 MW of utility-scale projects and 596 MW of commercial and industrial capacity across seven states, mainly in western India.
context: The deal adds a large solar, wind and hybrid portfolio, including commercial and industrial capacity, to JSW Energy's renewables business.

sources.title: JSW Energy completes acquisition of 4.7 GW renewables platform

title: Taiyo sells 37.3 MW Ford Oaks solar project to Infinis
summary: Taiyo Power & Storage, a Kajima and Low Carbon Alliance joint venture, sold the ready-to-build 37.3 MW Ford Oaks solar project in East Devon to Infinis.
details: Taiyo Power & Storage, a Kajima and Low Carbon Alliance joint venture, sold the ready-to-build 37.3 MW Ford Oaks solar project beside the A30 near Exeter Airport, East Devon, to Infinis. It covers 58 hectares and should produce 37.9 GWh a year.

sources.title: Taiyo sells 37.3 MW solar site to Infinis Solar Developments Ltd

title: DEME agrees to acquire offshore wind installation firm Havfram from Sandbrook Capital and PSP Investments
summary: Sandbrook Capital and Canadian pension investor PSP Investments have signed an agreement to sell Havfram, a Norwegian offshore wind installation company, to Belgian marine engineering group DEME. The deal is valued at about EUR 900 million.
details: Havfram operates wind turbine installation vessels, which are specialised ships used to lift and install turbines at sea. It has two newbuild vessels under construction and a contract backlog for large offshore wind farms. The company was set up in 2021 as a partnership between Sandbrook Capital and PSP Investments. Closing is expected by the end of April 2025, subject to usual closing conditions. Goldman Sachs acted as financial adviser and Thommessen as legal adviser to the sellers.
context: The deal gives DEME additional installation vessel capacity for offshore wind construction, a part of the supply chain the sellers describe as critical. The sellers say the investment delivered positive financial returns, and Havfram's management says joining DEME will help speed up offshore wind deployment.

sources.title: Sandbrook Capital and PSP Investments Announce Sale of Offshore Wind Pioneer Havfram to DEME

title: Saudi Fund for Development signs US$10 million renewable loan with Solomon Islands
summary: The Saudi Fund for Development signed its first loan with the Solomon Islands, US$10 million for a renewable energy project.
details: The Saudi Fund for Development signed a US$10 million loan with the Solomon Islands, its first with the country, for solar plants totalling 35.5 MW with storage.
context: The project aims to cut the islands' dependence on imported fuel for power, and the storage will keep supply stable as solar output varies.

sources.title: SFD Signs First-Ever Development Loan Deal with Solomon Islands for $10 Million Renewable Energy Project

title: Altus Power buys ten Maryland community solar projects from Prospect14
summary: Altus Power acquired ten development-stage community solar projects in Maryland totalling 58.4 MW from Prospect14.
details: Altus Power bought ten development-stage community solar projects in Maryland, 58.4 MW in total, from Prospect14, which will finish developing them under a services agreement.
context: Once running they will serve about 8,000 customers through Maryland's Community Solar programme.

sources.title: Altus Power Grows Solar Portfolio, Acquires Ten 58.4 MW Maryland Community Projects From Prospect14

title: Sunraycer closes $475 million financing for two Texas solar-plus-storage projects
target: Gaia and Midpoint solar and battery storage projects
summary: Sunraycer Renewables has closed a $475 million project financing facility with MUFG, Nomura and Nord/LB. The money will fund construction and operation of two solar projects with paired batteries in Texas, totaling 241 MWac of solar and 125 MWac of storage.
details: The Gaia project in Navarro County combines 143 MWac of solar with 75 MWac of batteries, and the Midpoint project in Hill County pairs 97.5 MWac of solar with 50 MWac of batteries. Midpoint started construction in late 2024, and both projects are expected to begin commercial operation later in 2025. The facility includes a construction-to-term loan, meaning a construction loan that converts into long-term debt once the plants run, plus a tax credit bridge loan, which advances cash against investment tax credits the company can sell to other parties under the Inflation Reduction Act's transferability rules. A letter of credit facility, a bank guarantee used to back project obligations, is also included. Orrick advised Sunraycer, while Milbank and Squire Patton Boggs advised the lenders.
context: The release says this is Sunraycer's first project financing and brings its total capital raised over the past six months to $675 million. The company presents the deal as a step toward becoming an independent power producer in the US, and it expects the projects to help serve rising power demand from manufacturing and data centers on the ERCOT grid. Sunraycer, owned by Crayhill Capital Management, reports a pipeline of about 2 GW of solar and 2 GW of battery storage.

sources.title: Sunraycer Renewables Closes $475mm Project Financing Facility with MUFG Bank, Ltd., Nomura Securities International, Inc. and Norddeutsche Landesbank Girzonentrale

title: EGCO Group buys 49% of 251 MW Pinnacle II wind and solar portfolio
summary: EGCO Group acquired 49% of the 251 MW Pinnacle II Portfolio of US wind and solar projects.
details: EGCO Group, through its US subsidiary EGCO Pinnacle II, signed an equity capital contribution agreement with Apex Clean Energy on 31 March 2025 for 49% of the 251 MW Pinnacle II portfolio of wind and solar projects.
context: It extends the Thai utility's US renewables business, in line with its strategy of investing in gas and renewable infrastructure.

sources.title: EGCO Group Expands U.S. Portfolio with 49% Stake in 251 MW Wind and Solar Projects

title: ACME Solar secures ₹2,491 crore to refinance 490 MW of operating projects
summary: ACME Solar secured a ₹2,491 crore long-term facility to refinance debt on 490 MW of operating projects in Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan and Punjab.
details: SBI and REC provided ACME Solar with a ₹2,491 crore long-term facility over 18 to 20 years, at a weighted average rate of 8.8%, to refinance debt on 490 MW of operating projects in Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan and Punjab.
context: ACME says lower debt costs strengthen its finances for growth over the next three years.

sources.title: ACME Solar bags INR 2,491 crores refinancing for renewable projects

title: Zero Industrial closes $10 million Series A led by Evok Innovations for thermal energy storage projects
summary: Zero Industrial, a Charleston, South Carolina developer of thermal energy storage projects for industrial heat, has closed a $10 million Series A funding round. Evok Innovations led the round and Rusheen Capital Management also invested. The money is meant to speed up project deployment in the United States and Canada.
details: Thermal energy storage systems take electricity, often cheap or off-peak renewable power, and store it as heat that can later supply steam or hot water to factories instead of burning gas, oil or coal. Zero Industrial, founded in 2024 by Ted Kniesche and Jim McDermott, selects commercially available storage technology, designs and engineers each system, and pays for the projects itself. It then sells the heat or steam to industrial customers under long-term Heat-as-a-Service contracts, meaning the customer buys the output without paying upfront for the equipment. A Series A is an early-stage venture funding round, and no specific projects, capacities or stake sizes were disclosed.
context: Industrial heat is widely seen as a hard sector to decarbonize, and the investors argue that growing amounts of curtailed or low-cost renewable electricity create an opportunity to turn it into steady heat supply. The company says it is quickly signing up potential project opportunities with industrial customers seeking lower energy costs and emissions. Evok is investing from its $284 million second fund, which targets North American energy transition companies at Series A and later stages.

sources.title: ZERO INDUSTRIAL ANNOUNCES $10 MILLION SERIES A INVESTMENT TO ACCELERATE DEVELOPMENT OF THERMAL ENERGY STORAGE IN NORTH AMERICA

title: Celepsa and Zelestra sign long-term PPA for 238 MWdc solar in Peru
summary: Celepsa, part of UNACEM Group, signed a long-term PPA with Zelestra for a 238 MWdc solar project in Peru.
details: Zelestra will supply Celepsa, a generator and power marketer in the UNACEM group, with about 450 GWh a year from a 238 MWdc solar project in Peru under a long-term PPA.
context: The contract helps Celepsa decarbonise its operations and gives Zelestra a long-term buyer for the project's output.

sources.title: Celepsa And Zelestra Sign Long-Term Power Purchase Agreement For 238 MWdc Solar Project In Peru

title: GoodPeak closes $22 million construction debt for two Texas battery storage projects
target: Two 10 MW / 2-hour battery storage projects near Houston, Texas
summary: Houston-based developer GoodPeak closed $22 million in construction loans from Pathward and BridgePeak Energy Capital for its first two battery storage projects near Houston. The two 10 MW projects sit in the ERCOT grid, which serves most of Texas, and construction has now started. GoodPeak also secured a growth equity investment from Current Equity Partners.
details: Each project has 10 MW of power and two hours of storage duration, meaning it can discharge at full power for about two hours. Construction debt is a loan that funds building costs before a project starts operating. The projects are expected to come online at the end of 2025. The size of the equity investment from Current Equity Partners and other strategic investors was not disclosed.
context: These are GoodPeak's first projects to reach construction, a key step for a young developer founded by former Stonepeak, ECP and Trilogy Power executives. The company says it plans to expand into larger projects, integrated generation and data center opportunities. Current Equity Partners argues that rising electricity demand from AI and data centers is straining the Texas grid, which it says storage can help balance.

sources.title: GOODPEAK BEGINS CONSTRUCTION ON ERCOT BATTERY STORAGE PROJECTS AFTER SECURING CONSTRUCTION DEBT FINANCING

title: MUFG and Nomura provide $388 million financing for Greenalia's Misae II solar park in Texas

buyers.name: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG)
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger, bookrunner and administrative agent

summary: MUFG and Nomura agreed to provide Spanish developer Greenalia with $388 million in financing for Misae Solar Park II in Childress County, Texas. The package backs a 430 MW-DC / 331.6 MW-AC solar project, which is Greenalia's first development in the United States.
details: The financing is made up of a $295 million construction-to-term loan, meaning a loan that funds building and then converts into long-term debt once the plant runs, plus a $93 million letter of credit facility, a bank guarantee used to cover project obligations. The project covers 3,970 acres and is expected to begin commercial operation in the third quarter of 2025. Two power purchase agreements settled at ERCOT's West hub cover 65% of output and its renewable energy certificates, while the other 35% will be sold at market prices in the merchant ERCOT market, without a fixed contract. The project has also signed a fixed-price deal to sell its production tax credits to another party and a separate fixed-price agreement for 40% of its certificates.
context: Greenalia describes the deal as a major step in its US expansion and says it is on track to reach 1 GW of operating projects by 2026. The company's CFO said the financing covers capital needs for projects now under construction. Nomura indicated it intends to support Greenalia's broader portfolio as well.

sources.title: MUFG and Nomura Announce $388M Financing for Greenalia's Texas Solar Park

title: World Bank approves US$800 million loan for the Philippines' clean energy transition
summary: The World Bank approved an US$800 million loan to help the Philippines speed up its clean energy transition, build climate resilience and open its power market to competition.
details: The World Bank approved an US$800 million First Energy Transition and Climate Resilience Development Policy Loan for the Philippines. It supports raising renewables' share of installed capacity from 30% in 2023 to 42% by 2027, including procuring 1,000 MW of offshore wind.
context: Development policy loans fund the budget in return for reforms, here to cut reliance on imported fuels and open the power market to competition.

sources.title: World Bank Approves $800-Million Loan to Strengthen the Philippines' Renewable Energy Transition and Climate Resilience

title: Octopus Energy takes 10% of 714 MW East Anglia One offshore wind farm
summary: Octopus Energy's generation arm went ahead with a 10% stake in the 714 MW East Anglia One offshore wind farm, operating off Suffolk since 2021.
details: Octopus Energy's generation arm went ahead with a 10% stake in East Anglia One, a 714 MW offshore wind farm of 102 turbines 43 km off Suffolk, operating since 2021.
context: It is Octopus's fourth British offshore wind stake, after Hornsea One, Lincs and Walney Extension, and its seventh in Europe.

sources.title: Octopus Energy moves forward with investment in East Anglia One offshore wind farm

title: Trinasolar ISBU signs 20-year PPA with Equinix for 30 MW Hokkaido solar project
summary: Trinasolar ISBU, the project development arm of Trina Solar, has signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with data center operator Equinix in Japan. Equinix will buy solar power from the 30 MW Yufutsu Abira Project in Hokkaido.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific generator. Under this deal, Equinix will take power from the 30 MW Yufutsu Abira solar project in Hokkaido for 20 years. The project is expected to begin delivering electricity in the third quarter of 2028. Financial terms were not disclosed.
context: Trinasolar ISBU says this is its first corporate solar power agreement in Japan and describes it as part of its shift from developer to independent power producer that sells electricity. Equinix says it is also its first PPA in Japan and links it to rising data center energy demand driven by AI and to its emission reduction goals.

sources.title: Trinasolar ISBU Signs 30 MW Corporate PPA with Equinix in Japan

title: ACEN signs ₱34.41 billion green loan for Quezon North wind project
summary: ACEN signed a senior green term loan of up to ₱34.41 billion (about US$601 million) to part-fund GIGA ACE 6's 344.5 MWp Quezon North onshore wind project.
details: BPI, BDO Unibank and RCBC signed a senior green term loan of up to ₱34.41 billion (about US$601 million) on 29 March to part-fund GIGA ACE 6's 344.5 MWp Quezon North onshore wind project in Mauban and Real, Quezon, and a neighbouring municipality.
context: Three Philippine banks share the loan, which covers part of the cost of one of ACEN's largest domestic wind projects.

sources.title: ACEN inks $601.15m loan for onshore wind project

title: Intera Renewables acquires 250 MW Limestone Coast North battery project from Pacific Green
summary: Pacific Green sold all shares in the Limestone Coast North Energy Park, a 250 MW / 500 MWh battery storage project in South Australia, to Intera Renewables in a deal valued at AUD 460 million. The project reached financial close, meaning the funding was fully committed, on March 19, 2025.
details: The battery system can deliver 250 MW for about two hours, giving 500 MWh of stored energy. Trina Storage supplies both the battery cells and the full battery system, with performance guarantees and warranties. The project has received grid connection approval from transmission operator ElectraNet and the Australian Energy Market Operator. Trina Storage's local Australian team is to support design, installation, operation and maintenance.
context: The project is the first in Pacific Green's 10 GWh Australian storage pipeline to reach financial close. It is described as one of the largest energy storage projects in South Australia. Trina Storage, which issued the release, claims its track record and financial strength helped build investor confidence in the financing.

sources.title: Trina Storage Powers One of South Australia's Largest Energy Storage Projects with Remarkable Product Strength, Enabling AUD 460 Million Financing

title: Siemens Financial Services invests US$50 million in AMPIN Energy Transition
summary: Siemens Financial Services invested US$50 million in Indian renewable energy company AMPIN Energy Transition.
details: Siemens Financial Services invested US$50 million in AMPIN Energy Transition to expand its commercial and industrial and utility-scale renewable projects.
context: It was AMPIN's third major equity raise that year, taking its total equity to nearly US$700 million, enough to deploy more than US$4 billion.

sources.title: AMPIN Energy Transition Secures $50 Million Investment from Siemens to Strengthen India’s Renewable Energy Growth

title: Elgin buys 318 MW UK solar and battery portfolio
summary: Elgin acquired a 318 MW portfolio of solar and battery storage projects in the UK.
details: Elgin bought a 318 MW portfolio of six solar and battery sites in the UK from a fund managed by Foresight Group, which co-developed them in their early stages. Construction on several starts in the first half of 2025.
context: The sites join Elgin's UK build-out programme, a major step in its expansion. Foresight's early co-development carried them to the point where construction can begin.

sources.title: Elgin Expands UK Footprint with 318 MW Solar and Battery Storage Acquisition

title: AIP Management to buy 49.99% of Clearway's Pine Forest solar and storage project
summary: AIP Management agreed to buy 49.99% of Pine Forest, a 300 MWac solar and 200 MW battery project in ERCOT North, from Clearway Energy Group, an investment of about US$200 million.
details: AIP Management agreed to buy 49.99% of Pine Forest, a 300 MWac solar plant with a 200 MW battery in ERCOT North, from Clearway Energy Group, an investment of about US$200 million. The project is under construction.
context: Its site has a low-congestion high-voltage connection near Dallas and Fort Worth, a valuable position as Texas demand grows.

sources.title: AIP Management to acquire stake in US solar and energy storage project

title: Masdar's Saeta invests in Valle Solar in Valencia
summary: Masdar, through its subsidiary Saeta, invested in Valle Solar, one of the largest solar projects in Spain's Valencia region.
details: Masdar's subsidiary Saeta invested in Valle Solar in Ayora, Jarafuel and Zarra, Valencia, one of the region's largest solar projects, first promoted by Genia Solar Energy and Solar Ventures. It should operate in the first half of 2026.
context: The investment helps secure construction and extends Masdar's expansion in Spain.

sources.title: Masdar Invests in Valle Solar, Advancing Spain's Renewable Energy Expansion

title: NBIM to buy 49% of RWE's Nordseecluster and Thor offshore wind projects for about €1.4 billion
summary: RWE agreed to sell 49% of its Nordseecluster and Thor offshore wind projects, both under construction, to Norges Bank Investment Management for about €1.4 billion.
details: RWE keeps responsibility for construction and operation.

sources.title: RWE and Norges Bank Investment Management join forces for Nordseecluster and Thor offshore wind projects

title: ONGC NTPC Green completes 100% acquisition of Ayana Renewable Power
summary: ONGC NTPC Green, the 50:50 joint venture of NTPC Green Energy and ONGC Green, completed the purchase of 100% of Ayana Renewable Power on 27 March 2025.
details: ONGC NTPC Green, the 50:50 joint venture of NTPC Green Energy and ONGC Green, completed its purchase of 100% of Ayana Renewable Power on 27 March 2025. Ayana has about 4,112 MW: 2,123 MW operating and 1,989 MW under construction, with long-term PPAs with SECI, NTPC, GUVNL and Indian Railways.
context: The purchase gives the two state companies a large ready portfolio with strong buyers.

sources.title: ONGC - NTPC Green Completes 100% Acquisition Of Ayana Renewable Power, Expanding Clean Energy Portfolio

title: Standard Solar buys two Illinois community solar farms from Cenergy Power
summary: Standard Solar acquired two community solar farms in Zion and Kankakee County, Illinois, with more than 9 MW combined, from Cenergy Power.
details: Standard Solar bought two community solar farms from Cenergy Power, more than 9 MW in total: a 2.53 MW fixed-tilt array in Zion and one in Kankakee County, Illinois.
context: Illinois aims for 40% renewable power by 2030 and 100% clean energy by 2050; community solar lets households buy local power.

sources.title: Standard Solar Expands In Illinois With 9MW Community Solar Acquisition, Enhancing Reliability And Supporting Local Communities

title: Ardian agrees to acquire Akuo
summary: Ardian agreed to acquire French independent power producer Akuo, backed by ICG since 2022.
details: Ardian agreed to buy Akuo, a French independent power producer founded in 2007 and backed by ICG since 2022. Akuo works in wind, solar and storage in Europe and the Americas, with capacity expected to reach 1.9 GW by end-2024.
context: The deal gives Ardian a developer with strong local community ties and a large growth pipeline.

sources.title: Ardian Reaches Agreement to Acquire Akuo, a Key Leader in Renewable Energy

title: Renewable Power Capital buys Njordr's 1.9 GW Nordic development business
summary: Renewable Power Capital acquired the Swedish and Finnish onshore wind and solar development business of Njordr, 22 early-stage projects with up to 1.9 GW.
details: Renewable Power Capital bought the Swedish and Finnish onshore wind and solar development business of Njordr, part of Vanir Green Industries: 22 early-stage projects with up to 1.9 GW and Njordr's development team.
context: Bringing in an experienced team strengthens RPC's ability to develop projects in the Nordics from the start.

sources.title: Renewable Power Capital acquires onshore wind and solar development business

title: ETIC invests €10 million in BelEnergia's 58 MW Italian portfolio
summary: ETIC Partners' Energy Transition Europe II fund invested €10 million in BelEnergia's 58 MW portfolio of solar plants across Puglia, Basilicata and other Italian regions.
details: ETIC Partners' Energy Transition Europe II fund provided €10 million of junior debt to refinance the sponsor's equity in BelEnergia's seven operating assets, 58 MW in total: solar plants in Puglia, Basilicata and Abruzzo and a 40 MW wind plant in Basilicata. Up to 31 MWp of new solar may follow.
context: The portfolio produces about 99 GWh a year. It is ETIC's second Italian investment.

sources.title: ETIC Partners, On Behalf Of Energy Transition Europe II, Invests €10M In BelEnergia’s 58MW Renewable Portfolio

title: HD Renewable Energy Japan buys majority of 50 MW / 104 MWh Helios I battery in Hokkaido
summary: HD Renewable Energy Japan bought a majority stake in the 50 MW / 104 MWh Helios I battery in Sapporo, Hokkaido, developed by Manoa Energy, through an agreement with Brawn Capital.
details: HD Renewable Energy Japan bought a majority stake in the 50 MW / 104 MWh Helios I battery in Sapporo, Hokkaido, developed by Manoa Energy and managed by Brawn Capital, through a Tokumei Kumiai (silent partnership) interest purchase. Hokkaido Electric will oversee construction and maintenance; it should operate by end-2025.
context: Japan faces growing solar curtailment; batteries like Helios I store surplus power to support grid stability.

sources.title: HDJP acquires majority stake in 50MW/104MWh battery project in Hokkaido

title: Actis buys Stride Climate Investments' 371 MW Indian solar portfolio from Macquarie
summary: Actis acquired 100% of Stride Climate Investments, a 371 MW Indian solar portfolio, from a Macquarie Asset Management fund.
details: Actis bought 100% of Stride Climate Investments from a Macquarie Asset Management fund: 371 MW (414 MWp) of operating solar across 21 projects in seven states, mostly Gujarat, with nearly ten years of operating record and long-term PPAs with central and state bodies and companies.
context: Pay-as-produce PPAs with a spread of buyers give stable cash flow, suiting Actis's operating-asset strategy.

sources.title: Actis Expands its Indian Renewable Energy Portfolio with the Acquisition of Stride's 371MW Solar Assets

title: Scatec signs 25-year PPA with STEG for 120 MW solar in Tunisia
summary: Scatec signed a 25-year PPA with Tunisian utility STEG for a new 120 MW solar plant, with Aeolus as partner.
details: Scatec signed a 25-year PPA with Tunisian state utility STEG for the 120 MW Sidi Bouzid II solar plant, won in a government tender in December 2024. It also signed a joint development agreement with Aeolus, part of Toyota Tsusho.
context: Tunisia is running tenders to meet its renewable targets and improve energy security.

sources.title: Scatec Signs 25-Year Power Purchase Agreement For 120 MW Solar Plant In Tunisia

title: ib vogt reaches financial close on 29.99 MW Sungai Petani solar in Malaysia
summary: ib vogt reached financial close and began building a 29.99 MW solar project in Sungai Petani, Kedah, under Malaysia's Corporate Green Power Programme.
details: ib vogt APAC reached financial close and began building a 29.99 MW solar plant with bifacial modules and single-axis trackers in Sungai Petani, Kedah, under Malaysia's Corporate Green Power Programme. Data centre operator AirTrunk buys the power under a long-term PPA.
context: It is believed to be the first CGPP project to start construction; it should avoid about 55,380 tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: ib vogt Secures Financial Close and Begins Construction on 29.99MW Solar Project in Malaysia

title: ENGIE Brasil Energia agrees to buy two hydro plants totalling 612 MW
summary: ENGIE Brasil Energia agreed to buy the Santo Antônio do Jari and Cachoeira Caldeirão hydropower plants in Amapá and Pará, 612 MW in total.
details: ENGIE Brasil Energia agreed to buy the Santo Antônio do Jari hydro plant (Amapá and Pará) and the Cachoeira Caldeirão plant (Amapá), 612 MW in total, for about R$2.9 billion: R$2.3 billion of equity and the rest net debt.
context: Both plants are fully contracted in Brazil's regulated market, giving predictable revenue.

sources.title: ENGIE Brasil Energia acquires two hydropower plants in Brazil

title: SUSI Partners sells 95 MW Lyngsåsa wind farm in Sweden to Equinor
summary: SUSI Partners sold the 95 MW, 22-turbine Lyngsåsa wind farm in southern Sweden to Equinor.
details: SUSI Partners sold the 95 MW Lyngsåsa wind farm in southern Sweden, 22 turbines producing about 311 GWh a year, to Equinor. SUSI bought it ready-to-build in 2019.
context: With the sale SUSI has exited three-quarters of its Renewable Energy Fund II, selling a project it bought ready-to-build and saw through construction.

sources.title: SUSI Partners sells onshore wind farm in Sweden

title: Actis closes US$600 million investment in MTerra Solar
summary: Actis closed its US$600 million investment for a stake in Terra Solar Philippines (MTerra Solar), the giant solar and battery project led by MGEN Renewable Energy through SP New Energy.
details: Actis closed its investment of about US$600 million for a stake in Terra Solar Philippines (MTerra Solar), whose project is led by MGEN Renewable Energy through SP New Energy. It completes an agreement signed in September 2024.
context: MTerra has 850 MW of capacity contracted over 20 years. Once fully built it will have 3,500 MWp of solar and 4,500 MWh of batteries, developed by Actis with Meralco PowerGen and MGreen.

sources.title: Actis closes $600 million Terra Solar investment

title: British Solar Renewables buys 150 MWp Little Crow solar and battery project from INRG
summary: INRG sold Little Crow, a 150 MWp solar project with a 60 MW battery that holds a development consent order and a Contract for Difference, to British Solar Renewables.
details: INRG sold Little Crow, a 150 MWp solar project with a 60 MW battery, to British Solar Renewables, which will build and run it. It holds a development consent order, the second for a UK solar project, and a Contract for Difference from Allocation Round 6. JLL advised the seller.
context: A development consent order is the planning route for nationally significant infrastructure projects. A Contract for Difference pays the gap between a fixed strike price and the market price.

sources.title: British Solar Renewables acquires solar park from INRG Solar

title: CIP reaches financial close on Fengmiao I offshore wind in Taiwan
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners reached financial close on Fengmiao I, its third Taiwanese offshore wind project and the first Round 3 project to close, with more than US$3 billion of financing.
details: CIP reached financial close on the Fengmiao I offshore wind project in Taiwan with about US$3.1 billion of project finance from 27 international and Taiwanese banks, partly guaranteed by four export credit agencies and Taiwan's National Credit Guarantee Administration. Vestas will supply 33 of its 15 MW turbines; construction should finish by end-2027.
context: It is CIP's third Taiwanese project after Changfang & Xidao and Zhongneng, and the first of Taiwan's Round 3 projects to close and start construction. Six corporations have long-term PPAs for its entire output.

sources.title: CIP reaches financial close on Fengmiao I offshore wind farm

title: JSW Neo Energy to buy Virya Infrapower
summary: JSW Neo Energy signed a share purchase agreement to buy 100% of Virya Infrapower, which holds a ready renewable power site with infrastructure.
details: JSW Neo Energy agreed to buy all of Virya Infrapower for an enterprise value of ₹7.54 crore in cash. Virya holds a ready renewable power site with infrastructure in place.
context: JSW says the site will let it develop a project faster. Virya becomes a step-down subsidiary of JSW Energy.

sources.title: JSW Energy acquires renewable energy firm Virya Infrapower

title: EIB grants up to €400 million to Energie AG for Austrian hydropower
summary: The EIB granted Energie AG Oberösterreich up to €400 million for the Ebensee pumped storage plant and the Roitham/Traunfall run-of-river plant, a programme of over €600 million.
details: The European Investment Bank granted Energie AG Oberösterreich up to €400 million for hydropower in Upper Austria: €320 million, signed in Luxembourg, for the new Ebensee pumped storage plant and €80 million, approved in advance, for the planned Roitham/Traunfall run-of-river plant. Energie AG will invest more than €600 million in total.
context: Ebensee is Energie AG's largest single investment; pumped storage acts as a large battery that balances wind and solar output. Traunfall will replace three hydro plants at the end of their life.

sources.title: European Investment Bank supports hydropower expansion in Austria

title: Equitix buys Ventus Investments' 122.5 MW UK onshore wind portfolio
summary: Equitix acquired Ventus Investments: four operating wind farms in England and Wales (Crook Hill, Reaps Moss, Pant y Wal and Mynydd Bwllfa), 122.5 MW in total.
details: Equitix bought Ventus Investments, owner of four operating onshore wind farms with 44 turbines and 122.5 MW in total: Crook Hill near Manchester, Reaps Moss in Lancashire, and Pant y Wal and Mynydd Bwllfa in Wales. IDCM, Linklaters, Everoze, DNV, Deloitte and Howden advised Equitix.
context: The farms can power more than 67,000 UK homes a year. Equitix has about 12.2 GW of renewable capacity across its wider platform.

sources.title: Equitix acquires additional UK onshore wind portfolio

title: ENGIE buys 157 MW UK wind and solar portfolio from MEAG
summary: ENGIE acquired an operating 157 MW portfolio of four solar and three wind farms in England and Wales from MEAG, subject to UK government clearance.
details: ENGIE bought a fully operating 157 MW UK portfolio of four solar farms and three onshore wind farms in England and Wales from MEAG, Munich Re's asset manager. The deal needs UK government clearance.
context: ENGIE plans to grow the sites by adding co-located batteries and solar and by repowering older turbines, replacing them with newer, larger machines.

sources.title: ENGIE acquires onshore renewables assets in UK

title: NaBFID approves ₹2.72 billion for KPI Green's 50 MW hybrid project
summary: NaBFID approved a ₹2.72 billion loan to KPI Green Energy for a 50 MW hybrid power project in Gujarat.
details: NaBFID, India's National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development, approved ₹2.72 billion to part-finance KPI Green Energy's 50 MW hybrid project in Bharuch district, Gujarat, which combines 75.2 MWp of solar with 16.95 MW of wind. It sells power to GUVNL under a 25-year PPA.
context: A hybrid plant pairs solar and wind at one grid connection so output is steadier through the day. KPI Green targets 10 GW of capacity by 2030.

sources.title: NaBFID Approves ₹2.72 Billion Loan for KPI Green’s 50 MW Hybrid Project

title: Alight buys 215 MWp Lidsø solar park in Denmark from European Energy
summary: Alight acquired the 215 MWp Lidsø solar park in Lolland, Denmark, developed by European Energy, with financing support from SEB.
details: Alight bought the 215 MWp Lidsø solar park at Rødby Havn, Lolland, from developer European Energy, its first project in Denmark. SEB lent €127 million to support the purchase. Construction began in summer 2024 and commissioning is due in summer 2025; two large companies will buy its power.
context: Lidsø will be one of Denmark's largest solar parks. Alight, founded in Sweden in 2013, also has over 900 MWp in development in Finland.

sources.title: Alight expands into Denmark with acquisition of solar park from European Energy

title: Jupiter Power closes $286 million construction financing for two US battery storage projects
target: Tibbits (Michigan) and Tidwell Prairie (Texas) battery storage projects
summary: Texas-based storage developer Jupiter Power has closed $286 million in project financing for two standalone battery storage projects in Michigan and Texas. Together the projects total 300 MW of power capacity and 800 MWh of storage. Barclays and HSBC led the lending group.
details: The projects are Tibbits in Michigan and Tidwell Prairie in Texas, both expected to begin commercial operation later in 2025. The financing combines construction loans, tax equity bridge loans (short-term loans repaid once tax equity investors, who invest in exchange for tax credits, fund the project) and a letter of credit facility. Tibbits has a 20-year power purchase agreement with the utility Consumers Energy, and Tidwell Prairie operates under a long-term tolling agreement, a contract where a buyer pays a fixed fee to use the battery, with an undisclosed counterparty. Simpson Thacher & Bartlett advised the borrower and Latham & Watkins advised the lenders.
context: Jupiter Power says the two projects will bring its operating fleet to nearly 2,200 MWh once complete, and that Tibbits is on track to be the first operational utility-scale battery storage system in Michigan. The deal follows a $225 million corporate credit facility the company completed in late 2024. The company states it is developing about 12,000 MW of storage projects across the US.

sources.title: Jupiter Power Secures $286 Million Construction Financing to Advance Two Utility-Scale Battery Energy Storage Projects

title: Recurrent Energy closes $183 million debt and tax equity for 200 MWh Fort Duncan storage project in Texas
summary: Recurrent Energy, a Canadian Solar subsidiary, has closed $183 million in project financing and tax equity for its 200 MWh Fort Duncan battery storage project in Maverick County, Texas. Nord/LB led $112 million of debt and Greenprint Capital committed $71 million in tax equity.
details: The battery project is under construction and is expected to begin commercial operation by summer 2025 on the ERCOT grid. Nord/LB's $112 million package combines a construction and term loan, a tax equity bridge loan (short-term debt repaid when the tax equity investor funds), and a letter of credit facility. Greenprint Capital's $71 million tax equity partnership means it invests in exchange for the project's federal tax credits and related benefits. The project will run on a merchant basis, meaning it sells power at market prices rather than under a long-term fixed contract, and stores power over a two-hour cycle. Canadian Solar's e-STORAGE supplies the battery systems and Burns & McDonnell is the construction contractor.
context: Recurrent Energy says the project will improve reliability on a Texas grid facing rising demand, including from AI. The deal shows lenders and tax equity investors backing merchant battery storage in ERCOT, where revenue depends on market prices. Recurrent Energy will own and operate the project and says it will generate local tax revenue.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Secures $183 Million in Project Financing and Tax Equity for Merchant Storage Project in Texas

title: Meta signs PPA for full output of RWE's 200 MW Waterloo Solar project in Texas
summary: RWE and Meta have signed a long-term power purchase agreement under which Meta will buy all the electricity from RWE's 200 MWac Waterloo Solar project in Bastrop County, Texas. It is the third such contract between the two companies in recent months.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase a project's electricity over many years, which helps the developer finance construction. Waterloo Solar is a 200 MWac solar project in Bastrop County, Texas, and onsite construction is scheduled to start in late 2025. The contract length and price were not disclosed. RWE estimates about 300 workers at peak construction, around 26 million US dollars in local economic activity during construction, and 49 million US dollars in tax revenue over a 40-year life.
context: With this deal, RWE's combined PPA offtake with Meta reaches 574 MW across Texas, Illinois and Louisiana, following earlier contracts for the 274 MWac County Run Solar and 100 MWac Lafitte Solar projects. Meta says the purchase supports its goal of matching its operations, including data centers, with clean and renewable electricity. RWE says it has more than 4 GW under construction in the U.S. and commissioned 1.6 GW there in 2024.

sources.title: RWE and Meta sign long-term power purchase agreement for offtake from 200 MW energy project

title: IRSC signs 30-year solar PPA with Arabian Cement
summary: IRSC for Renewable Energy Solutions signed a 30-year solar PPA with Arabian Cement Company in Egypt.
details: IRSC for Renewable Energy Solutions signed a 30-year PPA with Arabian Cement Company to develop, finance, build, own and operate the 17.6 MWp second phase of ACC's solar plant, expected to produce 32.5 GWh a year.
context: Under this kind of on-site PPA the developer owns the plant and the cement maker simply buys its power, avoiding upfront cost.

sources.title: IRSC Signs 30-Year PPA with Arabian Cement for Solar Energy Expansion

title: ACEN invests ₱660 million in Buendia Christiana Holdings
summary: ACEN injected ₱660 million into its subsidiary Buendia Christiana Holdings through common and redeemable preferred shares to fund renewable expansion.
details: ACEN put ₱660 million into its subsidiary Buendia Christiana Holdings by subscribing for 660,000 common shares and 5.94 million redeemable preferred shares. BCHC will use the money to buy land for future power projects.
context: ACEN aims for 20 GW of attributable renewable capacity by 2030; buying land early secures sites before projects are developed.

sources.title: ACEN Invests Php 660 Million in BCHC to Bolster Renewable Energy Expansion

title: Quinbrook closes £218.5 million term loan for Cleve Hill solar and battery park
summary: Quinbrook closed a £218.5 million term loan and a £20 million VAT facility for Cleve Hill, the UK's largest solar and battery project under construction and the first consented as a Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project.
details: Quinbrook closed a £218.5 million term loan and a £20 million VAT facility for the Cleve Hill solar and battery park in two tranches: the solar loans in August 2024 and the battery loans in March 2025. Norton Rose Fulbright advised Quinbrook.
context: It is the UK's largest solar and battery project under construction, the first consented as a Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project, and the largest such financing closed in the UK.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises Quinbrook on UK’s largest solar PV and BESS project financing

title: NorthStar Clean Energy secures up to $334 million to build two Michigan solar projects totaling 250 MW
target: Branch Solar and Genesee Solar projects
summary: NorthStar Clean Energy, a subsidiary of CMS Energy, has secured up to $334 million in construction-to-term financing for two solar projects in Michigan. The projects total 250 MW, with BNP Paribas, MUFG and SMBC acting as lead arrangers.
details: The Branch Solar project in Branch County is a 200 MW facility and will be the company's largest solar asset in Michigan. The Genesee Solar project is a 50 MW facility in Genesee County, sited in what the release describes as a historically disenfranchised community. The loan is a construction-to-term facility, meaning it funds building the plants and then converts into a longer-term loan once they are operating. Hunton Andrews Kurth, Arnold & Porter Kaye Scholer, Bodman and Warner Norcross + Judd acted as NorthStar's legal advisers.
context: The company says the two projects will produce enough electricity for nearly 36,000 homes a year. NorthStar presents the financing as part of its push to grow clean energy output nationally, adding to a portfolio of over 2 GW of generating capacity and a development pipeline of more than 1 GW.

sources.title: $334 Million in Construction Financing Secured for Two Major Michigan Solar Projects

title: NextPower UK ESG closes at £733 million
summary: NextEnergy Capital's NextPower UK ESG, the largest private fund for new-build UK solar, reached a final close of £733 million, nearly 50% above target.
details: NextEnergy Capital's NextPower UK ESG fund, the largest private fund for new-build UK solar, closed at £733 million, nearly 50% above its £500 million target. The National Wealth Fund was the cornerstone investor with £250 million on a match-funding basis; local government pension pools and overseas investors also joined.
context: The fund has deployed over 70% of its capital across 15 assets and 731 MW, including Llanwern, the UK's largest operating solar plant, plus 482 MW under construction or ready-to-build.

sources.title: NextPower UK ESG Fund Surpasses Fundraising Target, Boosts UK Solar Capacity

title: GS Inima signs PPA for 6.5 MWp Barka 5 solar plant in Oman
summary: GS Inima finalised a PPA for the 6.5 MWp Barka 5 solar plant to power its desalination operations in Oman.
details: GS Inima finalised a PPA for the 6.5 MWp Barka 5 solar plant in Oman, which will supply about 11% of the power used by its Barka 5 desalination plant. Construction can now start, with operation targeted for the first quarter of 2026.
context: The project began in 2022. Water desalination uses a lot of electricity, so on-site solar cuts operating costs.

sources.title: GS Inima Secures PPA for 6.5 MWp Barka 5 PV Plant, Boosting Sustainable Desalination in Oman

title: BG Energy Solutions to acquire K-One Energy 2
summary: BG Energy Solutions, a Bangkok Glass Group subsidiary, signed an agreement to acquire K-One Energy 2 from Kemrex of Sutee Group.
details: BG Energy Solutions, a subsidiary of Bangkok Glass Group, signed an agreement to buy K-One Energy 2, a subsidiary of Kemrex in the Sutee Group, to expand its renewable energy investments.
context: The article does not state the price or the size of K-One Energy 2's assets. BG says the deal supports Thailand's energy security.

sources.title: BG Energy Solutions Acquires K-One Energy 2 to Strengthen Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: Scatec signs 25-year PPA with Egypt Aluminium for 1.1 GW solar and 200 MWh battery
summary: Scatec signed a 25-year PPA with Egypt Aluminium for a project combining 1.1 GW of solar with a 100 MW / 200 MWh battery.
details: Scatec signed a 25-year PPA with Egypt Aluminium for a project with 1.1 GW of solar and a 100 MW / 200 MWh battery, backed by a sovereign guarantee. The project should cost about US$650 million, about 80% from non-recourse project debt; Scatec owns 100% and plans to bring in partners.
context: It is Egypt's first utility-scale PPA with an industrial buyer. Egypt Aluminium exports about 60% of its products to Europe and must comply with the EU's carbon border tax (CBAM) from 2026.

sources.title: Scatec Signs Power Purchase Agreement With Egypt Aluminium For Landmark 1 GW Solar And Battery Storage Project

title: Syntholene signs binding LOI for up to 20 MW of geothermal energy to power eSAF demonstration plant
summary: Syntholene Energy Corp has signed a binding letter of intent with an unnamed geothermal site partner for up to 20 MW of electricity or equivalent heat. The energy will power a commercial demonstration plant making synthetic aviation fuel (eSAF). The site location and partner were not disclosed.
details: Syntholene will design, build, commission and staff the demonstration facility at a geothermal site controlled by the partner, and will keep ownership of the equipment and project intellectual property. The plant will use geothermal heat and power for high temperature steam electrolysis, which splits water to make hydrogen, a feedstock for synthetic kerosene. The letter of intent, a preliminary agreement setting out main terms, includes an option giving access to about 20 MW for later commercial-scale operations, subject to technical, financial and regulatory viability. Completing the deal depends on conditions including signing a fuller definitive agreement. No financial terms or timelines were given.
context: Syntholene claims this will be the first geothermally powered eSAF facility and says its approach could make synthetic fuel cheaper than fossil fuel. The company argues that using both geothermal heat and electricity improves electrolysis efficiency compared with electricity-only setups. The processes have so far been shown only at lab scale.

sources.title: Syntholene Secures 20 Megawatt Energy Agreement for World's First Geothermally-Powered Synthetic Sustainable Aviation Fuel (eSAF) Commercial Demonstration Facility

title: Recurrent Energy signs solar PPA with Qualcomm in Spain
summary: Recurrent Energy signed a PPA with Qualcomm for solar power in Spain.
details: Recurrent Energy, a Canadian Solar subsidiary, signed a PPA with Qualcomm to supply power from a solar project it is developing in Spain. Recurrent will keep ownership and run the plant once it is built.
context: The article does not give the plant's size or location. Construction is expected to create more than 300 jobs; the PPA supports Qualcomm's decarbonisation goals.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy and Qualcomm Sign PPA to Advance Renewable Energy in Spain

title: Amrut Energy raises ₹100 crore from private equity
summary: Solar water pump maker Amrut Energy raised ₹100 crore from private equity investors to expand.
details: Amrut Energy, an Indian maker of solar water pumps founded in 2016 by Arvind Patel, raised ₹100 crore from private equity investors to expand manufacturing, fund research and development and reach underserved regions.
context: Solar pumps give farmers cheap, reliable power for irrigation in place of diesel or unreliable grid supply.

sources.title: Amrut Energy Secures ₹100 Crore Investment to Expand Solar Solutions

title: ENERPARC secures €266 million from LBBW for 400 MWp German solar pipeline
summary: ENERPARC secured €266 million from LBBW to build and run a 400 MWp pipeline of ground-mounted solar projects in Germany.
details: ENERPARC secured €266 million from LBBW for a 400 MWp pipeline of ground-mounted solar projects in Germany: a €216 million senior secured project finance facility of up to 24 years and a €50 million revolving credit facility. Capcora advised ENERPARC.
context: The portfolio facility funds projects in clusters as they become ready-to-build over the next 24 months, and accepts both feed-in tariff (EEG) and PPA revenues.

sources.title: ENERPARC Receives €266 Million From LBBW To Fund Construction And Operation Of 400 MWp Solar PV Pipeline In Germany

title: NextPower UK ESG buys Mere Flats 56 MW solar and 16 MW battery project
summary: NextEnergy Capital's NextPower UK ESG acquired Mere Flats, a ready-to-build 56 MW solar and 16 MW battery project in South Yorkshire.
details: NextEnergy Capital's NextPower UK ESG fund bought Mere Flats, a ready-to-build 56 MW solar project with a 16 MW co-located battery in South Yorkshire, from Korkia. It is the fund's fifteenth asset and takes its portfolio to 731 MW.
context: Ready-to-build means permits and grid connection are secured, so construction can begin. The fund expects to pass 400 MW of operating UK capacity by year-end.

sources.title: NextEnergy Capital Expands Portfolio with Acquisition of Mere Flats Solar and BESS Project

title: BayWa r.e. sells 127 MWp of French solar to Octopus and Commerz Real
summary: BayWa r.e. sold 127 MWp of French solar: the operating Greenberry and Fontenet 3 plants (40 MWp each) to Octopus Energy's generation arm, and the 47 MWp Amance project to Commerz Real.
details: BayWa r.e. sold 127 MWp of French solar: the operating Greenberry (40 MWp) and Fontenet 3 (40 MWp) parks, on former military bases in central and south-west France, to Octopus Energy's generation arm, and the 47 MWp Amance park, under construction on 42 ha of poor farmland, to Commerz Real.
context: Greenberry and Fontenet 3 are designed for sheep grazing and are part of a 136 MWp solar hub. BayWa r.e. has sold 1.5 GW of projects since the start of 2024 and keeps technical management of the two parks.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. completes sale of French solar projects

title: Sunsure secures ₹128.82 crore for 49 MWp Augasi open-access solar
summary: Sunsure Energy secured ₹128.82 crore of long-term debt from Tata Capital and Aditya Birla Finance for its 49 MWp open-access solar plant at Augasi, Uttar Pradesh.
details: Sunsure Energy secured ₹128.82 crore of long-term debt, shared equally by Tata Capital and Aditya Birla Finance, to build a 49 MWp open-access solar plant in Augasi, Uttar Pradesh, and support its 145 MWp of commissioned open-access projects in the state.
context: Open access lets large consumers buy power directly from a generator rather than the local utility. The plant should produce 72 million units (kWh) a year; Sunsure is building 270 MWp across Uttar Pradesh.

sources.title: Sunsure Energy bags INR 129 crore financing for Uttar Pradesh solar plant

title: Greenprint Capital Management and AB CarVal double tax equity commitment for US renewables and storage

buyers.name: AB CarVal
buyers.role: joint venture partner and capital provider

target: Greenprint and AB CarVal tax equity joint venture
summary: Greenprint Capital Management and funds managed by AB CarVal have doubled the capital committed to their joint venture that makes tax equity investments in renewable energy and storage projects. The venture was originally set up to support a tax equity pipeline of 2.5 billion US dollars. The exact size of the new commitment was not disclosed.
details: Tax equity is money from investors who receive a project's tax credits and depreciation benefits in exchange for funding part of its cost. The expanded platform will offer time-based flip deals, where the investor's share of returns drops after a set date, as well as preferred equity, which gets paid ahead of ordinary owners and comes with structured exit options. The partners say terms can be adjusted for deal size, technology, tax credit allocation and depreciation choices, and that sponsors keep control over flip dates and buyout rights. They are seeking solar, wind and battery storage developers as clients.
context: The partners say demand for their first offering exceeded expectations and that the larger commitment is meant to keep them among the leading tax equity providers as new competitors enter the market. AB CarVal is an alternative investment manager within AllianceBernstein with about 20 billion US dollars in assets under management, while Greenprint specializes in clean energy tax credit investments.

sources.title: Greenprint Capital Management and AB CarVal Double Investment Commitment to Expand Tax Equity Financing for Renewable Energy and Storage Projects

title: Arevon closes $509 million financing for 430 MWdc Kelso 1 & 2 solar projects in Missouri

buyers.name: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC)
buyers.role: Administrative Agent, Left Lead Arranger, Bookrunner, lender

summary: Arevon Energy has reached financial close on a $509 million debt package for its two-phase Kelso 1 & 2 solar projects in Scott County, Missouri. The projects total 430 MW measured on the direct-current side, and a group of five banks led by CIBC provided the funding.
details: The package consists of a $245 million bridge loan (short-term debt repaid when longer-term money arrives), a $172 million construction loan, and $92 million of credit support, which backs the project's payment obligations. CIBC acted as administrative agent, left lead arranger and bookrunner, and CIBC, Commerzbank, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Lloyds Bank and National Bank of Canada served as lenders, coordinating lead arrangers and green loan coordinators. BNY was collateral agent. Arevon developed the projects and will build and operate them, and they are its first utility-scale renewable projects in Missouri.
context: Arevon says this is its eighth project financing in 18 months, bringing the total raised over that period to more than $3.7 billion.
