The company expects the project to create about 450 peak construction jobs and pay more than $34 million to local governments over its life. The deal is part of Arevon's push into the Midwest, where it is also building 744 MW of solar in Indiana.

sources.title: Arevon Completes $509 Million Financing Package for its Kelso 1 & 2 Solar Projects in Missouri

title: POWERX signs 24.5 MWp solar PPA with Yellow Door Energy
summary: POWERX, South Africa's first licensed private electricity trader, signed a 24.5 MWp solar PPA with Yellow Door Energy.
details: POWERX, South Africa's first licensed private electricity trader, signed a PPA with Yellow Door Energy for 24.5 MWp of solar from the Naledi Ya YDE Solar Park in Leeudoringstad, North West Province. It should produce 57.5 GWh in its first year.
context: Through wheeling, power travels over the national grid from the plant to POWERX's customers across the country, giving smaller businesses access to renewable supply.

sources.title: POWERX and Yellow Door Energy Sign Landmark 24.5MWp Solar PPA to Advance South Africa’s Renewable Energy Goals

title: European Energy sells up to 470 MW Lithuanian wind and solar project to Energix
summary: European Energy agreed to sell Energix a Lithuanian project of up to 470 MW, including a 140 MW wind farm and solar.
details: European Energy agreed to sell a Lithuanian project of up to 470 MW, a 140 MW wind farm and a 330 MW solar plant, to Energix. European Energy will take it to ready-to-build in the coming months; Energix will then invest in and build it.
context: European Energy has built about 450 MW in the Baltics since opening its Lithuanian office four years ago, with about 200 MW more under construction.

sources.title: European Energy Finalizes Sale of Two Renewable Projects In Lithuania

title: Velto Renewables and Q Energy form partnership and complete first acquisition
summary: Velto Renewables, backed by CDPQ, signed a partnership to buy a portfolio of large renewable projects from Q ENERGY across Europe over the coming years and completed the first acquisition.
details: Velto Renewables, backed by CDPQ, formed a partnership with Q ENERGY to buy large renewable portfolios across Europe, and as a first step bought five French solar and wind projects of nearly 130 MW under construction, including the Les Îlots Blandin floating solar park on industrial water ponds.
context: Les Îlots Blandin is described as Europe's largest floating solar park. The projects should start operating between spring 2025 and early 2026; a further ~400 MW in Spain and Portugal was expected in late March 2025.

sources.title: Velto Renewables and Q Energy launch partnership to acquire European projects

title: IBV ACEN Renewables nears US$13 million investment in Malaysian solar
summary: IBV ACEN Renewables, the ACEN–ib vogt joint venture, is finalising a US$13 million investment in Malaysian solar projects of about 80 MW.
details: IBV ACEN Renewables, a joint venture of ACEN and ib vogt Singapore, was finalising a US$13 million investment in several Malaysian solar projects of about 80 MW in total, part of up to US$200 million of equity for the venture.
context: The venture, disclosed in October 2024, aims for at least 1,000 MW in operation across Asia-Pacific, including Bangladesh, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Indonesia and Malaysia.

sources.title: IBV ACEN Renewables Nears $13 Million Investment for Solar Projects in Malaysia

title: RATCH completes investment in Xekong 4A and 4B hydro projects in Laos
summary: RATCH Group completed its investment in the Xekong 4A and 4B hydroelectric projects in Lao PDR.
details: RATCH Group completed its investment in the 355 MW Xekong 4A and 4B hydropower projects in Laos and dissolved Sekong Investment Advisory, the subsidiary formed in July 2022 to support it. Project company Xekong 4 Power, set up in December 2023, signed a PPA with EGAT on 25 December 2023.
context: EGAT is Thailand's state utility, so the plant will sell its power across the border to Thailand under a long-term contract.

sources.title: RATCH Group subsidiary completes hydropower investment

title: Sunraycer Renewables closes US$200 million development facility with HPS-managed funds
target: Sunraycer Renewables 4 GW solar and battery portfolio
summary: Sunraycer Renewables, a Maryland-based developer and owner of clean energy projects, has closed a US$200 million credit facility with funds and accounts managed by HPS Investment Partners. The money will back its roughly 4 GW US pipeline of solar and battery projects and the purchase of new projects.
details: The pipeline is split into about 2 GW of solar and 2 GW of battery storage at development and construction stage. The facility will pay for development spending before notice to proceed, meaning the point when construction is formally authorised to begin, as well as the equity share of construction costs for projects in the ERCOT (Texas) and MISO (central US) power markets. Sunraycer also plans to acquire 3 to 4 GW of earlier-stage projects in the CAISO, PJM and MISO markets. Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe acted as Sunraycer's legal counsel.
context: Sunraycer, which is owned by Crayhill Capital Management, says it aims to bring about 1 GW of operating assets online each year and to become one of the largest independent power producers in the US. The company says its Accelerant Program, which offers capital and services to smaller developers, has drawn a growing number of large data center operators as partners.

sources.title: Sunraycer Renewables Closes $200mm Financing Facility with Funds and Accounts Managed by HPS Investment Partners

title: GoldenPeaks Capital signs 10-year PPA with NGK Ceramics Polska
summary: GoldenPeaks Capital signed a 10-year PPA to supply NGK Ceramics Polska with renewable power in Poland.
details: GoldenPeaks Capital signed a 10-year virtual PPA with NGK Ceramics Polska for about 125 GWh a year from its solar plants in Poland, roughly the use of 60,000 homes.
context: In a virtual PPA no power is delivered directly; the parties settle the difference between a fixed price and the market price, which lets NGK fix its energy budget.

sources.title: GoldenPeaks Capital Secures Power Purchase Agreement With NGK Ceramics Polska For Renewable Energy Supply

title: Brookfield sells 1.6 GW Indian solar and wind portfolio to Gentari
summary: Brookfield agreed to sell a 1.6 GW portfolio of solar and wind assets in India to Gentari Renewables India in two phases.
details: Brookfield agreed to sell a 1.6 GW Indian solar and wind portfolio to Gentari Renewables India in two phases; the first, 1 GW of operating assets, has completed. It is Brookfield's first full-cycle sale of an Indian portfolio under its Renewable Power & Transition business.
context: A full-cycle sale means building or buying assets, running them and then selling them to recycle capital. Brookfield has about 40 GW of wind and solar in India at various stages.

sources.title: Brookfield Sells 1.6 GW Renewable Portfolio in India to Gentari Renewables

title: Nedbank and Norfund invest US$31 million in Pele Energy Group
summary: Nedbank and Norfund acquired a substantial minority stake in South African renewables company Pele Energy Group for about US$31 million.
details: Nedbank and Norfund invested US$31 million (R573 million) for a substantial minority stake in South Africa's Pele Energy Group, co-founded by Gqi Raoleka. It follows a US$135 million structured loan from Nedbank, Norfund and the Industrial Development Corporation.
context: Pele plans to raise R2–3 billion more over two years. Coal still produces over 80% of South Africa's electricity, and demand for private renewable supply is growing.

sources.title: Nedbank and Norfund Invest $31M in Pele Energy to Drive South Africa’s Renewable Growth

title: RENOVA closes project financing for battery storage business
summary: RENOVA's R2 Energy Storage Facility arranged project financing for its battery storage business in Japan.
details: RENOVA's subsidiary R2 Energy Storage Facility G.K. arranged project financing for a battery storage business that won a contract in Japan's Long-Term Decarbonization Power Source Auction.
context: That auction, introduced in 2023, pays fixed capacity revenue for many years to new low-carbon plants and storage, which makes them easier to finance. The article does not state the loan size.

sources.title: Renova secures financing for battery storage business

title: Iberdrola signs 1,000 GWh solar PPA with Pam Panorama
summary: Iberdrola signed a PPA with Italian supermarket chain Pam Panorama for a total of 1,000 GWh of solar power.
details: Iberdrola signed a PPA with Italian supermarket chain Pam Panorama for a total of 1,000 GWh from solar plants, to supply its Pam, Panorama, Pam Local and Pam City stores across Italy.
context: The deal should cut CO2 by more than 38,300 tonnes a year. Iberdrola expects about 400 MW installed in Italy in 2025 and led Europe's PPA market by volume for a second year, per Pexapark.

sources.title: Iberdrola Signs 1,000 GWh PPA with Pam Panorama to Power Italian Stores with Solar Energy

title: Arevon secures US$258 million for 200 MW / 400 MWh Peregrine Energy Storage in San Diego
summary: Arevon Energy secured US$258 million of financing for its 200 MW / 400 MWh Peregrine Energy Storage project in San Diego's Barrio Logan.
details: Arevon raised US$258 million for its 200 MW / 400 MWh Peregrine Energy Storage project in Barrio Logan, San Diego: a US$179 million debt package led by Santander with CoBank, which will convert into preferred equity and tax credit transfers, plus a US$79 million preferred equity commitment arranged by Acadia Infrastructure Capital.
context: Under US law, tax credits earned by clean energy projects can be sold to other companies for cash. It is Arevon's seventh financial close in 15 months, taking its total to over US$3.2 billion.

sources.title: Arevon Energy Secures $258 Million Financing for 200 MW Peregrine Energy Storage Project in San Diego

title: Adani Green refinances US$1.06 billion of Rajasthan hybrid project debt
summary: Adani Green Energy raised US$1.06 billion of 19-year, fully amortising debt to refinance the 2021 construction facility for its solar-wind hybrid cluster in Rajasthan.
details: Adani Green Energy raised US$1.06 billion to refinance a 2021 construction facility for its solar-wind hybrid cluster in Rajasthan. The new debt has a 19-year door-to-door tenor and fully amortises, matching the life of the assets.
context: Replacing short construction loans with long-term debt once plants operate lowers financing risk. Adani says this completes its capital management plan for the portfolio.

sources.title: Adani Green refinances $1.06b for solar-wind hybrid project in Rajasthan

title: Enlight signs US$22 million PPA with Tel Aviv's NTA
summary: Enlight Renewable Energy signed a US$22 million PPA with NTA, the state company running Tel Aviv's light rail and metro.
details: Enlight Renewable Energy signed a five-year, US$22 million PPA with NTA, the state-owned company behind Tel Aviv's light rail and metro, which can increase its volumes during the term.
context: Enlight has similar deals with Big Shopping Centers, SodaStream and Amdocs, and a 12-year contract covering all of the Weizmann Institute's power.

sources.title: Enlight Renewable Energy Secures $22 Million PPA to Supply Green Power to Tel Aviv’s NTA

title: Scatec completes US$167 million sale of African hydropower stake to TotalEnergies
summary: Scatec completed the sale of its 51% stake in its African hydropower joint venture with Norfund and British International Investment to TotalEnergies for US$167 million.
details: Scatec closed the US$167 million sale of its 51% stake in its African hydropower joint venture with Norfund and BII to TotalEnergies, with estimated net proceeds of US$161 million. The assets include the operating 255 MW Bujagali plant in Uganda and the 361 MW Mpatamanga (Malawi) and 206 MW Ruzizi III developments.
context: Scatec is exiting hydro to focus on solar, onshore wind and batteries; the Hydro Africa team moves to TotalEnergies as SN Power AS.

sources.title: Scatec completes sale of African hydropower assets to TotalEnergies

title: Peak Energy buys 1 MW Singapore rooftop solar and signs VPPA with Arkema
summary: Peak Energy acquired a 1 MW rooftop solar installation in Singapore and signed a long-term virtual PPA with Arkema.
details: Peak Energy bought a 1 MW rooftop solar system in Singapore, on the roof of Matco Asia and operating since 2023, and signed a virtual PPA with Arkema for its Symphony plant on Jurong Island.
context: The rooftop produces about 1 GWh a year. Arkema aims to cut Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 48.5% by 2030 from 2019, an SBTi-approved goal.

sources.title: Peak Energy Acquires Solar Rooftop Project in Singapore, Enters into Long-Term Virtual Power Purchase Agreement with Arkema

title: Borosil Renewables completes ₹17.82 crore investment in Clean Max Prithvi
summary: Borosil Renewables completed a ₹17.82 crore investment in Clean Max Prithvi for a 16.5 MW captive hybrid solar-wind plant in Gujarat.
details: Borosil Renewables completed its ₹17.82 crore investment in Clean Max Prithvi, which is building a 16.5 MW hybrid solar-wind plant in Gujarat. Borosil keeps a 49% stake, bought for ₹49,000, and will take all of the plant's power.
context: Under India's captive power rules a consumer must own at least 26% of a plant to use its power free of some grid surcharges.

sources.title: Borosil Renewables Completes ₹17.82 Crore Investment In 16.50 MW Hybrid Solar-Wind Project

title: Thai Solar Energy and GPSC sell Thai Solar Renewable to Levanta
summary: Thai Solar Energy agreed to sell its 60% of Thai Solar Renewable to Levanta Renewables, and GPSC approved selling its 40%, with completion expected by the second quarter.
details: Thai Solar Energy agreed to sell its 60% stake in Thai Solar Renewable to Levanta Renewables (Thailand), and GPSC approved selling its 40% stake to Levanta under its tag-along right. Completion is expected by the second quarter, subject to approvals.
context: A tag-along right lets a minority shareholder sell on the same terms when the majority owner sells. The article does not give the price.

sources.title: Thai Solar Energy sells stake in Thai Solar Renewable

title: SMT Energy raises US$135 million for 160 MW / 320 MWh Houston battery project

buyers.name: Macquarie Group
buyers.role: joint lead arranger and preferred equity investor

summary: SMT Energy has closed US$135 million in funding for SMT Houston IV, a 160 MW / 320 MWh battery storage facility in Houston, Texas. Macquarie and KeyBanc Capital Markets arranged a US$100 million project loan, and Macquarie also provided preferred equity.
details: The battery can deliver 160 MW for about two hours and will connect to the ERCOT grid, earning money by selling energy and grid support services in the wholesale market rather than under a long-term contract. The capital includes a US$100 million project financing facility led by Macquarie and KeyBanc, plus a preferred equity investment from Macquarie's Commodities and Global Markets business, which is a form of ownership stake that gets paid before common equity. Macquarie is also mandated to sell the project's investment tax credits, federal tax incentives worth about US$62 million, to other buyers. FlexGen Power Systems is supplying the equipment and its HybridOS control software. Commercial operation is expected in the second quarter of 2026.
context: The company says the closing brings it to eighteen utility-scale battery assets of about 500 MWh in operation or construction, with a further 2 GWh pipeline in ERCOT and the Southwest Power Pool targeted by 2030. The release links the project to growing demand and intermittent generation on the Texas grid, where storage helps balance supply. SMT expects the facility to store and dispatch electricity equal to the yearly use of about 8,800 Texas homes.

sources.title: SMT Energy Secures US$135 Million for 320 MWH Battery in Houston

title: PGE closes €3 billion financing for 1.5 GW Baltica 2 offshore wind
summary: Polska Grupa Energetyczna closed a €3 billion multi-source project financing, arranged with 25 institutions, to build the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 offshore wind farm.
details: PGE and Ørsted closed €3 billion of project financing for the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 offshore wind farm in the Baltic Sea between Ustka and Choczewo, arranged by 25 lenders including BGK, the EIB, the EBRD and ING. Denmark's export credit agency EIFO backed a covered tranche.
context: It is part of the first phase of Poland's offshore wind programme, will use 107 turbines and meets the Green Loan Principles. Norton Rose Fulbright advised PGE.

sources.title: Norton Rose Fulbright advises PGE on project financing of offshore wind farm

title: Modern Niagara Group makes bridge equity investment in RNG technology firm Hydron Energy
summary: Canadian contractor Modern Niagara Group has made a further bridge investment in Hydron Energy, a North Vancouver company that makes equipment to upgrade biogas into renewable natural gas. The amount was not disclosed.
details: The funding is bridge financing, meaning short-term capital raised to carry a company until a larger round, in this case a planned Series A. Hydron says the money will support its ongoing manufacturing needs. Its INTRUPTor system upgrades biogas from anaerobic digesters, wastewater plants and landfills into renewable natural gas, which is biogas cleaned to pipeline quality. Modern Niagara, already a strategic investor, is also expected to supply manufacturing capacity for larger production volumes.
context: Hydron claims its technology cuts capital and operating costs by up to 50% and lowers greenhouse gas emissions by 85% compared with other commercial products. Modern Niagara says it also sees potential to use the platform for on-site oxygen production in hospitals and other industrial uses. The round positions Hydron ahead of its expected Series A raise.

sources.title: Hydron Energy Announces Equity Investment from Modern Niagara Group

title: Aura Power closes £33.1 million Rabobank financing for 40 MW Burtree Lane solar
summary: Aura Power closed £33.1 million of project finance from Rabobank to build the 40 MW Burtree Lane solar farm in Darlington.
details: Aura Power closed £33.1 million of project financing from Rabobank to build the 40 MW Burtree Lane solar farm in Darlington, the second project in its 400 MWp+ ready-to-build portfolio to close with Rabobank after Kemble in October 2024. Burges Salmon advised Aura Power.
context: The farm should power about 14,000 homes, deliver a 46% biodiversity net gain and fund a £20,000-a-year community benefit fund.

sources.title: Burges Salmon advises Aura Power on second solar project financing

title: BOOM Power and Topsun co-invest in 49.9 MW Low Farm solar
summary: BOOM Power secured a co-investment partnership with South Korea's Topsun for the 49.9 MW Low Farm solar plant near Wakefield.
details: South Korean investor Topsun, part-owned by SK Group, agreed to co-invest with BOOM Power in the 49.9 MW Low Farm solar plant on 210 acres near Wakefield, Yorkshire. BOOM Power stays an equity holder and manages construction, due to start in 2025 for operation in 2026.
context: It is Topsun's first UK renewable infrastructure investment. The project targets a 92% net gain in habitat units and secured capacity in a UK government auction.

sources.title: BOOM Power secures co-investment partnership with Topsun for UK solar farm

title: TransGrid Energy secures more than US$1.4 billion for two Arizona battery projects
summary: TransGrid Energy, part of Hanwha FutureProof, secured more than US$1.4 billion to build two large battery storage projects in Arizona.
details: TransGrid Energy, part of Hanwha FutureProof, raised over US$1.4 billion for the Atlas VII and Atlas IX standalone batteries in La Paz County, Arizona, 450 MW / 1,800 MWh combined: US$705 million of loans led by Société Générale and Santander, a US$270 million tax equity commitment and a tax credit transfer of up to US$490 million.
context: Both have 15-year resource adequacy contracts with Southern California Edison, paying them to be available when California's grid needs capacity. Qcells USA is building them for operation in 2025.

sources.title: TransGrid Secures $1.4 Billion Financing for Battery Storage Projects in Arizona

title: Ashtrom Renewable Energy signs PPA with CPS Energy for El Patrimonio Solar
summary: Ashtrom Renewable Energy signed a PPA with San Antonio utility CPS Energy for its El Patrimonio solar project in Texas.
details: Ashtrom Renewable Energy signed a 20-year fixed-price PPA with CPS Energy, San Antonio's municipal utility, for about 70% of the power and renewable energy certificates from its roughly 150 MWac El Patrimonio solar project in Bexar County, Texas. The rest will be sold on the open market.
context: It is Ashtrom's second Texas solar project; commercial operation is expected in the second half of 2027. Power sold without a contract at market prices is called merchant output.

sources.title: Ashtrom Renewable Energy Signs Power Purchase Agreement With CPS Energy For El Patrimonio Solar Project In Texas

title: Pacific Green sells Limestone Coast North battery to Palisade's Intera Renewables
summary: Pacific Green Technologies sold 100% of the Limestone Coast North Energy Park battery in South Australia to Intera Renewables for $293 million.
details: Commercial operation is planned for 2027.

sources.title: Pacific Green sells Limestone Coast North battery project

title: InfraCo Africa sells 25% of Golomoti JCM Solar to Old Mutual Malawi

buyers.name: Old Mutual Infrastructure Investment Trust Fund

summary: InfraCo Africa, part of PIDG, agreed to sell its 25% stake in Golomoti JCM Solar in Malawi to Old Mutual's infrastructure trust fund.
details: InfraCo Africa, part of PIDG, agreed to sell its 25% stake in Golomoti JCM Solar Corporation to Old Mutual's Infrastructure Investment Trust Fund in Malawi.
context: A local investor reduces currency risk because it holds Malawian kwacha. PIDG uses public money to de-risk projects, then sells stakes to private investors to recycle funds.

sources.title: InfraCo Africa Sells 25% Stake in Golomoti JCM Solar to Old Mutual Malawi, Boosting Renewable Energy Investment

title: TMB Thanachart provides long-term financing to Thai Solar Energy
summary: TMB Thanachart Bank provided long-term financing to Thai Solar Energy Group for clean energy development.
details: TMB Thanachart Bank provided long-term financing to Thai Solar Energy Group to expand its solar projects. The group runs 153.2 MW of solar and biomass plants and is building 88.7 MW more under a new solar PPA.
context: The article does not state the loan size. The bank links it to Thailand's goals of carbon neutrality by 2050 and net zero by 2065.

sources.title: TMB Thanachart Backs Thai Solar Energy Group with Long-Term Financing

title: OCI Energy and Arava Power form joint venture for 260 MWac SunRoper solar project in Texas
summary: San Antonio-based developer OCI Energy and Israeli solar company Arava Power have formed a joint venture to develop Project SunRoper, a 260 MWac solar farm in Wharton County, Texas. Financial terms and ownership split were not disclosed.
details: Project SunRoper is a 260 MWac solar farm (MWac refers to capacity measured on the alternating current side delivered to the grid) located about 60 miles southwest of downtown Houston. The partners say construction is scheduled to start in 2025. The release does not describe financing, offtake contracts or the stake each party holds. Sidley Austin advised OCI Energy and Norton Rose Fulbright advised Arava Power.
context: This is the second deal between the two companies, following Arava Power's 2021 acquisition of OCI Energy's 200 MWac SunRay solar project in Uvalde County, Texas, which began operating in September 2024. The companies say the new project will serve one of the highest-demand electricity areas in the US. Arava Power describes the deal as part of its long-term growth strategy in the US, while OCI Energy says it is targeting a 10 GW portfolio by 2028.

sources.title: OCI Energy and Arava Power announce joint venture for 260 MWac solar project in Texas

title: Nautilus Solar buys nearly 11 MWdc of Illinois community solar
summary: Nautilus Solar Energy acquired nearly 11 MWdc of community solar projects in Illinois.
details: Nautilus Solar bought nearly 11 MWdc of Illinois community solar from Renewable Properties: the 7 MW Highway 20 project in Kane County, due online in Q2 2025, and the 4 MW Deep Lake project in Antioch, due by end-2026. Both were developed under the Illinois Shines programme.
context: Community solar lets households subscribe to a share of a local solar farm and get bill credits. The two arrays should produce about 17,300 MWh a year.

sources.title: Nautilus Solar Expands In Illinois With Community Solar Project Acquisition

title: DP Energy sells 325 MW Saamis solar park to City of Medicine Hat
summary: DP Energy completed the sale of the 325 MW Saamis solar project, North America's largest urban solar park, to the City of Medicine Hat, Alberta.
details: DP Energy completed the sale of the 325 MW Saamis solar park, described as North America's largest urban solar project, to the City of Medicine Hat after the Alberta Utilities Commission approved the transfer. DP Energy secured the site in 2017, a permit in 2021 and AUC approval in 2024.
context: The city bought it ready-to-build and plans to build it in phases, starting with 75 MW. Fully built, its 600,000+ panels could supply about 100,000 households.

sources.title: DP Energy finalises sale of North America’s largest urban solar park to Canadian city

title: Scatec and Aboitiz reach financial close on 56 MW of Philippine battery storage
summary: Scatec's joint venture with Aboitiz Power reached financial close on the 16 MW Magat phase 2 and 40 MW Binga battery projects in the Philippines.
details: Scatec and Aboitiz Power's 50/50 joint venture reached financial close on the 16 MW Magat (Phase 2) and 40 MW Binga batteries in the Philippines, paired with the Magat and Binga hydro plants. They are financed with project debt under existing facilities for the hydro plants.
context: The batteries earn money in the ancillary services market by responding quickly to frequency swings. They will more than triple the venture's storage to 80 MW, after a 24 MW Magat battery that began in 2024.

sources.title: Scatec, Aboitiz Power Secure Financial Close for 56 MW BESS Projects in the Philippines

title: Mitsubishi Electric takes stake in HD Renewable Energy and forms joint venture
summary: Mitsubishi Electric announced a partnership with Taipei's HD Renewable Energy, including a stake purchase and a new joint venture for solar and battery storage.
details: Mitsubishi Electric agreed to take a stake in Taipei-based HD Renewable Energy and form a joint venture with it for energy aggregation in Japan.
context: Aggregators pool many small solar panels and batteries and run them as one resource, helping balance the grid and earning more from the market.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Electric Joins Forces With HD Renewable Energy, New Joint Venture And Stake Acquisition Announced

title: SUSI Partners sells 80 MW of wind farms in France and Finland
summary: SUSI Partners sold its French and Finnish onshore wind portfolios, 80 MW in total, from SUSI Renewable Energy Fund II.
details: SUSI Partners sold 80 MW of onshore wind from its SREF II fund: three French wind farms producing about 98 GWh a year to Watts Green, and three Finnish wind farms producing about 125 GWh a year to Locus Energy, a portfolio company of SEB Nordic Energy.
context: SUSI bought the farms one by one between 2015 and 2018. The sales follow disposals in Norway and Germany in 2024 as the fund winds down.

sources.title: SUSI Partners sells onshore wind farms in France and Finland

title: Montana-Dakota Utilities agrees to buy 49% stake in 250 MW Badger Wind Farm in North Dakota
summary: Montana-Dakota Utilities, a subsidiary of MDU Resources, has signed an agreement to acquire a 49% ownership interest in the Badger Wind Farm near Wishek, North Dakota. The stake corresponds to 122.5 MW of the 250 MW project, and MDU estimates its cost at about $294 million.
details: The wind farm is under construction near Wishek, North Dakota. In November MDU signed a power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy electricity, for 150 MW of the project's output, and that contract included the purchase option now being exercised. Once the deal closes, the volume under the power purchase agreement will drop to 27.5 MW, since MDU will own the equivalent of 122.5 MW directly. Closing depends on approval from the North Dakota Public Service Commission, and MDU has asked the regulator for an advance determination of prudence, a ruling that the project is a reasonable way to serve customers. The seller is not named in the release.
context: MDU says its 2024 integrated resource plan, a long-range plan for meeting power demand, showed a need for more generation and that this stake was the least-cost option for customers. The company estimates the purchase would raise renewables in its nameplate generation mix from 29% to 39%, while coal would fall from 31% to 26% and gas from 40% to 35%. The investment forms part of MDU Resources' five-year capital spending plan.

sources.title: MDU Resources Announces Plans to Invest in Badger Wind Farm

title: SWELECT to invest up to ₹21 crore in ESG Green Energy for 16 MW captive solar
summary: SWELECT Energy Systems will invest up to ₹21 crore in its subsidiary ESG Green Energy to build a 16 MW group-captive solar plant.
details: SWELECT Energy Systems will invest up to ₹21 crore in its subsidiary ESG Green Energy to build a 16 MW solar plant under the group captive scheme. SWELECT's stake will fall from 100% to 73.98% as consumers take shares.
context: Under group captive rules, the industrial users who take the power must hold shares in the plant, which lowers their grid charges.

sources.title: SWELECT Energy To Invest ₹21 Crore In ESG Green Energy For 16 MW Solar Power Project

title: Refex Sustainable Solutions to buy 100% of Spectrum Renewable Energy
summary: Refex Sustainable Solutions signed a share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Spectrum Renewable Energy.
details: Refex Sustainable Solutions, a Refex Group subsidiary, signed a share purchase agreement on 11 February 2025 to buy 100% of Spectrum Renewable Energy, which makes compressed biogas and organic manure from sugar-mill press mud and other waste at Warananagar, Kolhapur.
context: Press mud is a sugar-industry residue that can be digested into biogas and purified into compressed biogas, a substitute for natural gas. Spectrum had turnover of ₹2.62 crore in 2023-24.

sources.title: Refex Sustainable Solutions Acquires 100% Stake In Spectrum Renewable Energy

title: ONGC NTPC Green signs US$2.3 billion deal for Ayana Renewable Power
summary: ONGC NTPC Green signed a share purchase agreement to buy 100% of Ayana Renewable Power, with about 4.1 GW of operating and under-construction assets, for US$2.3 billion.
details: ONGC NTPC Green, a joint venture of India's state oil and power companies, signed an agreement to buy 100% of Ayana Renewable Power for US$2.3 billion. Ayana has about 4.1 GW of operating and under-construction assets across several Indian states.
context: It is the venture's first investment since it was formed in November 2024. ONGC and NTPC target net zero by 2038 and 2050; completion needs regulatory approval.

sources.title: ONGPL inks deal for 100% acquisition of Ayana Renewable Power

title: White Pine Renewables closes loan with Beneficial State Bank and Energetic Capital for two California public-sector solar projects
target: Two operating solar projects serving Feather Water District and Kettleman City Community Services District
summary: White Pine Renewables has closed a loan from Beneficial State Bank and Energetic Capital to finance two operating solar projects in California. The projects supply power to the Feather Water District in Sutter County and the Kettleman City Community Services District in Kings County. The loan amount and project sizes were not disclosed.
details: Both projects are already operating and are behind-the-meter, meaning they supply electricity directly to the customer's site rather than to the wider grid. The districts pay nothing upfront and, according to White Pine, receive long-term energy savings, typically through a power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy the electricity. The Feather Water project uses elevated carport-style racking beside irrigation ponds so the district keeps access to them. The Kettleman City project uses a high-density racking system from Planted Solar to fit more panels on a small site.
context: White Pine describes the deal as the start of a new lending relationship with both financiers. Beneficial State Bank, a community development lender majority-owned by a nonprofit foundation, presents the loan as evidence that banks can shift away from fossil fuels and still profit. Energetic Capital says it hopes the transaction shows what is possible for financing smaller commercial and distributed solar projects.

sources.title: White Pine Renewables Inks Financing Deal with Beneficial State Bank and Energetic Capital for California Public Projects

title: EGCO sells 113 MW Boco Rock wind farm stake
summary: Thailand's EGCO sold its entire stake in Boco Rock Wind Farm, which owns a 113 MW wind farm in New South Wales.
details: EGCO's subsidiary Millennium Energy agreed on 31 January to sell 100% of Boco Rock Wind Farm Pty Ltd, owner of the 113 MW Boco Rock wind farm in New South Wales, to Tilt Renewables. Closing is expected in the first quarter of 2025.
context: The farm has operated since November 2014 under a 15-year PPA with EnergyAustralia. EGCO will use the proceeds for new investments.

sources.title: EGCO divests in 113 MW Australian wind farm

title: Crayhill Capital provides up to US$50 million credit facility to Universal Kraft Canada Renewables for Alberta solar
target: Universal Kraft Canada Renewables Alberta solar development portfolio
summary: Universal Kraft Canada Renewables, a joint venture of Korkia and Universal Kraft, has closed a credit facility with New York asset-based lender Crayhill Capital Management. The facility starts with a US$15 million commitment and can grow to as much as US$50 million. It supports the developer's 1.7 GW solar pipeline in Alberta, Canada.
details: The money will fund Generator Unit Owner Contribution (GUOC) payments, which are refundable deposits that generators in Alberta must pay to the grid operator, the Alberta Electric System Operator. The deposit is meant to encourage building plants near existing transmission lines and is returned over time depending on the plant's size, location and performance. Paying it helps the developer secure grid connection for its more advanced projects. The release does not give the loan's term, pricing or project-level timelines.
context: The developer describes itself as one of the largest renewable developers in Alberta and says the financing confirms the quality of its portfolio. The company expects demand for renewable power to rise once ongoing Alberta market reforms are settled. Crayhill presents the deal as an example of tailored lending that fills financing gaps for projects still in development.

sources.title: Universal Kraft Canada Renewables secures USD 15 million credit facility for solar energy development

title: DESRI and Ranger Power close construction financing for 250 MWac Show Me State Solar in Missouri

buyers.name: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC)
buyers.role: left lead arranger and administrative agent

summary: DESRI and its development partner Ranger Power reached financial close on construction debt for the 250 MWac Show Me State Solar project in Callaway County, Missouri, and began building it. A lender group led by CIBC provided the financing, and an affiliate of Meta will buy the power.
details: Financial close means all loan agreements are signed and funds can be drawn to build the plant. The construction loan comes from CIBC as lead arranger and administrative agent, joined by Nord/LB, Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of America. The project has a power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to sell its electricity, with a Meta affiliate, though its length is not disclosed. Commercial operation is expected in 2026 and the companies expect up to about 300 workers at peak construction. Ranger Power describes the project as a venture of nearly 500 million US dollars, but the loan amount itself is not stated.
context: DESRI says this is its third Missouri project to start construction, and Ranger says it has now moved over 1.5 GW of projects into construction or operation with DESRI. Meta says the project supports its aim of matching its electricity use with renewable energy, including its Kansas City data center. The deal reflects growing demand from technology companies for contracted solar power.

sources.title: DESRI and Ranger Power Announce Close of Financing and Start of Construction for 250MWac Show Me State Solar Project in Missouri

title: Juniper Green Energy secures US$1 billion of phased debt financing
summary: Juniper Green Energy secured US$1 billion of phased debt from lenders including PFC, DBS, HSBC and IREDA to expand its Indian renewable projects.
details: Juniper Green Energy secured US$1 billion of debt in phases from Power Finance Corporation, DBS, HSBC and IREDA to build wind-solar hybrid and firm and dispatchable projects in India.
context: Phased debt lets Juniper draw funds as each project is ready, supporting its growing portfolio as demand for clean power rises.

sources.title: Juniper Green Energy Secures $1 Billion Debt Financing To Expand Renewable Energy Projects In India

title: Implats signs five-year wheeled renewable PPA with Discovery Green
summary: Implats signed a five-year PPA with Discovery Green for wheeled renewable power to its Impala Refineries in Springs.
details: Impala Platinum signed a five-year PPA with Discovery Green to supply wheeled renewable power to its Impala Refineries operation in Springs, east of Johannesburg.
context: Wheeling sends power from a distant plant over the grid to the buyer. Renewables were 37% of Implats' electricity in its 2024 financial year, up from 30%; it has also built a 35 MW solar plant at Zimplats.

sources.title: Implats Signs Five-Year Renewable Energy PPA with Discovery Green for Impala Refineries

title: SUNCATCHER secures construction bridge financing from Qualitas Energy for 111 MWp
summary: SUNCATCHER secured construction bridge financing from Qualitas Energy's debt fund for two solar projects in Germany and Poland totalling 111 MWp.
details: SUNCATCHER secured construction bridge financing from Qualitas Energy's debt fund for two solar projects under construction, 83 MWp in Germany and 28 MWp in Poland, with no long-term offtake contracts. It is Qualitas's first senior facility on a fully merchant basis; Capcora advised.
context: Lenders rarely finance fully merchant solar, which sells at market prices with no PPA or subsidy, because revenue is less predictable.

sources.title: SUNCATCHER Secures Construction Bridge Financing From Qualitas Energy For 111 MWp Solar PV Projects In Germany & Poland

title: NTPC Green Energy and Andhra Pradesh form joint venture for 25 GW
summary: NTPC Green Energy incorporated AP NGEL Harit Amrit, a 50:50 joint venture with an Andhra Pradesh state agency to develop 25 GW of renewable projects.
details: NTPC Green Energy and the New & Renewable Energy Development Corporation of Andhra Pradesh incorporated a 50:50 joint venture, AP NGEL Harit Amrit Limited, on 6 February 2025 to develop up to 25 GW of solar, wind and hybrid projects, up to 10 GW of pumped hydro storage and 0.5 million tonnes a year of green hydrogen and derivatives.
context: The Ministry of Power approved the venture on 5 December 2024 with DIPAM and NITI Aayog; NGEL subscribed for 50,000 shares to set it up.

sources.title: NTPC Green Energy And Andhra Pradesh Form Joint Venture For 25 GW Renewable Projects

title: Potentia Energy agrees to buy controlling stakes in over 1 GW of Australian renewables

buyers.name: Potentia Energy (Enel Green Power and INPEX)

summary: Potentia Energy, co-owned by Enel Green Power and INPEX, agreed to buy controlling stakes in more than 1 GW of Australian renewables from CVC DIF and Cbus Super, including about 700 MW of operating wind and solar.
details: Potentia Energy, co-owned by Enel Green Power and INPEX, agreed to buy controlling stakes from CVC DIF and Cbus Super in over 1 GW of Australian renewables: about 700 MW of operating wind and solar plus more than 430 MW in late-stage development, including batteries in South Australia and Queensland and a Western Australian wind project.
context: Potentia already has 309 MW of solar in South Australia and Victoria and a 75 MW WA wind farm. The deal needs Foreign Investment Review Board approval.

sources.title: Potentia Energy acquires over 1 GW of Australian renewables portfolio

title: CleanMax signs 100 MW wind power purchase agreement with Amazon in India
summary: Brookfield-backed CleanMax has signed a power purchase agreement with Amazon tied to a new 100 MW wind farm in India. CleanMax will build and run the project, and Amazon will buy its electricity for its Indian operations.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific project. The wind farm will connect to India's national grid and is expected to begin operating in the second quarter of 2026. CleanMax estimates it will generate about 355 million kWh a year and avoid roughly 252,000 tonnes of CO2 annually. Contract length and price were not disclosed.
context: The deal supports Amazon's Climate Pledge goal of net-zero carbon emissions across its operations by 2040. CleanMax, which says it has about 2 GW of operating renewable assets across Asia, presents the agreement as part of a wider trend of global tech companies buying clean power in India.

sources.title: CleanMax and Amazon sign PPA for 100MW of Wind Energy

title: BlueWave raises $118.2 million in debt and tax equity for four Maine community solar projects
summary: BlueWave has secured $118.2 million in financing for four community solar projects in Maine. The package combines a $48.2 million loan from City National Bank with $70 million of tax equity from First American Commercial Bancorp. The projects total 22.7 MW of DC capacity.
details: The four sites qualify for Maine's Net Energy Billing program, which lets community solar projects pass bill credits to residents and businesses that sign up. They add 22.7 MWDC (direct current panel capacity) and deliver bill savings to 43 small businesses. Construction finished in 2024. Tax equity means an investor provides cash in exchange for the federal tax credits and other tax benefits the projects generate. BlueWave was advised by Novogradac, KPMG and Foley Hoag LLP.
context: BlueWave, owned by Axium Infrastructure, has previously developed 46.4 MWDC in Maine, and the new projects expand that footprint. The company says the projects support the state's goal of net-zero emissions by 2040. The deal follows an earlier funding round for five projects under Massachusetts' SMART program.

sources.title: BlueWave Secures $118.2 Million Debt and Tax Equity Raise to Support Maine Solar Portfolio

title: Yeager Energy secures over €100 million from Pioneer Point Partners for geothermal
summary: Dutch geothermal company Yeager Energy secured commitments of more than €100 million from Pioneer Point Partners and existing shareholders, and agreed to buy two Dutch geothermal companies.
details: Dutch geothermal company Yeager Energy secured more than €100 million from Pioneer Point Partners and existing shareholders, making Pioneer its majority shareholder. Yeager bought a majority of Aardwarmte Vogelaer and signed a second acquisition expected to close in Q1 2025.
context: Dutch geothermal mostly supplies heat to greenhouses, homes and industry. Yeager also holds four exploration licences; Kerogen Capital was its first institutional investor.

sources.title: Yeager Energy secures investment from Pioneer Point Partners to support geothermal energy ventures

title: AMPYR Australia buys Shell's 50% of Wellington battery Stage 1
summary: AMPYR Australia bought Shell Energy Australia's 50% of Stage 1 of the Wellington battery in New South Wales, becoming sole owner.
details: AMPYR Australia bought Shell Energy Australia's 50% stake in stage 1 of the Wellington battery in New South Wales, becoming sole owner. Stage 1 is 300 MW / 600 MWh and stage 2 is 100 MW / 400 MWh; the partners had worked together since October 2022.
context: Stage 1 has planning and grid approval and is finalising procurement and financing, with energisation targeted for 2026. AMPYR aims to own 3 GW of storage in Australia by 2030.

sources.title: AMPYR Australia takes over Shell’s 50% stake in Wellington battery project

title: Shizen Energy secures ¥1 billion for 6.7 MW of solar supplying Bourbon factories
summary: Shizen Energy signed a ¥1 billion project finance agreement with Daishi Hokuetsu Bank for four solar plants in Niigata and Yamagata, 6.7 MW in total, supplying Bourbon's factories.
details: Shizen Energy signed a ¥1 billion (about US$6.67 million) project finance agreement with Daishi Hokuetsu Bank for four solar plants, 6.7 MW in total, in Niigata and Yamagata prefectures. They supply five Bourbon factories in Niigata under an off-site corporate PPA signed in 2024.
context: In an off-site PPA the plants are away from the factories and power is delivered over the grid. Three of the four plants already operate; the last is due in 2025.

sources.title: Shizen Energy secures $6.67m financing for 6.7 MW solar projects

title: Natixis CIB arranges $612 million construction bridge financing for MN8 Energy's 517 MWdc US solar portfolio
target: Portfolio of three solar projects in North Carolina, Kentucky and Illinois
summary: MN8 Energy closed $612 million of debt financing to build three solar plants with a combined 517 MWdc in North Carolina, Kentucky and Illinois. Natixis CIB served as sole bookrunner and administrative agent on the deal, which closed on December 31, 2024.
details: The package includes a construction bridge facility, which is short-term debt used during building until longer-term funding is arranged, with part of it tied to the sale of tax credits under US transferability rules. It also includes a letter of credit facility, a bank guarantee used to back project obligations. The structure lets MN8 later refinance the loan in the US private placement market, where investors buy long-term debt directly. Construction is underway at different stages and all three projects are expected to begin commercial operation by the end of 2025. The 517 MW figure is stated in direct current terms.
context: MN8 Energy, originally set up by Goldman Sachs Asset Management in 2017 and rebranded in 2022, reports about 4 GW of operating and under-construction solar and 1.1 GWh of battery storage across 28 states. MN8 describes the financing as a sign of its development pipeline strength, while Natixis presents the deal as part of a busy year for US power and renewables financings. The release points to private placements as a growing source of long-term debt for renewable projects.

sources.title: Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking acts as Sole Bookrunner for MN8 Energy in the Financing of Three Solar Facilities in North Carolina, Kentucky, and Illinois

title: ACME Solar signs 680 MW FDRE PPA with NHPC
summary: ACME Solar signed a PPA with NHPC for a 680 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy project.
details: ACME Solar signed a PPA with NHPC for a 680 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE) project combining solar, wind and batteries at sites in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka and Rajasthan, won in NHPC's 1,400 MW FDRE tender.
context: FDRE contracts require steady, on-demand supply: here a minimum 40% annual capacity utilisation factor and 90% of promised output in peak hours.

sources.title: ACME Solar Powers Up with NHPC, Signs 680 MW PPA For FDRE Project

title: Hydro Rein buys 20% of 902 MWp Vista Alegre solar complex in Brazil
summary: Hydro Rein acquired 20% of the 902 MWp Vista Alegre solar complex, Brazil's largest, from Atlas Renewable Energy.
details: Hydro Rein bought a 20% stake in the 902 MWp Vista Alegre solar complex in Minas Gerais from Atlas Renewable Energy. It began full operation in December 2024 and should produce about 2 TWh a year.
context: It is Brazil's largest solar complex built in a single phase and sells power to aluminium maker Albras under a 21-year PPA signed in 2023. Hydro Rein had held an option on the stake since March 2023.

sources.title: Hydro Rein acquires 20% stake in Brazil solar complex

title: Enlight sells 44% of Sunlight cluster to Harel and Amitim
summary: Enlight Renewable Energy agreed to sell 44% of the partnership holding its Sunlight cluster of Israeli renewable projects to Harel and Amitim.
details: Enlight Renewable Energy agreed to sell 44% of the partnership holding its Sunlight cluster of Israeli solar and storage projects: 25% to Harel Insurance and 19% to Amitim Senior Pension Funds.
context: The plants combine solar with batteries; Enlight's supply arm, Enlight Enterprise, will sell their power directly to large Israeli consumers. Selling minority stakes lets Enlight recycle capital while keeping control.

sources.title: Enlight Renewable Energy Sells 44% Stake in Sunlight Cluster to Harel and Amitim

title: ABEI Energy closes €46 million HoldCo debt for 250 MWp of Spanish solar
summary: ABEI Energy closed €46 million of HoldCo debt from Fuyo General Lease and Prime Capital for five solar projects in Spain, about 250 MWp.
details: HoldCo debt is lent to the company that owns the projects rather than to each project.

sources.title: ABEI Energy finalises financing for solar photovoltaics portfolio in Spain

title: HNO International signs hydrogen offtake deal with unnamed Texas mobility company
summary: HNO International has agreed to supply hydrogen to an unnamed Texas-based mobility company for its fleet of heavy-duty fuel cell trucks. The hydrogen will come from HNO's 1.25 MW production unit, which can make up to 500 kilograms of hydrogen per day.
details: An offtake agreement is a contract in which a buyer commits to purchase output, here hydrogen fuel, from a producer. HNO will supply hydrogen from its Scalable Hydrogen Energy Platform, a 1.25 MW electrolysis-based unit producing up to 500 kg daily, and will also provide its Compact Hydrogen Refueling System to fuel the customer's Class 8 fuel cell trucks. The release does not name the customer or state a fixed contract value. HNO says it projects multi-year contracts approaching $10 million as it scales production in its first year of operation, but this figure is a projection rather than the stated value of this agreement.
context: HNO presents the deal as evidence of rising demand for hydrogen in long-haul freight, a sector seeking alternatives to diesel. The company says it plans to expand production capacity to meet that demand. The release does not specify the energy source for hydrogen production, so whether the hydrogen is renewable-based is not confirmed.

sources.title: HNO International Secures $10 Million Hydrogen Offtake Agreement with Texas-Based Mobility Company

title: Blueleaf Energy and Jakson Green partner on 1 GW Rajasthan solar portfolio
summary: Blueleaf Energy and Jakson Green partnered to develop a 1 GW solar portfolio in Rajasthan, an investment of about US$400 million.
details: Blueleaf Energy, owned by a Macquarie Asset Management fund, and Jakson Green formed a partnership to build a 1 GW, US$400 million solar portfolio of three projects in Rajasthan, funded with debt and equity, with 25-year PPAs won in tenders by RUVNL, SECI and NHPC.
context: The plants mix intra-state (InSTS) and inter-state (ISTS) grid connections, will be built to own and operate, and are due online in 2025–26, producing over 1,800 GWh a year.

sources.title: Blueleaf Energy And Jakson Green Partner To Develop 1 GW Solar Portfolio In Rajasthan With USD 400 Million Investment

title: Standard Solar buys 3.2 MW Churchill Street Solar Farm from Sunfarm Solar
summary: Standard Solar acquired the 3.2 MW Churchill Street Solar Farm in Massachusetts from Sunfarm Solar.
details: Standard Solar bought the operating 3.2 MW Churchill Street Solar Farm in Pittsfield, Massachusetts, a ground-mounted site with five arrays, from developer Sunfarm Solar.
context: Standard Solar is growing its portfolio of operating assets in Massachusetts, one of its key markets for commercial and community solar.

sources.title: Standard Solar Expands Massachusetts Operations With Acquisition Of Churchill Street Solar Farm From Sunfarm Solar

title: EDP and Amazon sign 20-year PPA for 44 MWp solar farm in Fukushima
summary: EDP Renewables APAC signed a 20-year PPA with Amazon for its 44 MWp solar farm in Fukushima, Japan.
details: EDP Renewables APAC signed a 20-year PPA with Amazon for its 44 MWp ground-mounted solar farm in Fukushima, Japan, with about 63,000 panels producing over 48 GWh a year. It should start operating in the third quarter of 2025.
context: It is the second PPA between EDP and Amazon in Asia-Pacific, after one in Singapore in 2021.

sources.title: EDP and Amazon sign PPA for 44MWp solar farm in Japan

title: Innova sells 27.5 MWp Ducklington solar to Schroders Greencoat
summary: Innova sold the consented 27.5 MWp Ducklington solar project in Oxfordshire, which holds a Contract for Difference, to Schroders Greencoat.
details: Innova sold the 27.5 MWp Ducklington solar project in Oxfordshire to Schroders Greencoat. It has planning consent from March 2022 and a CfD from Allocation Round 6; construction starts in Q1 2025 with generation targeted for early 2026.
context: It is Innova's fifth project sold to Schroders Greencoat, over 110 MWp in total, after Stokeford, Carn Nicholas, Bicker Fen and Elms Farm.

sources.title: Innova completes sale of Ducklington solar to Schroders Greencoat

title: Matrix Renewables closes €124 million for 157 MW of Spanish solar
summary: Matrix Renewables closed €124 million of non-recourse financing to build three solar plants totalling 157 MW in Castilla y León and Castilla-La Mancha.
details: Matrix Renewables, backed by TPG Rise, closed €124 million of non-recourse financing from NORD/LB (agent), BBVA and Rabobank to build three solar plants totalling 157 MW in Palencia (Castilla y León) and Cuenca (Castilla-La Mancha), Spain.
context: Non-recourse means lenders are repaid only from the plants' cash flows, not from the sponsor. Construction began in November 2024 for operation in Q1 2026.

sources.title: Matrix Renewables secures financing for solar plant construction

title: Greenbacker secures US$950 million for New York's largest solar project
summary: Greenbacker secured US$950 million to acquire, build and run Cider, a 674 MWdc / 500 MWac solar farm that will be New York's largest.
details: Greenbacker raised US$950 million to buy, build and run the 674 MWdc / 500 MWac Cider solar farm, which will be New York's largest, after buying it from Hecate Energy. This includes US$869 million of construction-to-term loans, a tax equity bridge and letters of credit from six lead arrangers including MUFG and KeyBanc.
context: A tax equity bridge loan funds construction until tax equity investors pay in at completion. Greenbacker and Hecate had partnered on the project since 2021.

sources.title: Greenbacker secures financing to support New York’s largest solar project

title: esVolta closes preferred equity deal structured by Captona for three Texas battery storage projects

buyers.name: Captona LLC
buyers.role: preferred equity investor and transaction structurer

target: Anole, Desert Willow and Burksol battery storage projects

advisors.name: Kirkland & Ellis LLP
advisors.role: legal adviser to Captona and its equity partner

summary: Battery storage developer esVolta completed a preferred equity transaction structured by investment firm Captona to fund three standalone battery projects in Texas. Combined with the sale of investment tax credits, the deal is expected to provide a total of $243 million.
details: The funding covers the Anole, Desert Willow and Burksol projects in the ERCOT market, the grid serving most of Texas. The release describes their combined size as nearly 1 GWh in the body and nearly 1 GW in the subheadline, so the exact capacity is unclear. All three are under construction and are expected to begin commercial operation in the first half of 2025. Preferred equity is an ownership stake that gets paid before common equity, and ITC transfer means selling the federal investment tax credits earned by the projects to another company for cash. Morgan Lewis & Bockius advised esVolta, while Kirkland & Ellis advised Captona and its equity partner.
context: esVolta says this deal brings its 2024 fundraising to nearly $900 million and that it has a pipeline of over 30 projects totaling nearly 25 GWh. The company presents the projects as helping balance variable solar and wind output on the Texas grid. The deal shows how tax credit transfers are being paired with equity to finance US storage.

sources.title: esVolta Secures $243 Million Preferred Equity Investment for Three Standalone Battery Energy Storage Projects

title: J&V Energy's Pine Wind Power to buy Macquarie's 26% of Formosa 2 offshore wind
summary: Pine Wind Power, part of J&V Energy, agreed to buy Macquarie's 26% equity and debt interest in the 376 MW Formosa 2 offshore wind farm off Miaoli, Taiwan.
details: Pine Wind Power, part of J&V Energy, agreed to buy Macquarie Asset Management's 26% equity and debt interest in Formosa 2, a 376 MW offshore wind farm off Miaoli County, Taiwan, backed by capital from Taiwan Life Insurance and He Jun Energy.
context: Formosa 2 has been grid-connected since March 2023 and was developed by Macquarie with JERA and Synera Renewable Energy. It is J&V's first operating wind investment.

sources.title: Pine Wind Power to acquire stake in Formosa offshore wind farm

title: Keysight signs virtual PPA with Southern Power
summary: Keysight Technologies signed a virtual PPA with Southern Power, a Southern Company subsidiary, for renewable energy.
details: Keysight Technologies signed its first virtual PPA, with Southern Power, for renewable energy credits from a 39 MW share of the Millers Branch Solar Facility's Phase III in Haskell County, Texas, due to operate in Keysight's fiscal 2027.
context: The share will match all of Keysight's electricity use in the US and Canada. In a virtual PPA the buyer gets the certificates and settles a price difference rather than taking delivery.

sources.title: Keysight Commits To Renewable Energy With Virtual Power Purchase Agreement

title: Innovo Renewables buys 66 MW of Italian solar projects
summary: Innovo Renewables acquired 11 advanced-stage solar and agrivoltaic projects in Italy totalling 66 MW.
details: Innovo Renewables bought 11 ready-to-build solar plants, including agrivoltaic projects, totalling 66 MW across Lombardy, Tuscany, Lazio, Abruzzo and Puglia. Aviva Investors invested €30 million, raising its stake in Innovo to 45%.
context: Agrivoltaics combines solar panels with farming on the same land. Construction starts in summer 2025; Innovo aims for 150 MW of acquired projects by mid-2025.

sources.title: Innovo Renewables Acquires 66 MW of Photovoltaic Projects Across Italy

title: ContourGlobal buys 446 MWp US solar portfolio from Qcells
summary: ContourGlobal agreed with Qcells to acquire a 446 MW solar portfolio in Colorado and Virginia.
details: ContourGlobal agreed to buy a 446 MW solar portfolio from Qcells: 324 MW under construction in Colorado and a 122 MW Virginia project starting construction in 2026.
context: It takes ContourGlobal's planned US solar and storage to nearly 1.5 GW, after more than 1 GW of late-stage projects in South Carolina and Arizona, across the WECC and PJM grid regions.

sources.title: ContourGlobal Expands U.S. Solar Portfolio With 446 MWp Acquisition From Qcells

title: Solar Proponent signs PPAs for 1.6 GWac of Texas solar
summary: Solar Proponent signed agreements with a major technology company and others to deliver 1.6 GWac from four Texas solar projects.
details: Solar Proponent signed agreements to supply 1.6 GWac from four Texas solar projects to a major technology company. It is backed by EnCap Investments, Yorktown Partners and Mercuria Energy, which helped it raise a US$300 million credit facility.
context: The projects will serve the growing ERCOT market. Large tech buyers are signing contracts for new capacity to meet rising power demand.

sources.title: Solar Proponent Signs Power Purchase Agreements For 1.6 GWAC Solar Capacity, Advancing Renewable Energy Goals

title: Quinbrook closes A$722 million for Supernode battery stages 1 and 2
summary: Quinbrook closed A$722 million of new debt for the first two stages of the Supernode battery in Queensland.
details: Quinbrook closed A$722 million (US$451.25 million) of new debt from Bank of America, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deutsche Bank, Mizuho and MUFG for stages 1 and 2 of its Supernode battery in Queensland, 520 MW / 1,856 MWh combined, both under long-term offtake agreements with Origin Energy.
context: Supernode sits beside the central node of Queensland's grid. A planned stage 3 of 760 MW / 3,096 MWh would make it one of the largest batteries under construction in the world.

sources.title: Quinbrook closes $451.25m debt financing for Queensland battery storage project

title: Emeren sells 17 MW operational solar portfolio in Poland
target: 17 MW operational solar portfolio in Poland
summary: Emeren Group, a US-listed solar developer, has sold a 17 MW portfolio of operating solar projects in Poland. The buyer and the price were not disclosed.
details: The package combines a 15 MW portfolio that Emeren had announced earlier, which sells its output under a power purchase agreement (a long-term contract to sell electricity to a buyer at agreed terms), with an additional 2 MW of capacity. Emeren developed and built all of the projects and sold them together in a single deal. The plants are already operating. The release does not name the acquirer, the deal value, the length of the power contract or any advisers.
context: The sale fits Emeren's model of developing and building solar projects and then selling them to recycle capital. The company says the projects support Poland's climate targets and bring local jobs and tax revenue, and its CEO presented the deal as strengthening its position in the Polish market.

sources.title: Emeren Group Announces Sale of 17 MW Solar Portfolio in Poland

title: H2, Inc. raises $16 million bridge round led by STIC Investments for flow battery plant
summary: South Korean vanadium flow battery maker H2, Inc. raised $16 million in bridge funding led by private equity firm STIC Investments, with KRUN Ventures and Lighthouse Combined Investment also taking part. The round closed in the second half of 2024 and lifts the company's total funding to $77 million.
details: Bridge funding is short-term capital raised between larger financing rounds. H2 says the money will mainly fund its new K2 Plant in South Korea, which is meant to raise annual manufacturing capacity to 1.2 GWh, compared with 330 MWh a year at its existing K1 Plant. The company has secured land for the plant and plans to start operations in 2026. K2 will make its EnerFLOW 500 series for 4-hour storage, the EnerFLOW 600 series for 8 hours or more, and its 5000-series battery stacks.
context: Flow batteries store energy in liquid electrolytes and are aimed at long-duration storage that helps grids absorb more renewable power. H2 claims the funding shows its products are ready for commercial mass production. The company also says its first EnerFLOW 640 units are due to be installed in an 8.8 MWh project in Spain in mid-2025.

sources.title: H2, Inc. Secures $16 Million in Bridge Funding to Expand Flow Battery Manufacturing Capacity

title: EIB lends €150 million to Beka Credit for Spain's Pino small-scale renewables project
summary: The EIB signed a €150 million loan with Beka Credit, Beka Finance's private debt platform, for the Pino project financing small solar and wind in Spain.
details: The EIB signed a €150 million loan with Beka Credit for the Pino Project, a vehicle that lends to small solar and onshore wind projects across Spain, about 65–70 in all, mostly under €10 million each and 80% solar.
context: The loan is drawn in tranches as projects are added and repaid in one bullet at maturity. It takes commercial risk without relying on subsidies, helping smaller projects that banks often overlook.

sources.title: European Investment Bank Signs €150 Million Loan for Spain’s Pino Project to Boost Small-Scale Solar and Wind Energy Initiatives

title: Qualitas Energy buys 117 MWp ready-to-build Polish solar from ib vogt
summary: Qualitas Energy acquired two ready-to-build solar farms in Poland, 117 MWp in total, from ib vogt.
details: Qualitas Energy bought a 117 MWp portfolio of two ready-to-build solar farms in Poland's Mazowieckie and Świętokrzyskie provinces from ib vogt. Construction starts in Q2 and Q3 2025 and operation is due in the second half of 2026.
context: The plants should produce over 125 GWh a year. Qualitas already built the 113 MWp Milkowice plant, Poland's third-largest solar park, in 2024.

sources.title: Qualitas Energy acquires solar portfolio in Poland

title: Octopus Energy Generation buys OX2's French agrivoltaic business
summary: Octopus Energy Generation's Sky Fund acquired OX2's French agrivoltaic operations, targeting 500 MW by 2031.
details: Octopus Energy Generation, through its Octopus Sky Fund, bought the French business of Swedish developer OX2: 15 staff and 21 agrivoltaic projects of about 450 MW in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Centre-Val de Loire and Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes.
context: It is the fund's first investment in a French developer; with all projects built Octopus could reach nearly 500 MW in France by 2031. Agrivoltaics shares land between solar panels and farming.

sources.title: Octopus Energy Acquires OX2's Agrivoltaic Operations in France, Targets 500 MW by 2031

title: Aboitiz Upgrade Solar signs long-term solar PPA with Republic Cement
summary: Aboitiz Upgrade Solar, a joint venture of AboitizPower and Upgrade Energy Philippines, signed a long-term solar PPA with Republic Cement & Building Materials.
details: Aboitiz Upgrade Solar, a joint venture of AboitizPower and Upgrade Energy Philippines, signed a long-term PPA with Republic Cement to build, own and run a ground-mounted solar plant at its Norzagaray, Bulacan facility and sell all the power to the cement plant.
context: The developer pays the upfront cost, so the cement maker saves on power without capital outlay. Completion is due in the second half of 2025.

sources.title: AboitizPower and UGEP Sign Long-Term Solar PPA with Republic Cement in the Philippines

title: GoldenPeaks Capital buys 400 MW of ready-to-build Polish solar
summary: GoldenPeaks Capital acquired 400 MW of ready-to-build solar assets in Poland between December 2024 and January 2025.
details: GoldenPeaks Capital bought 400 MW of ready-to-build solar projects in Poland between December 2024 and January 2025, mostly in western and north-western Poland and up to 58 MW each, a mix of purchases and self-developed sites.
context: GoldenPeaks aims to pass 1 GW of solar in Poland in 2025 and add 300 MW more ready-to-build by end-Q1 2025; its in-house pipeline is about 1.7 GW.

sources.title: GoldenPeaks Capital Expands Portfolio With The Acquisition Of 400 MW Ready-To-Build Assets From December To January

title: PowerGen secures investment for 120 MW African renewables platform
summary: PowerGen Renewable Energy partnered with international investors on a platform to deploy 120 MW of renewables, including batteries, across Africa.
details: PowerGen Renewable Energy secured backing from PIDG, Denmark's IFU, EDFI's ElectriFi and the AfDB's SEFA for a platform to deploy 120 MW of renewables with battery storage in Nigeria, Sierra Leone and the DRC, through mini-grids, metro-grids and commercial and industrial supply. The first phase closed in January 2025.
context: Mini-grids supply communities beyond the main grid. About 570 million people in sub-Saharan Africa lack electricity, according to IRENA.

sources.title: PowerGen Secures Key Investment to Deploy 120 MW of Renewable Energy Across Africa

title: Alternergy secures ₱1 billion RCBC loan for 28 MWp Balsik solar
summary: Alternergy secured a ₱1 billion project loan from RCBC to build the 28 MWp Balsik solar project in Hermosa, Bataan.
details: Alternergy secured a ₱1 billion (about US$17.07 million) senior term loan from RCBC to build the 28 MWp Balsik solar project in Hermosa, Bataan, due for completion early in the second half of 2025.
context: RCBC also finances Alternergy's 64 MW Alabat wind project, subject to financial close, as well as the Pililla wind and Kirahon solar projects.

sources.title: Alternergy bags $17.07m financing for Balsik solar project

title: Vena Energy and MGreen reach financial close on 550 MW Bugallon solar
summary: Vena Energy and MGen Renewable Energy reached financial close on the 550 MW Bugallon solar project in Pangasinan, financed partly by a US$325 million green loan.
details: Vena Energy and MGEN Renewable Energy reached financial close on the 550 MW Bugallon solar project in Pangasinan, partly with a US$325 million green loan from Security Bank, RCBC and PNB, which also act as hedging banks.
context: Construction has started for completion in Q4 2025; the plant should produce about 958 GWh a year. A green loan funds only eligible environmental projects.

sources.title: Vena Energy, MGreen reach financial close for 550 MW Bugallon solar plant

title: Plenitude to buy 49% of EDPR's Sandrini solar and storage portfolio in California
summary: Plenitude agreed to buy 49% of EDP Renewables North America's Sandrini 100 and Sandrini 200 solar plants (300 MWac) and a battery under construction in California.
details: Plenitude, through Eni New Energy US, agreed to buy 49% of EDPR NA's Sandrini portfolio in California: the operating Sandrini 100 (100 MWac) and Sandrini 200 (200 MWac) solar farms and the 368 MWh Sandrini battery under construction, all sharing one grid connection.
context: The plants total about 499 MWdc, of which 245 MWdc is Plenitude's share, taking its US capacity to about 1.7 GW. Sharing a grid connection lets batteries store solar output for later.

sources.title: Plenitude signs agreement with EDP Renewables to acquire two PV plants and BESS in US

title: Tion Renewables buys its 15th German solar park
summary: Munich-based Tion Renewables acquired its 15th solar park in Germany.
details: Tion Renewables bought its 15th German solar park, a 26 MW plant at Klosterheide in eastern Germany completed in 2024, from developer and EPC firm Sunovis. It should produce about 26 GWh a year.
context: It earns a 20-year feed-in tariff plus a 10-year PPA from 2024 priced above the tariff until 2034, a combined offtake that raises revenue.

sources.title: Tion Renewables Expands Portfolio with Acquisition of 15th Solar Park in Germany

title: JERA and East Japan Railway sign off-site solar PPA
summary: JERA and East Japan Railway signed an off-site corporate PPA, with JERA supplying solar power through JERA Cross as aggregator from 1 February 2025.
details: JERA and East Japan Railway signed an off-site corporate PPA: from 1 February 2025, JERA supplies solar power through its aggregator JERA Cross, and JR East's trading arm retails it to the Atre Oimachi and Lumine Yokohama station buildings.
context: JR East's trading arm will also supply power from food waste, the first time JR East combines several renewable sources for its station buildings.

sources.title: JERA, East Japan Railway sign agreement for offsite solar PPA

title: Exus Renewables North America raises $312 million for TAG solar and storage project in New Mexico

buyers.name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

advisors.name: Norton Rose Fulbright
advisors.role: legal adviser to Exus Renewables North America

summary: Exus Renewables North America has closed $312 million of financing for its TAG project in Sandoval County, New Mexico. The project pairs 140 MW of solar with a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery system. Crédit Agricole CIB and ING led the debt, and Exus contributed equity.
details: TAG covers about 1,000 acres and uses Tesla Megapack batteries, which at 50 MW and 200 MWh can discharge for roughly four hours. The package combines construction debt, which funds building the plant, with term debt, a longer loan repaid from operating income. Crédit Agricole CIB and ING acted as coordinating lead arrangers, meaning they organized the lending. Power from the project will serve a Meta data center, and completion is scheduled for the second quarter of 2025. Norton Rose Fulbright advised Exus.
context: The lenders describe this as Exus's first major renewable financing in North America. It follows the company's purchase of New Mexico Renewable Development LLC's project portfolio in early 2024. Exus says the project supports more than 250 construction jobs and will pay over $17 million to the county and local school districts across 30 years.

sources.title: Exus Renewables North America Secures $312 Million in Financing for its New Mexico-Based Solar + Storage Project

title: SOLV Energy acquires solar foundation contractor SDI Services
summary: US solar and storage contractor SOLV Energy has bought Sacramento Drilling, Inc., which trades as SDI Services, a specialist in drilling and installing foundations for solar plants. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: SDI Services has more than 25 years of experience in drilled shafts, micropiles, ground anchors and solar foundation installation, serving public and private clients. Since 2010 it has done predrilling and pile foundation work, meaning preparing the ground and driving the posts that hold solar panels, on more than eight projects built by SOLV. The release does not state a price, stake details or the sellers. The two companies plan to work together on projects to improve installation efficiency.
context: SOLV Energy, which provides EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) and O&M (operations and maintenance) services, says it has over 20 GW of installed and awarded utility-scale solar and storage projects. The company presents the deal as part of a push to expand its in-house services and capacity for utility-scale solar construction.

sources.title: SOLV Energy Acquires SDI Services as Strategic Partner to Expand Renewable Energy Capabilities

title: Emeren sells 65 MWp German solar portfolio to Trina Solar ISBU

buyers.name: Trina Solar International System Business Unit

target: 65 MWp solar project portfolio in Germany
summary: US-listed solar developer Emeren Group has agreed to sell a 65 MWp portfolio of three solar projects in Germany to Trina Solar ISBU, the project development arm of Chinese manufacturer Trina Solar. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio has three projects, one in Saarland in western Germany and two agrivoltaic projects in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Lower Saxony in northern Germany. Agrivoltaics (Agri-PV) means placing solar panels on farmland so crops or grazing can continue beneath or between them. MWp refers to peak direct-current panel output. The transactions are expected to close in mid-to-late 2025, and the companies say the sites may later be suited to adding battery storage.
context: Emeren says the sale follows an earlier deal with Trina Solar in France and supports its European growth. Trina says this is its project unit's first activity in the German market, which it expects to be a key European market for its solar and battery development work.

sources.title: Emeren Group Sells 65 MWp Solar Project Portfolio in Germany to Trina Solar

title: Supreme Energy Muara Laboh signs loans for geothermal expansion in Indonesia
summary: PT Supreme Energy Muara Laboh, a joint venture of Sumitomo, INPEX and Supreme Energy, signed loan agreements with a syndicate including JBIC to expand the Muara Laboh geothermal plant in West Sumatra. ADB's part is US$92.6 million.
details: Supreme Energy Muara Laboh, a joint venture of Sumitomo, INPEX and PT Supreme Energy, signed loans with a bank syndicate including JBIC to add a second unit to the Muara Laboh geothermal plant in West Sumatra, roughly doubling it to about 170 MW at an estimated cost of ¥70 billion.
context: Unit 1 has run since December 2019. The plant sells to state utility PLN under a PPA to 2052; construction was due in March 2025 for operation in 2027, with up to 66 MW more possible later.

sources.title: Sumitomo signs loan agreement for expansion of Muara Laboh geothermal power project in Indonesia

title: Exagon Impact Capital invests in Solar Assets Latin America
summary: Exagon Impact Capital made the first investment from its XLA I fund, with co-investors, in solar platform Solar Assets Latin America.
details: Exagon Impact Capital made the first investment from its XLA I fund, with co-investors, taking a controlling stake in Solar Assets Latin America, which installs solar for commercial and industrial clients in Colombia, Ecuador, Panama and Mexico, alongside Entoria Energy.
context: Commercial and industrial (C&I) solar sits on or near a business's site and sells power directly to it, cutting its bills.

sources.title: Exagon Impact Capital Enters Latin America With Investment In Leading Solar Platform Solar Assets Latin America (SALA)

title: Sunsure secures ₹416.35 crore from Aseem Infrastructure for 150 MWp Maharashtra solar park
summary: Sunsure Energy received ₹416.35 crore of long-term debt from Aseem Infrastructure Finance for its 150 MWp solar park in Maharashtra.
details: Sunsure Energy received ₹416.35 crore of long-term debt from Aseem Infrastructure Finance for its 150 MWp solar park in Solapur, Maharashtra, built through several special purpose vehicles. The first phase already supplies large industrial customers; full operation was due by March 2025.
context: The park serves commercial and industrial buyers such as pharmaceutical, manufacturing and cement companies under long-term contracts.

sources.title: Sunsure Energy Achieves ₹416.35 Crore Debt Financing From Aseem Infrastructure For 150 MWp Solar Park In Maharashtra

title: Waaree Energies buys Enel Green Power India for ₹792 crore
summary: Waaree Energies agreed to acquire 100% of Enel Green Power India for ₹792 crore.
