details: Waaree Energies agreed on 10 January 2025 to buy 100% of Enel Green Power India from Enel Green Power Development for up to ₹792 crore. The company has 640 MWac (760 MWdc) of operating and in-development solar and wind projects, some held with a partner.
context: Waaree, best known as a solar module maker, is adding power generation to diversify its revenue.

sources.title: Waaree Energies Acquires 100% Stake In Enel Green Power India For ₹792 Crores To Boost Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: Exus Renewables buys 130 MWp Cibele solar project from Lightsource bp
summary: Exus Renewables acquired the ready-to-build 130 MWp Cibele solar project in Rio Maior and Cadaval, Portugal, from Lightsource bp.
details: Exus Renewables bought the 130 MWp ready-to-build Cibele solar farm in the municipalities of Rio Maior and Cadaval, Portugal, from Lightsource bp. Construction starts in the coming months for operation in 2026.
context: The site could later add wind turbines sharing the same grid connection, a hybrid set-up. Exus bought the 51 MW Cascante wind farm in Spain in early 2024.

sources.title: Exus Renewables acquires Lightsource bp’s Portuguese solar farm

title: Origis Energy closes $415 million financing for Swift Air Solar in Texas

buyers.name: Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking
buyers.role: coordinating lead arranger and lender, construction and term debt

advisors.name: Husch Blackwell
advisors.role: local counsel to Natixis CIB and Advantage Capital

summary: Origis Energy has closed a $415 million financing package for its Swift Air Solar project in Ector County, Texas. Natixis CIB arranged $290 million of construction and term debt and Advantage Capital is providing $125 million of tax equity.
details: The solar project is under construction and is expected to start commercial operation in mid-2025. Natixis CIB served as sole coordinating lead arranger, hedging bank, letter of credit issuer, green loan coordinator and administrative agent for the debt. Tax equity means an investor funds part of the project in exchange for using its tax credits. The project's power is contracted to Occidental and its subsidiary 1PointFive for the STRATOS direct air capture facility in the Permian Basin. The release does not state the project's capacity.
context: The project will supply power to a facility that the parties describe as the world's first large-scale direct air capture plant, which pulls carbon dioxide out of the air. It is the third transaction between Origis and Natixis CIB, following a construction warehouse facility and a development facility upsize in 2023. Origis says the deal fits its aim of offering decarbonization solutions.

sources.title: Origis Energy Closes $415M Funding Package for Texas-sited Swift Air Solar

title: US DOE offers Hydrostor up to US$1.76 billion loan guarantee for Willow Rock storage
summary: The US Department of Energy made a conditional commitment for a loan guarantee of up to US$1.76 billion for Hydrostor's Willow Rock long-duration storage project in California.
details: The US Department of Energy offered Hydrostor a conditional loan guarantee of up to US$1.76 billion (about US$1.5 billion of principal plus US$280 million of capitalised interest) for the 500 MW Willow Rock compressed air storage centre in Rosamond, California.
context: Advanced compressed air storage pumps air into underground caverns and releases it through turbines later; Willow Rock will give over eight hours of supply. A conditional commitment still needs final terms.

sources.title: Hydrostor's Willow Rock Energy Storage Project Gets Green Light For $1.76 Billion Loan Guarantee From U.S. DOE

title: Linea Energy closes debt financing for 109 MWdc Pineview Solar in Georgia

advisors.name: Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP

summary: Linea Energy, a developer backed by EnCap Investments, closed project debt financing in December 2024 for its Pineview Solar project. The 109 MWdc facility is in Wilcox County, Georgia. A lender group led by First Citizens Bank and NORD/LB provided the financing, whose size was not disclosed.
details: Pineview is a utility-scale solar plant rated at 109 MW of direct-current capacity, which is the panel-side rating before conversion to grid power. The package includes a construction-to-term loan, meaning a loan that funds building and then converts into long-term debt once the plant operates. It also includes a tax equity bridge loan, which is short-term debt repaid when tax equity investors (parties that invest in exchange for tax credits) fund their share, plus a letter of credit facility used to guarantee obligations. Winston & Strawn advised the lenders and Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom advised Linea.
context: Linea describes the financing as a key step toward building Pineview and delivering solar power in Georgia. First Citizens said the deal continues an existing relationship with Linea, and NORD/LB said it expects further collaboration as the project moves through construction and operation.

sources.title: Linea Energy Closes Project Debt Financing for Pineview Solar in Georgia

title: Estuary Power closes $340 million financing for Escape solar and storage project in Nevada
summary: Estuary Power closed a $340 million financing package in late December 2024 for its Escape Solar and Storage project in Lincoln County, Nevada. The project combines 185 MW of solar panels with 400 MWh of battery storage.
details: The financing includes a tax equity commitment from Morgan Stanley Renewables, meaning an investor that funds part of the project in exchange for its tax credits. A bridge loan covering that tax equity until it is paid in comes from First Citizens Bank, Nord/LB and National Bank of Canada, and Denham Capital provides a construction loan that converts into long-term debt. Power is sold under long-term contracts to MGM Resorts (115 MW solar plus all 400 MWh of storage), Overton Power District (25 MW), Caesars Entertainment (25 MW) and Wynn Las Vegas (20 MW). Bechtel is building the solar array, Tesla is supplying the batteries and JinkoSolar the modules, with operations expected to start in 2025. Estuary was advised by CRC-IB, Norton Rose Fulbright and Morgan Lewis, Morgan Stanley by Willkie Farr & Gallagher, and the lenders by Mayer Brown.
context: Escape is described as the first utility-scale solar project in Lincoln County, and the company expects it to generate nearly $80 million in local tax revenue over its life. Estuary is a majority woman-owned developer backed by the Ullico Infrastructure Fund, whose investors are mainly union pension funds, and the project is being built with union labor. The deal shows Las Vegas casino operators contracting directly for renewable power.

sources.title: ESTUARY POWER CLOSES FINANCING OF ESCAPE SOLAR AND STORAGE PROJECT

title: LS Power completes purchase of Algonquin's large-scale renewable energy business

buyers.name: Clearlight Energy
buyers.role: new LS Power company holding operating assets and part of pipeline

buyers.name: REV Renewables
buyers.role: LS Power subsidiary acquiring US development projects

target: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. renewable energy business
summary: LS Power has closed its acquisition of the renewable energy business of Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. The business includes 44 operating wind and solar projects with more than 3,000 MW of capacity in the United States and Canada, plus an 8,000 MW development pipeline. No price was disclosed in the release.
details: LS Power created a new company, Clearlight Energy, to run the operating assets and to take on 1,800 MW of the pipeline, covering Canadian projects and those sited alongside existing plants. LS Power subsidiary REV Renewables is taking the remaining 6,200 MW of US development projects, which the company says lifts its pipeline above 21,000 MW. Clearlight is led by Jeff Norman, formerly President of Renewables at Algonquin. The deal closed on January 8, 2025 after regulatory approvals in Canada and the US. Milbank was legal adviser and Scotiabank and BMO Capital Markets were financial advisers to LS Power.
context: LS Power says the deal adds to a fleet of more than 23,000 MW spanning renewables, storage, gas and renewable fuels. The company presents the acquisition as a way to meet rising power demand and to build renewable projects at scale across North America. For Algonquin, the sale marks its exit from large-scale renewable generation.

sources.title: LS Power Completes Acquisition of Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp.'s Large Scale Renewable Energy Business

title: ib vogt agrees to sell 780 MWp Greek solar and battery portfolio to Faria Renewables
summary: ib vogt agreed to sell its Greek portfolio of about 780 MWp of solar and battery projects to Faria Renewables, backed by Omnes Capital and the Faria Group.
details: ib vogt agreed to sell its Greek portfolio of about 780 MWp of solar and battery projects to Faria Renewables, backed by Omnes Capital's Capenergie 5 fund and the Faria Group. It includes a 45 MWp solar farm under construction on three sites in Almyros, financed by a Greek bank.
context: The Almyros plant should be finished in the second half of 2025. ib vogt is refocusing on its core European markets.

sources.title: ib vogt sells Greek renewables portfolio to Faria Renewables

title: NeXtWind buys 12 German wind farms for repowering
summary: NeXtWind acquired 12 wind farms in western, northern and eastern Germany with 140 MW, which it plans to repower to well over 300 MW.
details: NeXtWind bought 12 German wind farms of 140 MW, built in 2007–2011, from Nadara in a share deal. It plans to repower them to well over 300 MW, taking its repowering portfolio to 1,400 MW.
context: Repowering replaces old turbines with fewer, larger modern ones on sites that already have permits and grid connections, often more than doubling output.

sources.title: NeXtWind acquires 12 wind farms in Germany

title: E8 Angels' Decarbon8-US fund channels over $800,000 into three renewable energy startups
target: Atlas Power Technologies, Cecilia and Pecos Wind Power
summary: E8 Angels, a nonprofit cleantech angel investing group based in Seattle, said its Decarbon8-US 2024 program attracted more than $800,000 for three early-stage companies. The recipients are Atlas Power Technologies, Cecilia and Pecos Wind Power.
details: The money came from a mix of philanthropic donations through the Decarbon8-US fund and direct co-investment by E8 member angels, meaning individual investors who back young companies with their own money. The three firms were picked from more than 80 applicants in the US and Canada after review by over 20 E8 members and experts. Their work spans energy storage, community-scale wind turbines, clean hydrogen and carbon nanotubes. Atlas Power Technologies says it will use the funds to commercialize dry electrode technology for supercapacitors and batteries. The fund is administered by the charity Realize Impact and can make both equity and debt investments.
context: The 2024 round focused on renewable energy, inspired by the COP28 goal of tripling renewable capacity by 2030, and E8 describes it as a record year for investment and applications. E8 says it has facilitated over $64 million into more than 160 companies since 2006. The 2025 round will shift its theme to software and AI for climate, with applications opening in May 2025.

sources.title: Decarbon8-US Impact Fund Drives Investment of Over $800,000 into Three Renewable Energy Startups

title: World Bank approves US$3.5 million payment guarantee for Khorezm solar in Uzbekistan
summary: The World Bank approved a US$3.5 million payment guarantee supporting a solar plant in Uzbekistan's Khorezm region, due to be commissioned in November 2025.
details: The World Bank approved a US$3.5 million payment guarantee for a solar plant in Uzbekistan's Khorezm region developed by Voltalia's Sarimay Foreign Enterprise, covering the state grid company NEGU's obligation to buy power under a 25-year PPA. It helped mobilise US$80 million, including over US$54 million from the EBRD.
context: A payment guarantee assures investors they will be paid even if the state buyer is late, lowering risk. The 177-hectare plant should produce over 240 GWh a year from November 2025.

sources.title: World Bank OKs $3.5m financing for Uzbek solar plant

title: ACWA Power and HAU Energy reach financial close on 1.1 GW Suez wind farm
summary: ACWA Power and HAU Energy reached financial close on the 1.1 GW Suez wind farm in Egypt, the largest single-contracted wind farm in the Middle East.
details: ACWA Power and HAU Energy reached financial close on the 1.1 GW Suez wind farm in Egypt with US$703.6 million of senior debt from the EBRD (including a B loan from Standard Chartered and Arab Bank), the AfDB, BII, DEG, the OPEC Fund and APICORP.
context: It is the Middle East's largest single-contracted wind farm, built in two 550 MW phases with 138 turbines of about 8 MW. In a B loan, commercial banks lend alongside a development bank under its umbrella.

sources.title: ACWA Power and HAU Energy achieve financial close for Suez wind farm

title: Star Energy raises stake in Croatian geothermal developer A14 Energy to 71%
summary: Star Energy Group bought a further 20% of A14 Energy from Peninsula International, taking its stake to 71%. A14 holds three geothermal exploration licences in Croatia's Pannonian Basin.
details: Star Energy raised its stake in A14 Energy from 51% to 71% by converting a €529,614 loan to its partner Peninsula International. A14's Croatian subsidiary IGeoPen holds three geothermal exploration licences in the Pannonian Basin.
context: The 17.5 MWe Velika Ciglena geothermal plant shows the basin works. Star plans to farm down part of the licences, selling an interest to a partner who funds development.

sources.title: Star Energy Group acquires further shares in Croatian geothermal development company

title: Qualitas Energy and Northleaf sell 494 MWp Mula solar plant to China Three Gorges Spain
summary: Qualitas Energy and Northleaf Capital Partners sold the 494 MWp Mula solar plant in Murcia, Spain, to China Three Gorges Spain.
details: Qualitas Energy and Northleaf Capital Partners sold 100% of the 494 MWp Mula solar plant in Murcia to China Three Gorges Spain. Mula was refinanced in 2023 and has a 10-year PPA with an investment-grade international energy company.
context: Mula is one of Europe's largest solar plants. China Three Gorges is the world's largest hydropower developer.

sources.title: Qualitas Energy Sells 494 MWp Mula Solar Plant to China Three Gorges Spain

title: Greg Skinner buys 50% of Ethical Power from Hive Energy
summary: Greg Skinner acquired 50% of Ethical Power Group from Hive Energy, with a £15 million working capital loan to support its growth.
details: Greg Skinner, co-founder of Quadrature Capital, completed the purchase of Hive Energy's 50% of Ethical Power Group on 31 December, with a £15 million working capital loan. Founder and CEO Thomas Kneen keeps the other 50%.
context: Ethical Power, founded in Exeter in 2010, is a solar EPC contractor and one of the UK's largest battery installers, with over 300 staff in five countries and more than 30 projects worth over £400 million.

sources.title: Ethical Power Group Secures Major Investment To Drive Renewable Energy Growth

title: Econergy signs €38 million Raiffeisen financing for 92 MW Parau solar
summary: Econergy signed about €38 million of project finance with Raiffeisen Bank International for the 92 MW Parau solar plant in Romania, repaying related-party loans.
details: Econergy signed about €38 million of project financing with Raiffeisen Bank International to repay related-party loans used to buy, develop and build the 92 MW Parau solar plant in Romania, which began operating in 2024. The loan runs up to 10.5 years with a balloon payment and a six-month EURIBOR-linked rate.
context: A balloon payment leaves a large share of the loan to be repaid at maturity. It is Econergy's second RBI financing after the 155 MW Ratesti solar project.

sources.title: Econergy secures second project financing with Raiffeisen Bank for Romanian solar project

title: Aypa Power closes $190 million financing for 200 MW Bypass battery storage project in Texas

buyers.name: SMBC
buyers.role: Coordinating Lead Arranger, Administrative Agent and Green Loan Coordinator

summary: Aypa Power, owned by Blackstone, has closed a $190 million financing package for its Bypass battery storage project in Fort Bend County, Texas. The project has 200 MW of power capacity and 400 MWh of storage. Separately, Morgan Stanley Renewables committed $94 million in tax equity.
details: The battery can deliver its full 200 MW output for about two hours and sits near Houston in the ERCOT grid region. Construction financing totals $159 million, made up of a $68 million construction-to-term loan (a loan that funds building and then converts into a long-term loan) and a $91 million tax equity bridge loan (short-term debt repaid once tax equity investors fund). A further $31 million in letters of credit were issued, $26 million of them for project needs. Morgan Stanley Renewables committed $94 million of tax equity, meaning it invests in exchange for tax credits, through a hybrid partnership flip structure in which the share of returns shifts between partners over time. SMBC and Santander led the lending with Siemens Financial Services as joint lead arranger.
context: Aypa describes Bypass as one of the first fully contracted storage projects in ERCOT, backed by a long-term offtake arrangement, which is unusual in a market where batteries often earn variable merchant revenue. The company says the project will create hundreds of construction jobs and contribute about $20 million in local tax revenue over its life. Aypa reports 30 projects operating or under construction and a pipeline above 22 GW.

sources.title: AYPA POWER SECURES $190 MILLION FINANCING FOR THE BYPASS BATTERY STORAGE PROJECT IN TEXAS

title: Emeren signs 7-year PPA for 15 MWp solar farm in Poland's Silesia region

buyers.name: Polish subsidiary of an unnamed multinational consumer goods company

target: 15 MWp solar farm in southwest Silesia, Poland
summary: Emeren Group has signed a seven-year power purchase agreement to sell output from a 15 MWp solar farm in Poland's southwest Silesia region. The buyer is the Polish arm of an unnamed multinational consumer goods company.
details: A power purchase agreement, or PPA, is a long-term contract to buy electricity at agreed terms. This one runs for seven years and is pay-as-produced, meaning the buyer pays for whatever power the farm actually generates rather than a fixed volume. The plant is expected to produce about 14,958 MWh a year. Construction employed 80 workers and operations are expected to support 10 long-term jobs. Financial terms were not disclosed.
context: Emeren says the project will avoid around 16,150 tonnes of carbon dioxide each year and help diversify Poland's coal-heavy power mix. The company also expects the farm to pay about 90,000 PLN in property taxes and 167,000 PLN in land taxes annually. Emeren presents the contract as evidence that it can secure corporate buyers in key European markets.

sources.title: Emeren Group Signs 7-Year PPA for 15 MWp Solar Farm in Poland

title: UltraTech Cement takes 26% of Clean Max Terra for 55 MW hybrid project
summary: UltraTech Cement agreed to invest ₹45.76 crore for 26% of Clean Max Terra, which is building a 55 MW hybrid renewable project.
details: UltraTech Cement agreed to take 26% of Clean Max Terra and of its special purpose vehicle CleanMax Sapphire for ₹457.6 million, to fund a 55 MW wind-solar hybrid project in Honawad, Vijayapur district, Karnataka, that will supply UltraTech's plants.
context: Captive power rules require the consumer to hold equity in the plant; UltraTech expects to finish the deal within 180 days.

sources.title: UltraTech Cement Invests ₹457.6 Million for 26% Stake in CleanMax's 55 MW Hybrid Renewable Energy Project

title: Nozomi Energy buys 12 operating Japanese solar projects totalling 312 MW
summary: Nozomi Energy, Actis's Japanese platform, acquired 12 operating solar projects totalling 312 MW with a Japanese co-investor.
details: Nozomi Energy, Actis's Japanese renewables platform, bought 12 operating solar projects of 312 MW with a Japanese co-investor. They range from 1 MW to over 60 MW; nine are in Kanto and the rest in Tohoku, Chubu and Kyushu, all built in the past two years.
context: The plants have feed-in tariff contracts to at least 2040. Nozomi's portfolio is now about 750 MW, over 400 MW operating, towards 1.1 GW by 2027.

sources.title: Nozomi Energy Seals Landmark Deal: Acquires 12 Solar Projects With 312MW Capacity

title: Enlight secures US$550 million of debt for Roadrunner solar and storage in Arizona
summary: Enlight's Clēnera secured US$550 million of debt from a four-bank group including BNP Paribas for the Roadrunner solar and storage project near Tucson.
details: Enlight's subsidiary Clenera secured US$550 million of debt from BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole, Natixis and NORD/LB for the Roadrunner (Apache Solar II) project near Tucson, Arizona: 290 MW of solar and 940 MWh of storage on 1,200 acres. At operation it converts into a US$290 million term loan and US$320 million of tax equity funding.
context: It is a mini-perm loan: short maturity with long amortisation, to be refinanced later. A 20-year PPA with AEPCO should bring US$51–54 million of revenue a year; COD is due by late 2025.

sources.title: Enlight Secures $550M Financing for Roadrunner Solar and Storage Project in Arizona

title: ACME Solar secures ₹1,988 crore from PFC for 300 MW solar project
summary: ACME Solar's ACME Renewtech secured a ₹1,988 crore term loan from Power Finance Corporation for a 300 MW solar project.
details: ACME Renewtech, an ACME Solar subsidiary, secured a ₹1,988 crore term loan from Power Finance Corporation for a 300 MW solar-wind hybrid project with solar in Bikaner, Rajasthan, and wind in Bhuj, Gujarat. It has a PPA with NTPC, grid connectivity and all the solar land.
context: ACME also won 300 MW in SECI's ISTS-XVIII tender at ₹3.05/kWh and will use its Acme Sikar project to meet the June 2025 deadline, qualifying for the inter-state transmission charge waiver.

sources.title: ACME Solar Holdings Secures ₹1,988 Crore Financing From PFC And Wins 300 MW SECI ISTS Solar Project With Competitive Tariff Of INR 3.05 per Unit

title: Ørsted sells 50% of three US solar and storage projects to Energy Capital Partners
summary: Ørsted agreed to sell 50% of three US onshore solar and battery projects to Energy Capital Partners.
details: Ørsted agreed to sell 50% of three US projects to Energy Capital Partners for US$572 million: the Mockingbird (468 MW) and Sparta (250 MW) solar farms in Texas and the Eleven Mile Solar Center in Arizona, 300 MW of solar with a 300 MW / 1,200 MWh battery.
context: All three began operating in 2024 with tax equity and PPAs in place. Ørsted keeps 50% and operates them; a farm-down sells part of a project to recycle capital.

sources.title: Ørsted Divests Shares in Three US Solar and Battery Storage Projects to Energy Capital Partners

title: BluPine Energy signs long-term solar PPA with Suprajit Engineering
summary: BluPine Energy signed a long-term solar PPA with automotive cable maker Suprajit Engineering.
details: BluPine Energy signed a long-term PPA with Suprajit Engineering, India's largest automotive cable maker, to supply power from its solar plant in Karnataka.
context: Suprajit is AA-rated, a strong credit that makes the contract easier to finance. The article gives no size or term.

sources.title: BluPine Energy Signs Long-Term Solar Power PPA with Suprajit Engineering

title: EIB and Iberdrola sign €100 million green loan for Sicilian solar plant
summary: The EIB and Iberdrola signed a €100 million green loan, backed by a SACE guarantee, to build a solar plant in Sicily.
details: The EIB and Iberdrola signed a €100 million green loan, 70% covered by SACE's Archimede guarantee, to build a 242.78 MWp solar plant in the provinces of Enna and Catania, Sicily, due to operate in 2025.
context: It is the EIB's first deal with Iberdrola under a SACE guarantee; the state export credit agency's cover lowers the lender's risk. The plant could supply about 154,000 households.

sources.title: EIB and Iberdrola Partner on €100M Green Loan for Sicilian Solar Plant

title: Nordic Solar sells 2.8 MW Montmayon solar park in France
summary: Nordic Solar signed a share purchase agreement to sell the 2.8 MW Montmayon solar plant, its first sale in France.
details: Nordic Solar signed a share purchase agreement to sell Montmayon, a 2.8 MW solar plant in France it had run for eight years, its first sale in France.
context: Nordic Solar is selling smaller assets outside its core markets to reinvest in large solar parks; it was its record year for sales, with three in 2024.

sources.title: Nordic Solar Completes Third Strategic Sale Of 2024 With French Solar Park Divestment

title: Meta signs long-term PPA for Longroad Energy's 300 MWac 1000 Mile solar project in Texas
summary: Longroad Energy has finalized a long-term power purchase agreement with Meta covering the full output of its 1000 Mile solar project in Yoakum County, Texas. The project has a capacity of 300 MWac (400 MWdc).
details: A power purchase agreement, or PPA, is a contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific project over many years. Meta will take all of the power from 1000 Mile, which will feed into the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) grid and support Meta's data center operations. The project is rated at 300 MW in alternating current and 400 MW in direct current, the difference reflecting panel output before conversion for the grid. Commercial operation, meaning the start of regular power delivery, is expected in 2026. The length of the contract and its financial terms were not disclosed.
context: Longroad describes 1000 Mile as its largest solar project so far and its first development in the SPP portion of Texas, after six earlier wind and solar projects in the state. The company says the deal brings its joint work with Meta to more than 1.3 GW of projects. Meta says the power supports its goal of matching its electricity use with clean and renewable energy.

sources.title: Longroad Energy and Meta Sign Long-Term Power Purchase Agreement for 1000 Mile, a 300 MWac (400 MWdc) Solar Project

title: Novo Holdings and European Energy form joint venture to repower 17 German onshore wind parks
target: 17 operational onshore wind parks in Germany slated for repowering
summary: Novo Holdings and European Energy have set up a joint venture to repower 17 operating onshore wind parks in Germany with a current combined capacity of 151.9 MW. The partners expect capacity to more than triple once older turbines are replaced with newer, larger models.
details: The wind parks were built between 2002 and 2008. Repowering means taking down old turbines and installing modern, more efficient ones at the same sites. The partners project that the upgraded parks will produce over 1,100 GWh of electricity each year. Most permits and land rights are reportedly secured, with ready-to-build status expected between 2025 and 2027 and operation between 2027 and 2030. No financial terms, ownership split or advisers were disclosed.
context: The deal extends a partnership that began in 2021, when the two companies and pension fund Sampension started working together on solar and wind land projects in Denmark and Sweden. European Energy says rising electricity demand in Germany makes repowering older wind farms a logical step, and Novo Holdings describes German policy support for onshore wind as part of an attractive investment case.

sources.title: European Energy and Novo Holdings announce joint venture to triple renewable energy capacity of German onshore wind parks

title: HydrogenPro raises NOK 70 million from ANDRITZ and MHI, with further NOK 70 million conditionally agreed from LONGi Hydrogen
summary: Norwegian electrolyser maker HydrogenPro has raised about NOK 70 million by selling new shares to its existing shareholders ANDRITZ and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. It has also agreed a conditional NOK 70 million share investment and a cooperation deal with LONGi Hydrogen, which would bring total gross proceeds to about NOK 140 million.
details: ANDRITZ and MHI each subscribe for 6,350,000 new shares at NOK 5.50 per share, above the prior closing price of NOK 4.50, together equal to about 15.3% of outstanding shares. This private placement, meaning shares sold directly to selected investors rather than offered publicly, is expected to settle in the first half of January 2025. LONGi Hydrogen is to buy 12,703,209 shares at the same price, subject to Chinese outbound investment approval and a shareholder vote, with completion expected in the first half of 2025. All three investors accept a six-month lock-up, a period in which they agree not to sell, and LONGi Hydrogen plans to nominate a board member. The board also proposes a subsequent offering of up to 6,350,000 shares for other shareholders, worth up to about NOK 34.9 million, with Wikborg Rein acting as the company's legal counsel.
context: HydrogenPro makes high-pressure alkaline electrolysers, the machines that split water into hydrogen, and says the money will be used for general corporate purposes and to improve its liquidity. The company presents the deal as a sign of support from its two largest industrial shareholders. The cooperation with LONGi Hydrogen, a unit of solar manufacturer LONGi Green Energy, is intended to let the two firms bid jointly on projects and improve manufacturing in China and Europe.

sources.title: HydrogenPro ASA: Secures NOK 70 million from existing investors and conditionally NOK 70 million from new strategic partner

title: First Solar sells up to $870M in Section 45X manufacturing tax credits to undisclosed buyer via Reunion
target: Section 45X advanced manufacturing production tax credits
summary: First Solar agreed to sell up to $870 million of US advanced manufacturing production tax credits to an unnamed third party in two transactions entered into on December 6, 2024. Tax credit marketplace Reunion arranged and advised on the deals.
details: The credits come from the Section 45X program, a US federal incentive that pays manufacturers for each clean energy component they produce. They relate to First Solar's integrated production of thin film solar panels at some of its factories in Ohio and Alabama during 2024. Under a tax credit transfer, the company that earns a credit can sell it for cash to another taxpayer who uses it to reduce its own tax bill. Reunion found the buyer, led the negotiation of terms and ran the technical and commercial due diligence, meaning the checks that the credits are valid.
context: Reunion describes the deal as one of the largest advanced manufacturing tax credit transfers so far, which it says reflects the growth of US power equipment manufacturing. First Solar runs three factories in Ohio and one in Alabama and expects a fifth in Louisiana in the second half of 2025. Selling the credits turns them into cash that can support the company's domestic manufacturing.

sources.title: Reunion Facilitates Sale of up to $870M in Section 45X Tax Credits by First Solar

title: Altus Power acquires 2.8 MWdc Maine solar project from Emeren
summary: Emeren Group has sold a 2.8 MWdc solar project in Maine to Altus Power. The project is already operating and Altus Power will take over ownership and long-term management. No price was disclosed.
details: The project has a capacity of 2.8 MW measured on the direct current (DC) side of the panels and Emeren brought it to commercial operation, meaning it is already producing and selling power, before the sale. It is the last asset to be sold from Emeren's Maine pipeline. Altus Power links the acquisition to serving community solar subscribers, which are local customers who sign up to receive credits from a shared solar plant rather than installing panels themselves. The release does not name advisers or give financial terms.
context: The sale completes Emeren's exit from its Maine project pipeline, and the company presents it as evidence that it can deliver projects that reach their commercial operation date. Altus Power, which describes itself as the largest commercial-scale provider of clean electric power, says the deal expands its presence in Maine and supports its community solar business.

sources.title: Emeren Group Sells 2.8 MW Maine Solar Project to Altus Power

title: Thrive Renewables buys rights to 57 MW Whitelaw Brae wind farm
summary: Thrive Renewables acquired the rights to build the 57 MW Whitelaw Brae wind farm in the Scottish Borders, its largest project, funded through its Fair Play Clean Energy joint venture with TopCashback.
details: Thrive Renewables bought the rights to build the 57 MW, 14-turbine Whitelaw Brae wind farm in the Scottish Borders from BayWa r.e. after a tender in October 2024. It is funded by Fair Play Clean Energy, Thrive's £80 million joint venture with TopCashback Sustainability.
context: Construction should start in 2025 for commissioning by end-2026, generating up to 149,400 MWh a year. Thrive plans shared ownership through Ripple Energy, letting the public buy into the farm.

sources.title: Thrive Renewables acquires right to Scottish wind farm

title: IFC invests US$20 million in Brazilian solar lender Sol Agora
summary: The IFC invested BRL 115 million (about US$20 million) in Sol Agora, a Brazilian fintech that provides long-term financing for small-scale distributed solar.
details: IFC invested US$20 million (BRL 115 million) in senior quotas of Sol Agora's second receivables fund (FIDC), which has about BRL 900 million in commitments, to finance household and small business solar in Brazil.
context: An FIDC is a Brazilian investment fund that buys loans; senior quotas are repaid first. Sol Agora's first fund raised over BRL 1.4 billion and financed more than 43,000 clients.

sources.title: IFC Invests $20 Million to Support Sol Agora’s Solar Financing in Brazil

title: OPEC Fund approves more than US$130 million for renewables in Egypt, Türkiye and Mauritania
summary: The OPEC Fund approved more than US$130 million of debt for renewable energy projects in Egypt, Türkiye and Mauritania, part of a US$1 billion initiative.
details: The OPEC Fund approved more than US$130 million of debt for renewables in Egypt, Türkiye and Mauritania, including US$40 million for the 1.1 GW Gulf of Suez wind project developed by ACWA Power and partners, US$40 million for solar and a grid link to Mali in Mauritania, and €50 million more.
context: It is part of a US$1 billion OPEC Fund programme for developing countries. The AfDB has also approved up to US$170 million for the Suez wind project, part of Egypt's plan to get over 40% of its power from renewables.

sources.title: OPEC Fund Approves Over USD 130 Million for Renewable Energy Projects in Egypt, Turkey, and Mauritania

title: OX2 buys Bursjöliden wind project in Sweden from RWE
summary: OX2 acquired the Bursjöliden wind project in Örnsköldsvik, northern Sweden, from RWE: 11 planned turbines producing about 200 GWh a year.
details: OX2 bought the Bursjöliden wind project in Örnsköldsvik municipality, northern Sweden, from RWE, to own long-term. It is planned with 11 turbines producing about 200 GWh a year, plus a battery. Environmental and grid permits are in place; construction should start in summer 2025.
context: It sits in Swedish price area SE2. It is one of OX2's first Swedish projects that it will own rather than only manage for investors.

sources.title: OX2 acquires Bursjöliden wind farm

title: Origis Energy closes $533 million financing with MUFG for two US solar and storage projects
target: Optimist Solar + Storage and Wheatland Solar projects
summary: Origis Energy has closed a $533 million financing package with MUFG for two projects in Mississippi and Indiana. The projects total 350 MWac of solar plus 50 MW of battery storage. The parties say their joint US renewable financing now exceeds $1 billion over the past year.
details: The package combines a construction loan, a bridge loan (short-term funding until longer-term money arrives) and a later conversion into a term loan repaid over a set period. Optimist Solar + Storage in Clay County, Mississippi pairs 200 MWac of solar with 50 MW of storage and is expected to be completed in late 2025. Wheatland Solar in Knox County, Indiana adds 150 MWac and is expected online in early 2026. Origis Energy will build, own and operate both projects. Latham & Watkins and local counsel Butler Snow advised Origis, while Milbank and local counsel Baker Donelson advised MUFG.
context: The deal extends an ongoing lending relationship between Origis and MUFG. Origis claims the two projects will supply power equal to the needs of more than 100,000 homes a year and says the Mississippi storage will improve grid resilience. MUFG describes renewable energy as a core long-term focus.

sources.title: Origis Energy and MUFG Bring Renewable Energy Project Financing to Over $1 Billion in Last 12 Months

title: CleanCapital buys 22.7 MW of solar from Kendall Sustainable Infrastructure
summary: CleanCapital acquired 40 distributed solar assets totalling 22.7 MW from Kendall Sustainable Infrastructure.
details: CleanCapital bought 40 community and commercial solar assets of 22.7 MW from Kendall Sustainable Infrastructure, completing KSI's first community solar fund. Manulife Investment Management and co-investors added US$145 million of equity to CleanCapital.
context: CleanCapital now has more than 240 projects and 340 MW operating or under construction, one of the largest US commercial solar portfolios according to Wood Mackenzie.

sources.title: CleanCapital Boosts Solar Portfolio With 23 MW Acquisition From Kendall Sustainable Infrastructure

title: Recurrent Energy reaches financial close on 171 MW Carwarp Energy Park
summary: Recurrent Energy reached financial close on its 171 MW Carwarp Energy Park in Australia, with funding from ANZ and other lenders.
details: Recurrent Energy, a Canadian Solar subsidiary, reached financial close with ANZ, Westpac and Société Générale for the 171 MW Carwarp Energy Park solar farm near Carwarp in north-west Victoria. A 120 MW battery is planned as stage 2.
context: The farm will use 243,000 Canadian Solar modules, produce about 405 GWh a year and sell to a multinational corporate buyer under a long-term PPA from 2026.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Achieves Financial Close for 171 MW Solar Project in Australia

title: Cubico reaches financial close on 506 MW Wambo wind farms with about A$650 million
summary: Cubico reached financial close on Wambo Stage I (252 MW) and Stage II (254 MW) wind farms in Queensland with two five-year financings of about A$650 million.
details: Cubico reached financial close on the 252 MW Wambo Stage I and 254 MW Wambo Stage II wind farms near Jandowae in Queensland's Western Downs with two five-year loans of about A$650 million from ANZ, Crédit Agricole, ING, NAB and Westpac.
context: Wambo is a 50:50 venture with Stanwell, which also buys Cubico's share of output. Stage I is due in 2025 and Stage II in 2026, with 41 turbines that are Australia's tallest onshore.

sources.title: Cubico achieves financial close for Wambo wind project

title: Triton Anchor closes $2.2 million seed round for offshore wind anchoring technology
summary: Massachusetts-based Triton Anchor, which develops anchoring systems for offshore wind, has completed a $2.2 million seed funding round. The round was co-led by MWNW Consulting Group and Triton Early Growth Fund, and included a $1 million cornerstone investment from a Scottish family office. The company also said it was selected for $3.5 million in grant funding and set up a European subsidiary in Scotland.
details: A seed round is an early-stage equity investment in a young company. Besides the co-leads, OS Impact Investment, Katapult Deep Ocean Blue Fund and the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center took part. The separate $3.5 million grant is non-dilutive, meaning it does not give away ownership. The new subsidiary, Triton Anchor Europe, will operate from Aberdeen and Edinburgh and will be led by an offshore wind executive whose appointment is due to be announced in early 2025.
context: The company says it has a $1.5 billion global project pipeline, including planned anchor installations in Scotland, the Netherlands and Portugal. It presents the European base as a way to reach offshore wind developers in that region. The MWNW link may also open collaboration with tidal and river power firm RivTide, according to the release.

sources.title: Triton Anchor Completes Seed Financing, Secures $3.5 Million in New Grant Funding, and Establishes a New European Subsidiary to Accelerate European Expansion and Offshore Wind Innovation

title: SUSI Partners sells 99 MW German wind portfolio to Qualitas Energy
summary: SUSI Partners sold its 99 MW German wind portfolio of seven wind farms to Qualitas Energy.
details: SUSI Partners sold its SREF II fund's 99 MW German wind portfolio of seven farms and 33 turbines, producing about 213 GWh a year, to Qualitas Energy. The largest is the 61 MW, 20-turbine Obernwohlde farm north-east of Hamburg.
context: SUSI bought the farms in 2015–2017; Obernwohlde was Germany's largest onshore wind farm when bought in 2016. The sale follows the exit from Norway's 208 MW Tonstad farm in July 2024.

sources.title: SUSI Partners sells German wind portfolio

title: Aypa Power closes $398 million financing for 250 MW Pediment battery storage project in Arizona

buyers.name: ING Capital LLC
buyers.role: Coordinating Lead Arranger and green loan coordinator

buyers.name: Zions Bancorporation
buyers.role: Joint Lead Arranger and Administrative Agent

summary: Aypa Power, a Blackstone-owned storage developer, has closed a $398 million financing package for its Pediment battery project in Mesa, Arizona. The project has 250 MW of power capacity and 1,000 MWh of storage.
details: The battery system can store about four hours of output at full power and is located in Mesa in Maricopa County. Financing includes a construction-to-back-leverage loan, meaning a construction loan that converts into debt held at the owner level once the plant runs, plus a bridge loan backed by expected sales of tax credits to third parties, and letters of credit. Société Générale, ING Capital and Bank of America led as coordinating lead arrangers, with Zions Bancorporation, Royal Bank of Canada and Desjardins Group as joint lead arrangers. The project has a 20-year tolling agreement with Salt River Project, under which the utility pays for the right to use and dispatch the battery. Operations are expected to begin in 2026.
context: Aypa says the project will support Arizona's growing data center demand and help integrate more renewable power as the state seeks to more than double its capacity by 2035. The company expects the project to deliver over $16 million in direct economic impact, including $14 million in property taxes to Maricopa County over 20 years. Aypa reports 30 projects operating or under construction and a pipeline above 22 GW.

sources.title: AYPA POWER SECURES $398 MILLION FINANCING FOR ENERGY STORAGE PROJECT IN ARIZONA

title: Nofar Energy signs 7-year fixed-price tolling deal for 104.5 MW Stendal battery project in Germany
summary: Israeli power producer Nofar Energy has signed a 7-year fixed-price flexibility purchase agreement for its 104.5 MW / 209 MWh Stendal battery storage project in Germany. The counterparty is an unnamed large energy company with an investment-grade rating, and Nofar estimates the contract will bring in roughly 85 to 95 million euros over its term.
details: The Stendal project is a battery system of 104.5 MW that can store 209 MWh, which means about two hours of output at full power, and it is Nofar's first storage project in Germany. The agreement works as a tolling arrangement, where the buyer pays a fixed fee for the right to use the battery's capacity, so Nofar does not carry the risk of swinging power prices. The fixed-price term runs from 2027 to 2033, and the project may start earlier on a merchant basis, meaning selling into the market at prevailing prices, before January 2027. No lenders or advisers for Stendal are named.
context: Nofar claims this is the first physical fixed-price contract of its kind for a battery project in continental Europe, where such long-term contracts are common for solar and wind but still rare for storage. The company says the steady income should help it raise project debt on better terms and improve returns. It follows Nofar's recent 152 million pound financing for the 300 MW / 624 MWh Cellarhead battery project in the UK, and the company says it plans to pursue similar contracts for other storage projects.

sources.title: Nofar Energy Breaks Ground in Battery Storage: Secures First Long-Term Fixed-Price Flexibility Purchase Agreement for German BESS Project

title: Enfinity Global closes €165 million financing for 147 MW Lazio solar portfolio in Italy
target: Three utility-scale solar plants in Lazio, Italy (147 MW)
summary: Enfinity Global has closed €165 million of financing from ING and Rabobank to build three utility-scale solar plants in Italy's Lazio region. The plants have a combined capacity of 147 MW.
details: The package consists of €114 million of non-recourse senior debt, meaning lenders are repaid from project cash flows rather than from the parent company, plus €51 million to cover VAT (value added tax) payments during construction. It also includes letter of credit facilities, which are bank guarantees, backing the PPAs, the solar module purchases and future decommissioning. The two banks provided the loans together as a club deal and acted as mandated lead arrangers. Power from the plants is sold under long-term power purchase agreements with an international technology company, and the projects are expected to start operating in 2026. Advisers included Albion, Gianni & Origoni, DWF, Astris Finance, Fichtner Italia and Marsh.
context: Enfinity says it has raised €865 million in financing in 2024 for its 4.8 GW Italian pipeline of solar and storage projects, of which 205 MW is operating. Citing an Elemens report, the company claims to be Italy's leading independent power producer by permitted projects and the leader in Italian solar PPAs. ING said the deal supports its goal of tripling renewable financing to €7.5 billion a year by 2025.

sources.title: Enfinity Global closes €165 million financing for 147 MW solar energy projects in Italy

title: Raptor Maps raises $35 million Series C led by Maverix Private Equity
summary: Boston-based solar software company Raptor Maps has closed a $35 million Series C funding round. Toronto firm Maverix Private Equity led the round, with existing backers including Blue Bear Capital, Congruent Ventures and Y Combinator also taking part.
details: A Series C is a later-stage venture round used by companies that already have a product and customers to fund growth. Raptor Maps sells a platform called Raptor Solar that solar plant owners use to track, manage and maintain their sites, plus a newer tool, Raptor Solar Sentry, that coordinates maintenance work by staff and robots. The company says the money will go to product development in automation, work management and machine learning, and to hiring software engineers and data scientists. The release describes the round as oversubscribed, meaning investors wanted to put in more than was on offer.
context: The deal is a corporate investment in a software provider rather than in power-generating assets. Raptor Maps argues that many solar portfolios underperform their expected returns and claims its tools can help owners achieve double-digit gains in financial returns. Maverix says the investment fits its focus on technology-driven growth companies in North America.

sources.title: Raptor Maps Closes $35 Million Series C Financing to Drive Next-Generation Solar Asset Management Solutions

title: Recurrent Energy signs 10-year PPA with US tech company for 300 MWp Tordesillas solar project in Spain
summary: Recurrent Energy, a subsidiary of Canadian Solar, has signed a 10-year power purchase agreement with an unnamed major US technology company. The buyer will take power from the 300 MWp Tordesillas solar project in Valladolid, Castilla y León, Spain.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract in which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific project at set terms. The Tordesillas project has a peak installed capacity of 300 MWp and the company expects it to begin operating in 2026. Recurrent Energy plans to keep owning and operating the plant once it is connected. The company estimates output of about 620 GWh per year. Financial terms were not disclosed.
context: The deal adds to a trend of large technology companies contracting renewable power to meet net zero goals. Recurrent Energy says it has a Spanish pipeline of more than 2 GW of solar and 60 MWh of battery storage, and the company claims the project will support Spain's decarbonization targets.

sources.title: Recurrent Energy Signs 300 MW Power Purchase Agreement with Major U.S. Tech Company in Spain

title: Leyline Renewable Capital raises US$140 million follow-on funding
summary: Leyline Renewable Capital, which lends to renewable developers, raised US$140 million from Keystone National Group and a large public university foundation.
details: Leyline Renewable Capital raised US$140 million from Keystone National Group and a large public university foundation to lend to North American renewable developers for interconnection deposits and equipment down payments.
context: Developers need cash for grid deposits and equipment before projects can get bank loans; Leyline has deployed over US$340 million across more than 15 GW.

sources.title: Leyline Renewable Capital Secures $140 Million in Follow-On Funding from Keystone National Group and Public University Foundation

title: Avantus signs PPA with Arizona Public Service for Kitt Solar
summary: Avantus signed a PPA with Arizona Public Service for its Kitt Solar project.
details: Avantus signed a PPA with Arizona Public Service for the Kitt Solar Project in Pinal County near Eloy, Arizona: 100 MWac / 130 MWdc of solar with 400 MWh of storage. Construction should start in 2025 for operation in 2026.
context: The project could power up to 32,000 homes and create up to 400 construction jobs.

sources.title: Avantus and Arizona Public Service (APS) Seal Deal For Kitt Solar Project With Major Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)

title: Gentari signs 650 MW round-the-clock PPA with AM Green Ammonia
summary: Gentari signed a PPA to supply 650 MW of round-the-clock green power to AM Green Ammonia's planned green ammonia plants in India, backed by about 2,400 MW of new renewables.
details: Gentari signed a PPA with AM Green Ammonia for 650 MW of round-the-clock renewable power for its green ammonia plants. Gentari will build 2,400 MWp of renewables with 350 MW / 2,100 MWh of storage in Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka, solar at one site and wind at several, linked by the ISTS grid.
context: The supply meets the EU's rules for renewable fuels of non-biological origin (RFNBO), so AM Green can sell its ammonia in Europe.

sources.title: Gentari, AM Green Ammonia ink PPA for 650 MW of clean power

title: EDF Renewables and SPIC sign PPAs with SPPC for 1,400 MW of Saudi solar
summary: A consortium led by EDF Renewables Middle East and SPIC HHDC signed a PPA with the Saudi Power Procurement Company for two solar IPPs totalling 1,400 MW.
details: A consortium led by EDF Renewables Middle East and SPIC HHDC signed PPAs with the Saudi Power Procurement Company for two solar IPP projects totalling 1,400 MW, announced at the Saudi Investment Forum.
context: Saudi Arabia tenders large solar plants through SPPC as single buyer. The projects should displace over 2.7 million tonnes of CO2 a year.

sources.title: Saudi Arabia Advances Vision 2030 with 1,400 MW Solar Projects: EDF and SPIC Sign PPA with SPPC

title: Swedfund and IFU partner with Sturdee Energy for Southern African renewables
summary: Swedfund and the Danish fund IFU partnered with Sturdee Energy to expand renewables in Southern Africa, mainly South Africa.
details: Swedfund and Denmark's IFU each committed half of US$44 million of direct equity to Sturdee Energy, a Southern African IPP that runs 31 MW of solar in Namibia and Botswana and is building 20 MW in South Africa.
context: South Africa relies heavily on coal power, and the region has a large power deficit and little risk capital for renewables.

sources.title: Swedfund and IFU invest in renewable energy development in Southern Africa

title: Akuo issues €194 million green bond
summary: Akuo issued a €194 million green bond, its eleventh since 2013 and its largest, to fund its renewable portfolio.
details: Akuo issued a €194 million green bond, its eleventh since 2013 and its largest, to fund its renewable generation and storage projects. The senior unsecured bonds were offered to qualified EU investors and listed on Euronext Access Paris.
context: Green bonds follow ICMA principles that limit the use of proceeds to environmental projects. Senior unsecured means they rank ahead of junior debt but have no specific assets as security.

sources.title: Akuo Secures €194 Million in Green Bond Financing to Accelerate Renewable Energy Projects

title: CVC DIF sells Cerro Grande and Peralta wind farms in Uruguay to Pluspetrol
summary: CVC DIF's infrastructure funds completed the sale of the Cerro Grande and Peralta wind farms in Uruguay, a 169 MW portfolio, to Pluspetrol.
details: CVC DIF's DIF V and DIF VI funds completed the sale of the Cerro Grande (about 52 MW, bought 2019) and Peralta (about 118 MW, bought 2021) wind farms in Uruguay, over 169 MW with 72 Enercon E-92 turbines, to Pluspetrol.
context: It is the second-largest private renewable portfolio in Uruguay and CVC DIF's first exits in Latin America. While owning Peralta it upgraded all 50 towers over 18 months.

sources.title: CVC DIF sells 169 MW wind portfolio

title: EQT agrees to acquire German battery storage developer ju:niz Energy

buyers.name: EQT
buyers.role: acquirer via EQT Transition Infrastructure strategy, using balance sheet capital

summary: EQT has agreed to buy ju:niz Energy, a battery storage developer and operator based in Aschheim, Germany, from its founder Dr. Franz Hauk. The deal is the first investment of EQT's new Transition Infrastructure strategy and is funded from EQT's own balance sheet. No price or capacity figures were disclosed.
details: ju:niz Energy develops, builds and operates utility-scale battery energy storage systems, which are large batteries connected to the grid that store power and release it when needed. EQT says it will help the company grow from a developer into an independent flexibility provider that owns more of its assets, and work through a pipeline of projects at different stages of development. The deal still needs customary conditions and approvals before it can close. EQT was advised by UBS on finance, Gibson Dunn & Crutcher and Norton Rose Fulbright on legal matters and McKinsey on commercial issues.
context: EQT launched the Transition Infrastructure strategy to back scaling businesses in clean energy and the circular economy across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific, alongside its existing infrastructure funds. The firm argues that Germany, as Europe's largest power market with fast-growing renewable output, needs more storage to keep the grid stable as wind and solar supply varies. EQT claims ju:niz Energy has an early-mover advantage in this market.

sources.title: EQT introduces the EQT Transition Infrastructure strategy with the acquisition of energy storage system developer and operator ju:niz Energy

title: TotalEnergies agrees to acquire VSB Group
summary: TotalEnergies agreed to buy all of German renewables developer VSB Group, with a pipeline of more than 18 GW, from Partners Group and the founder.
details: TotalEnergies agreed to buy all of Germany's VSB Group from majority owner Partners Group and VSB's founder. VSB has a pipeline of over 18 GW of wind, solar and battery projects in six European markets and more than 475 MW in operation.
context: Buying a developer gives TotalEnergies a ready pipeline and teams in several European markets at once.

sources.title: TotalEnergies Completes 100% Acquisition Of VSB Group, Expanding Renewable Energy Portfolio

title: Mulilo reaches financial close on 75 MWac Ukuqala solar with Air Products South Africa
summary: Mulilo reached financial close on the 75 MWac Ukuqala solar project near De Aar, Northern Cape, which will supply Air Products South Africa.
details: Mulilo reached financial close on the Ukuqala solar project near De Aar, Northern Cape: 75 MWac (105 MWdc), its sixth close of 2024. It will be the first renewable plant to power Air Products' air separation units across South Africa, with power wheeled to several sites.
context: A high DC/AC ratio means more panels than inverter capacity, so the plant reaches peak output earlier and holds it longer, about 248 GWh a year. It will connect via the Kestrel substation under construction.

sources.title: Mulilo Secures Financial Close For 75MW Solar Plant In Partnership With Air Products South Africa

title: Alternergy secures ₱4 billion BPI loan for Tanay wind project
summary: Alternergy secured a ₱4 billion (about US$68.8 million) loan from the Bank of the Philippine Islands for the Tanay wind project in Rizal, funded from a green bond issued with IFC support.
details: Alternergy secured a ₱4 billion (about US$68.8 million) loan from BPI for the Tanay wind project in Rizal, as an eligible asset under BPI's IFC-supported green bond. It is part of the up to ₱8 billion syndicated loan signed in May 2024, half from BPI.
context: It is Alternergy's first project finance deal with BPI. Tanay should be completed by end-2025, supporting the Philippines' 35% renewables target for 2030.

sources.title: Alternergy bags $68.8 m loan for Tanay wind project

title: Pacolet Milliken acquires 14.95 MW Anderson Wind Farm in New Mexico from Goldman Sachs Asset Management affiliate
summary: Pacolet Milliken, a family-owned investment firm based in South Carolina, has bought full ownership of the Anderson Wind Farm from an affiliate of Goldman Sachs Asset Management. The operating project has 14.95 MW of capacity and is located in Chaves County, New Mexico. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: Anderson consists of eight wind turbines and has been in commercial operation since 2014. It produces more than 50,000 MWh of electricity a year, which the company says is enough for about 5,000 homes. Its output is sold to Western Farmers Electric Cooperative under a long-term power purchase agreement, meaning a contract in which the buyer agrees to purchase the electricity at set terms for many years. Vinson & Elkins acted as legal adviser to Pacolet.
context: According to Pacolet, the purchase is its first investment in wind power and expands its presence in the US Southwest, adding to an existing portfolio that includes solar, landfill gas and regulated electric assets. The company said it hopes to make further wind investments in the region.

sources.title: Pacolet Milliken Acquires Anderson Wind Farm to Grow its Sustainable Power and Infrastructure Portfolio

title: Longroad Energy closes financing for Sun Pond solar-plus-storage project in Arizona

buyers.name: U.S. Bancorp Impact Finance
buyers.role: Coordinating lead arranger and tax equity investor

buyers.name: CIBC
buyers.role: Joint lead arranger and green loan coordinator

summary: Longroad Energy has reached financial close on Sun Pond, a 111 MWdc solar and 85 MWac / 340 MWh battery project in Maricopa County, Arizona. Debt was led by U.S. Bancorp Impact Finance with Commerzbank and CIBC, and U.S. Bancorp is also the tax equity investor.
details: Financial close means the funding agreements are signed and money is available, and construction has now started with commercial operation expected by mid-2026. The battery holds four hours of energy at full power. U.S. Bancorp Impact Finance served as coordinating lead arranger and agent, CIBC as joint lead arranger and green loan coordinator, and Commerzbank as a lender. U.S. Bancorp also provides tax equity, an investment that pays in exchange for using the project's federal tax credits. Power is sold under long-term power purchase agreements with the City of San Jose and Ava Community Energy, with McCarthy as construction contractor, First Solar modules and a Fluence battery system.
context: Sun Pond is the fourth project in Longroad's Sun Streams Complex, which the company says will reach 973 MWdc of solar and 600 MWac / 2,400 MWh of storage. Longroad says its financed and under-construction solar in the county now exceeds 970 MWdc and represents about $2 billion of investment. The company also expects the project to deliver more than $30 million to local schools and jurisdictions through lease and tax payments.

sources.title: Longroad Energy Achieves Financial Close of Sun Pond, a 111 MWdc Solar and 85 MWac / 340 MWh Storage Project

title: Sembcorp signs second 15-year renewable PPA with Equinix
summary: Sembcorp Power signed a 15-year renewable PPA with Equinix, its second with the data centre company.
details: Sembcorp Power signed a second 15-year PPA with Equinix to supply up to 58.5 MWp from its Singapore renewable portfolio from 2029, taking total capacity contracted with Equinix to 133.5 MWp after a 75 MWp deal in April 2024.
context: Sembcorp is Singapore's largest solar provider with 771 MWp, more than half the country's 2025 solar target, and a leading supplier to data centres.

sources.title: Sembcorp Strengthens Partnership with Equinix through Second Renewable Energy PPA

title: TotalEnergies and Aljomaih sign 25-year PPA for 300 MW Rabigh 2 solar
summary: TotalEnergies and Aljomaih Energy and Water signed a 25-year PPA for the 300 MW Rabigh 2 solar project in Saudi Arabia.
details: TotalEnergies and Aljomaih Energy and Water signed a 25-year PPA with the Saudi Power Procurement Company for the 300 MW Rabigh 2 solar project, in Round 5 of the National Renewable Energy Program. They will build, own and operate it, with grid connection due by 2026.
context: Saudi Arabia aims for roughly half gas and half renewables in power by 2030, replacing liquid fuels. It was signed during President Macron's visit.

sources.title: TotalEnergies and AEW Sign 25-Year PPA for 300 MW Rabigh 2 Solar Project Under Saudi Vision 2030

title: SolAmerica secures US$129 million for 18 MW Illinois solar portfolio
summary: SolAmerica Energy secured US$129 million for seven Illinois solar projects totalling 18 MW: a US$50 million KeyBank construction loan and a US$79 million sale-leaseback tax equity.
details: SolAmerica Energy, owned by AB CarVal funds, raised US$129 million for seven community solar projects of 18 MW in Illinois: a US$50 million construction loan from KeyBank and a US$79 million sale-leaseback tax equity investment from Key Equipment Finance.
context: In a sale-leaseback the investor buys the plant, takes the tax credits and leases it back to the developer. The projects should operate in 2025.

sources.title: SolAmerica Energy Secures $129 Million Financing for 18 MW Illinois Solar Portfolio

title: EBRD adds €36 million to its investment in Sunly
summary: The EBRD increased its investment in Estonian renewable developer Sunly by €36 million.
details: The EBRD added €36 million to its stake in Sunly, taking its total investment to €66 million after a €30 million minority investment in 2023 alongside Mirova. The money supports Sunly's aim of 1 GW of renewables in the Baltic states and Poland by end-2026.
context: Sunly's pipeline includes solar, wind and hybrid projects. Development bank equity often helps a company attract further private investors.

sources.title: EBRD Expands Investment In Sunly To Boost Estonian Renewable Energy

title: Green & Clean Power raises about $300 million for 105 MW solar and 160 MWh storage project in Arkansas
target: Osceola solar and battery storage facility
summary: Green & Clean Power, a newly formed company, raised roughly $300 million in debt and equity to build a 105 MW solar plant with a 160 MWh battery in Osceola, Arkansas. KfW IPEX-Bank lent about $165 million for construction and the Arkansas Teacher Retirement System committed $100 million in takeout financing.
details: The facility sits on nearly 500 acres and is already under construction, with completion expected by fall 2025. It will supply power behind the meter, meaning directly to an adjacent user without passing through the public grid, to sister company Hybar, a scrap-recycling steel rebar mill. Takeout financing is longer-term money that replaces the construction loan once the project is built. DEPCOM Power is building the project under a fixed-price engineering, procurement and construction contract, and Aurora Energy Research acted as market adviser to KfW IPEX-Bank. Equity investors include TPG Rise Climate, Quanta Services and Global Principal Partners.
context: The company expects the plant to cover about 40% of Hybar's annual power use, supplementing grid power from Entergy Arkansas, and claims it will be the first behind-the-meter solar supply to a steel mill. GCP also plans to seek a connection to the MISO grid, which it expects to take about three years, so it can sell power to third parties. KfW IPEX-Bank previously financed the Hybar mill in 2023.

sources.title: GREEN & CLEAN POWER SECURES FINANCING FOR SOLAR AND ENERGY STORAGE PROJECT IN ARKANSAS

title: Matrix Renewables secures US$376 million debt and preferred equity for 210 MWac Stillhouse Solar in Texas

buyers.name: Acadia Infrastructure
buyers.role: preferred equity sourcing and EAC facilitator

summary: Matrix Renewables, backed by TPG Rise, has secured financing for its 210 MWac Stillhouse Solar project in Bell County, Texas. A lender group led by MUFG with HSBC, ING and BBVA provided US$376 million of debt, and Acadia Infrastructure sourced preferred equity.
details: Stillhouse is a solar photovoltaic plant under construction since Q2 2024, with commercial operation scheduled for Q3 2025. Its power is sold to Hyundai affiliates under a 15-year power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy the electricity. Acadia Infrastructure sourced preferred equity, a form of investment that is paid before ordinary shareholders, and separately arranged for Microsoft to buy the project's environmental attribute certificates, which are credits proving the power came from a renewable source. The project also committed nearly US$3 million to community benefits through the Sustain Our Future Foundation.
context: The company says the plant will supply power equivalent to about 48,862 homes and avoid around 185,598 tonnes of CO2 equivalent per year. The deal splits the electricity and its green attributes between two different buyers, Hyundai and Microsoft. Matrix says it owns over 8.7 GW of US projects in operation and development and more than 15.6 GW globally.

sources.title: MATRIX RENEWABLES SECURES COMMITMENTS FROM MICROSOFT AND MUFG-LED LENDER CONSORTIUM FOR 210MWAC SOLAR PROJECT IN BELL COUNTY, TEXAS

title: ADB signs US$24.3 million for grid-connected solar plant in Mymensingh, Bangladesh
summary: The Asian Development Bank signed a US$24.3 million package with Muktagacha Solartech Energy for a grid-connected solar plant in Mymensingh, Bangladesh, producing nearly 40 GWh a year.
details: ADB signed a US$24.3 million package, a US$15.5 million ADB loan and US$8.8 million from the Leading Asia's Private Infrastructure Fund 2, for Muktagacha Solartech Energy, a Joules Power subsidiary, to build a 20 MW grid-connected solar plant in Mymensingh, Bangladesh.
context: It is one of Bangladesh's first private utility-scale solar plants with international lenders; renewables are only 4.5% of the country's capacity. It should produce 37.9 GWh a year.

sources.title: ADB inks $24.3m financing package for grid-connected solar plant in Bangladesh

title: Standard Bank commits US$140 million senior debt to CrossBoundary Energy
summary: Standard Bank committed US$140 million of fully underwritten senior debt to CrossBoundary Energy, the first tranche of a broader mandate to fund renewables for African businesses.
details: CrossBoundary Energy secured a fully underwritten US$140 million senior debt commitment from Standard Bank of South Africa, the first tranche of up to US$300 million to grow its renewable portfolio serving commercial and industrial clients across Africa. Cygnum Capital advised.
context: Fully underwritten means the bank commits the whole amount itself before seeking other lenders. Unreliable power is a major barrier to business growth in Africa.

sources.title: CrossBoundary Energy secures financing to scale African renewable energy

title: ACEN to buy 49% of Vietnam's BIM Energy Holding for US$70.5 million
summary: ACEN signed a share purchase agreement to buy 49% of BIM Energy Holding in Vietnam from Huntington Renewable Investments for US$70.5 million.
details: ACEN, through ACEN Vietnam Investments, signed an agreement with Huntington Renewable Investments to buy 49% of BIM Energy Holding for US$70.5 million. BIMEH, BIM Group's renewables arm, has interests in the 405 MW Ninh Thuan Solar and 88 MW Ninh Thuan Wind projects.
context: The deal expands ACEN's presence in Vietnam, where it already works with BIM Group.

sources.title: ACEN acquires stake in Vietnamese renewables firm for $70.5m

title: O2 Power signs 100 MW PPA with East Central Railways
summary: O2 Power signed a 100 MW PPA with East Central Railways, supplied from its 360 MW of capacity in Rajasthan, Gujarat and other states.
details: O2 Power signed a 100 MW PPA with East Central Railways, supplied from 360 MW of O2 Power's solar and wind capacity in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Karnataka, with round-the-clock supply.
context: Combining solar and wind from several states smooths output across day and night. O2 Power has over 6 GW of projects; Indian Railways aims to cut its emissions.

sources.title: O2 Power Partners With East Central Railways For 100 MW Green Energy PPA

title: CIP signs corporate PPA for Fengmiao I offshore wind with Sino American Silicon
summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners signed a corporate PPA for its 500 MW Fengmiao I offshore wind farm with Sino American Silicon Products and its renewable energy unit.
details: CIP, through its Copenhagen Infrastructure V fund, signed a corporate PPA for the Fengmiao I offshore wind farm with Sino American Silicon Products and its renewable energy unit Sustainable Energy Solution.
context: Fengmiao I lies 35 km off Taichung City and will have 33 turbines totalling about 500 MW, due for completion by late 2027 to supply Taiwanese companies.

sources.title: CIP inks PPA for 500 MW offshore wind project in Taiwan

title: First Gen's hydro unit signs ₱7 billion of loans with three banks
summary: First Gen's hydropower unit signed ₱7 billion (about US$119 million) of loans with BDO Unibank, BPI and RCBC.
details: First Gen signed ₱7 billion (about US$119.13 million) of loans with BDO Unibank, BPI and RCBC for the general corporate needs of its subsidiary FG Hydro, which owns and runs the 132 MW Pantabangan-Masiway hydro plant in Nueva Ecija.
context: First Gen says hydro plants support the Philippines' energy security and decarbonisation goals.

sources.title: First Gen's hydro unit bags $119.13m loan

title: Econergy signs €28 million financing for 58 MW Iancu Jianu solar in Romania
summary: Econergy signed €28 million of project funding for the roughly 58 MW Iancu Jianu solar project under construction in Romania.
details: Econergy UK signed a €28 million loan from Kommunalkredit Austria for the roughly 58 MW Iancu Jianu solar project in Romania, under construction and due to connect in 2025: about €26 million for construction and repaying owner loans, and €2 million for VAT.
context: It is a short-term loan at six-month EURIBOR plus 4–5%, covering construction and early operation; Econergy plans to refinance it with long-term debt later.

sources.title: Econergy secures €28 million financing for Romanian solar project

title: Eiffel provides €65 million bond financing to TSE for agrivoltaic projects
summary: Eiffel Investment Group put in place €65 million of bond financing to fund construction of solar assets for TSE, a French agrivoltaics pioneer.
details: Eiffel Investment Group provided €65 million of bond financing, through Eiffel Energy Transition III and three partner funds, to build solar projects for TSE, a French agrivoltaics specialist founded in 2016.
context: TSE aims for about 800 MW of capacity. Agrivoltaics mounts panels above crops or grazing so the land stays in farming use.

sources.title: Eiffel Investment Group supports TSE with funding for solar projects

title: Renewable Power Capital refinances 146 MW Klevberget wind farm with €115 million
summary: Renewable Power Capital closed more than €115 million of long-term debt for the 146 MW Klevberget wind farm in Sweden, replacing a short-term construction bridge loan.
details: Renewable Power Capital closed a long-term refinancing of more than €115 million from the Nordic Investment Bank and Danske Bank for the 146 MW Klevberget onshore wind farm in Sweden, replacing a short-term construction bridge loan. Danske and Nomura are hedging banks.
context: Klevberget has run since December 2023 and sells almost all its output to Faurecia (FORVIA) under a 10-year PPA. It is RPC's second long-term Swedish financing of 2024.

sources.title: RPC future-proofs 146 MW Swedish wind farm with €115m refinancing

title: ADB signs US$820 million loan with Gulf for 12 Thai solar and battery projects
summary: The Asian Development Bank signed an US$820 million loan with Gulf Renewable Energy, a Gulf Energy Development subsidiary, to build 12 solar and battery projects in Thailand.
details: ADB signed an US$820 million loan package with Gulf Renewable Energy for 12 Thai projects: eight solar plants of 393 MW and four solar-plus-battery plants of 256 MW and 396 MWh. It combines US$260 million from ADB, US$529 million of parallel loans from AIIB, DEG, China Exim and KEXIM and others, and US$31.35 million of Clean Technology Fund concessional finance.
context: The projects are under Thailand's 5 GW renewable feed-in tariff programme; Thailand targets 50% renewable generation by 2037.

sources.title: ADB inks $820m loan for 12 renewable energy projects in Thailand

title: Jinko Power reaches financial close on 400 MW Tabarjal solar in Saudi Arabia
summary: Jinko Power reached financial close on the 400 MW Tabarjal solar project in Saudi Arabia with long-term non-recourse loans from Riyad Bank and APICORP.
details: Jinko Power reached financial close on the 400 MW Tabarjal solar project about 17 km north-east of Tabarjal in Al Jouf province, Saudi Arabia, with long-term non-recourse financing from Riyad Bank and APICORP. Construction can now start for commissioning in 2025.
context: It was tendered in SPPC's fourth round and has a 25-year PPA signed in November 2023. Jinko Power's Saudi portfolio is now 700 MW net with the 300 MW SAAD project.

sources.title: Jinko Power reaches financial close for 400 MW solar project in Saudi Arabia

title: Axium to buy 49% of Capital Power's 246 MW Canadian wind portfolio
summary: Axium Infrastructure agreed to buy 49% of two operating Canadian wind farms from Capital Power: Quality Wind in British Columbia and Port Dover and Nanticoke in Ontario.
details: Axium Infrastructure agreed to buy 49% of two operating Canadian wind farms from Capital Power, 246 MW in total: Quality Wind in British Columbia and Port Dover and Nanticoke Wind in Ontario, for pre-tax proceeds of about US$340 million.
context: Both are fully contracted with investment-grade buyers for about 11 more years on average. Capital Power keeps 51% and will operate them under a long-term agreement.

sources.title: Capital Power announces sale of Canadian wind facilities

title: RE Royalties lends $3 million to SolarBank subsidiary for three Ontario battery storage projects
target: Three 4.99 MW battery energy storage projects in Ontario
summary: A subsidiary of SolarBank Corporation has obtained a $3 million loan from RE Royalties Ltd. The money supports three 4.99 MW battery energy storage projects that SolarBank is developing in Ontario, Canada.
details: The borrower, Solar High Yield Projects #1 Ltd., is wholly owned by SolarBank and holds an indirect 50% interest in the two project companies, with the other half held by a partnership of First Nations communities in Ontario. The loan is paid out in one installment, carries 11% annual interest and matures on November 26, 2025. As a condition, the lender receives a royalty, meaning a small share of the projects' gross revenues, set at 0.40% and cut to 0.25% if the loan is repaid within six months. The loan is secured by a first-ranking claim on the borrower's assets, excluding its shares in the project companies, and covers development and construction costs already incurred.
context: The release describes the projects as SolarBank's first move into battery storage, adding to its mainly solar portfolio. SolarBank gained its interest in the project companies through its acquisition of Solar Flow-Through Funds Ltd., valued at $45 million and closed in July 2024. The company says it is still working on a larger financing package to cover the full construction cost of the projects.

sources.title: SolarBank BESS Subsidiary Secures Project Financing

title: Iberdrola signs 10-year solar PPA with Gres Panaria Portugal
summary: Iberdrola signed a 10-year PPA with ceramics maker Gres Panaria Portugal to supply 92 GWh of solar power from 2025.
details: Iberdrola signed a 10-year PPA with ceramics maker Gres Panaria Portugal, owner of the Margres, Love Tiles and Gresart brands, to supply 92 GWh of solar power from 2025.
context: A fixed-price PPA shields energy-intensive manufacturers like ceramics makers from swings in power prices.

sources.title: Iberdrola and Gres Panaria Portugal Partner on 10-Year Solar Energy PPA to Drive Sustainability

title: ADB approves US$200 million loan for Sri Lanka's grid and renewables
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a US$200 million loan to modernise Sri Lanka's power grid and integrate more renewable energy.
details: ADB approved a US$200 million loan to modernise Sri Lanka's transmission and distribution networks and help integrate more renewable energy into the grid.
context: Sri Lanka reached full household electrification in 2016, and peak demand was about 2,800 MW in 2023, partly met by distributed renewables. Better grids cut power cuts and losses.

sources.title: ADB Approves $200 Million Loan To Boost Sri Lanka's Power Grid And Renewable Energy Projects

title: EBRD lends up to €50 million to Tenevo Solar for Bulgarian plant
