summary: The EBRD is providing up to €50 million to Tenevo Solar Technologies to build and run a solar plant in south-eastern Bulgaria.
details: The EBRD is lending up to €50 million and Raiffeisen Bank International €53 million, €103 million in total, to Tenevo Solar Technologies for a 238 MW solar plant in south-eastern Bulgaria, with up to 250 MW of storage planned. It is the EBRD's first use of the InvestEU guarantee in Bulgaria.
context: It will be Bulgaria's first renewable plant over 100 MW to sell all its power on the market without subsidy or a corporate PPA. It should produce over 300 GWh a year.

sources.title: EBRD Grants €50M Loan To Tenevo Solar For Bulgaria's New Solar Plant

title: JERA sells 49% of Thai solar project to Gunkul
summary: JERA sold its entire 49% stake in a solar VSPP project in Thailand to Gunkul Engineering.
details: JERA sold its entire 49% stake in a Thai small power producer solar project to Gunkul Engineering. It comprises six plants: Bangkluai1 (3 MW), Bangkluai2 (4.4 MW), Wichienburi (8 MW), Srichula (8 MW), Noenpor (4.5 MW) and Buengsamphan (3 MW).
context: Some plants have run since 2011 and others since 2013. JERA is selling assets and reinvesting the proceeds as it reshapes its portfolio.

sources.title: JERA sells stake in Thai solar project

title: J&V Energy buys 180 MW solar project in General Santos, Philippines
summary: Taiwan's J&V Energy, through JNV Philippines Renewable, acquired the entire equity of a 180 MW solar project in General Santos, its first utility-scale project in the Philippines.
details: Operation is expected in 2027.

sources.title: J&V Energy acquires stake in 180-MW solar project in PH

title: IMEA signs power purchase agreement for National Grid Renewables' 150 MW Bee Hollow Solar in Illinois
summary: National Grid Renewables has signed a power purchase agreement with the Illinois Municipal Electric Agency (IMEA) for its Bee Hollow Solar Project. The 150 MW project is in St. Clair County, Illinois, within the MISO power market.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract under which a buyer agrees to purchase the electricity a project produces. Bee Hollow is a 150 MW solar project still in development, and construction is expected to start in 2025. The project sits in the MISO market, the grid operator covering much of the US Midwest. The contract length and price were not disclosed.
context: Together with the previously announced Prairie Wolf Solar in Coles County, the project would bring National Grid Renewables' operating solar portfolio in Illinois to 350 MW. IMEA says the purchase supports its sustainability plan to reach net-zero carbon emissions in the power supplied to its member municipalities by 2050. The developer estimates the project's direct economic impact at about $34 million over its first 20 years of operation.

sources.title: National Grid Renewables Signs Power Purchase Agreement with IMEA

title: BayWa r.e. sells 517 MWdc US solar portfolio to unnamed private IPP

buyers.name: Unnamed privately held renewable independent power producer

target: Three solar projects in the PJM and MISO regions totaling 517 MWdc
summary: BayWa r.e. has completed the sale of three US solar projects totaling 517 MWdc to a privately held independent power producer whose name was not disclosed. The projects sit in the PJM and MISO grid regions. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio consists of three solar projects with combined capacity of 517 MW measured on the direct current side, meaning the panel rating before conversion to grid power. The projects are located in areas served by PJM Interconnection and the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, two large US grid operators covering parts of the East and Midwest. They are under construction and expected to begin commercial operation, meaning start selling power, by the end of 2025. The deal closed in October 2024. Stoel Rives acted as BayWa r.e.'s legal counsel and Marathon Capital acted as its sell-side financial adviser.
context: BayWa r.e. describes this as the largest portfolio sale in the history of its group. The company says the sale supports its strategy of developing projects in key markets and selling them on, and it plans to grow its US pipeline, which it puts at over 11.6 GW, to meet rising power demand.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. Completes Sale of Largest Solar Portfolio

title: Scatec completes sale of South African solar stakes to STANLIB's Greenstreet 1
summary: Scatec completed the second and final phase of selling its stakes in the Kalkbult, Linde and Dreunberg solar plants to STANLIB's Greenstreet 1.
details: Scatec completed the second and final phase of selling stakes in the Kalkbult, Linde and Dreunberg solar plants in South Africa to Greenstreet 1, part of STANLIB Infrastructure Fund II, receiving ZAR 433 million in this phase and ZAR 921 million (about US$51 million) in total. The deal values the plants at about ZAR 1.86 billion, about US$1.6 million per MW.
context: Scatec keeps about 13% of Kalkbult and 12% of Linde and Dreunberg, and books a total consolidated gain of about ZAR 2.4 billion. Enterprise value includes the plants' debt as well as equity.

sources.title: Scatec Completes Sale of Ownership Stakes in South African Solar Plants to STANLIB

title: Aneo buys Kokkoneva wind farm, its first in Finland
summary: Aneo acquired the Kokkoneva wind farm from Greencoat Renewables, its first in Finland.
details: Aneo, set up in 2022 by TrønderEnergi and HitecVision, bought the 43.2 MW Kokkoneva wind farm in Finland from Greencoat Renewables, its first Finnish wind farm. Its nine turbines have run since 2022 and produce about 129 GWh a year.
context: Aneo is Norway's second-largest wind operator and already provides energy optimisation services in Sweden and Finland, so the farm gives it an integrated business there.

sources.title: Aneo acquires its first wind farm in Finland

title: National Renewable Solutions closes $145 million financing for Shallow Basket solar-plus-storage project in New Mexico
summary: National Renewable Solutions (NRS) has closed $145 million in project financing for its Shallow Basket solar and storage project in Rio Arriba County, New Mexico. Deutsche Bank provided the construction financing for the 140 MWac solar and 50 MW storage facility.
details: The project sits on land leased from the Jicarilla Apache Nation, about 30 miles west of Cuba, New Mexico, and is under construction with operation expected in 2025. Deutsche Bank supplied the construction loan, which is short-term debt used to pay for building the plant. Guzman Energy will buy all of the electricity and the associated renewable attributes, meaning the certificates that prove the power is green, but the contract length is not stated. Albuquerque-based Gridworks is the engineering, procurement and construction contractor, and the build is expected to create 250 jobs over 12 months. The storage energy capacity in MWh was not disclosed.
context: NRS says this is the first project it will both finance and operate itself, in line with its strategy of keeping projects through operation rather than selling them. The Jicarilla Apache Nation earns lease income and will receive power from the project through its wholesale supply agreement with Guzman Energy. NRS is owned by an investment fund managed by a BlackRock subsidiary and says it has commercialized more than 1.2 GW of projects.

sources.title: National Renewable Solutions Secures $145 Million in Project Financing for New Mexico Shallow Basket Project

title: Westbridge sells 75% stake in 332 MWp Alberta solar project to METLEN subsidiary, repays Leyline loans
target: Sunnynook Solar Energy Inc. (Special Area 2, Alberta solar project)
summary: Westbridge Renewable Energy completed the sale of its 75 percent interest in a solar project of up to 332 MWp in Special Area 2, Alberta, to a subsidiary of METLEN Energy & Metals. From the sale proceeds, Westbridge repaid C$18,405,650 in loans provided by lending entities set up by Leyline Renewable Capital, which says it has now exited its investment.
details: The project is a large solar power plant in Special Area 2, Alberta, held through the company Sunnynook Solar Energy Inc., with capacity of up to 332 MWp (megawatts peak, the panels' maximum output under ideal conditions). Leyline's loan facilities were secured by the project and by the shares of Sunnynook. According to Leyline, its funding was used to pay interconnection deposits, which are payments developers make to reserve a connection to the power grid. The loans were repaid in full when the sale closed. The sale price was not disclosed.
context: Leyline lends to developers in the early, pre-construction stage of projects, and this repayment marks the return of its capital after a partnership with Westbridge that Leyline says spans three years. The deal shows how early-stage debt can be paid back when a developer sells a project to a larger owner. Leyline says it expects the plant to start supplying power to the region soon.

sources.title: Leyline Renewable Capital Realizes Investment in Westbridge Renewable Energy Solar Project

title: AMPIN Energy Transition and CIP announce US$300 million Indian renewables partnership
summary: AMPIN Energy Transition and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners announced a second partnership, a US$300 million investment in Indian renewable projects.
details: AMPIN Energy Transition and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners formed a second partnership with more than US$300 million of investment to develop about 2 GWp of solar, wind, hybrid and storage projects connected to India's central grid, an asset base of about US$1.5 billion.
context: Their first partnership, from 2021, grew from US$200 million to US$300 million and from 1.7 GWp to about 2.4 GWp.

sources.title: AMPIN Energy Transition and CIP Announce $300 Million Investment in Indian Renewable Energy

title: Masdar signs PPA for 1 GW wind farm in Kazakhstan

buyers.name: Financial Settlement Centre for Renewable Energy Sources Support

summary: Masdar signed a PPA with Kazakhstan's Financial Settlement Centre for Renewable Energy Sources for its 1 GW wind farm in the Jambyl region.
details: Masdar signed a PPA with Kazakhstan's Financial Settlement Centre for Renewable Energy Sources Support for a 1 GW wind farm with a 600 MWh battery in the Jambyl region, after an investment agreement with the Energy Ministry. Partners are W Solar, Qazaq Green Power and the Kazakhstan Investment Development Fund.
context: It will be Masdar's first project in Kazakhstan and one of the largest wind farms in the CIS region. Construction is due to start by Q1 2026; it could power about 300,000 homes in southern Kazakhstan.

sources.title: Masdar enters PPA for 1 GW wind farm in Kazakhstan

title: Atlantic Green closes £152 million for 624 MWh Cellarhead battery
summary: Atlantic Green closed £152 million of financing for the 624 MWh Cellarhead battery near Stoke-on-Trent, one of the UK's largest.
details: Atlantic Green closed £152 million of financing from Goldman Sachs (sole structuring bank and lead arranger), Santander, Bank Hapoalim and Bank Leumi for the 624 MWh Cellarhead battery, about five miles north-east of Stoke-on-Trent, connecting to National Grid's 400 kV Cellarhead substation. Burges Salmon advised.
context: It is one of the largest UK batteries in development. Atlantic Green plans about 2 GW of UK battery storage.

sources.title: Burges Salmon advises on financing for Atlantic Green’s BESS

title: Masdar and SOCAR Green reach financial close on Bilasuvar and Neftchala solar in Azerbaijan
summary: Masdar and SOCAR Green reached financial close on the 445 MW Bilasuvar and 315 MW Neftchala solar projects in Azerbaijan, with the EBRD, ADB and AIIB among the lenders.
details: Masdar and SOCAR Green reached financial close on the 445 MW Bilasuvar and 315 MW Neftchala solar projects in Azerbaijan, costing more than US$600 million, financed by the EBRD, ADB and AIIB. The agreements were signed at COP29 in Baku.
context: Together the plants add 760 MW of solar in Azerbaijan; the EBRD, ADB and AIIB lend side by side as development banks.

sources.title: Masdar and SOCAR Green achieve financial close for solar projects in Azerbaijan

title: Field buys 200 MW / 800 MWh Hartmoor battery project from Clearstone
summary: Field acquired the 200 MW / 800 MWh Hartmoor battery project near Hartlepool from Clearstone Energy.
details: Field bought the 200 MW / 800 MWh Hartmoor battery on the outskirts of Hartlepool, North East England, from developer Clearstone Energy. Clearstone won planning consent in 2023 and worked with NESO to bring the grid connection forward from 2033 to 2026.
context: Grid reforms let ready projects jump the connection queue. The four-hour battery will balance supply and demand and provide frequency, inertia and stability services; Field has 11 GW in development across Europe.

sources.title: Field acquires battery storage project from Clearstone Energy

title: Standard Solar buys 25 MWdc Windhub Solar B from Balanced Rock Power
summary: Standard Solar acquired the 25 MWdc Windhub Solar B project in California from Balanced Rock Power.
details: Standard Solar bought the 25 MWdc Windhub Solar B project in the Mojave area of Kern County, California, from Balanced Rock Power. It will connect to the Windhub substation, cover 160 acres and supply Southern California Edison.
context: Standard Solar targets projects of 20–75 MW from utility-scale developers. Part of the land will be preserved for local habitat.

sources.title: Standard Solar Boosts California’s Clean Energy With 25 MW Solar Project Acquisition

title: Ecolectro closes $10.5 million Series A led by Toyota Ventures for AEM electrolyzers
summary: Ithaca, New York based Ecolectro, which makes anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolyzers for green hydrogen, closed a $10.5 million Series A round. Toyota Ventures led the round with several venture and impact investors participating. The company says its total capital raised, including government grants, now stands at $27.7 million.
details: A Series A is a company's first major round of venture funding after early seed money. Ecolectro plans to use the money to develop commercial electrolyzers in the 250-500 kW and 1-5 MW size ranges, with prototype testing with industry partners planned for early 2025 and commercial availability expected by late 2025. Electrolyzers split water into hydrogen and oxygen using electricity. Its first commercial deployment was a 10 kW pilot with Liberty New York Gas in Massena, New York, blending hydrogen into natural gas for building heat, which Liberty has chosen to expand to 1 MW. Earlier funding included grants from the U.S. Department of Energy, NYSERDA and the National Science Foundation.
context: Ecolectro claims its membrane avoids iridium, a rare and costly metal, and PFAS chemicals used in competing PEM electrolyzers. The company says the Liberty pilot produced hydrogen for under $2.50 per kg, below the Department of Energy's 2030 target of $3 per kg, and expects tax credits to push costs lower. It positions on-site production as a way to avoid costly hydrogen transport and storage.

sources.title: Ecolectro Closes $10.5M Series A Round to Accelerate Next-Generation Green Hydrogen Electrolyzers

title: EBRD to invest €100 million in Green Genius
summary: The EBRD will invest €100 million in Lithuanian developer Green Genius and become a minority shareholder once competition authorities approve.
details: The EBRD will invest €100 million for a minority stake in Green Genius, a Lithuanian renewable developer, subject to competition approval. It is the EBRD's largest equity commitment to a single company in the Baltic states and its first equity investment in Green Genius.
context: The money supports Green Genius's plans to develop over 2 GW of renewables across Europe; the EBRD has financed many of its projects over the past decade.

sources.title: Green Genius Secures €100 Million Investment From EBRD For Renewable Energy Growth

title: Masdar and KESH sign term sheet to explore gigawatt-scale renewable joint venture in Albania
summary: UAE renewable developer Masdar and Albania's state power producer KESH signed a joint venture term sheet to explore building gigawatt-scale renewable projects in Albania. The deal was signed in Baku on the sidelines of COP29.
details: A term sheet is a preliminary document setting out the main terms the parties intend to negotiate, so this is not yet a binding joint venture. The planned venture would develop, build and operate solar PV, wind and hybrid projects, which combine more than one technology at a site, possibly with battery storage. Power would be sold in Albania and exported to neighbouring countries through cross-border grid links. No capacity figures beyond gigawatt scale, investment amounts, ownership split or timelines were disclosed.
context: KESH, which mainly runs hydropower plants, says the partnership would diversify its supply and strengthen energy resilience and exports. Masdar describes the deal as a step in its expansion into the Balkans and Southeast Europe, alongside its proposed acquisition of Greece's TERNA ENERGY and its Čibuk wind projects in Serbia. Masdar is targeting 100 GW of renewable capacity by 2030.

sources.title: Masdar and KESH Sign Agreement to Explore Renewable Energy Joint Venture in Albania

title: Schroders Greencoat buys 28.5 MW Stokeford solar farm
summary: Schroders Greencoat acquired the 28.5 MW Stokeford solar farm near Wareham, Dorset, from Innova and its landowner partner.
details: Schroders Greencoat bought the 28.5 MW Stokeford solar farm near Wareham, Dorset, from Innova and its joint venture partner Will Bond, the landowner. It energised on 31 July 2024 and won a CfD in Allocation Round 4 in July 2022.
context: Stokeford shares a grid connection with the 8 MW Alaska Wind Farm, one of few shared solar-wind connections at utility scale in England. It is Innova's fourth project sold to Schroders Greencoat.

sources.title: Schroders Greencoat acquires Stokeford solar farm

title: Greenprint Capital provides $110 million tax equity for esVolta's 300 MWh Hummingbird storage project
summary: esVolta has closed a $110 million tax equity deal with Greenprint Capital Management to fund construction of its Hummingbird battery storage project. The project in San Jose, California has 300 MWh of storage capacity.
details: Tax equity is an arrangement where an investor puts money into a project in exchange for the right to use its federal tax credits. The Hummingbird battery is under construction and is scheduled to finish in 2025. Once running, it will supply Pacific Gas & Electric with resource adequacy capacity, meaning guaranteed availability to meet peak demand, under a long-term contract. It will also sell fast-response energy and ancillary grid services, such as frequency support, into the California grid operator's (CAISO) market. Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe and DCH Law advised esVolta, while Leverage Law Group advised Greenprint.
context: esVolta, a storage developer owned by Generate Capital, says its operating and under-construction portfolio totals about 1.5 GWh. The company says the project will ease grid congestion in the growing San Jose area and has created around 200 local union jobs. The deal shows tax credit investors continuing to back standalone battery projects in California.

sources.title: esVolta Secures $110 Million Tax Equity Investment for 300 MWh Hummingbird Energy Storage Project

title: S4 Energy agrees to buy 310 MW German battery storage portfolio from Terra One
target: 310 MW battery energy storage project portfolio in Germany
summary: S4 Energy, a subsidiary of Castleton Commodities International, has signed an agreement to acquire a 310 MW portfolio of battery storage projects in Germany from developer Terra One. The deal is S4 Energy's first move into the German market. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: The portfolio mixes shovel-ready projects, meaning ones ready to start construction, with projects at an advanced development stage. S4 Energy plans to build, own and operate the batteries itself. The projects are expected to start operating between 2026 and 2028. The release does not give storage energy capacity in MWh, a price or an expected closing date.
context: CCI presents the deal as an expansion of its battery storage platform across key European markets. The company claims the batteries will help Germany meet its renewable targets by improving grid stability and flexibility. A CCI executive said the transaction reflects the firm's belief in the role of storage in German decarbonization.

sources.title: S4 Energy Enters Germany with Agreement to Acquire a 310 MW Battery Energy Storage Portfolio from Terra One

title: ENGIE signs 21-year solar PPA with STMicroelectronics in Malaysia
summary: ENGIE, through BKH Solar with Conextone Energy, signed a 21-year PPA with STMicroelectronics for 50 GWh a year from a new solar farm in Bukit Kayu Hitam, Kedah.
details: ENGIE, through BKH Solar, its venture with Conextone Energy, signed a 21-year PPA with STMicroelectronics for about 50 GWh a year from a new 30 MW solar farm in Bukit Kayu Hitam, Kedah, under Malaysia's Corporate Green Power Programme.
context: The programme, launched by the Malaysian Single Buyer in 2023, lets companies buy solar power from new plants over the grid. ST aims for 100% renewable sourcing.

sources.title: ENGIE, STMicroelectronics enter 21-year PPA for new solar farm in Malaysia

title: Eku Energy reaches financial close on 250 MW / 500 MWh Williamsdale battery
summary: Eku Energy reached financial close on the 250 MW / 500 MWh Williamsdale battery in the Australian Capital Territory, using Tesla Megapacks.
details: Eku Energy reached financial close on the 250 MW / 500 MWh Williamsdale battery in the Australian Capital Territory, using Tesla Megapacks, its seventh asset to close. It is part of the ACT Government's Big Canberra Battery project and connects to the Evoenergy network.
context: Under a revenue swap, the territory takes a share of the battery's market revenue and Eku gets fixed quarterly payments for 15 years. It could power a third of Canberra for two hours from 2026.

sources.title: Eku Energy reaches financial close for Williamsdale BESS

title: SSE Renewables buys 120 MW / 240 MWh Irish battery project from Low Carbon
summary: SSE Renewables acquired the development rights to a 120 MW / 240 MWh battery in Ireland's Midlands from Low Carbon.
details: SSE Renewables bought the development rights to the consented 120 MW / 240 MWh Thornsberry battery project near Tullamore, County Offaly, from Grid Systems Services, owned by Low Carbon. It has a grid offer to connect via an adjacent 110 kV substation and could operate by the end of the decade if approved for delivery.
context: A two-hour battery can supply the equivalent of over 115,000 Irish homes at peak times. SSE is growing a battery development portfolio in Ireland.

sources.title: SSE acquires Irish BESS

title: Econergy secures financing for Resko solar, its first in Poland
summary: Econergy secured investment and financing for the Resko solar project, its first in Poland.
details: Econergy secured €33 million of senior project finance from PKO Bank Polski for its first Polish solar project, the roughly 52 MW Resko plant in West Pomerania, due to connect within months. Phoenix Insurance converted a €4.2 million loan into a 49% equity stake in the project company.
context: The rest of Phoenix's loan becomes an unsecured shareholder loan, 49% of the project's shareholder loans, matching its equity share.

sources.title: Econergy secures financing for Resko solar project in Poland

title: PNE sells 59.4 MW Papenrode repowering project to Qualitas Energy
summary: PNE sold the 59.4 MW Papenrode wind repowering project under construction in Lower Saxony to Qualitas Energy.
details: PNE sold the Papenrode wind farm, a 59.4 MW, nine-turbine repowering project under construction in Groß Twülpstedt and Bahrdorf, Lower Saxony, to Qualitas Energy Deutschland, turnkey. Operation is scheduled for Q2 2025.
context: Repowering replaces older turbines with modern ones on an existing site. PNE will reinvest the proceeds in growing its own operating portfolio.

sources.title: PNE sells Papenrode wind farm

title: Ampd Energy raises $27.3 million Series B led by Kibo Invest and Openspace
summary: Singapore-based Ampd Energy, which makes battery storage systems that replace diesel generators on construction sites and in heavy industry, has raised $27.3 million in a Series B round. Kibo Invest and Openspace co-led the round, and existing backers MTR Lab, Taronga Ventures and 2150 also took part.
details: A Series B is a company's second major round of venture funding, typically used to scale an established business. Openspace was the largest investor, and the existing investors put in more than their proportional share, known as investing above pro-rata. Ampd makes the Enertainer and Ampd Silo battery systems and says it has deployed more than 300 units across seven countries, mostly on construction sites. The company plans to use the money in 2025 to enter the mining and manufacturing sectors and to expand into Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and the United States.
context: Ampd says the round was oversubscribed, meaning investors offered more money than it sought, despite a difficult fundraising climate. The company claims its products cut carbon footprints by up to 90% compared with diesel generators and that its units have avoided over 69,000 tons of CO2. The deal reflects investor interest in replacing diesel power in hard-to-decarbonize industrial settings with batteries.

sources.title: Ampd Energy Secures Oversubscribed $27.3 Million in Series B Funding to Accelerate Clean Battery Energy Storage Solutions Globally

title: JSW Energy signs 25-year PPA with SECI for 700 MW solar at ₹2.56
summary: JSW Energy's unit JSW Renew Energy Eleven signed a 25-year PPA with SECI for 700 MW of grid-connected solar at ₹2.56 per kWh under Tranche XIII.
details: JSW Renew Energy Eleven, a JSW Energy unit, signed a 25-year PPA with SECI for 700 MW of ISTS-connected solar won in SECI Tranche XIII, at ₹2.56/kWh. It should be commissioned within 24 months.
context: JSW Energy has 7.9 GW operating and 16.2 GWh of storage locked in, and targets 20 GW and 40 GWh before 2030.

sources.title: JSW Energy, SECI ink PPA for 700 MW solar project

title: EBRD signs up to US$54.6 million for Voltalia's Sarimay solar plant in Uzbekistan
summary: Voltalia signed financing documents with the EBRD for up to US$54.6 million for the Sarimay solar plant in Uzbekistan.
details: Voltalia signed up to US$54.6 million of EBRD financing for the 126 MW Sarimay solar plant in Uzbekistan: a senior loan of up to US$44.8 million and a €9 million VAT facility for construction. The EU's EFSD+ guarantees a US$7 million senior tranche.
context: Awarded in 2022, the plant has a 25-year power sales contract and is due for commissioning in the second half of 2025. An unfunded guarantee covers losses without lending money upfront.

sources.title: Voltalia secures financing for Sarimay Solar plant

title: Iberdrola and NBIM add 50 MW Peñarrubia solar to their alliance
summary: Iberdrola and Norges Bank Investment Management added their first solar plant, the 50 MW Peñarrubia in Murcia, to their €2 billion renewable alliance.
details: Iberdrola and Norges Bank Investment Management added the 50 MW Peñarrubia solar plant, between Yecla and Jumilla in Murcia, to their €2 billion co-investment alliance in Spain and Portugal. Iberdrola holds 51% of the alliance's assets.
context: The alliance now has nearly 200 MW operating, with more plants under construction to be added towards a 2,500 MW portfolio.

sources.title: Iberdrola and Norges Bank Investment Management incorporate first solar photovoltaic into alliance

title: Green Bridge Energy, Archetype Energy and Climate Commodities agree US$500 million financing framework for mid-market US renewables
summary: Green Bridge Energy, Archetype Energy and Climate Commodities signed a strategic framework agreement to provide US$500 million in programmatic financing for middle-market renewable energy projects in the United States. The partnership targets decentralized clean energy infrastructure for corporations, municipalities and reshoring projects.
details: The agreement is a framework rather than financing for a named project, meaning it sets terms under which money can be deployed across many projects over time, which is what programmatic financing means. It covers turnkey development and finance offerings for corporations, independent developers and other industry players. Green Bridge Energy invests in commercial and industrial (C&I) solar, battery storage and fleet charging, while Archetype Energy develops solar and storage projects for the middle market. No specific projects, capacities, lenders or timelines were disclosed.
context: The parties say mid-sized C&I projects, those serving businesses and institutions rather than utilities, have long struggled to attract investment, and they present this deal as a way to close that funding gap. Archetype Energy links the effort to rising electricity demand from artificial intelligence. The companies claim their management teams have handled several billion dollars of energy transactions.

sources.title: Green Bridge Energy Announces $500 Million Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Partnership with Archetype Energy & Climate Commodities

title: Jupiter Power closes $225 million corporate credit facility for US battery storage growth
summary: Austin-based battery storage developer Jupiter Power has closed a $225 million corporate credit facility. Barclays, HSBC and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation led the lending group. The money supports the company's US storage pipeline of more than 12,000 MW.
details: The facility is revolving, meaning the company can draw, repay and draw again, and it is split into up to $175 million of letters of credit and $50 million of revolving loans. Letters of credit are bank guarantees often used to post security for grid connection and power market obligations. The loan is made to the company as a whole rather than to a single project. Kirkland & Ellis advised Jupiter Power and Latham & Watkins advised the lenders. The company says it has 2,575 MWh of battery storage in operation or under construction.
context: Jupiter Power says the facility will help it advance projects across its development pipeline, which it describes as one of the largest in the US, stretching from California to Maine. HSBC noted this is its first facility with the company. Corporate-level credit lines like this give developers flexible capital and collateral capacity alongside project-specific financing.

sources.title: Jupiter Power Secures $225 Million Corporate Credit Facility to Accelerate Energy Storage Growth

title: Assan Alüminyum acquires 10 MWp solar plant in Karaman, Türkiye
target: 10 MWp solar power plant in Karaman
summary: Flat-rolled aluminium producer Assan Alüminyum has bought a solar power plant in Karaman, Türkiye. The plant has an installed capacity of 10 MWp and sits on 11.37 hectares. The seller and price were not disclosed.
details: The acquired facility is an operating solar plant with 10 MWp of capacity, where MWp means megawatts peak, the maximum output of the panels under standard test conditions. It covers 11.37 hectares in Karaman province. The release does not name the seller, the purchase price or any advisers. Assan Alüminyum already runs a hydroelectric plant in Manavgat that it says produces close to its yearly electricity use.
context: The company says the purchase supports its decarbonization roadmap, which targets net-zero emissions by 2050, and will help offset its Scope 2 emissions, meaning emissions from the electricity it buys. It also uses International Renewable Energy Certificates to cover its power use. The company recently obtained 90 million US dollars in green financing from the International Finance Corporation, which it describes as a first for its sector.

sources.title: Assan Alüminyum Acquires Solar Power Plant to Boost Sustainability Efforts

title: EIB approves €300 million for Salto de Chira pumped hydro in Gran Canaria
summary: The EIB approved a €300 million loan for Red Eléctrica to build the Salto de Chira pumped storage plant in Gran Canaria.
details: The EIB approved a €300 million loan for the Salto de Chira pumped-storage hydro plant being built by Red Eléctrica, part of Redeia, in Gran Canaria: 200 MW of power and 3.5 GWh of storage, with a sea-water desalination plant.
context: Pumped storage moves water between two reservoirs at different heights, storing surplus renewable power that an island grid would otherwise waste.

sources.title: EIB approves loan for construction of Salto de Chira hydroelectric power plant

title: CCI's S4 Energy acquires LC Energy's Dutch battery storage platform
summary: S4 Energy, a subsidiary of Castleton Commodities International (CCI), has bought LC Energy's battery storage platform LCEGS. The Netherlands-based business develops grid-scale, high-voltage battery storage systems. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: LCEGS focuses on developing large battery systems connected to the high-voltage grid in the Netherlands. S4 Energy is separately building four medium-voltage battery projects in the country, each able to discharge for four hours, which it expects to start operating in 2025. After the deal, the combined pipeline is said to total about 7.5 GW, including a fully permitted 2 GWh battery project in Groningen that the company describes as the largest in the Netherlands. No price, stake details or advisers were disclosed.
context: CCI says the purchase moves it closer to building an integrated battery storage platform across Europe. S4 Energy aims to become a large independent provider of grid flexibility, meaning the ability to absorb and release power to balance supply and demand, within three years, focusing on the Netherlands, Germany and neighbouring markets. The company claims it is positioned to become the leading owner and operator of battery storage in Europe, citing growth in intermittent renewables and rising power demand from electrification and data centres.

sources.title: CCI acquires LC Energy Grid Services, strengthens presence in Dutch battery energy storage sector

title: ICG buys 50% of Korean onshore wind developer Revent Energy
summary: ICG acquired 50% of Revent Energy, a South Korean onshore wind developer, with ST International keeping the other half.
details: ICG bought 50% of Revent Energy, a South Korean onshore wind developer, with ST International keeping the other 50%. Revent holds interests in the operating Yeongyang and Youngduk wind farms, both planned for repowering, and targets over 500 MW installed within five years.
context: It is ICG's entry into South Korea's renewables market, which targets 72.7 GW of cumulative capacity by 2030.

sources.title: ICG invests in Korean onshore wind

title: ADB approves US$434.25 million for 500 MW Assam solar project
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a US$434.25 million loan for the 500 MW grid-connected Assam Solar Project in Karbi Anglong, which also includes battery storage.
details: ADB approved a US$434.25 million loan for the 500 MW grid-connected Assam Solar Project in Karbi Anglong district, with a grid battery to be set up by a joint venture of APDCL and ONGC Tripura Power, plus a US$1 million grant for implementation and capacity building.
context: ADB will also help structure a public–private partnership for another 250 MW solar plant in Karbi Anglong. Assam targets 3,000 MW of solar by 2030.

sources.title: ADB OKs $434.25m loan for solar facility in Assam, India

title: BayWa r.e. sells Perscheid Ost wind farm to KGAL
summary: BayWa r.e. sold the Perscheid Ost wind farm in Rhineland-Palatinate, three 5.7 MW Nordex turbines, to KGAL.
details: BayWa r.e. sold the Perscheid Ost wind farm in Rhineland-Palatinate, three Nordex N163 turbines of 5.7 MW each (17.1 MW), to KGAL, its second sale to KGAL in 2024 after the 18.6 MW Reichenbach project. It is under construction for commissioning in April 2025.
context: It should produce about 48,000 MWh a year. Under section 6 of Germany's EEG, nearby municipalities receive a share of the farm's revenue.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells German wind farm to KGAL

title: Pine Gate Renewables closes $288 million preferred equity investment from Blackstone Credit & Insurance for 780 MWdc solar portfolio
target: Six-project solar portfolio across two US states

advisors.name: Stoel Rives LLP
advisors.role: legal adviser to Pine Gate Renewables

advisors.name: Milbank LLP
advisors.role: legal adviser to Blackstone Credit & Insurance

summary: Pine Gate Renewables has closed a $288 million preferred equity investment from funds affiliated with Blackstone Credit & Insurance. The money supports six solar projects in two US states with a combined 780 MWdc of capacity.
details: The portfolio consists of six solar projects spread across two states, which the release does not name, totaling 780 MW measured on the direct current side of the panels. All six projects sell their power to corporate buyers under offtake agreements, meaning contracts in which companies agree to purchase the electricity. Preferred equity is an ownership-style investment that gets paid before ordinary equity holders but sits behind lenders. Stoel Rives advised Pine Gate and Milbank advised Blackstone.
context: Pine Gate says this is its first preferred equity deal and describes it as a repeatable, scalable financing model for its business. Blackstone says the deal reflects its origination and structuring capabilities in energy transition sectors and that it hopes to expand the relationship. Pine Gate reports more than 2 GW of operating solar capacity and over 30 GW of projects in development.

sources.title: Pine Gate Renewables Closes $288 Million Preferred Equity Financing with Blackstone Credit & Insurance

title: LG Technology Ventures invests in sodium-ion battery startup UNIGRID
summary: LG Technology Ventures, the venture investment arm linked to the LG group, has made an investment of undisclosed size in UNIGRID, a San Diego startup that develops sodium-ion batteries. The money is intended to help UNIGRID scale production and commercialise its cells.
details: UNIGRID was spun out of the University of California, San Diego in 2021, based on doctoral research by its founders Darren H. S. Tan and Erik A. Wu. Its cells use sodium-based materials and contain no lithium, nickel, cobalt or copper. The company says its cells reach energy densities above those of lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries, a common lithium-based chemistry. The release does not state the amount invested, the stake acquired or other participants in the round.
context: UNIGRID presents sodium-ion technology as a way to reduce supply chain risks tied to lithium-based batteries, and claims it is cheaper, safer and works across a wide temperature range. The company says it is ramping up production to meet customer demand and will use the funding for energy storage and e-mobility uses. The investor describes the deal as part of its strategy to build ties between startups and LG companies.

sources.title: U.S. Sodium-Ion Battery Startup Receives Investment from LG Technology Ventures

title: Foss & Company closes tax credit investment of over $100 million in Plus Power's 200 MW Anemoi storage project in Texas
summary: Foss & Company has closed an investment of more than $100 million in Anemoi Energy Storage, a standalone battery project developed by Plus Power. The 200 MW / 400 MWh facility is located near Edinburg, Texas.
details: Anemoi is a standalone battery system, meaning it is not paired with a solar or wind plant, with 200 MW of power and 400 MWh of energy, which works out to about two hours of discharge at full output. It serves the ERCOT grid, which covers most of Texas. The deal used a t-flip structure, which Foss says it pioneered in 2023 and which combines traditional tax equity (where an investor funds a project in exchange for its federal tax benefits) with the ability for investors to buy transferable tax credits. The stated amount exceeds $100 million, so the figure given is a minimum.
context: This is Foss & Company's third investment in a utility-scale battery project and follows its earlier deal for Plus Power's Rodeo Ranch Energy Storage facility. Plus Power says the project helps ERCOT maintain supply amid rising demand and more frequent extreme weather. Foss presents the deal as strengthening its position as a tax equity provider.

sources.title: Foss & Company and Plus Power Close $100 Million Investment Tax Credit Deal for Battery Energy Storage System

title: Stonepeak completes purchase of 50% noncontrolling stake in Dominion's 2.6 GW Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project
target: Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) commercial project
summary: Dominion Energy has closed the sale of a 50% noncontrolling interest in the 2.6 GW Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project to infrastructure investor Stonepeak. Dominion received 2.6 billion US dollars at closing, and Stonepeak will pay half of the remaining construction costs.
details: The project, under construction off Virginia Beach, is planned to have 176 turbines and three offshore substations across a lease area of almost 113,000 acres, with full completion expected in late 2026. The 2.6 billion dollar payment reimburses Stonepeak's share of roughly half the capital spent on the project so far. Stonepeak will fund 50% of future costs as they arise, subject to previously disclosed conditions, and the release says the structure gives meaningful protection against unexpected budget increases. Dominion keeps full operational control over construction and operation, while Stonepeak holds the usual rights of a minority owner. The deal was first announced on February 22, 2024.
context: Dominion says this closing completes its business review program, under which it announced transactions worth about 21 billion dollars in debt reduction, including several gas business sales and a fuel securitization. The company claims the partnership improves its credit and risk profile as it refocuses on regulated electric utility operations. Dominion describes CVOW as the largest offshore wind farm under construction in the US and says it is on time and on budget.

sources.title: Dominion Energy, Stonepeak Announce Closing of Sale of Noncontrolling Equity Interest In Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind Commercial Project

title: Alcazar Energy Partners to buy 200 MW Celzijus 1 wind project in Serbia from RP Global
summary: Alcazar Energy Partners signed an agreement with RP Global for the 200 MW Celzijus 1 wind project east of Belgrade and a 768 MW wind and solar pipeline in Serbia.
details: Alcazar Energy Partners agreed with RP Global to secure the rights to Celzijus 1, a 200 MW onshore wind project east of Belgrade, together with a 768 MW pipeline of wind and solar projects in Serbia. Closing was expected by end-2024.
context: Celzijus 1 is a roughly US$300 million investment and will be one of the Western Balkans' largest wind farms. Alcazar aims to build US$600 million of assets in Serbia.

sources.title: Alcazar acquires Serbian renewable energy projects

title: NW Group secures €430 million from Santander and Rabobank for batteries in France and Finland
summary: NW Group secured €430 million of non-recourse bank financing from Santander CIB and Rabobank to operate more than 2 GWh of batteries in France and Finland by the end of 2025.
details: NW Group secured €430 million of non-recourse bank financing from Santander CIB and Rabobank to run more than 2 GWh of storage in France and Finland by end-2025, using its JBox distributed lithium-ion battery units.
context: NW, France's largest electricity storage company with over 600 MW installed, raised €300 million of equity in 2022. The JBoxes provide grid stability services and can pair with its fast EV chargers.

sources.title: NW secures financing for European energy storage projects

title: Trina Solar ISBU signs 15-year PPA with Shell-owned EGO for 69 MWp Italian solar portfolio
target: Nine solar projects totaling 69 MWp in Italy

advisors.name: Parola Associati
advisors.role: legal adviser to Trina Solar ISBU

summary: Trina Solar's utility-scale development unit has agreed a 15-year power purchase agreement with EGO, an Italian energy management company owned by Shell. The contract covers nine solar projects in Italy with a combined 69 MWp of capacity.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract under which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a generator at set terms. The nine projects are spread across several Italian regions and are either under construction or due to start building in 2024 and 2025. Once running, the portfolio is expected to produce about 119 GWh of electricity per year, which the companies say matches the needs of roughly 7,000 average households. Trina Solar ISBU was advised by law firm Parola Associati.
context: EGO buys and aggregates power from distributed plants and trades it on the Italian market, and its CEO says its link to Shell Energy Europe's trading business helped it secure the deal. Trina Solar presents the agreement as a contribution to Italy's goal of sourcing 65% of electricity from renewables by 2030. The companies also expect the projects to create around 1,000 jobs across nine regions.

sources.title: Trina Solar and EGO sign a Power Purchase Agreement in Italy for a 69MW portfolio

title: KPI Green Energy signs PPAs with GUVNL for 620 MW of renewables
summary: KPI Green Energy signed PPAs with GUVNL for 620 MWac of grid-connected renewables, including a 250 MWac solar project and a 370 MW hybrid plant.
details: KPI Green Energy signed PPAs with GUVNL for 620 MWac of grid-connected projects: a 250 MWac solar project won in a tender on 15 March 2024 and a 370 MWac solar-wind hybrid project won on 14 February 2024.
context: GUVNL is Gujarat's state power buyer. KPI Green targets 10 GW of capacity by 2030.

sources.title: KPI Green inks PPA for 620 MW grid-connected RE projects in Gujarat

title: Atlas Renewable Energy secures US$289 million for BESS del Desierto in Chile
summary: Atlas Renewable Energy secured US$289 million of senior loans and credit lines from BNP Paribas and Crédit Agricole CIB for BESS del Desierto, its first standalone battery in Chile.
details: Atlas Renewable Energy secured US$289 million of senior loans and credit lines from BNP Paribas and Crédit Agricole CIB for BESS del Desierto, its first standalone battery in Chile, with 800 MWh of storage. DNV did market, contract-risk and dispatch due diligence.
context: It is one of Latin America's largest storage projects and should deliver about 280 GWh a year, cutting curtailment of solar power that the grid cannot absorb in the day.

sources.title: DNV supports Atlas Renewable Energy with Chile BESS financing

title: Clearvise buys stake in 70 MW French solar co-development
summary: Clearvise signed a purchase agreement for a French ground-mounted solar project with more than 70 MW approved, its largest co-development with its ClearPARTNERS.
details: Clearvise agreed to buy a stake in a permitted ground-mounted solar project of more than 70 MW in western France, its largest co-development under its ClearPARTNERS model with regional developers. The price was not disclosed.
context: The park should produce over 90 GWh a year, earning a mix of state-guaranteed feed-in tariffs and PPAs. In co-development the IPP partners with a local developer from the permitting stage.

sources.title: Clearvise acquires stake in French photovoltaic project

title: King Energy raises $10 million in round led by ArcTern Ventures
summary: Colorado-based King Energy, which provides solar for multi-tenant commercial buildings, closed a $10 million funding round. ArcTern Ventures led with $7 million and existing backers Blackhorn Ventures, Active Impact Investments and Next Frontier Capital added $3 million.
details: King Energy combines rooftop solar financing, installation and long-term management with its OneBill software, which splits and bills solar power among the tenants of a shared building. The company says it runs nearly 200 energy programs covering more than 25 million square feet of tenant space. The new money is meant for scaling operations, hiring and technology improvements across North America. ArcTern Partner Mira Inbar will join the King Energy board.
context: Multi-tenant buildings have been hard to solarize because owners pay for systems while tenants pay the power bills, a mismatch known as the split incentive problem. ArcTern claims King Energy has solved this so both owners and tenants benefit. The round follows ArcTern closing its US$337 million Fund III in January 2024.

sources.title: King Energy Secures $10 Million in Funding Led by ArcTern Ventures to Scale Solar Solutions for Multi-Tenant Commercial Properties

title: Scout Clean Energy buys 200 MWdc solar and 160 MWh storage project in Kentucky from Redeux Energy
target: Hybrid solar and battery storage development project in Ohio County, Kentucky
summary: Redeux Energy has sold a hybrid solar and battery storage development project in Western Kentucky to Scout Clean Energy, a Brookfield-owned developer. The project combines 200 MWdc of solar with a 40 MW, 160 MWh battery. Financial terms were not disclosed.
details: The project pairs a 200 MWdc solar array with a 40 MW battery that can discharge for four hours, giving 160 MWh of storage. It sits in Ohio County next to the 400 MW DB Wilson coal-fired plant and will connect to a nearby MISO transmission switchyard. It is moving through MISO's 2021 DPP interconnection cluster, the grid operator's queue process for studying and approving new grid connections. Scout plans to take the project through later development, financing and construction. Marathon Capital acted as financial adviser to Redeux.
context: This is the second sale from an 11-project portfolio Redeux put on the market in late 2023, and Redeux says it plans to offer another portfolio in Q1 2025. The deal adds to Scout's development pipeline, which the company puts at about 19,000 MW across 23 states. Siting the project beside an operating coal plant lets it use existing grid infrastructure in a coal region.

sources.title: Redeux Energy Announces Sale of Utility-Scale, Solar and Storage Development Project to Scout Clean Energy

title: Intesa Sanpaolo provides €32.6 million for GreenGo solar developments
summary: Intesa Sanpaolo provided €32.6 million to Bologna-based GreenGo for its large solar developments in Italy.
details: Intesa Sanpaolo provided €32.6 million to GreenGo of Bologna to build eight solar plants of 41.8 MW: four in Calabria (22.8 MW), three in Sicily (13.7 MW) and one in Marche (5.3 MW), due online in the first half of 2025.
context: Revenue is mixed: 47% from corporate PPAs with Sasol Italia, 17% from GSE incentive tariffs and 36% merchant. It comes from Intesa's €8 billion circular economy fund linked to Italy's recovery plan.

sources.title: Intesa Sanpaolo invests €32 million in GreenGo solar plant developments

title: Sumitomo's Perennial Power forms joint venture with CEP Solar for over 1.5 GW of Virginia solar and storage

sellers.name: CEP Solar, LLC

target: Virginia solar and battery storage development portfolio
summary: Sumitomo Corporation, through its US arm and subsidiary Perennial Power Holdings, has formed a joint venture with Richmond-based developer CEP Solar. The venture will develop a portfolio of solar and battery storage projects in Virginia that exceeds 1.5 GW.
details: The portfolio combines solar farms and battery storage projects across Virginia, and construction is expected to begin from late 2025. CEP brings local development know-how and relationships with landowners and communities, while the Sumitomo group contributes experience in arranging project finance, meaning loans repaid from the cash flows of the projects themselves. The venture also plans to originate new projects. Financial terms and ownership shares were not disclosed.
context: Virginia's 2020 clean energy law targets a fully clean grid by 2050, and the state hosts a very large data center market, which the companies say drives demand for new renewable power. The deal extends the Sumitomo group's early-stage US development work launched in the Midwest and Northeast in 2023. Perennial currently holds five US renewable projects with about 313 MW of net owned capacity and aims to reach 1 GW of net ownership by 2030.

sources.title: Sumitomo Corporation Group Establishes Joint Venture to Develop Renewable Energy Projects in Virginia; Expanding Over 1.5 GW of Solar Power Projects in a Key IT Infrastructure Hub and Data Center Cluster

title: OX2 acquires 1 GW onshore wind project north of Perth
summary: OX2 secured its first Australian onshore wind project, up to 1 GW north of Perth in Western Australia, with a 100 MW battery to be built first.
details: OX2 acquired its first Australian onshore wind project, up to 1 GW north of Perth in Western Australia, across land of more than 20 landowners, with a 100 MW battery to be built first. The original developers will keep managing approvals.
context: OX2 entered Australia in 2023 by buying ESCO Pacific and has about 1 GW of solar and 230 MW of storage in development in the eastern states.

sources.title: OX2 acquires 1 GW onshore wind project in Australia

title: BrightNight and Cordelio close $260M tax equity from J.P. Morgan and Capital One for 300 MW Box Canyon solar in Arizona

advisors.name: Milbank
advisors.role: legal adviser to tax equity investors

summary: BrightNight and its co-owner Cordelio Power closed a $260 million tax equity financing commitment for the 300 MW Box Canyon solar project in Pinal County, Arizona. An affiliate of J.P. Morgan and Capital One are providing the funds.
details: Tax equity is investment from parties that receive a project's tax benefits in return for capital. The deal uses a partnership flip, a structure where the investors take most of the tax benefits and cash early before ownership shares shift to the sponsors, here to monetize production tax credits earned on each unit of power generated. The amount includes deferred contributions paid later. Construction financing was closed in May 2024 with Zions Bank, CIBC, RBC, NBC and SMTB, and the project is expected to start operating in the first half of 2025. Norton Rose Fulbright advised the sponsors and Milbank advised the tax equity investors.
context: The project is described as the largest renewable procurement in the history of the Southwest Public Power Agency, the buyer of its power. It belongs to a 2 GW Arizona portfolio owned by BrightNight and Cordelio, which is owned by Canada Pension Plan Investment Board. BrightNight projects more than 900,000 MWh of annual output, enough by its estimate for about 77,000 homes and businesses.

sources.title: BrightNight Announces $260M Tax-Equity Financing from J.P. Morgan and Capital One for 300MW Solar Project in Arizona

title: Nexif Ratch reaches financial close on 145 MWp Bacolod solar in the Philippines
summary: Nexif Ratch Energy reached financial close on the 145 MWp Bacolod solar project in Bacolod and Bago cities, its second in the Philippines.
details: Nexif Ratch Energy reached financial close on the 145 MWp Bacolod solar project in Bacolod City and Bago City, developed by Negros PH Solar and financed through Security Bank and PNB, an investment of more than US$100 million. Most power goes to an Aboitiz Power subsidiary under a 10-year supply deal.
context: The rest is sold on the wholesale spot market. Construction was set for October 2024 with operation in Q4 2025; up to 20 MW more and a battery are planned.

sources.title: Nexif Ratch secures financing for 145MWp PH solar project

title: Ingka Investments takes 15% of Golden Plains Wind Farm Stage 2
summary: Ingka Investments took a further 15% stake, this time in the 577 MW Stage 2 of the 1,333 MW Golden Plains Wind Farm in Victoria, with TagEnergy.
details: Ingka Investments, IKEA's investment arm, took a 15% stake in the 577 MW Stage 2 of TagEnergy's Golden Plains Wind Farm in Victoria, after taking 15% of Stage 1 in 2023. It can claim up to 15% of Stage 2's output.
context: The full project is 1,333 MW. The 756 MW, 215-turbine Stage 1 has started operating; Stage 2 should finish by mid-2027.

sources.title: Ingka Investments acquires 15% of Golden Plains Wind Farm stage 2

title: Boralex buys 50 MW Sallachy wind project from WKN
summary: Boralex acquired the yet-to-be-built Sallachy wind project, nine turbines of up to 50 MW in Scotland, from WKN, a PNE subsidiary.
details: Boralex bought the Sallachy wind project from WKN, part of PNE: up to 50 MW from nine turbines up to 149.9 m tip height on the Sallachy Estate in Sutherland, in the Scottish Highlands. It has not yet been built.
context: Boralex buys shovel-ready projects to complement its own UK development; it sees the UK as a high-potential market.

sources.title: Boralex acquires Sallachy wind farm

title: NextEnergy Capital signs 20-year sleeved PPA for Llanwern, one of the UK's largest solar farms
summary: NextEnergy Capital's NextPower UK ESG fund signed a 20-year, inflation-linked sleeved PPA covering 90% of the output and certificates of the Llanwern solar farm.
details: In a sleeved PPA a utility delivers the power from the plant to the end buyer.

sources.title: UK’s largest solar farm secure 20 year PPA

title: Google signs 12-year PPA for 435 MWdc energyRe solar project in SPP region
summary: Google has agreed to buy power and renewable energy credits from a 435 MWdc solar project that energyRe will develop, own and operate. The power purchase agreement runs for 12 years and the project will supply the Southwest Power Pool grid in the United States.
details: A power purchase agreement is a long-term contract under which a buyer agrees to purchase electricity from a specific project. Under this 12-year deal, energyRe will deliver both electricity and Renewable Energy Credits, which are certificates proving that power came from a renewable source. The project is yet to be built and its capacity is measured in direct current (MWdc), the output of the panels before conversion for the grid. The release says the output equals the needs of more than 56,000 homes. The deal was arranged through LEAP, a standardized procurement process co-developed by Google and LevelTen Energy.
context: Google says the contract supports its goal of running on carbon-free energy every hour of every day on each grid where it operates by 2030. The deal adds to energyRe's contracted US portfolio, which the company states includes 1,520 MWdc of solar and 398 MWh of battery storage. It also shows LevelTen's LEAP process being used to speed up corporate clean energy purchases.

sources.title: energyRe and Google Sign 12-Year Power Purchase Agreement for 435-MWdc Solar Project

title: Photon Energy sells two NSW solar farms and a hybrid project to CleanPeak
summary: Photon Energy agreed to sell its operating Leeton and Fivebough solar farms and a development-stage solar and battery project in New South Wales to CleanPeak Energy.
details: Photon Energy agreed to sell its operating Leeton and Fivebough solar farms (14.5 MWp combined) and the 8.2 MWp / 10.9 MWh Boggabri hybrid solar-battery development in New South Wales to CleanPeak Energy, for a net cash contribution of over €6 million.
context: The farms sell mostly into the National Electricity Market, with a small share under a PPA. Photon is refocusing on energy storage development.

sources.title: Photon Energy sells Aussie solar plants to focus on energy storage

title: Future Fund Oman invests US$156 million in polysilicon maker United Solar Holding
summary: Future Fund Oman, a vehicle set up by Oman's sovereign wealth fund, is investing OMR 60 million (about US$156 million) in United Solar Holding. United Solar is building a polysilicon factory in Sohar Port and Freezone in Oman to supply the solar panel industry.
details: Polysilicon is the purified silicon used to make solar cells. The plant under construction in Sohar is designed to produce 100,000 tons of polysilicon a year, and the company describes it as the largest single-unit plant of its kind in the world and the first in the Middle East. The total project cost is put at US$1.6 billion, with operations scheduled to start in 2025. The release does not state the size of the stake acquired or the deal structure.
context: Future Fund Oman, which has OMR 2 billion (about US$5.2 billion) in capital, was created by Oman Investment Authority to support economic diversification. The fund presents the investment as a step toward making Oman part of the solar manufacturing supply chain and expects it to draw further downstream investment. United Solar, founded in 2023, says it is focused on the U.S. market.

sources.title: United Solar Holding Inc. Receives US$156 million Investment from Future Fund Oman.

title: Mainstream Renewable Power reaches financial close on 50 MW Ilikwa solar plant in South Africa with Investec
summary: Mainstream Renewable Power has reached financial close on its 50 MW Ilikwa solar PV plant in South Africa's Free State province. Investec is providing development finance plus debt and equity for construction and holds 30% of the project, with Mainstream holding 70%. No deal value was disclosed.
details: Financial close is the point when all funding agreements are signed and money can be drawn to build the project. Construction has already started and the company expects commercial operation in early 2026, with expected annual output of 141 GWh. Investec supplied pre-construction development finance as well as construction debt and equity. Power will be sold to several commercial and industrial customers under Renewable Energy Supply Agreements, which are power purchase agreements (long-term electricity sale contracts) with shorter terms of five to 10 years.
context: Mainstream describes the shorter, more flexible supply contracts as a new product that lets a wider range of South African businesses buy renewable power. It is the company's second solar plant with private offtake contracts to reach financial close in the country within a year. Mainstream, majority-owned by Aker Horizons, says it has a 12 GW pipeline in South Africa and a further 180 MW ready for construction in 2025.

sources.title: Mainstream Renewable Power reaches financial close on 50 MW solar PV plant to provide new flexible PPAs to private customers in South Africa

title: J.P. Morgan commits tax equity to Origis Energy's Golden Triangle I solar and storage project in Mississippi
summary: Origis Energy has secured a tax equity commitment from J.P. Morgan for its Golden Triangle I project in Lowndes County, Mississippi. The project combines 200 MWac of solar with 50 MW of battery storage, and an initial funding was made alongside the commitment.
details: Golden Triangle I pairs a 200 MWac solar plant with 50 MW of battery storage and sells its output to the Tennessee Valley Authority under a power purchase agreement, a long-term contract to buy the electricity. Tax equity means an investor provides capital in exchange for using the project's tax benefits, here the Investment Tax Credit under the Inflation Reduction Act. The funding is meant to pay for completing construction of the project. Latham & Watkins advised Origis Energy and Hunton Andrews Kurth advised J.P. Morgan. No deal value or storage duration was disclosed.
context: The project is one of four Origis is building in Mississippi for TVA, totaling 750 MWac of solar and 350 MW of storage. Origis estimates the complex will bring about $182 million in near-term construction and hiring benefits to the area plus roughly $7.2 million in further regional benefits over its life. The deal shows how developers use federal tax credits through bank investors to fund utility-scale projects.

sources.title: Origis Energy Secures Tax Equity Commitment with J.P. Morgan for Golden Triangle I Solar + Storage

title: CS Energy and Aula Energy reach financial close on 228 MW Boulder Creek wind farm
summary: CS Energy and Aula Energy reached financial close on the 228 MW Boulder Creek wind farm in Queensland, a $740 million joint venture in which CS Energy takes 50% and all output under a 20-year PPA.
details: CS Energy and Aula Energy reached financial close on the A$740 million, 228 MW Boulder Creek wind farm 40 km south-west of Rockhampton, Queensland, with 38 GE Vernova turbines. CS Energy takes 50% and all the output under a 20-year PPA.
context: The Queensland Government has committed A$399.7 million, including A$174.3 million from its Renewable Energy and Hydrogen Jobs Fund. Operation is due in 2027.

sources.title: CS Energy, Aula Energy reach financial close on Boulder Creek Wind Farm

title: Microsoft signs PPA for National Grid Renewables' 250 MW Portage Solar project in Wisconsin
summary: National Grid Renewables has signed a power purchase agreement with Microsoft for its 250 MW Portage Solar Project in Portage County, Wisconsin. Under a power purchase agreement, a buyer commits to purchase electricity from a project over a set period.
details: Portage Solar is a 250 MW solar project still in development in Portage County, Wisconsin. Construction is expected to start in 2025, with operation targeted for 2027. The release does not give the price or length of the contract. As part of the deal, National Grid Renewables says it will donate $20 million over the contract term to a community fund managed by the Sustain Our Future Foundation.
context: The deal gives the project a long-term buyer for its power ahead of construction, which typically helps a developer secure financing. National Grid Renewables estimates the project's direct economic impact at about $88 million over its first 25 years, including tax revenue, landowner income and jobs. The company also highlights a dedicated charitable fund for the local community.

sources.title: National Grid Renewables Signs Power Purchase Agreement with Microsoft

title: Leyline Renewable Capital provides $28 million development financing to Golden State Clean Energy
target: Golden State Clean Energy solar and storage development portfolio
summary: Leyline Renewable Capital has provided a $28 million financing package to developer Golden State Clean Energy. The money will support more than 1.9 GW of solar and energy storage projects in California.
details: The package combines several types of capital aimed at projects at different stages of development, with a focus on mid to late-stage projects. Leyline says it offered two different costs of capital, meaning two interest or return levels, to match the different risk levels of earlier and later-stage assets. Development finance of this kind funds work before construction begins, such as permitting and grid connection. No lenders other than Leyline or advisers are named, and no timeline is given.
context: Leyline describes the deal as a milestone in its partnership with GSCE and presents it as an example of flexible structuring for developers. The company claims the two-tier pricing lets the developer structure its capital more efficiently. The financing supports utility-scale solar and storage build-out in the California market.

sources.title: Leyline Renewable Capital Provides $28 Million in Financing to Golden State Clean Energy

title: Masdar completes purchase of 50% stake in Terra-Gen from Energy Capital Partners

buyers.name: Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC)

advisors.name: Mayer Brown
advisors.role: legal advisor to Igneo Infrastructure Partners

summary: Abu Dhabi clean energy company Masdar has closed its purchase of a 50% stake in US renewable producer Terra-Gen from Energy Capital Partners, which has fully exited. Terra-Gen operates 3.8 GW of wind, solar and battery projects across the United States. The price was not disclosed.
details: Terra-Gen's operating portfolio spans 30 sites, mostly in California and Texas, and includes 5.1 GWh of battery storage. The company is developing more than 12 GW of further projects in California, Texas and New York, including 386 MW of Texas wind and California solar plus 512 MWh of California storage expected to start commercial operation in 2025. Igneo Infrastructure Partners keeps its existing 50% stake, making it Masdar's co-owner. Lazard and Guggenheim Securities advised Terra-Gen financially with Latham & Watkins as legal counsel, BMO Capital Markets and JP Morgan advised Masdar with White & Case and Covington & Burling as legal counsel, and Mayer Brown advised Igneo.
context: Masdar describes the deal as one of its largest and says it significantly expands its US presence, where it previously held more than 1.4 GW of wind, solar and storage. The company says the acquisition puts it on track to exceed its goal of 10 GW of US renewable capacity by 2030, as part of a global target of 100 GW. The deal also fits within a UAE and US clean energy partnership announced in 2023.

sources.title: Masdar Accelerates U.S. Renewables Expansion, Closes Acquisition of 50% Stake in Terra-Gen

title: BayWa r.e. sells three German wind projects
summary: BayWa r.e. sold three German wind projects, Beckum, Jembke and Reichenbach, which will produce more than 120,000 MWh a year.
details: BayWa r.e. sold three German wind projects: rights to the 21.9 MW, four-turbine Beckum project (North Rhine-Westphalia) to EEF, the 15.3 MW Jembke project (Lower Saxony) to ENOVA Value, and the 18.6 MW Reichenbach project (Rhineland-Palatinate), both of the latter with EPC contracts.
context: Together they should produce over 120,000 MWh a year. Under an EPC contract BayWa r.e. builds the farm for the buyer.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells three German wind projects

title: Emeren sells 57 MWp French solar portfolio to Trina Solar's French arm
target: 57 MWp solar project portfolio in France
summary: Emeren Group, a US-listed solar developer, has agreed to sell a 57 MWp portfolio of solar projects in France to Trina Solar (France) Systems. The buyer is the French subsidiary of Trina Solar's international system business unit. No price was disclosed.
details: The portfolio has five projects at different stages of development. One early-stage and one late-stage project were sold in the third quarter of 2024. The three mid-stage projects will be transferred in steps as they reach agreed development milestones, meaning payment is tied to progress such as permitting. The release says battery storage could potentially be added to the projects later. MWp refers to the peak direct-current output of the solar panels.
context: Emeren says the sale shows the strength of its development work despite a difficult permitting process in France. Trina says the projects add to its pipeline in France and the wider EMEA region as it shifts from developing and selling projects toward owning assets long term as an independent power producer, meaning a company that owns plants and sells their electricity.

sources.title: Emeren Group Sells 57 MWp Solar Project Portfolio to Trina Solar ISBU in France

title: Renewable Land buys 435-acre Ohio site leased to 50 MW Blue Harvest Solar Park
target: 435-acre property in Putnam County, Ohio leased to Blue Harvest Solar Park
summary: Renewable Land, a California real estate investment firm, has bought a 435-acre parcel in Putnam County, Ohio. The land is leased to the Blue Harvest Solar Park, a 50 MW solar plant. The seller and price were not disclosed.
details: The site hosts an operating 50 MW solar plant run by EDP Renewables. The plant sells its power to Amazon, which uses renewable supply for AWS data centers, offices and fulfillment centers. Renewable Land owns the ground under the plant and earns income from the lease paid by the project, rather than owning the solar equipment itself. No price, seller or advisers were named in the release.
context: Renewable Land specializes in buying land that is leased to solar, wind and battery storage projects, and describes itself as one of the most active investors in this niche in the United States. The firm says the deal fits its aim of backing long-term growth of renewable infrastructure. Its founders are said to have managed more than $15 billion of energy and infrastructure investments.

sources.title: RENEWABLE LAND ACQUIRES 435 ACRES IN OHIO LEASED TO SOLAR FARM

title: BayWa r.e. sells four UK solar projects totalling 222 MWp to Octopus Energy Generation
summary: BayWa r.e. sold four UK solar projects totalling 222 MWp, including the 50 MWp Perrinpit Road solar park, to Octopus Energy Generation.
details: BayWa r.e. sold four UK solar projects of 222 MWp to Octopus Energy Generation: rights to the 50 MWp Perrinpit Road park, developed with Grüne Energien Solar, and three ready-to-build parks it will build under EPC contracts: Driffield (48 MWp, east of York, with a 30 MW battery Octopus will build), South Fambridge Hall (52 MWp, Rochford, Essex) and Corner Copse (72 MWp, near Swindon).
context: BayWa r.e. also signed 20-year operations, maintenance and asset management agreements for the projects. Together they can supply about 80,000 UK homes.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells four UK solar projects to Octopus Energy Generation

title: EIB and Natixis refinance Libeccio's Sicilian wind farms and fund 44.8 MW Vento di Vino 2
summary: The EIB and Natixis signed facilities with Libeccio to refinance two operating Sicilian wind farms and fund the new 44.8 MW Vento di Vino 2 wind farm.
details: The EIB (€42 million) and Natixis CIB (€55 million) signed about €96 million of green project finance for Libeccio, owned by Fabbrica Energie Rinnovabili Alternative and Byom, to refinance its 24 MW Vento di Vino 1 wind farm and build the 44.8 MW Vento di Vino 2 in Mazara del Vallo, Sicily.
context: Vento di Vino 1 has run since 2011 with a short incentive period left; Vento di Vino 2 won 20-year incentives in Italy's Auction No. 13 in February 2024. Mixing an operating and a new project spreads lender risk.

sources.title: Two Sicilian wind farms receive refinancing

title: TAURON buys 190.8 MW Miejska Górka wind project rights from VSB
summary: TAURON acquired the project rights for the 190.8 MW Miejska Górka wind farm in Poland from VSB Group.
details: TAURON Zielona Energia agreed to buy 100% of the project rights for the 190.8 MW Miejska Górka wind farm in Greater Poland from VSB Group, which will also handle further construction and planning work. Nordex will supply up to 53 turbines.
context: Operation is expected in early 2027. TAURON is Poland's second-largest energy supplier and is shifting away from coal.

sources.title: TAURON acquires project rights wind farm in Poland from VSB Group

title: Dandelion Energy raises $40 million Series C led by GV for geothermal heat pump expansion
summary: Home geothermal company Dandelion Energy has closed a $40 million Series C funding round led by GV, with participation from Collaborative Fund, LenX, Breakthrough Energy Ventures and NGP. The money will support the US company's expansion across the country.
details: A Series C is a later-stage round in which a growing startup sells shares to investors for cash. Dandelion plans to use the funds in two ways: selling its geothermal heat pumps to installers and homeowners, and running large installation projects for production home builders and multifamily developers. Geothermal heat pumps heat and cool buildings by exchanging heat with the ground. The round follows a $70 million Series B1 completed in 2022. No stake size or valuation was disclosed.
context: The company says large home builders and apartment developers are increasingly turning to it as they move to fully electric buildings, with projects ranging from developments of over a thousand homes to buildings with hundreds of units. GV, a repeat investor, describes geothermal as the cheapest and highest quality heating and cooling option for builders, a claim made by the investor. Dandelion also points to its recently launched Dandelion Geo heat pump, which it says achieved record heating performance in AHRI testing.

sources.title: Dandelion Energy Closes $40M Series C Funding Round to Expand Geothermal Offerings Nationwide

title: CDPQ agrees to buy Brookfield's 25% stake in UK pumped hydro operator First Hydro
summary: Canadian investment group CDPQ has agreed to acquire the 25% stake in First Hydro Company held by Brookfield and its institutional partners. First Hydro runs two pumped hydro plants in Wales with more than 2,000 MW of capacity. Engie keeps the other 75%.
details: First Hydro manages the Dinorwig and Ffestiniog power stations in the Snowdonia region of Wales. These are pumped hydro storage plants, which pump water uphill when power is plentiful and release it through turbines when power is needed, acting like a large battery. The release says the plants account for 76% of the UK's pumped hydro storage capacity. No price was disclosed. Financial close, meaning the point when the deal is completed, is expected by the end of 2024, subject to usual conditions and approvals.
context: CDPQ says this is its first investment in pumped hydro storage and that it joins Engie, a long-standing partner, as co-owner. The parties describe the asset as important for the grid flexibility and stability the UK needs as it moves toward net zero. For Brookfield, the sale marks an exit after a period of ownership in which it says it helped secure the business's long-term future.

sources.title: CDPQ acquires 25% of UK's First Hydro Company from Brookfield

title: Zelestra closes €132 million for 435 MW Gorbea solar in India
summary: Zelestra closed a €132 million (about US$147 million) rupee-denominated green project financing with HSBC, Crédit Agricole, MUFG and Bank of America for its 435 MW Gorbea solar plant in India.
details: Zelestra signed a €132 million (about US$146.67 million) green financing with HSBC, Crédit Agricole, MUFG and Bank of America for its 435 MW Gorbea solar plant in Rajasthan, which will sell power to SECI for 25 years.
context: The loan follows the Loan Market Association's Green Loan Principles. Zelestra India has 1.5 GW operating, under construction, signed or awarded, and a pipeline of close to 5 GW.

sources.title: Zelestra bags $146.67m financing for Indian solar plant

title: Ammper Power signs 50 MW solar PPA in Texas
summary: Texas electricity retailer Ammper Power has signed a power purchase agreement for 50 MW of solar output from a project in Texas. The company plans to resell the power to commercial, industrial and government customers in the state.
details: A power purchase agreement (PPA) is a long-term contract to buy electricity from a specific generating project. The solar project, whose name and developer were not disclosed, is expected to start commercial operation in the fourth quarter of 2025. The 50 MW figure refers to alternating current capacity. Contract length, price and financial terms were not stated.
